title: File Download Using ProtocolHandler.exe

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects usage of the Get-ADUser cmdlet to collect user information and output it to a file
falsepositives: Legitimate admin scripts may use the same technique, it's better to exclude specific computers or users who execute these commands or scripts often
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%Get-ADUser %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -Filter *%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% > %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% | Select %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Out-File%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Set-Content%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Add-Content%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: User Discovery And Export Via Get-ADUser Cmdlet

author: James Pemberton / @4A616D6573
description: Detects the use of various web request commands with commandline tools and Windows PowerShell cmdlets (including aliases) via PowerShell scriptblock logs
falsepositives: Use of Get-Command and Get-Help modules to reference Invoke-WebRequest and Start-BitsTransfer.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ((ScriptBlockText LIKE '%[System.Net.WebRequest]::create%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%curl %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Invoke-RestMethod%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Invoke-WebRequest%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '% irm %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%iwr %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Resume-BitsTransfer%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Start-BitsTransfer%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%wget %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%WinHttp.WinHttpRequest%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((Path LIKE 'C:\\Packages\\Plugins\\Microsoft.GuestConfiguration.ConfigurationforWindows\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Usage Of Web Request Commands And Cmdlets - ScriptBlock

author: frack113
description: Detect use of X509Enrollment
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%X509Enrollment.CBinaryConverter%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%884e2002-217d-11da-b2a4-000e7bbb2b09%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Suspicious X509Enrollment - Process Creation

author: Joseph Kamau
description: Detects when a browser process or browser tab is launched from an application that handles document files such as Adobe, Microsoft Office, etc. And connects to a web application over http(s), this could indicate a possible phishing attempt.
falsepositives: Unlikely in most cases, further investigation should be done in the commandline of the browser process to determine the context of the URL accessed.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((ParentProcessName LIKE '%Acrobat Reader%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%Microsoft Office%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%PDF Reader%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\brave.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\chrome.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\firefox.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\msedge.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\opera.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\maxthon.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\seamonkey.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\vivaldi.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%http%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/%' ESCAPE '\'), 0)) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%http://ad.foxitsoftware.com/adlog.php_%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%https://globe-map.foxitservice.com/go.php_do=redirect%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Potential Suspicious Browser Launch From Document Reader Process

author: Timur Zinniatullin, oscd.community
description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via RUNDLL LAUNCHER
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='System' AND (Provider_Name='Service Control Manager' AND EventID=7045 AND (ImagePath LIKE '%rundll32.exe%' ESCAPE '\' AND ImagePath LIKE '%shell32.dll%' ESCAPE '\' AND ImagePath LIKE '%shellexec\_rundll%' ESCAPE '\' AND ImagePath LIKE '%powershell%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Invoke-Obfuscation RUNDLL LAUNCHER - System

author: Elastic, Josh Nickels, Marius Rothenbücher
description: Detects the modification of Group Policy Objects (GPO) to add a startup/logon script to users or computer objects.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=5136 OR EventID=5145) AND ((((AttributeLDAPDisplayName='gPCMachineExtensionNames' OR AttributeLDAPDisplayName='gPCUserExtensionNames') AND AttributeValue LIKE '%42B5FAAE-6536-11D2-AE5A-0000F87571E3%' ESCAPE '\') AND (AttributeValue LIKE '%40B6664F-4972-11D1-A7CA-0000F87571E3%' ESCAPE '\' OR AttributeValue LIKE '%40B66650-4972-11D1-A7CA-0000F87571E3%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (ShareName LIKE '%\\SYSVOL' ESCAPE '\' AND (RelativeTargetName LIKE '%\\scripts.ini' ESCAPE '\' OR RelativeTargetName LIKE '%\\psscripts.ini' ESCAPE '\') AND AccessList LIKE '%\%\%4417%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Startup/Logon Script Added to Group Policy Object

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects suspicious execution of "PDQDeployRunner" which is part of the PDQDeploy service stack that is responsible for executing commands and packages on a remote machines
falsepositives: Legitimate use of the PDQDeploy tool to execute these commands
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\PDQDeployRunner-%' ESCAPE '\' AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\bash.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\certutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\csc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\dllhost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\msiexec.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\scriptrunner.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wmic.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wsl.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (NewProcessName LIKE '%:\\ProgramData\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%:\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%:\\Windows\\TEMP\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% -decode %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -enc %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -encodedcommand %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -w hidden%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%DownloadString%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%FromBase64String%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%http%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%iex %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Invoke-%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Potentially Suspicious Execution Of PDQDeployRunner

author: Zach Mathis
description: Detects when the password policy is enumerated.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4661 AND AccessList LIKE '%\%\%5392%' ESCAPE '\' AND ObjectServer='Security Account Manager')
title: Password Policy Enumerated

author: Tim Rauch, Elastic (idea)
description: Detects attempts to disable the Windows Firewall using PowerShell
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell\_ise.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Set-NetFirewallProfile %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -Enabled %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% False%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -All %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Public%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Domain%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Private%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Windows Firewall Disabled via PowerShell

author: Joseliyo Sanchez, @Joseliyo_Jstnk
description:
Detects a CodePage modification using the "mode.com" utility to Russian language.
This behavior has been used by threat actors behind Dharma ransomware.
falsepositives: Russian speaking people changing the CodePage
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\mode.com' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='MODE.COM') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '% con %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% cp %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% select=%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%=1251' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%=866' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: CodePage Modification Via MODE.COM To Russian Language

author: Christian Burkard (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the Setting of Windows Defender Exclusions
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Microsoft-Windows-Windows Defender/Operational' AND (EventID=5007 AND NewValue LIKE '%\\Microsoft\\Windows Defender\\Exclusions%' ESCAPE '\')
title: Windows Defender Exclusions Added

author: Christian Burkard (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects potential evasion or obfuscation attempts using bogus path traversal via the commandline
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\Windows\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\..\\Windows\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\..\\System32\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\..\\..\\%' ESCAPE '\')) OR CommandLine LIKE '%.exe\\..\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%\\Google\\Drive\\googledrivesync.exe\\..\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Citrix\\Virtual Smart Card\\Citrix.Authentication.VirtualSmartcard.Launcher.exe\\..\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Potential Command Line Path Traversal Evasion Attempt

author: Roberto Rodriguez @Cyb3rWard0g
description: Detects non-system users failing to get a handle of the SCM database.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4656 AND ObjectType LIKE 'SC\_MANAGER OBJECT' ESCAPE '\' AND ObjectName='ServicesActive' AND AccessMask='0xf003f') AND (NOT COALESCE((SubjectLogonId='0x3e4'), 0)))
title: SCM Database Handle Failure

author: Micah Babinski
description: Detects possible execution via LNK file accessed on a WebDAV server.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\explorer.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\DavWWWRoot\\%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Potentially Suspicious WebDAV LNK Execution

author: frack113
description: An adversary may use legitimate desktop support and remote access software,to establish an interactive command and control channel to target systems within networks
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (Description='VNCViewer' OR Product='UltraVNC VNCViewer' OR Company='UltraVNC' OR OriginalFileName='VNCViewer.exe'))
title: Use of UltraVNC Remote Access Software

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects potentially suspicious child processes of WinRAR.exe.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\WinRAR.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='Cmd.Exe' OR OriginalFileName='cscript.exe' OR OriginalFileName='mshta.exe' OR OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll' OR OriginalFileName='regsvr32.exe' OR OriginalFileName='RUNDLL32.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='wscript.exe'))))
title: Potentially Suspicious Child Process Of WinRAR.EXE

author: Avneet Singh @v3t0_, oscd.community
description: Detects potential DLL injection and execution using "Tracker.exe"
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\tracker.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Description='Tracker') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% /d %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /c %' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '% /ERRORREPORT:PROMPT %' ESCAPE '\' OR (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\Msbuild\\Current\\Bin\\MSBuild.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\Msbuild\\Current\\Bin\\amd64\\MSBuild.exe' ESCAPE '\')), 0))))
title: Potential DLL Injection Or Execution Using Tracker.exe

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali
description: Detects the execution of WMIC in order to get a list of firewall and antivirus products
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wmic.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='wmic.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '%Product%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE(((CommandLine LIKE '% uninstall%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% install%' ESCAPE '\') OR CommandLine LIKE '%csproduct%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Potential Product Reconnaissance Via Wmic.EXE

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects usage of the "Add-WindowsCapability" cmdlet to add Windows capabilities. Notable capabilities could be "OpenSSH" and others.
falsepositives: Legitimate usage of the capabilities by administrators or users. Add additional filters accordingly.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Add-WindowsCapability %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Name OpenSSH.%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Add Windows Capability Via PowerShell Script

author: juju4, Jonhnathan Ribeiro, oscd.community
description: Detects suspicious process run from unusual locations
falsepositives: False positives depend on scripts and administrative tools used in the monitored environment
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%:\\RECYCLER\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%:\\SystemVolumeInformation\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR (NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\Tasks\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\debug\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\fonts\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\help\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\drivers\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\addins\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\cursors\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\system32\\tasks\\%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Suspicious Process Start Locations

author: Christopher Peacock @securepeacock, SCYTHE @scythe_io, TactiKoolSec
description: An attacker may execute an application as a SCR File using rundll32.exe desk.cpl,InstallScreenSaver
falsepositives: Legitimate installation of a new screensaver
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='RUNDLL32.EXE') AND CommandLine LIKE '%InstallScreenSaver%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Rundll32 InstallScreenSaver Execution

author: Agro (@agro_sev), Ensar Şamil (@sblmsrsn), oscd.community
description:
There is an option for a MS VS Just-In-Time Debugger "vsjitdebugger.exe" to launch specified executable and attach a debugger.
This option may be used adversaries to execute malicious code by signed verified binary.
The debugger is installed alongside with Microsoft Visual Studio package.
falsepositives: The process spawned by vsjitdebugger.exe is uncommon.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\vsjitdebugger.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\vsimmersiveactivatehelper%.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\devenv.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Malicious PE Execution by Microsoft Visual Studio Debugger

author: frack113
description: Detects technique used by MAZE ransomware to enumerate directories using Powershell
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%foreach%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-ChildItem%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Path %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-ErrorAction %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%SilentlyContinue%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Out-File %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-append%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Powershell Directory Enumeration

author: frack113
description: Ntvdm.exe allows the execution of 16-bit Windows applications on 32-bit Windows operating systems, as well as the execution of both 16-bit and 32-bit DOS applications
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\ntvdm.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\csrstub.exe' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Start of NT Virtual DOS Machine

author: CD_ROM_
description: Detects execution of "rundll32.exe" with a parent process of Explorer.exe. This has been observed by variants of Raspberry Robin, as first reported by Red Canary.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\explorer.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='RUNDLL32.EXE')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '% C:\\Windows\\System32\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -localserver 22d8c27b-47a1-48d1-ad08-7da7abd79617' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Rundll32 Spawned Via Explorer.EXE

author: Timur Zinniatullin, oscd.community
description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via COMPRESS OBFUSCATION
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='System' AND (Provider_Name='Service Control Manager' AND EventID=7045 AND (ImagePath LIKE '%new-object%' ESCAPE '\' AND ImagePath LIKE '%text.encoding]::ascii%' ESCAPE '\' AND ImagePath LIKE '%readtoend%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ImagePath LIKE '%:system.io.compression.deflatestream%' ESCAPE '\' OR ImagePath LIKE '%system.io.streamreader%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Invoke-Obfuscation COMPRESS OBFUSCATION - System

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects requests to exclude files, folders or processes from Antivirus scanning using PowerShell cmdlets
falsepositives: Other Cmdlets that may use the same parameters
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%Add-MpPreference %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Set-MpPreference %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -ExclusionPath %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -ExclusionExtension %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -ExclusionProcess %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -ExclusionIpAddress %' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Powershell Defender Exclusion

author: frack113, Tim Shelton (update fp)
description: Detects when a shell program such as the Windows command prompt or PowerShell is launched with system privileges from a uncommon parent location.
falsepositives: Some legitimate applications may spawn shells from uncommon parent locations. Apply additional filters and perform an initial baseline before deploying.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell\_ise.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName LIKE 'powershell\_ise.EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll' OR OriginalFileName='Cmd.Exe')) AND ((User LIKE '%AUTHORI%' ESCAPE '\' OR User LIKE '%AUTORI%' ESCAPE '\') AND SubjectLogonId='0x3e7')) AND (NOT COALESCE(((ParentProcessName LIKE '%:\\Program Files (x86)\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%:\\Program Files\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%:\\ProgramData\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%:\\Windows\\WinSxS\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR ParentProcessName IS NULL OR (ParentProcessName='' OR ParentProcessName='-')), 0)) AND (NOT COALESCE(((ParentProcessName LIKE '%:\\ManageEngine\\ADManager Plus\\pgsql\\bin\\postgres.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%:\\WINDOWS\\system32\\cmd.exe /c "%' ESCAPE '\' AND CurrentDirectory LIKE '%:\\WINDOWS\\Temp\\asgard2-agent\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR (ParentProcessName LIKE '%:\\IBM\\SpectrumProtect\\webserver\\scripts\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%:\\IBM\\SpectrumProtect\\webserver\\scripts\\%' ESCAPE '\')), 0))))
title: Elevated System Shell Spawned From Uncommon Parent Location

author: Roberto Rodriguez @Cyb3rWard0g
description: Detects potential abuse of Active Directory Replication Service (ADRS) from a non machine account to request credentials.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4662 AND (Properties LIKE '%1131f6ad-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2%' ESCAPE '\' OR Properties LIKE '%1131f6aa-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2%' ESCAPE '\' OR Properties LIKE '%9923a32a-3607-11d2-b9be-0000f87a36b2%' ESCAPE '\' OR Properties LIKE '%89e95b76-444d-4c62-991a-0facbeda640c%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((SubjectUserName LIKE '%$' ESCAPE '\'), 0)) AND (NOT COALESCE((SubjectDomainName='Window Manager' OR (SubjectUserName LIKE 'NT AUT%' ESCAPE '\' OR SubjectUserName LIKE 'MSOL\_%' ESCAPE '\')), 0)))
title: Active Directory Replication from Non Machine Account - DcSync Indicator

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel
description:
Detects usage of the "ms-appinstaller" protocol handler via command line to potentially download arbitrary files via AppInstaller.EXE
The downloaded files are temporarly stored in ":\Users\%username%\AppData\Local\Packages\Microsoft.DesktopAppInstaller_8wekyb3d8bbwe\AC\INetCache\<RANDOM-8-CHAR-DIRECTORY>"
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%ms-appinstaller://_source=%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%http%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Potential File Download Via MS-AppInstaller Protocol Handler

author: frack113
description: Download and compress a remote file and store it in a cab file on local machine.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%diantz.exe%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% \\\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.cab%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Suspicious Diantz Download and Compress Into a CAB File

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: The "VSIISExeLauncher.exe" binary part of the Visual Studio/VS Code can be used to execute arbitrary binaries
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\VSIISExeLauncher.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='VSIISExeLauncher.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -p %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -a %' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Use of VSIISExeLauncher.exe

author: frack113, Nasreddine Bencherchali
description: Detects code execution via Pester.bat (Pester - Powershell Modulte for testing)
falsepositives: Legitimate use of Pester for writing tests for Powershell scripts and modules
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%\\WindowsPowerShell\\Modules\\Pester\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ParentCommandLine LIKE '%{ Invoke-Pester -EnableExit ;%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '%{ Get-Help "%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Execute Code with Pester.bat as Parent

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects installation of a potentially suspicious new shim with an uncommon extension using sdbinst.exe.
Adversaries may establish persistence and/or elevate privileges by executing malicious content triggered by application shims
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\sdbinst.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='sdbinst.exe') AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%.sdb%' ESCAPE '\' OR ((CommandLine LIKE '% -c' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -f' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -mm' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -t' ESCAPE '\') OR CommandLine LIKE '% -m -bg%' ESCAPE '\') OR CommandLine IS NULL OR CommandLine=''), 0))))
title: Uncommon Extension Shim Database Installation Via Sdbinst.EXE

author: Victor Sergeev, Daniil Yugoslavskiy, Gleb Sukhodolskiy, Timur Zinniatullin, oscd.community, Tim Shelton, frack113 (split)
description: Detects modification of autostart extensibility point (ASEP) in registry.
falsepositives: Legitimate software automatically (mostly, during installation) sets up autorun keys for legitimate reason
Legitimate administrator sets up autorun keys for legitimate reason
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\Software\\Wow6432Node\\Classes%' ESCAPE '\' AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\Folder\\ShellEx\\ExtShellFolderViews%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\Folder\\ShellEx\\DragDropHandlers%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\Folder\\ShellEx\\ColumnHandlers%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\Directory\\Shellex\\DragDropHandlers%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\Directory\\Shellex\\CopyHookHandlers%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\CLSID\\{AC757296-3522-4E11-9862-C17BE5A1767E}\\Instance%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\CLSID\\{ABE3B9A4-257D-4B97-BD1A-294AF496222E}\\Instance%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\CLSID\\{7ED96837-96F0-4812-B211-F13C24117ED3}\\Instance%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\CLSID\\{083863F1-70DE-11d0-BD40-00A0C911CE86}\\Instance%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\AllFileSystemObjects\\ShellEx\\DragDropHandlers%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\ShellEx\\PropertySheetHandlers%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\ShellEx\\ContextMenuHandlers%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((NewValue='(Empty)'), 0))))
title: Wow6432Node Classes Autorun Keys Modification

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Jonhnathan Ribeiro, oscd.community, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the execution of certutil with certain flags that allow the utility to download files.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\certutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='CertUtil.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%urlcache %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%verifyctl %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%URL %' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%http%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Suspicious Download Via Certutil.EXE

author: Nikita Nazarov, oscd.community, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects calls to WinAPI libraries from PowerShell scripts. Attackers can often leverage these APIs to avoid detection based on typical PowerShell function calls. Use this rule as a basis to hunt for interesting scripts.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Advapi32.dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%kernel32.dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%KernelBase.dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ntdll.dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%secur32.dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%user32.dll%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: WinAPI Library Calls Via PowerShell Scripts

author: Josh Nickels
description: Detects command line usage of "findstr" to search for the "passwords" keyword in a variety of different languages
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\findstr.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='FINDSTR.EXE') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%contraseña%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%hasło%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%heslo%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%parola%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%passe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%passw%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%senha%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%senord%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%密碼%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Potential Password Reconnaissance Via Findstr.EXE

author: Connor Martin, Nasreddine Bencherchali
description: Detects service installation of different remote access tools software. These software are often abused by threat actors to perform
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='System' AND (Provider_Name='Service Control Manager' AND (EventID=7045 OR EventID=7036) AND (ServiceName LIKE '%AmmyyAdmin%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceName LIKE '%Atera%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceName LIKE '%BASupportExpressSrvcUpdater%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceName LIKE '%BASupportExpressStandaloneService%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceName LIKE '%chromoting%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceName LIKE '%GoToAssist%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceName LIKE '%GoToMyPC%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceName LIKE '%jumpcloud%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceName LIKE '%LMIGuardianSvc%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceName LIKE '%LogMeIn%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceName LIKE '%monblanking%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceName LIKE '%Parsec%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceName LIKE '%RManService%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceName LIKE '%RPCPerformanceService%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceName LIKE '%RPCService%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceName LIKE '%SplashtopRemoteService%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceName LIKE '%SSUService%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceName LIKE '%TeamViewer%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceName LIKE '%TightVNC%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceName LIKE '%vncserver%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceName LIKE '%Zoho%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Remote Access Tool Services Have Been Installed - System

author: frack113
description: Detects the removal of a port or application rule in the Windows Firewall configuration using netsh
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\netsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='netsh.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%firewall%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%delete %' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE(((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\Dropbox.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%name=Dropbox%' ESCAPE '\') OR (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\instup.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%advfirewall firewall delete rule name="Avast Antivirus Admin Client"%' ESCAPE '\')), 0))))
title: Firewall Rule Deleted Via Netsh.EXE

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects execution of WinRAR in order to compress a file with a ".dmp"/".dump" extension, which could be a step in a process of dump file exfiltration.
falsepositives: Legitimate use of WinRAR with a command line in which ".dmp" or ".dump" appears accidentally
Legitimate use of WinRAR to compress WER ".dmp" files for troubleshooting
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\rar.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\winrar.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR Description='Command line RAR') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%.dmp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dump%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.hdmp%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Winrar Compressing Dump Files

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Jonhnathan Ribeiro, oscd.community
description: Detects a suspicious command line execution that includes an URL and AppData string in the command line parameters as used by several droppers (js/vbs > powershell)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%http%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%://%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\%AppData\%%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Command Line Execution with Suspicious URL and AppData Strings

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects suspicious powershell download cradle using nslookup. This cradle uses nslookup to extract payloads from DNS records
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\nslookup.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName LIKE '\\nslookup.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -q=txt %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -querytype=txt %' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Nslookup PowerShell Download Cradle - ProcessCreation

author: Andreas Braathen (mnemonic.io)
description:
Detects the setting of a registry inside the "\Shell\Open\Command" value with PowerShell classes from the "System.Security.Cryptography" namespace.
The PowerShell namespace "System.Security.Cryptography" provides classes for on-the-fly encryption and decryption.
These can be used for example in decrypting malicious payload for defense evasion.
falsepositives: Classes are legitimately used, but less so when e.g. parents with low prevalence or decryption of content in temporary folders.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\Shell\\Open\\Command%' ESCAPE '\' AND (NewValue LIKE '%powershell%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%pwsh%' ESCAPE '\') AND NewValue LIKE '%System.Security.Cryptography.%' ESCAPE '\' AND (NewValue LIKE '%.AesCryptoServiceProvider%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%.DESCryptoServiceProvider%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%.DSACryptoServiceProvider%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%.RC2CryptoServiceProvider%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%.Rijndael%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%.RSACryptoServiceProvider%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%.TripleDESCryptoServiceProvider%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Registry Set With Crypto-Classes From The "Cryptography" PowerShell Namespace

author: frack113
description: Detects registry modifications that disable internal tools or functions in explorer (malware like Agent Tesla uses this technique)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND ((TargetObject LIKE '%SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Policies\\Explorer\\NoLogOff' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Policies\\Explorer\\NoDesktop' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Policies\\Explorer\\NoRun' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Policies\\Explorer\\NoFind' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Policies\\Explorer\\NoControlPanel' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Policies\\Explorer\\NoFileMenu' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Policies\\Explorer\\NoClose' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Policies\\Explorer\\NoSetTaskbar' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Policies\\Explorer\\NoPropertiesMyDocuments' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Policies\\Explorer\\NoTrayContextMenu' ESCAPE '\') AND NewValue='DWORD (0x00000001)'))
title: Registry Explorer Policy Modification

author: Elastic, Josh Nickels, Marius Rothenbücher
description: Detects the first occurrence of a modification to Group Policy Object Attributes to add privileges to user accounts or use them to add users as local admins.
falsepositives: Users allowed to perform these modifications (user found in field SubjectUserName)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=5136 AND AttributeLDAPDisplayName='gPCMachineExtensionNames' AND (AttributeValue LIKE '%827D319E-6EAC-11D2-A4EA-00C04F79F83A%' ESCAPE '\' OR AttributeValue LIKE '%803E14A0-B4FB-11D0-A0D0-00A0C90F574B%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Group Policy Abuse for Privilege Addition

author: frack113
description: Adversaries may use to interact with a remote network share using Server Message Block (SMB). The adversary may then perform actions as the logged-on user.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-PSDrive%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-psprovider %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%filesystem%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-root %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%\\\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%$%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Suspicious New-PSDrive to Admin Share

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the use of a Microsoft signed script 'REGISTER_APP.VBS' to register a VSS/VDS Provider as a COM+ application.
falsepositives: Legitimate usage of the script. Always investigate what's being registered to confirm if it's benign
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\register\_app.vbs%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-register%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: REGISTER_APP.VBS Proxy Execution

author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects the creation of a scheduled task using schtasks.exe, potentially in combination with curl for downloading payloads and PowerShell for executing them.
This facilitates executing malicious payloads or connecting with C&C server persistently without dropping the malware sample on the host.
falsepositives: Legitimate use of schtasks for administrative purposes.
Automation scripts combining curl and PowerShell in controlled environments.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\schtasks.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -create %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /create %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –create %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —create %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―create %' ESCAPE '\')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%curl %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%http%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-o%' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%powershell%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Scheduled Task Creation with Curl and PowerShell Execution Combo

author: Roberto Rodriguez (Cyb3rWard0g), OTR (Open Threat Research), MSTIC
description:
This detection uses Windows security events to detect suspicious access attempts to the registry key values and sub-keys of Azure AD Health service agents (e.g AD FS).
Information from AD Health service agents can be used to potentially abuse some of the features provided by those services in the cloud (e.g. Federation).
This detection requires an access control entry (ACE) on the system access control list (SACL) of the following securable object: HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\ADHealthAgent.
Make sure you set the SACL to propagate to its sub-keys.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (((EventID=4656 OR EventID=4663) AND ObjectType='Key' AND ObjectName LIKE '\\REGISTRY\\MACHINE\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\ADHealthAgent' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((ProcessName LIKE '%Microsoft.Identity.Health.Adfs.DiagnosticsAgent.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE '%Microsoft.Identity.Health.Adfs.InsightsService.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE '%Microsoft.Identity.Health.Adfs.MonitoringAgent.Startup.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE '%Microsoft.Identity.Health.Adfs.PshSurrogate.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE '%Microsoft.Identity.Health.Common.Clients.ResourceMonitor.exe%' ESCAPE '\'), 0)))
title: Azure AD Health Service Agents Registry Keys Access

author: Andreas Braathen (mnemonic.io)
description: Detects exploitation attempt of CVE-2023-22518 (Confluence Data Center / Confluence Server), where an attacker can exploit vulnerable endpoints to e.g. create admin accounts and execute arbitrary commands.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\tomcat8.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\tomcat9.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\tomcat10.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%confluence%' ESCAPE '\') AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='Cmd.Exe' OR OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE'))))
title: CVE-2023-22518 Exploitation Attempt - Suspicious Confluence Child Process (Windows)

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects execution of "Diskshadow.exe" in script mode to execute an script with a potentially uncommon extension.
Initial baselining of the allowed extension list is required.
falsepositives: False postitve might occur with legitimate or uncommon extensions used internally. Initial baseline is required.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((OriginalFileName='diskshadow.exe' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\diskshadow.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-s %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/s %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–s %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—s %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―s %' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%.txt%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Diskshadow Script Mode - Uncommon Script Extension Execution

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), oscd.community, Natalia Shornikova, frack113
description: Detects the use of the Microsoft signed script "CL_mutexverifiers" to proxy the execution of additional PowerShell script commands
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -nologo -windowstyle minimized -file %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Potential Script Proxy Execution Via CL_Mutexverifiers.ps1

author: Michael Haag
description: Detects script file execution (.js, .jse, .vba, .vbe, .vbs, .wsf, .wsh) by Wscript/Cscript.
falsepositives: Some additional tuning is required. It is recommended to add the user profile path in CommandLine if it is getting too noisy.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((OriginalFileName='wscript.exe' OR OriginalFileName='cscript.exe') OR (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%.js%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.jse%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.vba%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.vbe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.vbs%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.wsf%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.wsh%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: WSF/JSE/JS/VBA/VBE File Execution Via Cscript/Wscript

author: Teymur Kheirkhabarov (idea), Mangatas Tondang (rule), oscd.community
description: Detects Windows Installer service (msiexec.exe) spawning "cmd" or "powershell"
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='Cmd.Exe' OR OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\Windows\\Installer\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentProcessName LIKE '%msi%' ESCAPE '\') AND ParentProcessName LIKE '%tmp' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Always Install Elevated MSI Spawned Cmd And Powershell

author: frack113
description: Detects the execution of the LOLBIN gpscript, which executes logon or startup scripts configured in Group Policy
falsepositives: Legitimate uses of logon scripts distributed via group policy
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\gpscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='GPSCRIPT.EXE') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% /logon%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /startup%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentCommandLine LIKE 'C:\\windows\\system32\\svchost.exe -k netsvcs -p -s gpsvc' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Gpscript Execution

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), Karneades / Markus Neis, Jonhnathan Ribeiro, oscd.community
description: Detects the usage of the "Squirrel.exe" to download arbitrary files. This binary is part of multiple Electron based software installations (Slack, Teams, Discord, etc.)
falsepositives: Expected FP with some Electron based applications such as (1Clipboard, Beaker Browser, Caret, Discord, GitHub Desktop, etc.)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\squirrel.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\update.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% --download %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --update %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --updateRollback=%' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%http%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Arbitrary File Download Via Squirrel.EXE

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects calls to PowerShell with Invoke-WebRequest cmdlet using direct IP access
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell\_ise.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName LIKE 'powershell\_ise.EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%curl %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Invoke-RestMethod%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Invoke-WebRequest%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% irm %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%iwr %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%wget %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%://1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%://2%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%://3%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%://4%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%://5%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%://6%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%://7%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%://8%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%://9%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Suspicious Invoke-WebRequest Execution With DirectIP

author: Markus Neis, keepwatch
description: Detects service principal name (SPN) enumeration used for Kerberoasting
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\setspn.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='setspn.exe' OR (Description LIKE '%Query or reset the computer%' ESCAPE '\' AND Description LIKE '%SPN attribute%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -q %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /q %' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Potential SPN Enumeration Via Setspn.EXE

author: frack113
description:
Detects the execution of "ConfigSecurityPolicy.EXE", a binary part of Windows Defender used to manage settings in Windows Defender.
Users can configure different pilot collections for each of the co-management workloads.
It can be abused by attackers in order to upload or download files.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%ConfigSecurityPolicy.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\ConfigSecurityPolicy.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='ConfigSecurityPolicy.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%ftp://%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%http://%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%https://%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Arbitrary File Download Via ConfigSecurityPolicy.EXE

author: Frack113
description: Detects registry modifications that add Windows Filtering Platform (WFP) filters, which may be used to block security tools and EDR agents from reporting events.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\BFE\\Parameters\\Policy\\Persistent\\Filter\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\svchost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\svchost.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: WFP Filter Added via Registry

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Perez Diego (@darkquassar), Tuan Le (NCSGroup)
description: Detects potentially suspicious keywords that could indicate the use of a PowerShell exploitation framework
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%System.Reflection.Assembly.Load($%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%[System.Reflection.Assembly]::Load($%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%[Reflection.Assembly]::Load($%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%System.Reflection.AssemblyName%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Reflection.Emit.AssemblyBuilderAccess%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Reflection.Emit.CustomAttributeBuilder%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Runtime.InteropServices.UnmanagedType%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Runtime.InteropServices.DllImportAttribute%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%SuspendThread%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%rundll32%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Potential Suspicious PowerShell Keywords

author: frack113
description: Enumerates Active Directory to determine computers that are joined to the domain
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-Object %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%System.DirectoryServices.DirectorySearcher%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.PropertiesToLoad.Add%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.findall()%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Properties.name%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: DirectorySearcher Powershell Exploitation

author: frack113
description: Detects the use of the 'Pubprn.vbs' Microsoft signed script to execute commands.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\pubprn.vbs%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%script:%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Pubprn.vbs Proxy Execution

author: frack113 , X__Junior (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects execution of the "del" builtin command to remove files using greedy/wildcard expression. This is often used by malware to delete content of folders that perhaps contains the initial malware infection or to delete evidence.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='Cmd.Exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%del %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%erase %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\*.au3%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\*.dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\*.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\*.js%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Greedy File Deletion Using Del

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects execution of ruby using the "-e" flag. This is could be used as a way to launch a reverse shell or execute live ruby code.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\ruby.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='ruby.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '% -e%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Ruby Inline Command Execution

author: Timur Zinniatullin, oscd.community
description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via COMPRESS OBFUSCATION
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ((ScriptBlockText LIKE '%new-object%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%text.encoding]::ascii%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%system.io.compression.deflatestream%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%system.io.streamreader%' ESCAPE '\') AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%readtoend' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Invoke-Obfuscation COMPRESS OBFUSCATION - PowerShell

author: frack113, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Adversaries may search for private key certificate files on compromised systems for insecurely stored credential
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%.key%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.pgp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.gpg%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.ppk%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.p12%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.pem%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.pfx%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.cer%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.p7b%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.asc%' ESCAPE '\') AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='Cmd.Exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '%dir %' ESCAPE '\') OR (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND CommandLine LIKE '%Get-ChildItem %' ESCAPE '\') OR (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\findstr.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='FINDSTR.EXE'))))
title: Private Keys Reconnaissance Via CommandLine Tools

author: Tim Rauch, Elastic (idea)
description: Detects the desktopimgdownldr utility being used to download a remote file. An adversary may use desktopimgdownldr to download arbitrary files as an alternative to certutil.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\desktopimgdownldr.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\desktopimgdownldr.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/lockscreenurl:http%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Remote File Download Via Desktopimgdownldr Utility

author: OTR (Open Threat Research)
description: Detects the use of the spoolss named pipe over SMB. This can be used to trigger the authentication via NTLM of any machine that has the spoolservice enabled.
falsepositives: Domain Controllers acting as printer servers too? :)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=5145 AND ShareName LIKE '\\\\*\\IPC$' ESCAPE '\' AND RelativeTargetName='spoolss')
title: DCERPC SMB Spoolss Named Pipe

author: Beyu Denis, oscd.community
description: Detects execution of Windows Problem Steps Recorder (psr.exe), a utility used to record the user screen and clicks.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\Psr.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/start%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-start%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Screen Capture Activity Via Psr.EXE

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects powershell scripts that import modules from suspicious directories
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Import-Module "$Env:Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Import-Module ''$Env:Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Import-Module $Env:Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Import-Module "$Env:Appdata\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Import-Module ''$Env:Appdata\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Import-Module $Env:Appdata\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Import-Module C:\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ipmo "$Env:Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ipmo ''$Env:Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ipmo $Env:Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ipmo "$Env:Appdata\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ipmo ''$Env:Appdata\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ipmo $Env:Appdata\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ipmo C:\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Import PowerShell Modules From Suspicious Directories

author: frack113
description:
Detects the execution of "wmic" with the "process" flag, which might indicate an attempt to perform reconnaissance on running processes.
Adversaries may use wmic to query for running processes and their details as part of their reconnaissance efforts.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\WMIC.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='wmic.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '%process%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE(((CommandLine LIKE '%call%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%create%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%call%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%terminate%' ESCAPE '\')), 0))))
title: Potential Process Reconnaissance via Wmic.EXE

author: Meroujan Antonyan (vx3r)
description:
Detects the execution of PowerShell commands that attempt to install MSI packages via the
Windows Installer COM object (`WindowsInstaller.Installer`) hosted remotely.
This could be indication of malicious software deployment or lateral movement attempts using Windows Installer functionality.
And the usage of WindowsInstaller COM object rather than msiexec could be an attempt to bypass the detection.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell\_ise.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName LIKE 'PowerShell\_ISE.EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-ComObject%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%InstallProduct(%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%http%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\\\%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%://127.0.0.1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%://localhost%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: PowerShell MSI Install via WindowsInstaller COM From Remote Location

author: frack113
description: Detects the mounting of Windows SMB shares over QUIC, which can be an unexpected event in some enterprise environments.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\net.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\net1.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='net.exe' OR OriginalFileName='net1.exe')) AND CommandLine LIKE '%/TRANSPORT:QUIC%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: SMB over QUIC Via Net.EXE

author: @juju4
description: Detects potential RDP Session Hijacking activity on Windows systems
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\tscon.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='tscon.exe') AND (IntegrityLevel='System' OR IntegrityLevel='S-1-16-16384')))
title: Potential RDP Session Hijacking Activity

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects uncommon or suspicious child processes spawning from a WSL process. This could indicate an attempt to evade parent/child relationship detections or persistence attempts via cron using WSL
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\wsl.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\wslhost.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\calc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%C:\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%C:\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%C:\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\Downloads\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\Desktop\\%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: WSL Child Process Anomaly

author: frack113
description:
Adversaries may leverage the COR_PROFILER environment variable to hijack the execution flow of programs that load the .NET CLR.
The COR_PROFILER is a .NET Framework feature which allows developers to specify an unmanaged (or external of .NET) profiling DLL to be loaded into each .NET process that loads the Common Language Runtime (CLR).
These profiliers are designed to monitor, troubleshoot, and debug managed code executed by the .NET CLR.
(Citation: Microsoft Profiling Mar 2017)
(Citation: Microsoft COR_PROFILER Feb 2013)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%$env:COR\_ENABLE\_PROFILING%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%$env:COR\_PROFILER%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%$env:COR\_PROFILER\_PATH%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Registry-Free Process Scope COR_PROFILER

author: Kirill Kiryanov, oscd.community
description: Detects process dump via legitimate sqldumper.exe binary
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\sqldumper.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%0x0110%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%0x01100:40%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Dumping Process via Sqldumper.exe

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects child processes of "dfsvc" which indicates a ClickOnce deployment execution.
falsepositives: False positives are expected in environement leveraging ClickOnce deployments. An initial baselining is required before using this rule in production.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\dfsvc.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Apps\\2.0\\' ESCAPE '\'))
title: ClickOnce Deployment Execution - Dfsvc.EXE Child Process

author: frack113, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detect the use of "<" to read and potentially execute a file via cmd.exe
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((OriginalFileName='Cmd.Exe' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%<%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Read Contents From Stdin Via Cmd.EXE

author: Austin Songer @austinsonger
description: Detects when a user installs certificates by using CertOC.exe to loads the target DLL file.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\certoc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='CertOC.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -LoadDLL %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /LoadDLL %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –LoadDLL %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —LoadDLL %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―LoadDLL %' ESCAPE '\')))
title: DLL Loaded via CertOC.EXE

author: Victor Sergeev, Daniil Yugoslavskiy, oscd.community, Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects direct modification of autostart extensibility point (ASEP) in registry using reg.exe.
falsepositives: Legitimate software automatically (mostly, during installation) sets up autorun keys for legitimate reasons.
Legitimate administrator sets up autorun keys for legitimate reasons.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='reg.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '%add%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\software\\WOW6432Node\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Policies\\Explorer\\Run%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\software\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Winlogon\\Userinit%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\software\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Winlogon\\Shell%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\software\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Windows%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\system\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\SafeBoot\\AlternateShell%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Direct Autorun Keys Modification

author: @ROxPinTeddy
description: Detects creation of a local user via PowerShell
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-LocalUser%' ESCAPE '\')
title: PowerShell Create Local User

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), X__Junior (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects the execution of a Word document via the WinWord Start Menu shortcut.
This behavior was observed being used by KamiKakaBot samples in order to initiate the 2nd stage of the infection.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/c %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.lnk ~%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%Start Menu\\Programs\\Word%' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%.doc' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Potential KamiKakaBot Activity - Lure Document Execution

author: Sreeman
description: The .SettingContent-ms file type was introduced in Windows 10 and allows a user to create "shortcuts" to various Windows 10 setting pages. These files are simply XML and contain paths to various Windows 10 settings binaries.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%.SettingContent-ms%' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%immersivecontrolpanel%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Arbitrary Shell Command Execution Via Settingcontent-Ms

author: Micah Babinski (@micahbabinski), Zach Mathis (@yamatosecurity)
description: Detects successful logon from public IP address via RDP. This can indicate a publicly-exposed RDP port.
falsepositives: Legitimate or intentional inbound connections from public IP addresses on the RDP port.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4624 AND LogonType=10) AND (NOT COALESCE(((IpAddress='::1' OR IpAddress LIKE '10.%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE '127.%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE '172.16.%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE '172.17.%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE '172.18.%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE '172.19.%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE '172.20.%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE '172.21.%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE '172.22.%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE '172.23.%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE '172.24.%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE '172.25.%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE '172.26.%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE '172.27.%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE '172.28.%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE '172.29.%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE '172.30.%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE '172.31.%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE '192.168.%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE '169.254.%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE 'fc%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE 'fd%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE 'fe8%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE 'fe9%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE 'fea%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE 'feb%' ESCAPE '\') OR IpAddress='-'), 0)))
title: External Remote RDP Logon from Public IP

author: Thomas Patzke, @atc_project (improvements)
description: An attacker can use the SID history attribute to gain additional privileges.
falsepositives: Migration of an account into a new domain
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4765 OR EventID=4766) OR (EventID=4738 AND (NOT COALESCE((SidHistory='-' OR SidHistory LIKE '\%\%1793' ESCAPE '\'), 0)) AND (NOT COALESCE((SidHistory IS NULL), 0))))
title: Addition of SID History to Active Directory Object

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects uncommon service installation commands by looking at suspicious or uncommon image path values containing references to encoded powershell commands, temporary paths, etc.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='System' AND ((Provider_Name='Service Control Manager' AND EventID=7045) AND ((ImagePath LIKE '%\\\\.\\pipe%' ESCAPE '\' OR ImagePath LIKE '%\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ImagePath LIKE '%\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR (ImagePath LIKE '% -e%' ESCAPE '\' AND (ImagePath LIKE '% aQBlAHgA%' ESCAPE '\' OR ImagePath LIKE '% aWV4I%' ESCAPE '\' OR ImagePath LIKE '% IAB%' ESCAPE '\' OR ImagePath LIKE '% JAB%' ESCAPE '\' OR ImagePath LIKE '% PAA%' ESCAPE '\' OR ImagePath LIKE '% SQBFAFgA%' ESCAPE '\' OR ImagePath LIKE '% SUVYI%' ESCAPE '\'))) AND (NOT COALESCE((ImagePath LIKE 'C:\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\Windows Defender\\Definition Updates\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0)) AND (NOT COALESCE((ImagePath LIKE 'C:\\WINDOWS\\TEMP\\thor10-remote\\thor64.exe%' ESCAPE '\'), 0)))
title: Uncommon Service Installation Image Path

author: Nikita Nazarov, oscd.community
description: Adversaries may attempt to enumerate software for a variety of reasons, such as figuring out what security measures are present or if the compromised system has a version of software that is vulnerable.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%get-itemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%\\software\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%select-object%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%format-table%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Detected Windows Software Discovery - PowerShell

author: Ilyas Ochkov, Jonhnathan Ribeiro, Daniil Yugoslavskiy, oscd.community
description: Detects keywords that could indicate clearing PowerShell history
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND (((ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-PSReadlineOption%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%–HistorySaveStyle%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%SaveNothing%' ESCAPE '\') OR (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-PSReadlineOption%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-HistorySaveStyle%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%SaveNothing%' ESCAPE '\')) OR ((ScriptBlockText LIKE '%del%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Remove-Item%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%rm%' ESCAPE '\') AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%(Get-PSReadlineOption).HistorySavePath%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Clear PowerShell History - PowerShell

author: frack113
description: Detect set DisallowRun to 1 to prevent user running specific computer program
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Policies\\Explorer\\DisallowRun' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue='DWORD (0x00000001)'))
title: Add DisallowRun Execution to Registry

author: Victor Sergeev, oscd.community
description: Detects the execution of a renamed "ftp.exe" binary based on the PE metadata fields
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (OriginalFileName='ftp.exe' AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\ftp.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Renamed FTP.EXE Execution

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects the setting of the "ImagePath" value of a service registry key to a path controlled by a non-administrator user such as "\AppData\" or "\ProgramData\".
Attackers often use such directories for staging purposes.
This rule might also trigger on badly written software, where if an attacker controls an auto starting service, they might achieve persistence or privilege escalation.
Note that while ProgramData is a user controlled folder, software might apply strict ACLs which makes them only accessible to admin users. Remove such folders via filters if you experience a lot of noise.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (((TargetObject LIKE '%ControlSet%' ESCAPE '\' AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\Services\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\ImagePath' ESCAPE '\' AND (NewValue LIKE '%:\\ProgramData\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%\\AppData\\Roaming\\%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE(((TargetObject LIKE '%\\Services\\WinDefend\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\Services\\MpKs%' ESCAPE '\') AND NewValue LIKE '%C:\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\Windows Defender\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0)) AND (NOT COALESCE(((TargetObject LIKE '%\\Services\\ZoomCptService%' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue LIKE '%C:\\Program Files\\Common Files\\Zoom\\Support\\CptService.exe%' ESCAPE '\') OR (TargetObject LIKE '%\\Services\\MBAMInstallerService%' ESCAPE '\' AND (NewValue LIKE '%C:\\Users\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue LIKE '%AppData\\Local\\Temp\\MBAMInstallerService.exe%' ESCAPE '\'))), 0))))
title: Service Binary in User Controlled Folder

author: Joseliyo Sanchez, @Joseliyo_Jstnk
description:
Detects suspicious usage of the cmd.exe 'for /f' loop combined with the 'tokens=' parameter and a recursive directory listing.
This pattern may indicate an attempt to discover and execute system binaries dynamically, for example powershell, a technique sometimes used by attackers to evade detection.
This behavior has been observed in various malicious lnk files.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%for /f%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%tokens=%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%in (%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%dir%' ESCAPE '\') OR (ParentCommandLine LIKE '%for /f%' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%tokens=%' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%in (%' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%dir%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Suspicious Usage of For Loop with Recursive Directory Search in CMD

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Samir Bousseaden
description: Detects potentially suspicious command line arguments of common data compression tools
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((OriginalFileName LIKE '7z%.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName LIKE '%rar.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName LIKE '%Command%Line%RAR%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -p%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -ta%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -tb%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -sdel%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -dw%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -hp%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentProcessName LIKE '%:\\Program Files\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%:\\Program Files (x86)\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Potentially Suspicious Compression Tool Parameters

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects execution of the Windows Kernel Debugger "kd.exe".
falsepositives: Rare occasions of legitimate cases where kernel debugging is necessary in production. Investigation is required
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\kd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='kd.exe'))
title: Windows Kernel Debugger Execution

author: frack113
description:
Adversaries may target user email on local systems to collect sensitive information.
Files containing email data can be acquired from a users local system, such as Outlook storage or cache files.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-Inbox.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Microsoft.Office.Interop.Outlook%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Microsoft.Office.Interop.Outlook.olDefaultFolders%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-comobject outlook.application%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Powershell Local Email Collection

author: Konstantin Grishchenko, oscd.community
description: setupapi.dll library provide InstallHinfSection function for processing INF files. INF file may contain instructions allowing to create values in the registry, modify files and install drivers. This technique could be used to obtain persistence via modifying one of Run or RunOnce registry keys, run process or use other DLLs chain calls (see references) InstallHinfSection function in setupapi.dll calls runonce.exe executable regardless of actual content of INF file.
falsepositives: Scripts and administrative tools that use INF files for driver installation with setupapi.dll
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\runonce.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (ParentCommandLine LIKE '%setupapi.dll%' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%InstallHinfSection%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Suspicious Rundll32 Setupapi.dll Activity

author: Austin Songer @austinsonger
description: Detects potential abuse of the "register_app.vbs" script that is part of the Windows SDK. The script offers the capability to register new VSS/VDS Provider as a COM+ application. Attackers can use this to install malicious DLLs for persistence and execution.
falsepositives: Other VB scripts that leverage the same starting command line flags
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='cscript.exe' OR OriginalFileName='wscript.exe')) AND CommandLine LIKE '%.vbs -register %' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Potential Register_App.Vbs LOLScript Abuse

author: Antonlovesdnb, Trent Liffick (@tliffick)
description: Alerts on trust record modification within the registry, indicating usage of macros
falsepositives: This will alert on legitimate macro usage as well, additional tuning is required
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND (OperationType='New registry value created' OR OperationType='Existing registry value modified')) AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\Security\\Trusted Documents\\TrustRecords%' ESCAPE '\')
title: Windows Registry Trust Record Modification

author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects attempts to modify the registry using VBScript's CreateObject("Wscript.shell") and RegWrite methods embedded within PowerShell scripts or commands.
Threat actors commonly embed VBScript code within PowerShell to perform registry modifications, attempting to evade detection that monitors for direct registry access through traditional tools.
This technique can be used for persistence, defense evasion, and privilege escalation by modifying registry keys without using regedit.exe, reg.exe, or PowerShell's native registry cmdlets.
falsepositives: Some legitimate admin or install scripts may use these processes for registry modifications.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%CreateObject%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Wscript.shell%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.RegWrite%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Registry Modification Attempt Via VBScript - PowerShell

author: Thomas Patzke
description: Detects execution of ntdsutil.exe, which can be used for various attacks against the NTDS database (NTDS.DIT)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\ntdsutil.exe' ESCAPE '\')
