title: Invocation of Active Directory Diagnostic Tool (ntdsutil.exe)

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects execution of "curl.exe" with the "insecure" flag over proxy or DOH.
falsepositives: Access to badly maintained internal or development systems
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\curl.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='curl.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%--doh-insecure%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%--proxy-insecure%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Insecure Proxy/DOH Transfer Via Curl.EXE

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the presence of the keywords "Wscript", "Shell" and "Run" in the command, which could indicate a suspicious activity
falsepositives: Inline scripting can be used by some rare third party applications or administrators. Investigate and apply additional filters accordingly
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Wscript.%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.Shell%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.Run%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Wscript Shell Run In CommandLine

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects execution of Microsoft bash launcher without any flags to execute the content of a bash script directly.
This can be used to potentially bypass defenses and execute Linux or Windows-based binaries directly via bash.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\bash.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\bash.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR OriginalFileName='Bash.exe') AND (NOT COALESCE(((CommandLine LIKE '%bash.exe -%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%bash -%' ESCAPE '\') OR CommandLine IS NULL OR CommandLine='' OR (CommandLine='bash.exe' OR CommandLine='bash')), 0))))
title: Indirect Command Execution From Script File Via Bash.EXE

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects NetSupport Manager service installation on the target system.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='System' AND ((Provider_Name='Service Control Manager' AND EventID=7045) AND (ImagePath LIKE '%\\NetSupport Manager\\client32.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceName='Client32'))
title: NetSupport Manager Service Install

author: Sittikorn S
description: Detects set value ms-msdt MSProtocol URI scheme in Registry that could be an attempt to exploit CVE-2022-30190.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND TargetObject LIKE 'HKCR\\ms-msdt\\%' ESCAPE '\')
title: Suspicious Set Value of MSDT in Registry (CVE-2022-30190)

author: Ahmed Nosir (@egycondor)
description:
Detects TacticalRMM agent installations where the --api, --auth, and related flags are used on the command line.
These parameters configure the agent to connect to a specific RMM server with authentication, client ID, and site ID.
This technique could indicate a threat actor attempting to register the agent with an attacker-controlled RMM infrastructure silently.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\TacticalAgent\\tacticalrmm.exe%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%--api%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%--auth%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%--client-id%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%--site-id%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%--agent-type%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Remote Access Tool - TacticalRMM Agent Registration to Potentially Attacker-Controlled Server

author: Roberto Rodriguez (Cyb3rWard0g), OTR (Open Threat Research)
description:
Detects "svchost.exe" spawning "rundll32.exe" with command arguments like "C:\windows\system32\davclnt.dll,DavSetCookie".
This could be an indicator of exfiltration or use of WebDav to launch code (hosted on a WebDav server).
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\svchost.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='RUNDLL32.EXE') AND CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\windows\\system32\\davclnt.dll,DavSetCookie%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: WebDav Client Execution Via Rundll32.EXE

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects usage of the SysInternals Procdump utility
falsepositives: Legitimate use of procdump by a developer or administrator
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\procdump.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\procdump64.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\procdump64a.exe' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Procdump Execution

author: Norbert Jaśniewicz (AlphaSOC)
description:
Detects potential execution of MeshAgent which is a tool used for remote access.
Historical data shows that threat actors rename MeshAgent binary to evade detection.
Matching command lines with the '--meshServiceName' argument can indicate that the MeshAgent is being used for remote access.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND CommandLine LIKE '%--meshServiceName%' ESCAPE '\')
title: Remote Access Tool - Potential MeshAgent Execution - Windows

author: Tobias Michalski (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects disabling the CrashDump per registry (as used by HermeticWiper)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\CrashControl%' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue='DWORD (0x00000000)'))
title: CrashControl CrashDump Disabled

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the installation of VsCode tunnel (code-tunnel) as a service.
falsepositives: Legitimate installation of code-tunnel as a service
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%tunnel %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%service%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%internal-run%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%tunnel-service.log%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Visual Studio Code Tunnel Service Installation

author: Matt Anderson (Huntress)
description: Detects the execution of a renamed BOINC binary.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (OriginalFileName='BOINC.exe' AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\BOINC.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Renamed BOINC Client Execution

author: frack113
description: Detects events that appear when a user click on a link file with a powershell command in it
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\explorer.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%powershell%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.lnk%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Hidden Powershell in Link File Pattern

author: Sreeman, Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), frack113
description:
Detects usage of winget to install applications via manifest file. Adversaries can abuse winget to download payloads remotely and execute them.
The manifest option enables you to install an application by passing in a YAML file directly to the client.
Winget can be used to download and install exe, msi or msix files later.
falsepositives: Some false positives are expected in some environment that may use this functionality to install and test their custom applications
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\winget.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='winget.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%install%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% add %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-m %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%--manifest%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Install New Package Via Winget Local Manifest

author: frack113, Tim Shelton (fp AWS)
description:
Adversaries may use hidden windows to conceal malicious activity from the plain sight of users.
In some cases, windows that would typically be displayed when an application carries out an operation can be hidden
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ((ScriptBlockText LIKE '%powershell%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%WindowStyle%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Hidden%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((ScriptBlockText LIKE '%:\\Program Files\\Amazon\\WorkSpacesConfig\\Scripts\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%$PSScriptRoot\\Module\\WorkspaceScriptModule\\WorkspaceScriptModule%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Suspicious PowerShell WindowStyle Option

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), omkar72, oscd.community, Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel
description: Detects the execution of netsh commands that configure a new port forwarding (PortProxy) rule
falsepositives: WSL2 network bridge PowerShell script used for WSL/Kubernetes/Docker (e.g. https://github.com/microsoft/WSL/issues/4150#issuecomment-504209723)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\netsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='netsh.exe') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%interface%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%portproxy%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%add%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%v4tov4%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%i %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%p %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%a %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%v %' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%connectp%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%listena%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%c=%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: New Port Forwarding Rule Added Via Netsh.EXE

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects port forwarding activity via SSH.exe
falsepositives: Administrative activity using a remote port forwarding to a local port
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\ssh.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -R %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /R %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –R %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —R %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―R %' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Port Forwarding Activity Via SSH.EXE

author: frack113
description: Detects execution of curl.exe with custom useragent options
falsepositives: Scripts created by developers and admins
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\curl.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Product='The curl executable') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -A %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --user-agent %' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Curl.EXE Execution With Custom UserAgent

author: Ilyas Ochkov, oscd.community, Chakib Gzenayi (@Chak092), Hosni Mribah
description: Detects DCShadow via create new SPN
falsepositives: Valid on domain controllers; exclude known DCs
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4742 AND ServicePrincipalNames LIKE '%GC/%' ESCAPE '\') OR (EventID=5136 AND AttributeLDAPDisplayName='servicePrincipalName' AND AttributeValue LIKE 'GC/%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Possible DC Shadow Attack

author: Micah Babinski, @micahbabinski
description:
Detects the presence of unicode characters which are homoglyphs, or identical in appearance, to ASCII letter characters.
This is used as an obfuscation and masquerading techniques. Only "perfect" homoglyphs are included; these are characters that
are indistinguishable from ASCII characters and thus may make excellent candidates for homoglyph attack characters.
falsepositives: Commandlines with legitimate Cyrillic text; will likely require tuning (or not be usable) in countries where these alphabets are in use.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%А%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%В%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Е%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%К%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%М%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Н%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%О%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Р%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%С%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Т%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Х%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Ѕ%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%І%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Ј%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Ү%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Ӏ%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Ԍ%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Ԛ%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Ԝ%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Α%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Β%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Ε%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Ζ%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Η%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Ι%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Κ%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Μ%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Ν%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Ο%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Ρ%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Τ%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Υ%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Χ%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%а%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%е%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%о%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%р%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%с%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%х%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ѕ%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%і%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ӏ%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ј%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%һ%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ԁ%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ԛ%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ԝ%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ο%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Potential Homoglyph Attack Using Lookalike Characters

author: Trent Liffick
description: Detects usage of findstr to identify and execute a lnk file as seen within the HHS redirect attack
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\find.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\findstr.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='FIND.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='FINDSTR.EXE')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%.lnk' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.lnk"' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.lnk''' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Findstr Launching .lnk File

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects usage of Sysinternals PsService which can be abused for service reconnaissance and tampering
falsepositives: Legitimate use of PsService by an administrator
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (OriginalFileName='psservice.exe' OR (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\PsService.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\PsService64.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\PsService64a.exe' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Sysinternals PsService Execution

author: frack113
description: Detects suspicious execution of 'Msbuild.exe' by a uncommon parent process
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\MSBuild.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='MSBuild.exe') AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\devenv.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\msbuild.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\python.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\explorer.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\nuget.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Suspicious Msbuild Execution By Uncommon Parent Process

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects when an attacker adds a new AMSI provider via the Windows Registry to bypass AMSI (Antimalware Scan Interface) protections.
Attackers may add custom AMSI providers to persist on the system and evade detection by security software that relies on AMSI for scanning scripts and other content.
This technique is often used in conjunction with fileless malware and script-based attacks to maintain persistence while avoiding detection.
falsepositives: Legitimate security products adding their own AMSI providers. Filter these according to your environment.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND ((TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\AMSI\\Providers\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\WOW6432Node\\Microsoft\\AMSI\\Providers\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((((NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\Avast Software\\Avast\\RegSvr.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\Avast Software\\Avast\\x86\\RegSvr.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\{FB904E4E-D2C7-4C8D-8492-B620BB9896B1}%' ESCAPE '\') OR ((NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\AVG\\Antivirus\\RegSvr.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\AVG\\Antivirus\\x86\\RegSvr.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\{FB904E4E-D2C7-4C8D-8492-B620BB9896B1}%' ESCAPE '\') OR (NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\Avira\\Endpoint Protection SDK\\endpointprotection.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\{00000001-3DCC-4B48-A82E-E2071FE58E05}%' ESCAPE '\')), 0))))
title: Potential Persistence Via New AMSI Providers - Registry

author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel
description:
Detects the enumeration of a specific DLL or EXE being used by a binary via "tasklist.exe".
This is often used by attackers in order to find the specific process identifier (PID) that is using the DLL in question.
In order to dump the process memory or perform other nefarious actions.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\tasklist.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='tasklist.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-m%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/m%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–m%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—m%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―m%' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%rdpcorets.dll%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Loaded Module Enumeration Via Tasklist.EXE

author: frack113
description: Adversaries may modify system firewalls in order to bypass controls limiting network usage
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\netsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='netsh.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%advfirewall%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%firewall%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%set%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%rule%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%group=%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%new%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%enable=Yes%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Netsh Allow Group Policy on Microsoft Defender Firewall

author: frack113, Nasreddine Bencherchali
description:
Detects the use of short name paths (8.3 format) in command lines, which can be used to obfuscate paths or access restricted locations.
Windows creates short 8.3 filenames (like PROGRA~1) for compatibility with MS-DOS-based or 16-bit Windows programs.
When investigating, examine:
- Commands using short paths to access sensitive directories or files
- Web servers on Windows (especially Apache) where short filenames could bypass security controls
- Correlation with other suspicious behaviors
- baseline of short name usage in your environment and look for deviations
falsepositives: Applications could use this notation occasionally which might generate some false positives. In that case investigate the parent and child process.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%~1\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%~2\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE(((ParentProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\Dism.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\cleanmgr.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\winget.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\WinGet\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR (ParentProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\Microsoft.NET\\Framework64\\v%' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\csc.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\AppData\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\')), 0)) AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\GPSoftware\\Directory Opus\\dopus.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\aurora-agent-64.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\aurora-agent.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\thor\\thor64.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR (CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\Program Files\\Git\\post-install.bat%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\Program Files\\Git\\cmd\\scalar.exe%' ESCAPE '\') OR (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\WebEx\\webexhost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\appdata\\local\\webex\\webex64\\meetings\\wbxreport.exe%' ESCAPE '\') OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\veeam.backup.shell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\Everything\\Everything.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Use Short Name Path in Command Line

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the keyboard preload installation with a suspicious keyboard layout, e.g. Chinese, Iranian or Vietnamese layout load in user session on systems maintained by US staff only
falsepositives: Administrators or users that actually use the selected keyboard layouts (heavily depends on the organisation's user base)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND ((TargetObject LIKE '%\\Keyboard Layout\\Preload\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\Keyboard Layout\\Substitutes\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NewValue LIKE '%00000429%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%00050429%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%0000042a%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Suspicious Keyboard Layout Load

author: frack113
description: Use of the commandline to shutdown or reboot windows
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\shutdown.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/r %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/s %' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Suspicious Execution of Shutdown

author: frack113
description: Adversaries may log user keystrokes to intercept credentials as the user types them.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-Keystrokes%' ESCAPE '\' OR (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-ProcAddress user32.dll GetAsyncKeyState%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-ProcAddress user32.dll GetForegroundWindow%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Powershell Keylogging

author: Tim Shelton (HAWK.IO)
description: Detects unusual processes accessing desktop.ini remotely over network share, which can be leveraged to alter how Explorer displays a folder's content (i.e. renaming files) without changing them on disk.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=5145 AND ObjectType='File' AND RelativeTargetName LIKE '%\\desktop.ini' ESCAPE '\' AND (AccessList LIKE '%WriteData%' ESCAPE '\' OR AccessList LIKE '%DELETE%' ESCAPE '\' OR AccessList LIKE '%WriteDAC%' ESCAPE '\' OR AccessList LIKE '%AppendData%' ESCAPE '\' OR AccessList LIKE '%AddSubdirectory%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Windows Network Access Suspicious desktop.ini Action

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects a program executing from a web server root folder. Use this rule to hunt for potential interesting activity such as webshell or backdoors
falsepositives: Tools that include ping or nslookup command invocations
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wwwroot\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wmpub\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\htdocs\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE(((NewProcessName LIKE '%bin\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\Tools\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\SMSComponent\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\services.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Execution From Webserver Root Folder

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects usage of the "Write-EventLog" cmdlet with 'RawData' flag. The cmdlet can be levreage to write malicious payloads to the EventLog and then retrieve them later for later use
falsepositives: Legitimate applications writing events via this cmdlet. Investigate alerts to determine if the action is benign
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Write-EventLog%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-RawData %' ESCAPE '\'))
title: PowerShell Write-EventLog Usage

author: frack113
description: Adversaries may abuse the Windows Task Scheduler to perform task scheduling for initial or recurring execution of malicious code
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND (((ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-ScheduledTaskAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-ScheduledTaskTrigger%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-ScheduledTaskPrincipal%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-ScheduledTask%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Register-ScheduledTask%' ESCAPE '\') OR (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Invoke-CimMethod%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-ClassName%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%PS\_ScheduledTask%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-NameSpace%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Root\\Microsoft\\Windows\\TaskScheduler%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Microsoft.PowerShell.Core\\Export-ModuleMember%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Microsoft.Management.Infrastructure.CimInstance%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%\_\_cmdletization\_methodParameter%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Powershell Create Scheduled Task

author: frack113
description: Executes arbitrary PowerShell code using SyncAppvPublishingServer.vbs
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\SyncAppvPublishingServer.vbs%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%;%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: SyncAppvPublishingServer VBS Execute Arbitrary PowerShell Code

author: Matthew Green @mgreen27, Ecco, James Pemberton @4A616D6573, oscd.community, Andreas Hunkeler (@Karneades)
description: Detects the execution of a renamed binary often used by attackers or malware leveraging new Sysmon OriginalFileName datapoint.
falsepositives: Custom applications use renamed binaries adding slight change to binary name. Typically this is easy to spot and add to whitelist
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((OriginalFileName='Cmd.Exe' OR OriginalFileName='CONHOST.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='7z.exe' OR OriginalFileName='7za.exe' OR OriginalFileName='7zr.exe' OR OriginalFileName='WinRAR.exe' OR OriginalFileName='wevtutil.exe' OR OriginalFileName='net.exe' OR OriginalFileName='net1.exe' OR OriginalFileName='netsh.exe' OR OriginalFileName='InstallUtil.exe') AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\conhost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\7z.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\7za.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\7zr.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\WinRAR.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wevtutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\net.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\net1.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\netsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\InstallUtil.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Potential Defense Evasion Via Binary Rename

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects usage of the "Add-AppxPackage" or it's alias "Add-AppPackage" to install unsigned AppX packages
falsepositives: Installation of unsigned packages for testing purposes
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Add-AppPackage %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Add-AppxPackage %' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '% -AllowUnsigned%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Unsigned AppX Installation Attempt Using Add-AppxPackage

author: frack113, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects potentially suspicious CommandLine of electron apps (teams, discord, slack, etc.). This could be a sign of abuse to proxy execution through a signed binary.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\chrome.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\code.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\discord.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\GitHubDesktop.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\keybase.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\msedge\_proxy.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\msedge.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\msedgewebview2.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\msteams.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\slack.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\Teams.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='chrome.exe' OR OriginalFileName='code.exe' OR OriginalFileName='discord.exe' OR OriginalFileName='GitHubDesktop.exe' OR OriginalFileName='keybase.exe' OR OriginalFileName LIKE 'msedge\_proxy.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='msedge.exe' OR OriginalFileName='msedgewebview2.exe' OR OriginalFileName='msteams.exe' OR OriginalFileName='slack.exe' OR OriginalFileName='Teams.exe')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%--browser-subprocess-path%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%--gpu-launcher%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%--renderer-cmd-prefix%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%--utility-cmd-prefix%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Potentially Suspicious Electron Application CommandLine

author: Jakob Weinzettl, oscd.community, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects a file or folder's permissions being modified or tampered with.
falsepositives: Users interacting with the files on their own (unlikely unless privileged users).
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cacls.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\icacls.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\net.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\net1.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/grant%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/setowner%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/inheritance:r%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\attrib.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-r%' ESCAPE '\') OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\takeown.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%ICACLS C:\\ProgramData\\dynatrace\\gateway\\config\\connectivity.history /reset' ESCAPE '\' OR (CommandLine LIKE '%ICACLS C:\\ProgramData\\dynatrace\\gateway\\config\\config.properties /grant :r %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%S-1-5-19:F%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Programs\\Microsoft VS Code%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Program Files\\Microsoft VS Code%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Program Files (x86)\\Avira%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Program Files\\Avira%' ESCAPE '\')), 0))))
title: File or Folder Permissions Modifications

author: frack113
description: Detect enable rdp feature to allow specific user to rdp connect on the targeted machine
falsepositives: Legitimate use of the feature (alerts should be investigated either way)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%System\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\Terminal Server\\fAllowToGetHelp' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue='DWORD (0x00000001)'))
title: Allow RDP Remote Assistance Feature

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects execution of client32.exe (NetSupport RAT) from an unusual location (outside of 'C:\Program Files')
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\client32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Product LIKE '%NetSupport Remote Control%' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName LIKE '%client32.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=a9d50692e95b79723f3e76fcf70d023e%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Program Files (x86)\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Remote Access Tool - NetSupport Execution From Unusual Location

author: Sreeman
description: Detects the modification of an existing service in order to execute an arbitrary payload when the service is started or killed as a potential method for persistence.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((CommandLine LIKE '%sc %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%config %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%binpath=%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%sc %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%failure%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%command=%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (((CommandLine LIKE '%reg %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%add %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%FailureCommand%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%reg %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%add %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%ImagePath%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%.sh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.bin$%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.bat%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.cmd%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.js%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.msh$%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.reg$%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.scr%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.ps%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.vb%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.jar%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.pl%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Potential Persistence Attempt Via Existing Service Tampering

author: Thomas Patzke
description: Detects files that have extensions commonly seen while SDelete is used to wipe files.
falsepositives: Files that are interacted with that have these extensions legitimately
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4656 OR EventID=4663 OR EventID=4658) AND (ObjectName LIKE '%.AAA' ESCAPE '\' OR ObjectName LIKE '%.ZZZ' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Potential Secure Deletion with SDelete

author: Roberto Rodriguez @Cyb3rWard0g
description: Detects anyone attempting a backup for the DPAPI Master Key. This events gets generated at the source and not the Domain Controller.
falsepositives: If a computer is a member of a domain, DPAPI has a backup mechanism to allow unprotection of the data. Which will trigger this event.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND EventID=4692
title: DPAPI Domain Master Key Backup Attempt

author: @kostastsale
description:
Detects the execution of "csc.exe" via "w3wp.exe" process. MOVEit affected hosts execute "csc.exe" via the "w3wp.exe" process to dynamically compile malicious DLL files.

MOVEit is affected by a critical vulnerability. Exploited hosts show evidence of dynamically compiling a DLL and writing it under C:\\Windows\\Microsoft\.NET\\Framework64\\v4\.0\.30319\\Temporary ASP\.NET Files\\root\\([a-z0-9]{5,12})\\([a-z0-9]{5,12})\\App_Web_[a-z0-9]{5,12}\.dll.

Hunting Opportunity

Events from IIS dynamically compiling binaries via the csc.exe on behalf of the MOVEit application, especially since May 27th should be investigated.
falsepositives: Initial software installation and software updates.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\w3wp.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%moveitdmz pool%' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\csc.exe' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Potential MOVEit Transfer CVE-2023-34362 Exploitation - Dynamic Compilation Via Csc.EXE

author: oscd.community, Teymur Kheirkhabarov @HeirhabarovT, Zach Stanford @svch0st, wagga
description: Detects when an admin share is mounted using net.exe
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\net.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\net1.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='net.exe' OR OriginalFileName='net1.exe')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '% use %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% \\\\%\\%$%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Windows Admin Share Mount Via Net.EXE

author: frack113
description: Detect set UseActionCenterExperience to 0 to disable the Windows security center notification
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%Windows\\CurrentVersion\\ImmersiveShell\\UseActionCenterExperience' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue='DWORD (0x00000000)'))
title: Disable Windows Security Center Notifications

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects usage of "MSPUB" (Microsoft Publisher) to download arbitrary files
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\MSPUB.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='MSPUB.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%ftp://%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%http://%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%https://%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Arbitrary File Download Via MSPUB.EXE

author: frack113
description: Detects a suspicious call to the user32.dll function that locks the user workstation
falsepositives: Scripts or links on the user desktop used to lock the workstation instead of Windows+L or the menu option
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='RUNDLL32.EXE') AND ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%user32.dll,%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%LockWorkStation%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Suspicious Workstation Locking via Rundll32

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), oscd.community, Jonhnathan Ribeiro
description: Detects a Powershell process that contains download commands in its command line string
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell\_ise.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName LIKE 'PowerShell\_ISE.EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%new-object%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%net.webclient).%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%download%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%string(%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%file(%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: PowerShell Download Pattern

author: E.M. Anhaus, Tony Lambert, oscd.community, omkar72
description: Detects execution of "dsquery.exe" for domain trust discovery
falsepositives: Legitimate use of the utilities by legitimate user for legitimate reason
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\dsquery.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='dsquery.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '%trustedDomain%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Domain Trust Discovery Via Dsquery

author: Max Altgelt (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects process creation events that use the Sysnative folder (common for CobaltStrike spawns)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Sysnative\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Sysnative\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE(((NewProcessName LIKE '%C:\\Windows\\Microsoft.NET\\Framework64\\v%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%C:\\Windows\\Microsoft.NET\\Framework\\v%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%C:\\Windows\\Microsoft.NET\\FrameworkArm\\v%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%C:\\Windows\\Microsoft.NET\\FrameworkArm64\\v%' ESCAPE '\') AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\ngen.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%install%' ESCAPE '\'), 0)) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%"C:\\Windows\\sysnative\\cmd.exe"%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\xampp\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\catalina\_start.bat%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Process Creation Using Sysnative Folder

author: frack113
description: Detects usage of COM objects that can be abused to download files in PowerShell by CLSID
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%[Type]::GetTypeFromCLSID(%' ESCAPE '\' AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%0002DF01-0000-0000-C000-000000000046%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%F6D90F16-9C73-11D3-B32E-00C04F990BB4%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%F5078F35-C551-11D3-89B9-0000F81FE221%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%88d96a0a-f192-11d4-a65f-0040963251e5%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%AFBA6B42-5692-48EA-8141-DC517DCF0EF1%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%AFB40FFD-B609-40A3-9828-F88BBE11E4E3%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%88d96a0b-f192-11d4-a65f-0040963251e5%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%2087c2f4-2cef-4953-a8ab-66779b670495%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%000209FF-0000-0000-C000-000000000046%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%00024500-0000-0000-C000-000000000046%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Potential COM Objects Download Cradles Usage - PS Script

author: mdecrevoisier
description: Detects scenarios where an attacker enables the OpenSSH server and server starts to listening on SSH socket.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='OpenSSH/Operational' AND (EventID=4 AND process='sshd' AND payload LIKE 'Server listening on %' ESCAPE '\')
title: OpenSSH Server Listening On Socket

author: omkar72
description: Detects the addition of office test registry that allows a user to specify an arbitrary DLL that will be executed every time an Office application is started
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND (OperationType='New registry value created' OR OperationType='Existing registry value modified')) AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\Software\\Microsoft\\Office test\\Special\\Perf%' ESCAPE '\')
title: Office Application Startup - Office Test

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects child processes of the "Trace log generation tool for Media Foundation Tools" (Mftrace.exe) which can abused to execute arbitrary binaries.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\mftrace.exe' ESCAPE '\')
title: Potential Mftrace.EXE Abuse

author: ANosir
description:
Detects suspicious Kerberos TGT requests with pre-authentication disabled (Pre-Authentication Type = 0) and Ticket Encryption Type (0x17) i.e, RC4-HMAC.
This may indicate an AS-REP Roasting attack, where attackers request AS-REP messages for accounts without pre-authentication and attempt to crack the encrypted ticket offline to recover user passwords.
falsepositives: Legacy systems or applications that legitimately use RC4 encryption
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4768 AND TicketEncryptionType='0x17' AND ServiceName='krbtgt' AND PreAuthType=0)
title: Potential AS-REP Roasting via Kerberos TGT Requests

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the execution of WMIC with the "csproduct" which is used to obtain information such as hardware models and vendor information
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wmic.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='wmic.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '%csproduct%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Hardware Model Reconnaissance Via Wmic.EXE

author: frack113, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detect use of the Windows 8.3 short name. Which could be used as a method to avoid Image based detection
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%~1.bat%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%~1.dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%~1.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%~1.hta%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%~1.js%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%~1.msi%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%~1.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%~1.tmp%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%~1.vbe%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%~1.vbs%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%~2.bat%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%~2.dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%~2.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%~2.hta%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%~2.js%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%~2.msi%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%~2.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%~2.tmp%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%~2.vbe%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%~2.vbs%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\explorer.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0)) AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\WebEx\\WebexHost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\thor\\thor64.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\PROGRA~1\\WinZip\\WZPREL~1.EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\VCREDI~1.EXE' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Use NTFS Short Name in Image

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects execution of "odbcconf" with "INSTALLDRIVER" which installs a new ODBC driver. Attackers abuse this to install and run malicious DLLs.
falsepositives: Legitimate driver DLLs being registered via "odbcconf" will generate false positives. Investigate the path of the DLL and its contents to determine if the action is authorized.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\odbcconf.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='odbcconf.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%INSTALLDRIVER %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Driver/DLL Installation Via Odbcconf.EXE

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Jonhnathan Ribeiro, oscd.community, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the execution of the certutil with the "exportPFX" flag which allows the utility to export certificates.
falsepositives: There legitimate reasons to export certificates. Investigate the activity to determine if it's benign
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\certutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='CertUtil.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-exportPFX %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/exportPFX %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–exportPFX %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—exportPFX %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―exportPFX %' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Certificate Exported Via Certutil.EXE

author: Pushkarev Dmitry
description: Detects when AppLocker prevents the execution of an Application, DLL, Script, MSI, or Packaged-App from running.
falsepositives: Unlikely, since this event notifies about blocked application execution. Tune your applocker rules to avoid blocking legitimate applications.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-AppLocker/MSI and Script' OR Channel='Microsoft-Windows-AppLocker/EXE and DLL' OR Channel='Microsoft-Windows-AppLocker/Packaged app-Deployment' OR Channel='Microsoft-Windows-AppLocker/Packaged app-Execution') AND (EventID=8004 OR EventID=8007 OR EventID=8022 OR EventID=8025)
title: AppLocker Prevented Application or Script from Running

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects suspicious PowerShell download command
falsepositives: PowerShell scripts that download content from the Internet
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%System.Net.WebClient%' ESCAPE '\' AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.DownloadFile(%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.DownloadFileAsync(%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.DownloadString(%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.DownloadStringAsync(%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Suspicious PowerShell Download - Powershell Script

author: Jose Luis Sanchez Martinez (@Joseliyo_Jstnk)
description: Detects registry key established after masqueraded .scr file execution using Rundll32 through desk.cpl
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\Control Panel\\Desktop\\SCRNSAVE.EXE%' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue LIKE '%.scr' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((NewValue LIKE '%C:\\Windows\\System32\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: ScreenSaver Registry Key Set

author: Konstantin Grishchenko, oscd.community
description: Csi.exe is a signed binary from Microsoft that comes with Visual Studio and provides C# interactive capabilities. It can be used to run C# code from a file passed as a parameter in command line. Early version of this utility provided with Microsoft “Roslyn” Community Technology Preview was named 'rcsi.exe'
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\csi.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\rcsi.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='csi.exe' OR OriginalFileName='rcsi.exe')) AND Company='Microsoft Corporation'))
title: Suspicious Csi.exe Usage

author: Roberto Rodriguez (Cyb3rWard0g), OTR (Open Threat Research)
description: A General detection for sdclt being spawned as an elevated process. This could be an indicator of sdclt being used for bypass UAC techniques.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%sdclt.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (IntegrityLevel='High' OR IntegrityLevel='S-1-16-12288')))
title: Potential UAC Bypass Via Sdclt.EXE

author: Matt Anderson, Kris Luzadre, Andrew Schwartz, Huntress
description:
This detects file modifications to the temporary xml user database file indicating local user modification in the ScreenConnect server.
This will occur during exploitation of the ScreenConnect Authentication Bypass vulnerability (CVE-2024-1709) in versions <23.9.8, but may also be observed when making legitimate modifications to local users or permissions.
This requires an Advanced Auditing policy to log a successful Windows Event ID 4663 events and with a SACL set on the directory.
falsepositives: This will occur legitimately as well and will result in some benign activity.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4663 AND ObjectType='File' AND AccessMask='0x6' AND ObjectName LIKE '%.xml' ESCAPE '\' AND (ObjectName LIKE '%Temp%' ESCAPE '\' AND ObjectName LIKE '%ScreenConnect%' ESCAPE '\') AND ProcessName LIKE '%ScreenConnect.Service.exe%' ESCAPE '\')
title: ScreenConnect User Database Modification - Security

author: Nik Seetharaman, frack113
description: Detects the execution of Microsoft Workflow Compiler, which may permit the execution of arbitrary unsigned code.
falsepositives: Legitimate MWC use (unlikely in modern enterprise environments)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\Microsoft.Workflow.Compiler.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='Microsoft.Workflow.Compiler.exe'))
title: Microsoft Workflow Compiler Execution

author: Sai Prashanth Pulisetti, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects the execution of an AnyDesk binary with a version prior to 8.0.8.
Prior to version 8.0.8, the Anydesk application used a signing certificate that got compromised by threat actors.
Use this rule to detect instances of older versions of Anydesk using the compromised certificate
This is recommended in order to avoid attackers leveraging the certificate and signing their binaries to bypass detections.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\AnyDesk.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Description='AnyDesk' OR Product='AnyDesk' OR Company='AnyDesk Software GmbH') AND (FileVersion LIKE '7.0.%' ESCAPE '\' OR FileVersion LIKE '7.1.%' ESCAPE '\' OR FileVersion LIKE '8.0.1%' ESCAPE '\' OR FileVersion LIKE '8.0.2%' ESCAPE '\' OR FileVersion LIKE '8.0.3%' ESCAPE '\' OR FileVersion LIKE '8.0.4%' ESCAPE '\' OR FileVersion LIKE '8.0.5%' ESCAPE '\' OR FileVersion LIKE '8.0.6%' ESCAPE '\' OR FileVersion LIKE '8.0.7%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '% --remove%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --uninstall%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Remote Access Tool - AnyDesk Execution With Known Revoked Signing Certificate

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the execution of Scheduled Tasks where the Program being run is located in a suspicious location or it's an unusale program to be run from a Scheduled Task
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Microsoft-Windows-TaskScheduler/Operational' AND (EventID=129 AND (Path LIKE '%C:\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Path LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Path LIKE '%\\Desktop\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Path LIKE '%\\Downloads\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Path LIKE '%\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Path LIKE '%C:\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Scheduled Task Executed From A Suspicious Location

author: Sami Ruohonen
description: Detects usage of attrib.exe to hide files from users.
falsepositives: IgfxCUIService.exe hiding *.cui files via .bat script (attrib.exe a child of cmd.exe and igfxCUIService.exe is the parent of the cmd.exe)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\attrib.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='ATTRIB.EXE') AND CommandLine LIKE '% +h %' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%\\desktop.ini %' ESCAPE '\'), 0)) AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '+R +H +S +A \\*.cui' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE 'C:\\WINDOWS\\system32\\*.bat' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Hiding Files with Attrib.exe

author: oscd.community, @redcanary, Zach Stanford @svch0st
description: Adversaries may install a root certificate on a compromised system to avoid warnings when connecting to adversary controlled web servers.
falsepositives: Help Desk or IT may need to manually add a corporate Root CA on occasion. Need to test if GPO push doesn't trigger FP
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ((ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Move-Item%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Cert:\\LocalMachine\\Root%' ESCAPE '\') OR (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Import-Certificate%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Cert:\\LocalMachine\\Root%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Root Certificate Installed - PowerShell

author: Andreas Hunkeler (@Karneades), oscd.community
description: Detect the harvesting of wifi credentials using netsh.exe
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\netsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='netsh.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%wlan%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% s%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% p%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% k%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%=clear%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Harvesting Of Wifi Credentials Via Netsh.EXE

author: Thomas Patzke
description: Detects PsExec service installation and execution events
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='System' AND ((Provider_Name='Service Control Manager' AND EventID=7045) AND (ServiceName='PSEXESVC' OR ImagePath LIKE '%\\PSEXESVC.exe' ESCAPE '\'))
title: PsExec Service Installation

author: frack113
description: Adversaries may carry out malicious operations using a virtual instance to avoid detection
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-VM%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-VMFirmware%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Start-VM%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Suspicious Hyper-V Cmdlets

author: bohops
description: Detects Microsoft Visual Studio vsls-agent.exe lolbin execution with a suspicious library load using the --agentExtensionPath parameter
falsepositives: False positives depend on custom use of vsls-agent.exe
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\vsls-agent.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%--agentExtensionPath%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%Microsoft.VisualStudio.LiveShare.Agent.%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Suspicious Vsls-Agent Command With AgentExtensionPath Load

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects creation of a new service (kernel driver) with the type "kernel"
falsepositives: Rare legitimate installation of kernel drivers via sc.exe
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\sc.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%create%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%config%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%binPath%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%type%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%kernel%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE(((CommandLine LIKE '%create netprotection\_network\_filter%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%type= kernel start= %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%binPath= System32\\drivers\\netprotection\_network\_filter%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%DisplayName= netprotection\_network\_filter%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%group= PNP\_TDI tag= yes%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%create avelam binpath=C:\\Windows\\system32\\drivers\\avelam.sys%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%type=kernel start=boot error=critical group=Early-Launch%' ESCAPE '\')), 0))))
title: New Kernel Driver Via SC.EXE

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects usage of the Get-ADComputer cmdlet to collect computer information and output it to a file
falsepositives: Legitimate admin scripts may use the same technique, it's better to exclude specific computers or users who execute these commands or scripts often
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%Get-ADComputer %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -Filter *%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% > %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% | Select %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Out-File%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Set-Content%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Add-Content%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Computer Discovery And Export Via Get-ADComputer Cmdlet

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects applications or users re-enabling old TLS versions by setting the "Enabled" value to "1" for the "Protocols" registry key.
falsepositives: Legitimate enabling of the old tls versions due to incompatibility
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND ((TargetObject LIKE '%\\Control\\SecurityProviders\\SCHANNEL\\Protocols\\TLS 1.0\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\Control\\SecurityProviders\\SCHANNEL\\Protocols\\TLS 1.1\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\Enabled' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue='DWORD (0x00000001)'))
title: Old TLS1.0/TLS1.1 Protocol Version Enabled

author: frack113
description: Deployment Image Servicing and Management tool. DISM is used to enumerate, install, uninstall, configure, and update features and packages in Windows images
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\DismHost.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (ParentCommandLine LIKE '%/Online%' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%/Disable-Feature%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\Dism.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/Online%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/Disable-Feature%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Dism Remove Online Package

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects execution of "rundll32" with potential obfuscated ordinal calls
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='RUNDLL32.EXE' OR CommandLine LIKE '%rundll32%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%#+%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%#-%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%#0%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%#655%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%#656%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Potential Obfuscated Ordinal Call Via Rundll32

author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects execution of TruffleHog, a tool used to search for secrets in different platforms like Git, Jira, Slack, SharePoint, etc. that could be used maliciously.
While it is a legitimate tool, intended for use in CI pipelines and security assessments,
It was observed in the Shai-Hulud malware campaign targeting npm packages to steal sensitive information.
falsepositives: Legitimate use of TruffleHog by security teams or developers.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\trufflehog.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ((CommandLine LIKE '% docker --image %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% Git %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% GitHub %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% Jira %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% Slack %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% Confluence %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% SharePoint %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% s3 %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% gcs %' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '% --results=verified%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: PUA - TruffleHog Execution

author: frack113
description:
The attacker creates a computer object using those permissions with a password known to her.
After that she clears the attribute ServicePrincipalName on the computer object.
Because she created the object (CREATOR OWNER), she gets granted additional permissions and can do many changes to the object.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='System' AND (Provider_Name='Microsoft-Windows-Kerberos-Key-Distribution-Center' AND (EventID=35 OR EventID=36 OR EventID=37 OR EventID=38))
title: Potential CVE-2021-42278 Exploitation Attempt

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), Karneades / Markus Neis, Jonhnathan Ribeiro, oscd.community
description: Detects the usage of the "Squirrel.exe" binary to execute arbitrary processes. This binary is part of multiple Electron based software installations (Slack, Teams, Discord, etc.)
falsepositives: Expected FP with some Electron based applications such as (1Clipboard, Beaker Browser, Caret, Discord, GitHub Desktop, etc.)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\squirrel.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\update.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%--processStart%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%--processStartAndWait%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%--createShortcut%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((((CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Users\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Discord\\Update.exe%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%Discord.exe%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%--createShortcut%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%--processStart%' ESCAPE '\')) OR ((CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Users\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\GitHubDesktop\\Update.exe%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%GitHubDesktop.exe%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%--createShortcut%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%--processStartAndWait%' ESCAPE '\')) OR ((CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Users\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Microsoft\\Teams\\Update.exe%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%Teams.exe%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%--processStart%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%--createShortcut%' ESCAPE '\')) OR ((CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Users\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\yammerdesktop\\Update.exe%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%Yammer.exe%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%--processStart%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%--createShortcut%' ESCAPE '\'))), 0))))
title: Process Proxy Execution Via Squirrel.EXE

author: Craig Sweeney, Matt Anderson, Jose Oregon, Tim Kasper, Faith Stratton, Samantha Shaw, Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects suspicious child processes spawned by the CrushFTP service that may indicate exploitation of remote code execution vulnerabilities such as
CVE-2025-31161, where attackers can achieve RCE through crafted HTTP requests.
The detection focuses on commonly abused Windows executables (like powershell.exe, cmd.exe etc.) that attackers typically use post-exploitation to execute malicious commands.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\crushftpservice.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\bash.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell\_ise.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\sh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Suspicious CrushFTP Child Process

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects usage of "MSOHTMED" to download arbitrary files
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\MSOHTMED.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='MsoHtmEd.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%ftp://%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%http://%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%https://%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Arbitrary File Download Via MSOHTMED.EXE

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the use of the 'Launch-VsDevShell.ps1' Microsoft signed script to execute commands.
falsepositives: Legitimate usage of the script by a developer
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Launch-VsDevShell.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%VsWherePath %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%VsInstallationPath %' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Launch-VsDevShell.PS1 Proxy Execution

author: frack113
description: Hides the file extension through modification of the registry
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Internet Settings\\ZoneMap\\Domains\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((NewValue='DWORD (0x00000000)' OR NewValue='DWORD (0x00000001)' OR NewValue='(Empty)'), 0))))
title: IE Change Domain Zone

author: @BarryShooshooga
description: Detects modifications to the Windows Defender exclusion registry key. This could indicate a potentially suspicious or even malicious activity by an attacker trying to add a new exclusion in order to bypass security.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4657 AND ObjectName LIKE '%\\Microsoft\\Windows Defender\\Exclusions\\%' ESCAPE '\')
title: Windows Defender Exclusion List Modified

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description:
Adversaries may acquire credentials from web browsers by reading files specific to the target browser.
Web browsers commonly save credentials such as website usernames and passwords so that they do not need to be entered manually in the future.
Web browsers typically store the credentials in an encrypted format within a credential store.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((CommandLine LIKE '%copy-item%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%copy %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cpi %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% cp %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%move %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%move-item%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% mi %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% mv %' ESCAPE '\') OR (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\esentutl.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\xcopy.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\robocopy.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='esentutl.exe' OR OriginalFileName='XCOPY.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='robocopy.exe')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\Amigo\\User Data%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\BraveSoftware\\Brave-Browser\\User Data%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\CentBrowser\\User Data%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Chromium\\User Data%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\CocCoc\\Browser\\User Data%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Comodo\\Dragon\\User Data%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Elements Browser\\User Data%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Epic Privacy Browser\\User Data%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Google\\Chrome Beta\\User Data%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Google\\Chrome SxS\\User Data%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Google\\Chrome\\User Data\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Kometa\\User Data%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Maxthon5\\Users%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Microsoft\\Edge\\User Data%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Mozilla\\Firefox\\Profiles%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Nichrome\\User Data%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Opera Software\\Opera GX Stable\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Opera Software\\Opera Neon\\User Data%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Opera Software\\Opera Stable\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Orbitum\\User Data%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\QIP Surf\\User Data%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Sputnik\\User Data%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Torch\\User Data%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\uCozMedia\\Uran\\User Data%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Vivaldi\\User Data%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Potential Browser Data Stealing

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects usage of findstr with the "EVERYONE" or "BUILTIN" keywords.
This was seen being used in combination with "icacls" and other utilities to spot misconfigured files or folders permissions.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\find.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\findstr.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='FIND.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='FINDSTR.EXE')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%"Everyone"%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%''Everyone''%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%"BUILTIN\\"%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%''BUILTIN\\''%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (CommandLine LIKE '%icacls %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%findstr %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%Everyone%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Permission Misconfiguration Reconnaissance Via Findstr.EXE

author: Victor Sergeev, Daniil Yugoslavskiy, Gleb Sukhodolskiy, Timur Zinniatullin, oscd.community, Tim Shelton, frack113 (split)
description: Detects modification of autostart extensibility point (ASEP) in registry.
falsepositives: Legitimate software automatically (mostly, during installation) sets up autorun keys for legitimate reason
Legitimate administrator sets up autorun keys for legitimate reason
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND ((TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Wow6432Node\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion%' ESCAPE '\' AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\Windows\\Appinit\_Dlls%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\Image File Execution Options%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\Drivers32%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((NewValue='(Empty)' OR NewValue IS NULL OR NewValue LIKE '%\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Image File Execution Options' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Wow6432Node Windows NT CurrentVersion Autorun Keys Modification

author: frack113
description: Detects when an attacker tries to disable User Account Control (UAC) by setting the registry value "EnableLUA" to 0.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Policies\\System\\EnableLUA%' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue='DWORD (0x00000000)'))
title: UAC Disabled

author: Austin Songer @austinsonger
description: Detects when a user disables the Windows Firewall via a Profile to help evade defense.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ((ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-NetFirewallProfile %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '% -Enabled %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '% False%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '% -All %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Public%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Domain%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Private%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Windows Firewall Profile Disabled

author: frack113
description: Detects the usage of "reg.exe" to add Defender folder exclusions. Qbot has been seen using this technique to add exclusions for folders within AppData and ProgramData.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows Defender\\Exclusions\\Paths%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Microsoft Antimalware\\Exclusions\\Paths%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%ADD %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/t %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%REG\_DWORD %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/v %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/d %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%0%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Suspicious Windows Defender Folder Exclusion Added Via Reg.EXE

author: frack113
description:
Adversaries may interrupt availability of system and network resources by inhibiting access to accounts utilized by legitimate users.
Accounts may be deleted, locked, or manipulated (ex: changed credentials) to remove access to accounts.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Remove-ADGroupMember%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Identity %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-Members %' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Remove Account From Domain Admin Group

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects usage of Sysinternals PsSuspend which can be abused to suspend critical processes
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (OriginalFileName='pssuspend.exe' OR (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pssuspend.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pssuspend64.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pssuspend64a.exe' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Sysinternals PsSuspend Execution

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detect filter driver unloading activity via fltmc.exe
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\fltMC.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='fltMC.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '%unload%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\endpoint-protection-installer-x64.tmp' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%unload rtp\_filesystem\_filter' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%unload rtp\_filter' ESCAPE '\')) OR (ParentProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Program Files (x86)\\ManageEngine\\uems\_agent\\bin\\dcfaservice64.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%unload DFMFilter' ESCAPE '\')), 0))))
title: Filter Driver Unloaded Via Fltmc.EXE

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects service ticket requests using RC4 encryption type
falsepositives: Service accounts used on legacy systems (e.g. NetApp)
Windows Domains with DFL 2003 and legacy systems
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4769 AND TicketOptions='0x40810000' AND TicketEncryptionType='0x17') AND (NOT COALESCE((ServiceName LIKE '%$' ESCAPE '\'), 0)))
title: Suspicious Kerberos RC4 Ticket Encryption

author: Christopher Peacock @SecurePeacock, SCYTHE @scythe_io
description: The Workflow Command-line Compiler can be used for AWL bypass and is listed in Microsoft's recommended block rules.
falsepositives: Legitimate use by a software developer
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wfc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='wfc.exe'))
title: Use of Wfc.exe

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects an attempt to terminate a process via "wmic" with the "call terminate" flag. Adversaries may
use wmic to terminate security products or other applications on the compromised host. This event is
triggered on on attempt and process creation can be either successful or unsuccessful.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\WMIC.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='wmic.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%call%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%terminate%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Application Termination Attempt via Wmic.EXE

author: Roberto Rodriguez, Teymur Kheirkhabarov, Dimitrios Slamaris, Mark Russinovich, Aleksey Potapov, oscd.community (update)
description: Detects process handle on LSASS process with certain access mask
falsepositives: Legitimate software accessing LSASS process for legitimate reason; update the whitelist with it
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (((EventID=4656 AND ObjectName LIKE '%\\lsass.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (AccessMask LIKE '%0x40%' ESCAPE '\' OR AccessMask LIKE '%0x1400%' ESCAPE '\' OR AccessMask LIKE '%0x100000%' ESCAPE '\' OR AccessMask LIKE '%0x1410%' ESCAPE '\' OR AccessMask LIKE '%0x1010%' ESCAPE '\' OR AccessMask LIKE '%0x1438%' ESCAPE '\' OR AccessMask LIKE '%0x143a%' ESCAPE '\' OR AccessMask LIKE '%0x1418%' ESCAPE '\' OR AccessMask LIKE '%0x1f0fff%' ESCAPE '\' OR AccessMask LIKE '%0x1f1fff%' ESCAPE '\' OR AccessMask LIKE '%0x1f2fff%' ESCAPE '\' OR AccessMask LIKE '%0x1f3fff%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4663 AND ObjectName LIKE '%\\lsass.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (AccessList LIKE '%4484%' ESCAPE '\' OR AccessList LIKE '%4416%' ESCAPE '\'))) AND (NOT COALESCE((((ProcessName LIKE '%\\csrss.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE '%\\GamingServices.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE '%\\lsm.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE '%\\MicrosoftEdgeUpdate.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE '%\\minionhost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE '%\\MRT.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE '%\\MsMpEng.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE '%\\perfmon.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE '%\\procexp.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE '%\\procexp64.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE '%\\procexp64a.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE '%\\svchost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE '%\\taskmgr.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE '%\\thor.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE '%\\thor64.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE '%\\vmtoolsd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE '%\\VsTskMgr.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE '%\\wininit.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE '%\\wmiprvse.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE
