rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND (OperationType='New registry value created' OR OperationType='Existing registry value modified')) AND (TargetObject LIKE 'HKLM\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\Session Manager\\AppCertDlls' ESCAPE '\' OR NewName LIKE 'HKLM\\SYSTEM\\CurentControlSet\\Control\\Session Manager\\AppCertDlls' ESCAPE '\'))
title: New DLL Added to AppCertDlls Registry Key

author: frack113
description: Detects an appx package deployment that was blocked by AppLocker policy.
falsepositives: Unlikely, since this event notifies about blocked application deployment. Tune your applocker rules to avoid blocking legitimate applications.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Microsoft-Windows-AppXDeploymentServer/Operational' AND EventID=412
title: Deployment AppX Package Was Blocked By AppLocker

author: frack113
description: Compress target file into a cab file stored in the Alternate Data Stream (ADS) of the target file.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%diantz.exe%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.cab%' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine REGEXP ':[^\\]'))
title: Suspicious Diantz Alternate Data Stream Execution

author: juju4
description: Detects suspicious process related to rasdial.exe
falsepositives: False positives depend on scripts and administrative tools used in the monitored environment
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND NewProcessName LIKE '%rasdial.exe' ESCAPE '\')
title: Suspicious RASdial Activity

author: Ján Trenčanský, frack113
description: Detects when the "Windows Defender Threat Protection" service is disabled.
falsepositives: Auto updates of Windows Defender causes restarts
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='System' AND (EventID=7036 AND Provider_Name='Service Control Manager' AND (param1='Windows Defender Antivirus Service' OR param1='Service antivirus Microsoft Defender') AND (param2='stopped' OR param2='arrêté'))
title: Windows Defender Threat Detection Service Disabled

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects potentially suspicious changes to the SentinelOne context menu scan command by a process other than SentinelOne.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\shell\\SentinelOneScan\\command\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((((NewValue LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\SentinelOne\\Sentinel Agent%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE 'C:\\Program Files (x86)\\SentinelOne\\Sentinel Agent%' ESCAPE '\') AND NewValue LIKE '%\\SentinelScanFromContextMenu.exe%' ESCAPE '\') OR (NewProcessName LIKE '%C:\\Program Files\\SentinelOne\\' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%C:\\Program Files (x86)\\SentinelOne\\' ESCAPE '\')), 0))))
title: Potential SentinelOne Shell Context Menu Scan Command Tampering

author: frack113
description:
Adversaries may abuse PowerShell commands and scripts for execution.
PowerShell is a powerful interactive command-line interface and scripting environment included in the Windows operating system. (Citation: TechNet PowerShell)
Adversaries can use PowerShell to perform a number of actions, including discovery of information and execution of code
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ((ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-Object%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%System.Xml.XmlDocument%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.Load%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%IEX %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Invoke-Expression %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Invoke-Command %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ICM -%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Powershell XML Execute Command

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), kagebunsher
description:
Detects potentially suspicious search for JWT tokens via CLI by looking for the string "eyJ0eX" or "eyJhbG".
JWT tokens are often used for access-tokens across various applications and services like Microsoft 365, Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, and others.
Threat actors may search for these tokens to steal them for lateral movement or privilege escalation.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%find %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%find.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%findstr%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%select-string %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%strings%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%eyJ0eXAiOi%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%eyJhbGciOi%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% eyJ0eX%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% "eyJ0eX"%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ''eyJ0eX''%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% eyJhbG%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% "eyJhbG"%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ''eyJhbG''%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Potentially Suspicious JWT Token Search Via CLI

author: Zach Mathis
description: Detects when a DNS zone transfer failed.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='DNS Server' AND EventID=6004
title: Failed DNS Zone Transfer

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects a suspicious download using the BITS client from a FQDN that is unusual. Adversaries may abuse BITS jobs to persistently execute or clean up after malicious payloads.
falsepositives: This rule doesn't exclude other known TLDs such as ".org" or ".net". It's recommended to apply additional filters for software and scripts that leverage the BITS service
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Microsoft-Windows-Bits-Client/Operational' AND (EventID=16403 AND (NOT COALESCE((RemoteName LIKE '%.azureedge.net/%' ESCAPE '\' OR RemoteName LIKE '%.com/%' ESCAPE '\' OR RemoteName LIKE '%.sfx.ms/%' ESCAPE '\' OR RemoteName LIKE '%download.mozilla.org/%' ESCAPE '\' OR RemoteName LIKE '%cdn.onenote.net/%' ESCAPE '\' OR RemoteName LIKE '%cdn.office.net/%' ESCAPE '\' OR RemoteName LIKE '%tscdn.m365.static.microsoft/%' ESCAPE '\'), 0)))
title: BITS Transfer Job With Uncommon Or Suspicious Remote TLD

author: frack113
description: Detects the mounting of Windows SMB shares over QUIC, which can be an unexpected event in some enterprise environments
falsepositives: Due to the nature of the script block, the matching of the string could sometimes result in a false positive. Use this rule to hunt for potential malicious or suspicious scripts.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-SmbMapping%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-TransportType QUIC%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: SMB over QUIC Via PowerShell Script

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects an uncommon parent process of "LINK.EXE".
Link.EXE in Microsoft incremental linker. Its a utility usually bundled with Visual Studio installation.
Multiple utilities often found in the same folder (editbin.exe, dumpbin.exe, lib.exe, etc) have a hardcode call to the "LINK.EXE" binary without checking its validity.
This would allow an attacker to sideload any binary with the name "link.exe" if one of the aforementioned tools get executed from a different location.
By filtering the known locations of such utilities we can spot uncommon parent process of LINK.EXE that might be suspicious or malicious.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\link.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%LINK /%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE(((ParentProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\Microsoft Visual Studio\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Microsoft Visual Studio\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\VC\\bin\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\VC\\Tools\\%' ESCAPE '\')), 0))))
title: Uncommon Link.EXE Parent Process

author: frack113
description:
Adversaries may abuse msiexec.exe to proxy execution of malicious payloads.
Msiexec.exe is the command-line utility for the Windows Installer and is thus commonly associated with executing installation packages (.msi)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\msiexec.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -Y%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /Y%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –Y%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —Y%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―Y%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%\\MsiExec.exe" /Y "C:\\Program Files\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\MsiExec.exe" /Y "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\MsiExec.exe" /Y "C:\\Windows\\System32\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\MsiExec.exe" /Y "C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Suspicious Msiexec Execute Arbitrary DLL

author: @gott_cyber
description: Detects the execution of "Ldifde.exe" with the import flag "-i". The can be abused to include HTTP-based arguments which will allow the arbitrary download of files from a remote server.
falsepositives: Since the content of the files are unknown, false positives are expected
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\ldifde.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='ldifde.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-i%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-f%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Import LDAP Data Interchange Format File Via Ldifde.EXE

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), frack113
description:
Detects the recovery of files from backups via "wbadmin.exe".
Attackers can restore sensitive files such as NTDS.DIT or Registry Hives from backups in order to potentially extract credentials.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wbadmin.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='WBADMIN.EXE') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% recovery%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%recoveryTarget%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%itemtype:File%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: File Recovery From Backup Via Wbadmin.EXE

author: Timur Zinniatullin, oscd.community
description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via COMPRESS OBFUSCATION
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4103 AND ((Payload LIKE '%new-object%' ESCAPE '\' AND Payload LIKE '%text.encoding]::ascii%' ESCAPE '\') AND (Payload LIKE '%system.io.compression.deflatestream%' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%system.io.streamreader%' ESCAPE '\') AND Payload LIKE '%readtoend' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Invoke-Obfuscation COMPRESS OBFUSCATION - PowerShell Module

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects execution of the "cloudflared" tool with the tunnel "cleanup" flag in order to cleanup tunnel connections.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine LIKE '% tunnel %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%cleanup %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-config %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-connector-id %' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Cloudflared Tunnel Connections Cleanup

author: _pete_0, TheDFIRReport
description: Detects use of chcp to look up the system locale value as part of host discovery
falsepositives: During Anaconda update the 'conda.exe' process will eventually execution the 'chcp' command.
Discord was seen using chcp to look up code pages
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (ParentCommandLine LIKE '% -c %' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '% /c %' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '% –c %' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '% —c %' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '% ―c %' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '% -r %' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '% /r %' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '% –r %' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '% —r %' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '% ―r %' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '% -k %' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '% /k %' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '% –k %' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '% —k %' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '% ―k %' ESCAPE '\') AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\chcp.com' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%chcp' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%chcp ' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%chcp  ' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Console CodePage Lookup Via CHCP

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects when a user downloads a file by using CertOC.exe
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\certoc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='CertOC.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-GetCACAPS%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%http%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: File Download via CertOC.EXE

author: frack113
description: Open a handle on the drive volume via the \\.\ DOS device path specifier and perform direct access read of the first few bytes of the volume.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-Object%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%IO.FileStream%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%\\\\.\\%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Suspicious IO.FileStream

author: frack113
description: Detects usage of the "Import-Module" cmdlet to load the "Microsoft.ActiveDirectory.Management.dl" DLL. Which is often used by attackers to perform AD enumeration.
falsepositives: Legitimate use of the library for administrative activity
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Import-Module %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ipmo %' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%Microsoft.ActiveDirectory.Management.dll%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Potential Active Directory Enumeration Using AD Module - ProcCreation

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), KevTheHermit, fuzzyf10w
description: Detect Attempt PrintNightmare (CVE-2021-1675) Remote code execution in Windows Spooler Service
falsepositives: Account fallback reasons (after failed login with specific account)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Microsoft-Windows-SmbClient/Security' AND (EventID=31017 AND UserName='' AND ServerName LIKE '\\1%' ESCAPE '\')
title: Suspicious Rejected SMB Guest Logon From IP

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), frack113
description:
Detects PowerShell scripts that make use of the "Compress-Archive" Cmdlet in order to compress folders and files where the output is stored in a potentially suspicious location that is used often by malware for exfiltration.
An adversary might compress data (e.g., sensitive documents) that is collected prior to exfiltration in order to make it portable and minimize the amount of data sent over the network.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Windows PowerShell' AND (Data LIKE '%Compress-Archive -Path%-DestinationPath $env:TEMP%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%Compress-Archive -Path%-DestinationPath%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%Compress-Archive -Path%-DestinationPath%:\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\')
title: Zip A Folder With PowerShell For Staging In Temp - PowerShell

author: frack113
description: Detect usage of the "unregmp2.exe" binary as a proxy to launch a custom version of "wmpnscfg.exe"
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\unregmp2.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='unregmp2.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -HideWMP%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /HideWMP%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –HideWMP%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —HideWMP%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―HideWMP%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Lolbin Unregmp2.exe Use As Proxy

author: omkar72
description: Detects user accept agreement execution in psexec commandline
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\psexec.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='psexec.c'))
title: Psexec Execution

author: Roberto Rodriguez @Cyb3rWard0g
description: Detects remote PowerShell sections by monitoring for wsmprovhost (WinRM host process) as a parent or child process (sign of an active PowerShell remote session).
falsepositives: Legitimate usage of remote Powershell, e.g. for monitoring purposes.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wsmprovhost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\wsmprovhost.exe' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Remote PowerShell Session Host Process (WinRM)

author: Oddvar Moe, Sander Wiebing, oscd.community
description: Detects the import of the specified file to the registry with regedit.exe.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\regedit.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='REGEDIT.EXE') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% /i %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /s %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.reg%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE(((CommandLine LIKE '% -e %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /e %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –e %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —e %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―e %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -a %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /a %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –a %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —a %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―a %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -c %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /c %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –c %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —c %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―c %' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine REGEXP ':[^ \\]'), 0))))
title: Imports Registry Key From a File

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), frack113
description: Detects usage of the "Import-Module" cmdlet to load the "Microsoft.ActiveDirectory.Management.dl" DLL. Which is often used by attackers to perform AD enumeration.
falsepositives: Legitimate use of the library for administrative activity
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4103 AND ((Payload LIKE '%Import-Module %' ESCAPE '\' OR Payload LIKE '%ipmo %' ESCAPE '\') AND Payload LIKE '%Microsoft.ActiveDirectory.Management.dll%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Potential Active Directory Enumeration Using AD Module - PsModule

author: Teymur Kheirkhabarov (idea), Vasiliy Burov (rule), oscd.community, Tim Shelton
description: Detects usage of the "ConvertTo-SecureString" cmdlet via the commandline. Which is fairly uncommon and could indicate potential suspicious activity
falsepositives: Legitimate use to pass password to different powershell commands
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND CommandLine LIKE '%ConvertTo-SecureString%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: ConvertTo-SecureString Cmdlet Usage Via CommandLine

author: @Kostastsale
description:
Detects the use of MeshAgent to execute commands on the target host, particularly when threat actors might abuse it to execute commands directly.
MeshAgent can execute commands on the target host by leveraging win-console to obscure their activities and win-dispatcher to run malicious code through IPC with child processes.
falsepositives: False positives can be found in environments using MeshAgent for remote management, analysis should prioritize the grandparent process, MeshAgent.exe, and scrutinize the resulting child processes triggered by any suspicious interactive commands directed at the target host.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\meshagent.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Remote Access Tool - MeshAgent Command Execution via MeshCentral

author: Sajid Nawaz Khan
description:
Detects the enabling of the Windows Recall feature via registry manipulation. Windows Recall can be enabled by setting the value of "DisableAIDataAnalysis" to "0".
Adversaries may enable Windows Recall as part of post-exploitation discovery and collection activities.
This rule assumes that Recall is already explicitly disabled on the host, and subsequently enabled by the adversary.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\Software\\Policies\\Microsoft\\Windows\\WindowsAI\\DisableAIDataAnalysis' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue='DWORD (0x00000000)'))
title: Windows Recall Feature Enabled - Registry

author: X__Junior (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the execution of a renamed "CURL.exe" binary based on the PE metadata fields
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((OriginalFileName='curl.exe' OR Description='The curl executable') AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\curl%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Renamed CURL.EXE Execution

author: frack113
description:
An adversary may use legitimate desktop support and remote access software, such as Team Viewer, Go2Assist, LogMein, AmmyyAdmin, etc, to establish an interactive command and control channel to target systems within networks.
These services are commonly used as legitimate technical support software, and may be allowed by application control within a target environment.
Remote access tools like VNC, Ammyy, and Teamviewer are used frequently when compared with other legitimate software commonly used by adversaries. (Citation: Symantec Living off the Land)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (Description='NetSupport Client Configurator' OR Product='NetSupport Remote Control' OR Company='NetSupport Ltd' OR OriginalFileName='PCICFGUI.EXE'))
title: Remote Access Tool - NetSupport Execution

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects ScreenConnect program starts that establish a remote access to a system.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%e=Access&%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%y=Guest&%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%&p=%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%&c=%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%&k=%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Remote Access Tool - ScreenConnect Installation Execution

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects use of .NET InstallUtil.exe in order to download arbitrary files. The files will be written to "%LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows\INetCache\IE\"
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\InstallUtil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='InstallUtil.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%ftp://%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%http://%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%https://%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: File Download Via InstallUtil.EXE

author: Sreeman
description:
Detects applications trying to modify the registry in order to disable any write-protect property for storage devices.
This could be a precursor to a ransomware attack and has been an observed technique used by cypherpunk group.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\System\\CurrentControlSet\\Control%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%Write Protection%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%0%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%storage%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Write Protect For Storage Disabled

author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects the use of SFTP.exe to execute commands indirectly via ProxyCommand parameter.
Threat actors were seen leveraging this legitimate Windows binary to bypass security controls and execute arbitrary commands while evading detection.
falsepositives: Legitimate use of SFTP with proxy commands for administration or networking tasks
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\sftp.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%ProxyCommand=%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Indirect Command Execution via SFTP ProxyCommand

author: frack113
description: Detects the execution of Winscp from an a non standard folder. This could indicate the execution of Winscp portable.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\WinSCP.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='winscp.exe') AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Program Files (x86)\\WinSCP\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Winscp Execution From Non Standard Folder

author: frack113, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description:
An adversary might use WMI to check if a certain remote service is running on a remote device.
When the test completes, a service information will be displayed on the screen if it exists.
A common feedback message is that "No instance(s) Available" if the service queried is not running.
A common error message is "Node - (provided IP or default) ERROR Description =The RPC server is unavailable" if the provided remote host is unreachable
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\WMIC.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='wmic.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '%service%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE(((CommandLine LIKE '%stopservice%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%startservice%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%Change%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Create%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Delete%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%PauseService%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ResumeService%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%SetSecurityDescriptor%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%StartService%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%StopService%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%UserControlService%' ESCAPE '\')), 0))))
title: Service Reconnaissance Via Wmic.EXE

author: frack113, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the execution of WMIC to query information on a remote system
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\WMIC.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='wmic.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-node:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/node:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–node:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—node:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―node:%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%localhost%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%127.0.0.1%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: WMIC Remote Command Execution

author: frack113, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the execution of "gpg.exe" from uncommon location. Often used by ransomware and loaders to decrypt/encrypt data.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\gpg.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\gpg2.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR OriginalFileName='gpg.exe' OR Description='GnuPG’s OpenPGP tool') AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE '%:\\Program Files (x86)\\GNU\\GnuPG\\bin\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%:\\Program Files (x86)\\GnuPG VS-Desktop\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%:\\Program Files (x86)\\GnuPG\\bin\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%:\\Program Files (x86)\\Gpg4win\\bin\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Portable Gpg.EXE Execution

author: Daniel Koifman (KoifSec)
description: Detects the use of wmic.exe to modify user account settings and explicitly disable password expiration.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wmic.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='wmic.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%useraccount%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% set %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%passwordexpires%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%false%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Password Set to Never Expire via WMI

author: frack113, MatilJ
description:
Adversaries may abuse PowerShell commands and scripts for execution.
PowerShell is a powerful interactive command-line interface and scripting environment included in the Windows operating system. (Citation: TechNet PowerShell)
Adversaries can use PowerShell to perform a number of actions, including discovery of information and execution of code
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-Object%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-ComObject%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%MsXml2.%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%XmlHttp%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Powershell MsXml COM Object

author: frack113
description:
Adversaries may abuse msiexec.exe to proxy execution of malicious payloads.
Msiexec.exe is the command-line utility for the Windows Installer and is thus commonly associated with executing installation packages (.msi)
falsepositives: WindowsApps installing updates via the quiet flag
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\msiexec.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='msiexec.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-i%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/i%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–i%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—i%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―i%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-package%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/package%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–package%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—package%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―package%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-a%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/a%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–a%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—a%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―a%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-j%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/j%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–j%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—j%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―j%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-q%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/q%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–q%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—q%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―q%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR (ParentProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\CCM\\Ccm32BitLauncher.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (IntegrityLevel='System' OR IntegrityLevel='S-1-16-16384'))), 0)) AND (NOT COALESCE(((ParentProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Users\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR (ParentProcessName LIKE '%C:\\Windows\\System32\\wsl.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%C:\\Windows\\System32\\msiexec.exe' ESCAPE '\')), 0))))
title: Msiexec Quiet Installation

author: Liran Ravich
description: Detects a child process spawned by 'winrshost.exe', which suggests remote command execution through Windows Remote Shell (WinRs) and may indicate potential lateral movement activity.
falsepositives: Legitimate use of WinRM within the organization
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\winrshost.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\conhost.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Potential Lateral Movement via Windows Remote Shell

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects scheduled task creations or modification to be run with high privileges on a suspicious schedule type
falsepositives: Some installers were seen using this method of creation unfortunately. Filter them in your environment
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\schtasks.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='schtasks.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% ONLOGON %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ONSTART %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ONCE %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ONIDLE %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%NT AUT%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% SYSTEM%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%HIGHEST%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Suspicious Schtasks Schedule Type With High Privileges

author: Timur Zinniatullin, oscd.community
description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via COMPRESS OBFUSCATION
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4697 AND (ServiceFileName LIKE '%new-object%' ESCAPE '\' AND ServiceFileName LIKE '%text.encoding]::ascii%' ESCAPE '\' AND ServiceFileName LIKE '%readtoend%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ServiceFileName LIKE '%system.io.compression.deflatestream%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceFileName LIKE '%system.io.streamreader%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Invoke-Obfuscation COMPRESS OBFUSCATION - Security

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects execution of the "VMwareToolBoxCmd.exe" with the "script" and "set" flag to setup a specific script to run for a specific VM state
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\VMwareToolBoxCmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='toolbox-cmd.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% script %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% set %' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Potential Persistence Via VMwareToolBoxCmd.EXE VM State Change Script

author: frack113
description: Detect standard users login that are part of high privileged groups such as the Administrator group
falsepositives: Standard domain users who are part of the administrator group. These users shouldn't have these right. But in the case where it's necessary. They should be filtered out using the "TargetUserName" field
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Microsoft-Windows-LSA/Operational' AND ((EventID=300 AND TargetUserSid LIKE 'S-1-5-21-%' ESCAPE '\' AND (SidList LIKE '%S-1-5-32-544%' ESCAPE '\' OR SidList LIKE '%-500}%' ESCAPE '\' OR SidList LIKE '%-518}%' ESCAPE '\' OR SidList LIKE '%-519}%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((TargetUserSid LIKE '%-500' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetUserSid LIKE '%-518' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetUserSid LIKE '%-519' ESCAPE '\'), 0)))
title: Standard User In High Privileged Group

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), @Kostastsale
description: Detects potentially suspicious child processes launched via the ScreenConnect client service.
falsepositives: If the script being executed make use of any of the utilities mentioned in the detection then they should filtered out or allowed.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((ParentCommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\TEMP\\ScreenConnect\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%run.cmd%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\bitsadmin.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\curl.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\dllhost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\net.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\nltest.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wevtutil.exe' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Remote Access Tool - ScreenConnect Potential Suspicious Remote Command Execution

author: Cian Heasley
description: Detects Windows Pcap driver installation based on a list of associated .sys files.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4697 AND (ServiceFileName LIKE '%pcap%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceFileName LIKE '%npcap%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceFileName LIKE '%npf%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceFileName LIKE '%nm3%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceFileName LIKE '%ndiscap%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceFileName LIKE '%nmnt%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceFileName LIKE '%windivert%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceFileName LIKE '%USBPcap%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceFileName LIKE '%pktmon%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Windows Pcap Drivers

author: frack113
description: Adversaries may use Valid Accounts to interact with remote systems using Windows Remote Management (WinRM). The adversary may then perform actions as the logged-on user.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%invoke-command %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '% -ComputerName %' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Execute Invoke-command on Remote Host

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects usage of "appcmd" to create new global URL rewrite rules. This behaviour has been observed being used by threat actors to add new rules so they can access their webshells.
falsepositives: Legitimate usage of appcmd to add new URL rewrite rules
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\appcmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='appcmd.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%set%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%config%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%section:system.webServer/rewrite/globalRules%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%commit:%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Suspicious IIS URL GlobalRules Rewrite Via AppCmd

author: William Gokah (idea), Raylee Hawkins, Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects PowerShell command line arguments containing ADSI (Active Directory Service Interfaces) patterns
trying to create a new user account via the WinNT or LDAP provider. This is an uncommon method to create
user accounts and may indicate an attempt to evade detection by avoiding more commonly monitored commands
such as "net user", "New-LocalUser" or "New-ADUser".

author: frack113
description: Detect adversaries enumerate sensitive files
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ((ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ls%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%get-childitem%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%gci%' ESCAPE '\') AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-recurse%' ESCAPE '\' AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.pass%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.kdbx%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.kdb%' ESCAPE '\')))

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects uncommon child processes spawning from "sigverif.exe", which could indicate potential abuse of the latter as a living of the land binary in order to proxy execution.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\sigverif.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\WerFault.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\WerFault.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Uncommon Sigverif.EXE Child Process

author: frack113, Nasreddine Bencherchali
description: Detect usage of the "ssh.exe" binary as a proxy to launch other programs.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\OpenSSH\\sshd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\ssh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Product='OpenSSH for Windows' OR (Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=55b4964d29aad5438b9e950052dbbbc0%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=334d66c33503ccbf647c15b47c27eef4%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=27b0da080ef92afb37983d30d839141e%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=977eb4c263d384e47daa0712d34713ab%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=3eaadce9ae43d5a918bb082065815c3b%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=980fe6cf0d996ab1eedf877222e722aa%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=5f959422308ac3d721010d66647e100e%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=a49aaa3d03d1cd9c8dc7fca60f7f480b%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=dd335f759b6d5d6a8382b71dd9d65791%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%ProxyCommand=%' ESCAPE '\' OR (CommandLine LIKE '%PermitLocalCommand=yes%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% LocalCommand%' ESCAPE '\')))))

author: Christopher Peacock @securepeacock, SCYTHE @scythe_io
description: Detects enabling TurnOffCheck which can be used to bypass defense of MSDT Follina vulnerability
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\Policies\\Microsoft\\Windows\\ScriptedDiagnostics\\TurnOffCheck' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue='DWORD (0x00000001)'))
title: Scripted Diagnostics Turn Off Check Enabled - Registry

author: @kostastsale
description: Detects the execution of the Ammy Admin RMM agent for remote management.
falsepositives: Legitimate use of Ammy Admin RMM agent for remote management by admins.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%AMMYY\\aa\_nts.dll",run%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Remote Access Tool - Ammy Admin Agent Execution

author: omkar72
description: Detects uncommon "conhost" child processes. This could be a sign of "conhost" usage as a LOLBIN or potential process injection activity.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\conhost.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\conhost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName IS NULL OR NewProcessName=''), 0)) AND (NOT COALESCE((Provider_Name='SystemTraceProvider-Process'), 0))))
title: Uncommon Child Process Of Conhost.EXE

author: sam0x90
description: Conti recommendation to its affiliates to use esentutl to access NTDS dumped file. Trickbot also uses this utilities to get MSEdge info via its module pwgrab.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%esentutl%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% /p%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Esentutl Gather Credentials

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the creation of a registry value in the ".wav\OpenWithProgIds" key with an uncommon name. This could be related to SNAKE Malware as reported by CISA
falsepositives: Some additional tuning might be required to tune out legitimate processes that write to this key by default
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Classes\\.wav\\OpenWithProgIds\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((TargetObject LIKE '%.AssocFile.WAV' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%.wav.%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Potential Encrypted Registry Blob Related To SNAKE Malware

author: Timur Zinniatullin, oscd.community
description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via COMPRESS OBFUSCATION
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%new-object%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%text.encoding]::ascii%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%system.io.compression.deflatestream%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%system.io.streamreader%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%readtoend(%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Invoke-Obfuscation COMPRESS OBFUSCATION

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), memory-shards
description: Detects execution of the AgentExecutor.exe binary. Which can be abused as a LOLBIN to execute powershell scripts with the ExecutionPolicy "Bypass" or any binary named "powershell.exe" located in the path provided by 6th positional argument
falsepositives: Legitimate use via Intune management. You exclude script paths and names to reduce FP rate
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '\\AgentExecutor.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='AgentExecutor.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -powershell%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -remediationScript%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\Microsoft.Management.Services.IntuneWindowsAgent.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: AgentExecutor PowerShell Execution

author: @kostastsale
description:
Detects the OpenEDR ssh-shellhost.exe spawning a command shell (cmd.exe) or PowerShell with PTY (pseudo-terminal) capabilities.
This may indicate remote command execution through OpenEDR's remote management features, which could be legitimate administrative activity or potential abuse of the remote access tool.
Threat actors may leverage OpenEDR's remote shell capabilities to execute commands on compromised systems, facilitating lateral movement or other command-and-control operations.
falsepositives: Legitimate use of OpenEDR for remote command execution
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\ITSMService.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\ssh-shellhost.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%--pty%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%bash%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%powershell%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%pwsh%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: OpenEDR Spawning Command Shell

author: frack113
description: Detects execution from an Alternate Data Stream (ADS). Adversaries may use NTFS file attributes to hide their malicious data in order to evade detection
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%txt:%' ESCAPE '\' AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%type %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% > %' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%makecab %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.cab%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%reg %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% export %' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%regedit %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% /E %' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%esentutl %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% /y %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% /d %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% /o %' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Execute From Alternate Data Streams

author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects suspicious registry modifications made by suspicious processes such as script engine processes such as WScript, or CScript etc.
These processes are rarely used for legitimate registry modifications, and their activity may indicate an attempt to modify the registry
without using standard tools like regedit.exe or reg.exe, potentially for evasion and persistence.
falsepositives: Some legitimate admin or install scripts may use these processes for registry modifications.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND (OperationType='New registry value created' OR OperationType='Existing registry value modified')) AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((NewValue='Binary Data' OR NewValue IS NULL OR (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (TargetObject LIKE '%SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Notifications\\Data\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\Services\\bam\\State\\UserSettings\\S-1-%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%Software\\Microsoft\\Windows Script\\Settings\\Telemetry\\wscript.exe\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Internet Settings\\%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\wscript.exe%' ESCAPE '\')), 0))))
title: Registry Tampering by Potentially Suspicious Processes

description: Detects child processes of "provlaunch.exe" which might indicate potential abuse to proxy execution.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\provlaunch.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE(((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\calc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\notepad.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (NewProcessName LIKE '%:\\PerfLogs\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%:\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%:\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\AppData\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\Windows\\System32\\Tasks\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\Windows\\Tasks\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\')), 0))))

Threat actors abused older vulnerable versions to manipulate system processes.
falsepositives: While sometimes 'Process Hacker is used by legitimate administrators, the execution of Process Hacker must be investigated and allowed on a case by case basis
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\ProcessHacker\_%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\ProcessHacker.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR (OriginalFileName='ProcessHacker.exe' OR OriginalFileName='Process Hacker') OR Description='Process Hacker' OR Product='Process Hacker' OR (Hashes LIKE '%MD5=68F9B52895F4D34E74112F3129B3B00D%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%MD5=B365AF317AE730A67C936F21432B9C71%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%SHA1=A0BDFAC3CE1880B32FF9B696458327CE352E3B1D%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%SHA1=C5E2018BF7C0F314FED4FD7FE7E69FA2E648359E%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%SHA256=D4A0FE56316A2C45B9BA9AC1005363309A3EDC7ACF9E4DF64D326A0FF273E80F%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%SHA256=BD2C2CF0631D881ED382817AFCCE2B093F4E412FFB170A719E2762F250ABFEA4%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=3695333C60DEDECDCAFF1590409AA462%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=04DE0AD9C37EB7BD52043D2ECAC958DF%' ESCAPE '\')))

ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Users\\All Users\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Users\\Default\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Users\\Public%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Temp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Roaming\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%AppData\%%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%Public\%%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (ParentCommandLine LIKE '%\\svchost.exe -k netsvcs -p -s Schedule' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Perflogs%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Temp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Users\\Public%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%Public\%%' ESCAPE '\'))) AND (NOT COALESCE(((ParentCommandLine LIKE '%unattended.ini%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%update\_task.xml%' ESCAPE '\') OR CommandLine LIKE '%/Create /TN TVInstallRestore /TR%' ESCAPE '\' OR (CommandLine LIKE '%/Create /Xml %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\Temp\\.CR.%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\Avira\_Security\_Installation.xml%' ESCAPE '\') OR ((CommandLine LIKE '%/Create /F /TN%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/Xml %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%Avira\_%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%.tmp\\UpdateFallbackTask.xml%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.tmp\\WatchdogServiceControlManagerTimeout.xml%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.tmp\\SystrayAutostart.xml%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.tmp\\MaintenanceTask.xml%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (CommandLine LIKE '%\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/Create /TN "klcp\_update" /XML %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\klcp\_update\_task.xml%' ESCAPE '\')), 0))))
title: Schedule Task Creation From Env Variable Or Potentially Suspicious Path Via Schtasks.EXE

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects usage of OpenConsole binary as a LOLBIN to launch other binaries to bypass application Whitelisting
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((OriginalFileName='OpenConsole.exe' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\OpenConsole.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\WindowsApps\\Microsoft.WindowsTerminal%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Use of OpenConsole

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects usage of Msiexec.exe to install packages hosted remotely quietly
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\msiexec.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='msiexec.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-i%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/i%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–i%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—i%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―i%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-package%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/package%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–package%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—package%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―package%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-a%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/a%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–a%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—a%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―a%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-j%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/j%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–j%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—j%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―j%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-q%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/q%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–q%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—q%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―q%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%http%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\\\%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\OpenOffice%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%Installation Files\\openoffice%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Suspicious Msiexec Quiet Install From Remote Location

author: Sajid Nawaz Khan
description:
Detects the enabling of the Windows Recall feature via registry manipulation.
Windows Recall can be enabled by deleting the existing "DisableAIDataAnalysis" value, or setting it to 0.
Adversaries may enable Windows Recall as part of post-exploitation discovery and collection activities.
This rule assumes that Recall is already explicitly disabled on the host, and subsequently enabled by the adversary.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='reg.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Microsoft\\Windows\\WindowsAI%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%DisableAIDataAnalysis%' ESCAPE '\') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%add%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%0%' ESCAPE '\') OR CommandLine LIKE '%delete%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Windows Recall Feature Enabled Via Reg.EXE

author: Beyu Denis, oscd.community
description:
Detects the execution of Dnx.EXE. The Dnx utility allows for the execution of C# code.
Attackers might abuse this in order to bypass application whitelisting.
falsepositives: Legitimate use of dnx.exe by legitimate user
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\dnx.exe' ESCAPE '\')
title: Potential Application Whitelisting Bypass via Dnx.EXE

author: X__Junior (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects potential "ShellDispatch.dll" functionality abuse to execute arbitrary binaries via "ShellExecute"
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='RUNDLL32.EXE') AND CommandLine LIKE '%RunDll\_ShellExecuteW%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Potential ShellDispatch.DLL Functionality Abuse

author: Tobias Michalski (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the Installation of a Exchange Transport Agent
falsepositives: Legitimate installations of exchange TransportAgents. AssemblyPath is a good indicator for this.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND CommandLine LIKE '%Install-TransportAgent%' ESCAPE '\')
title: MSExchange Transport Agent Installation

author: E.M. Anhaus (originally from Atomic Blue Detections, Endgame), oscd.community
description: Detect attacker collecting audio via SoundRecorder application.
falsepositives: Legitimate audio capture by legitimate user.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\SoundRecorder.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/FILE%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Audio Capture via SoundRecorder

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects suspicious application installed by looking at the added shortcut to the app resolver cache
falsepositives: Packages or applications being legitimately used by users or administrators
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Microsoft-Windows-Shell-Core/Operational' AND ((EventID=28115 AND (Name LIKE '%Zenmap%' ESCAPE '\' OR Name LIKE '%AnyDesk%' ESCAPE '\' OR Name LIKE '%wireshark%' ESCAPE '\' OR Name LIKE '%openvpn%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=28115 AND (AppID LIKE '%zenmap.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR AppID LIKE '%prokzult ad%' ESCAPE '\' OR AppID LIKE '%wireshark%' ESCAPE '\' OR AppID LIKE '%openvpn%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Suspicious Application Installed

author: frack113
description: Detects MsiExec loading a DLL and calling its DllUnregisterServer function
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\msiexec.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName LIKE '\\msiexec.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -z %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /z %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –z %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —z %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―z %' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: DllUnregisterServer Function Call Via Msiexec.EXE

author: frack113, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the use of "Ilasm.EXE" in order to compile C# intermediate (IL) code to EXE or DLL.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\ilasm.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='ilasm.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% /dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /exe%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: C# IL Code Compilation Via Ilasm.EXE

author: Timur Zinniatullin, oscd.community
description:
Winlogon.exe is a Windows component responsible for actions at logon/logoff as well as the secure attention sequence (SAS) triggered by Ctrl-Alt-Delete.
Registry entries in HKLM\Software[Wow6432Node]Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon\ and HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon\ are
used to manage additional helper programs and functionalities that support Winlogon. Malicious modifications to these Registry keys may cause Winlogon to
load and execute malicious DLLs and/or executables.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%CurrentVersion\\Winlogon%' ESCAPE '\' AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%New-Item%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Winlogon Helper DLL

author: Microsoft (idea), Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects potentially suspicious inline JavaScript execution using Node.js with specific keywords in the command line.
falsepositives: Legitimate scripts using Node.js with these modules
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\node.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='node.exe' OR Product='Node.js') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%http%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%execSync%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%spawn%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%fs%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%path%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%zlib%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Potentially Suspicious Inline JavaScript Execution via NodeJS Binary

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), oscd.community, Teymur Kheirkhabarov @HeirhabarovT, Zach Stanford @svch0st, Nasreddine Bencherchali
description: Detects a copy command or a copy utility execution to or from an Admin share or remote
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%\\\\%\\%$%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Sysvol\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\robocopy.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\xcopy.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='robocopy.exe' OR OriginalFileName='XCOPY.EXE')) OR ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='Cmd.Exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '%copy%' ESCAPE '\') OR (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell\_ise.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe%' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName LIKE 'powershell\_ise.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%copy-item%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%copy %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cpi %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% cp %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%move %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% move-item%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% mi %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% mv %' ESCAPE '\')))))
title: Copy From Or To Admin Share Or Sysvol Folder

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), frack113
description:
Detects PowerShell scripts that make use of the "Compress-Archive" Cmdlet in order to compress folders and files where the output is stored in a potentially suspicious location that is used often by malware for exfiltration.
An adversary might compress data (e.g., sensitive documents) that is collected prior to exfiltration in order to make it portable and minimize the amount of data sent over the network.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Compress-Archive -Path%-DestinationPath $env:TEMP%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Compress-Archive -Path%-DestinationPath%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Compress-Archive -Path%-DestinationPath%:\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Folder Compress To Potentially Suspicious Output Via Compress-Archive Cmdlet

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), Stephen Lincoln @slincoln-aiq (AttackIQ)
description:
Detects registry value settings that would replace the user's desktop background.
This is a common technique used by malware to change the desktop background to a ransom note or other image.
falsepositives: Administrative scripts that change the desktop background to a company logo or other image.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND ((TargetObject LIKE '%Control Panel\\Desktop%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%CurrentVersion\\Policies\\ActiveDesktop%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%CurrentVersion\\Policies\\System%' ESCAPE '\') AND ((TargetObject LIKE '%NoChangingWallpaper' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue='DWORD (0x00000001)') OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\Wallpaper' ESCAPE '\' OR (TargetObject LIKE '%\\WallpaperStyle' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue='2')) AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\svchost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR (TargetObject LIKE '%\\Control Panel\\Desktop\\Wallpaper' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue='(Empty)') OR NewProcessName LIKE '%C:\\Windows\\Explorer.EXE' ESCAPE '\'), 0)) AND (NOT COALESCE(((NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\Amazon\\EC2Launch\\EC2Launch.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Amazon\\EC2Launch\\EC2Launch.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\Control Panel\\Desktop\\Wallpaper' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Potentially Suspicious Desktop Background Change Via Registry

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detect the use of "sc.exe" to change the startup type of a service to "disabled" or "demand"
falsepositives: False positives may occur with troubleshooting scripts
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\sc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='sc.exe') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '% config %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%start%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%disabled%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%demand%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Service StartupType Change Via Sc.EXE

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects Remote Utilities Host service installation on the target system.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='System' AND ((Provider_Name='Service Control Manager' AND EventID=7045) AND ((ImagePath LIKE '%\\rutserv.exe%' ESCAPE '\' AND ImagePath LIKE '%-service%' ESCAPE '\') OR ServiceName='Remote Utilities - Host'))
title: Remote Utilities Host Service Install

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects execution of "curl.exe" with a potential custom "User-Agent". Attackers can leverage this to download or exfiltrate data via "curl" to a domain that only accept specific "User-Agent" strings
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\curl.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='curl.exe') AND (CommandLine REGEXP '\s-H\s' OR CommandLine LIKE '%--header%' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%User-Agent:%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Curl Web Request With Potential Custom User-Agent

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects Winword starting uncommon sub process FLTLDR.exe as used in exploits for CVE-2017-0261 and CVE-2017-0262
falsepositives: Several false positives identified, check for suspicious file names or locations (e.g. Temp folders)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\WINWORD.EXE' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\FLTLDR.exe%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Exploit for CVE-2017-0261

author: X__Junior (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the creation of a schtasks that potentially executes a payload stored in the Windows Registry using PowerShell.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\schtasks.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='schtasks.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '%/Create%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Get-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% gp %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%HKCU:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%HKLM:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%registry::%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%HKEY\_%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%FromBase64String%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%encodedcommand%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Scheduled Task Executing Payload from Registry

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects regsvr32 execution to download/install/register new DLLs that are hosted on Web or FTP servers.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='REGSVR32.EXE') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% /i%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -i%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%ftp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%http%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Potentially Suspicious Regsvr32 HTTP/FTP Pattern

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects updates to Sysmon's configuration. Attackers might update or replace the Sysmon configuration with a bare bone one to avoid monitoring without shutting down the service completely
falsepositives: Legitimate administrators might use this command to update Sysmon configuration.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\Sysmon64.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\Sysmon64a.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\Sysmon.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR Description='System activity monitor') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-c%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/c%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–c%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—c%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―c%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Sysmon Configuration Update

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects processes that query known 3rd party registry keys that holds credentials via commandline
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\Aerofox\\Foxmail\\V3.1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\Aerofox\\FoxmailPreview%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\DownloadManager\\Passwords%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\FTPWare\\COREFTP\\Sites%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\IncrediMail\\Identities%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\Martin Prikryl\\WinSCP 2\\Sessions%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\Mobatek\\MobaXterm\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\OpenSSH\\Agent\\Keys%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\OpenVPN-GUI\\configs%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\ORL\\WinVNC3\\Password%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\Qualcomm\\Eudora\\CommandLine%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\RealVNC\\WinVNC4%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\RimArts\\B2\\Settings%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\SimonTatham\\PuTTY\\Sessions%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\SimonTatham\\PuTTY\\SshHostKeys\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\Sota\\FFFTP%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\TightVNC\\Server%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\WOW6432Node\\Radmin\\v3.0\\Server\\Parameters\\Radmin%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE '%reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%export%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%save%' ESCAPE '\')), 0))))
title: Enumeration for 3rd Party Creds From CLI

author: frack113
description: Detects changing the PowerShell script execution policy to a potentially insecure level using the "-ExecutionPolicy" flag.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((((OriginalFileName LIKE 'powershell\_ise.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll') OR (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell\_ise.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-executionpolicy %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -ep %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -exec %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Bypass%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Unrestricted%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE(((ParentProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\msiexec.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\msiexec.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\PowerShell\\7\\%' ESCAPE '\')), 0)) AND (NOT COALESCE(((ParentProcessName LIKE '%C:\\Program Files\\Avast Software\\Avast\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Avast Software\\Avast\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\instup.exe%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-ExecutionPolicy ByPass -File "C:\\Program Files\\Avast Software\\Avast%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-ExecutionPolicy ByPass -File "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Avast Software\\Avast\\%' ESCAPE '\')), 0))))
title: Change PowerShell Policies to an Insecure Level

author: Jason Mull
description: Detects "BugCheck" errors indicating the system rebooted due to a crash, capturing the bugcheck code, dump file path, and report ID.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='System' AND (Provider_Name='Microsoft-Windows-WER-SystemErrorReporting' AND EventID=1001)
title: Crash Dump Created By Operating System

author: frack113
description:
An adversary may use legitimate desktop support and remote access software, such as Team Viewer, Go2Assist, LogMein, AmmyyAdmin, etc, to establish an interactive command and control channel to target systems within networks.
These services are commonly used as legitimate technical support software, and may be allowed by application control within a target environment.
Remote access tools like VNC, Ammyy, and Teamviewer are used frequently when compared with other legitimate software commonly used by adversaries. (Citation: Symantec Living off the Land)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (Product='UltraViewer' OR Company='DucFabulous Co,ltd' OR OriginalFileName LIKE 'UltraViewer\_Desktop.exe' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Remote Access Tool - UltraViewer Execution

author: Aedan Russell, frack113, X__Junior (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects a Chromium based browser process with the 'load-extension' flag to start a instance with a custom extension
falsepositives: Usage of Chrome Extensions in testing tools such as BurpSuite will trigger this alert
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\brave.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\chrome.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\msedge.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\opera.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\vivaldi.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%--load-extension=%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Chromium Browser Instance Executed With Custom Extension

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the execution of a renamed Microsoft Teams binary.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((OriginalFileName='msteams.exe' OR OriginalFileName='teams.exe') AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\msteams.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\teams.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Renamed Microsoft Teams Execution

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects an appx package deployment / installation with the error code "0x80073cff" which indicates that the package didn't meet the signing requirements.
falsepositives: Legitimate AppX packages not signed by MS used part of an enterprise.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Microsoft-Windows-AppXDeploymentServer/Operational' AND (EventID=401 AND ErrorCode='0x80073cff')
title: AppX Package Deployment Failed Due to Signing Requirements

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects execution of python using the "-c" flag. This is could be used as a way to launch a reverse shell or execute live python code.
falsepositives: Python libraries that use a flag starting with "-c". Filter according to your environment
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((OriginalFileName='python.exe' OR (NewProcessName LIKE '%python.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%python3.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%python2.exe' ESCAPE '\')) AND CommandLine LIKE '% -c%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((((ParentProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\Python%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Python%' ESCAPE '\') AND ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\python.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%-E -s -m ensurepip -U --default-pip%' ESCAPE '\') OR ((ParentProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\Python%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Python%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-W ignore::DeprecationWarning%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%[''install'', ''--no-cache-dir'', ''--no-index'', ''--find-links'',%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%''--upgrade'', ''pip''%' ESCAPE '\'))), 0)) AND (NOT COALESCE(((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Programs\\Microsoft VS Code\\Code.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR (ParentProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\Microsoft VS Code\\Code.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Microsoft VS Code\\Code.exe' ESCAPE '\')) OR (CommandLine LIKE '%<pip-setuptools-caller>%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%exec(compile(%' ESCAPE '\')), 0))))
title: Python Inline Command Execution

author: frack113, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects the deletion of backups or system state backups via "wbadmin.exe".
This technique is used by numerous ransomware families and actors.
This may only be successful on server platforms that have Windows Backup enabled.
falsepositives: Legitimate backup activity from administration scripts and software.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wbadmin.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='WBADMIN.EXE') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%delete %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%backup%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%keepVersions:0%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Windows Backup Deleted Via Wbadmin.EXE

author: Tim Rauch, Elastic (idea)
description: Detects potential use of an SSH utility to establish RDP over a reverse SSH Tunnel. This can be used by attackers to enable routing of network packets that would otherwise not reach their intended destination.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%:3389%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -L %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -P %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -R %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -pw %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -ssh %' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Potential Remote Desktop Tunneling

author: frack113
description: Detects a Sysmon configuration change, which could be the result of a legitimate reconfiguration or someone trying manipulate the configuration
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational' AND EventID=16
title: Sysmon Configuration Change

author: Omar Khaled (@beacon_exe)
description: Detects DNS queries for subdomains related to "Put.io" sharing website.
falsepositives: Legitimate DNS queries and usage of Put.io
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Microsoft-Windows-DNS Client Events/Operational' AND (EventID=3008 AND (QueryName LIKE '%api.put.io%' ESCAPE '\' OR QueryName LIKE '%upload.put.io%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: DNS Query To Put.io - DNS Client

author: frack113
description: Detects suspicious Powershell code that execute COM Objects
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%::GetTypeFromCLSID(%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.ShellExecute(%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Suspicious GetTypeFromCLSID ShellExecute

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects modification of LSA PPL protection settings via CommandLine.
It may indicate an attempt to disable protection and enable credential dumping tools to access LSASS process memory.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='reg.exe' OR OriginalFileName='powershell.exe' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%ControlSet%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\Control\\Lsa%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Set-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%New-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% add %' ESCAPE '\')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%IsPplAutoEnabled%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%RunAsPPL%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%RunAsPPLBoot%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: LSA PPL Protection Setting Modification via CommandLine

author: Stephen Lincoln @slincoln-aiq (AttackIQ)
description:
Detects the execution of "reg.exe" to alter registry keys that would replace the user's desktop background.
