author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects suspicious sysprep process start with AppData folder as target (as used by Trojan Syndicasec in Thrip report by Symantec)
falsepositives: False positives depend on scripts and administrative tools used in the monitored environment
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\sysprep.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Sysprep on AppData Folder

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects execution of the Notepad++ updater (gup) to launch other commands or executables
falsepositives: Other parent binaries using GUP not currently identified
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\gup.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\explorer.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE(((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\explorer.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\Notepad++\\notepad++.exe%' ESCAPE '\') OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\Notepad++\\updater\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine IS NULL), 0))))
title: Arbitrary Binary Execution Using GUP Utility

author: frack113
description: Detect use of PDQ Deploy remote admin tool
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (Description='PDQ Deploy Console' OR Product='PDQ Deploy' OR Company='PDQ.com' OR OriginalFileName='PDQDeployConsole.exe'))
title: PDQ Deploy Remote Adminstartion Tool Execution

author: Victor Sergeev, Daniil Yugoslavskiy, Gleb Sukhodolskiy, Timur Zinniatullin, oscd.community, Tim Shelton, frack113 (split)
description: Detects modification of autostart extensibility point (ASEP) in registry.
falsepositives: Legitimate software automatically (mostly, during installation) sets up autorun keys for legitimate reason
Legitimate administrator sets up autorun keys for legitimate reason
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\System\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\WinSock2\\Parameters%' ESCAPE '\' AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\Protocol\_Catalog9\\Catalog\_Entries%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\NameSpace\_Catalog5\\Catalog\_Entries%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((NewValue='(Empty)' OR NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\MsiExec.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\syswow64\\MsiExec.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: WinSock2 Autorun Keys Modification

author: Roberto Rodriguez @Cyb3rWard0g
description: Detects alternate PowerShell hosts potentially bypassing detections looking for powershell.exe
falsepositives: Programs using PowerShell directly without invocation of a dedicated interpreter
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Windows PowerShell' AND (EventID=400 AND (Data LIKE '%HostApplication=%' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((Data LIKE '%HostApplication=_:/Windows/System32/WindowsPowerShell/v1.0/powershell%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%HostApplication=_:/Windows/SysWOW64/WindowsPowerShell/v1.0/powershell%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%HostApplication=_:\\Windows\\System32\\sdiagnhost.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%HostApplication=_:\\Windows\\System32\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\powershell%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%HostApplication=_:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\sdiagnhost.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%HostApplication=_:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\powershell%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%HostApplication=powershell%' ESCAPE '\'), 0)) AND (NOT COALESCE((Data LIKE '%Citrix\\ConfigSync\\ConfigSync.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%HostApplication=C:\\Hexnode\\Hexnode Agent\\Current\\HexnodeAgent.exe%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Uncommon PowerShell Hosts

author: frack113
description: Detects attempts of decoding a base64 Gzip archive via PowerShell. This technique is often used as a method to load malicious content into memory afterward.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%FromBase64String%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%MemoryStream%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%H4sI%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Suspicious FromBase64String Usage On Gzip Archive - Process Creation

author: David Faiss
description:
Detects the invocation of vshadow.exe with the -exec parameter that executes a specified script or command after the shadow copies are created but before the VShadow tool exits.
VShadow is a command-line tool that you can use to create and manage volume shadow copies. While legitimate backup or administrative scripts may use this flag,
attackers can leverage this parameter to proxy the execution of malware.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\vshadow.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='vshadow.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '%-exec%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Proxy Execution via Vshadow

author: Beyu Denis, oscd.community
description: Detects execution of arbitrary DLLs or unsigned code via a ".csproj" files via Dotnet.EXE.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\dotnet.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='.NET Host') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%.csproj' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.csproj"' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dll' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dll"' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.csproj''' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dll''' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE(((ParentProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Notepad++\\notepad++.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\Notepad++\\notepad++.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\ProgramData\\CSScriptNpp\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-cscs\_path:%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\cs-script\\cscs.dll%' ESCAPE '\')), 0))))
title: Arbitrary DLL or Csproj Code Execution Via Dotnet.EXE

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects execution of php using the "-r" flag. This is could be used as a way to launch a reverse shell or execute live php code.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\php.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='php.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '% -r%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Php Inline Command Execution

author: Andreas Braathen (mnemonic.io)
description: Detects when the DLL export function 'DllRegisterServer' is called in the commandline by Rundll32 explicitly where the DLL is located in a non-standard path.
falsepositives: Legitimate usage as part of application installation, but less likely from e.g. temporary paths.
Not every instance is considered malicious, but this rule will capture the malicious usages.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='RUNDLL32.EXE') AND CommandLine LIKE '%DllRegisterServer%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Program Files (x86)%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Program Files\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Rundll32.EXE Calling DllRegisterServer Export Function Explicitly

author: frack113
description:
An adversary may use legitimate desktop support and remote access software, such as Team Viewer, Go2Assist, LogMein, AmmyyAdmin, etc, to establish an interactive command and control channel to target systems within networks.
These services are commonly used as legitimate technical support software, and may be allowed by application control within a target environment.
Remote access tools like VNC, Ammyy, and Teamviewer are used frequently when compared with other legitimate software commonly used by adversaries. (Citation: Symantec Living off the Land)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (Description='LMIGuardianSvc' OR Product='LMIGuardianSvc' OR Company='LogMeIn, Inc.'))
title: Remote Access Tool - LogMeIn Execution

author: frack113, Duc.Le-GTSC
description:
Adversaries may employ various system checks to detect and avoid virtualization and analysis environments.
This may include changing behaviors based on the results of checks for the presence of artifacts indicative of a virtual machine environment (VME) or sandbox
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ((ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-WmiObject%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%gwmi%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%MSAcpi\_ThermalZoneTemperature%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Win32\_ComputerSystem%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Powershell Detect Virtualization Environment

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), omkar72, @svch0st, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects suspicious reconnaissance command line activity on Windows systems using Net.EXE
Check if the user that executed the commands is suspicious (e.g. service accounts, LOCAL_SYSTEM)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\net.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\net1.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='net.exe' OR OriginalFileName='net1.exe')) AND ((((CommandLine LIKE '% group %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% localgroup %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%domain admins%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% administrator%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% administrateur%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%enterprise admins%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Exchange Trusted Subsystem%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Remote Desktop Users%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Utilisateurs du Bureau à distance%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Usuarios de escritorio remoto%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /do%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '% /add%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))) OR (CommandLine LIKE '% accounts %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% /do%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Suspicious Group And Account Reconnaissance Activity Using Net.EXE

author: Roberto Rodriguez (Cyb3rWard0g), OTR (Open Threat Research)
description: A General detection for sdclt spawning new processes. This could be an indicator of sdclt being used for bypass UAC techniques.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\sdclt.exe' ESCAPE '\')
title: Sdclt Child Processes

author: frack113
description:
Detects the execution of powershell scripts with calls to the "Start-NetEventSession" cmdlet. Which allows an attacker to start event and packet capture for a network event session.
Adversaries may attempt to capture network to gather information over the course of an operation.
Data captured via this technique may include user credentials, especially those sent over an insecure, unencrypted protocol.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Start-NetEventSession%' ESCAPE '\')
title: Potential Packet Capture Activity Via Start-NetEventSession - ScriptBlock

author: Roberto Rodriguez @Cyb3rWard0g, Tim Shelton
description: Detects non-system users performing privileged operation os the SCM database
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4674 AND ObjectType LIKE 'SC\_MANAGER OBJECT' ESCAPE '\' AND ObjectName='servicesactive' AND PrivilegeList='SeTakeOwnershipPrivilege') AND (NOT COALESCE((SubjectLogonId='0x3e4' AND ProcessName LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\services.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0)))
title: SCM Database Privileged Operation

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), frack113
description:
Detects PowerShell scripts that make use of the "Compress-Archive" Cmdlet in order to compress folders and files where the output is stored in a potentially suspicious location that is used often by malware for exfiltration.
An adversary might compress data (e.g., sensitive documents) that is collected prior to exfiltration in order to make it portable and minimize the amount of data sent over the network.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4103 AND (ContextInfo LIKE '%Compress-Archive -Path%-DestinationPath $env:TEMP%' ESCAPE '\' AND ContextInfo LIKE '%Compress-Archive -Path%-DestinationPath%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND ContextInfo LIKE '%Compress-Archive -Path%-DestinationPath%:\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Zip A Folder With PowerShell For Staging In Temp  - PowerShell Module

author: Daniel Koifman (KoifSec), Michael Vilshin
description:
Detects attempts to disable windows recovery environment using Reagentc.
ReAgentc.exe is a command-line tool in Windows used to manage the Windows Recovery Environment (WinRE).
It allows users to enable, disable, and configure WinRE, which is used for troubleshooting and repairing common boot issues.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\reagentc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='reagentc.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-disable%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/disable%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–disable%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—disable%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―disable%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Windows Recovery Environment Disabled Via Reagentc

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects usage of the Get-ADComputer cmdlet to collect computer information and output it to a file
falsepositives: Legitimate admin scripts may use the same technique, it's better to exclude specific computers or users who execute these commands or scripts often
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ((ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-ADComputer %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '% -Filter *%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '% | Select %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Out-File%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-Content%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Add-Content%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Computer Discovery And Export Via Get-ADComputer Cmdlet - PowerShell

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), GossiTheDog, frack113
description: Detects execution of msdt.exe using the "cab" flag which could indicates suspicious diagcab files with embedded answer files leveraging CVE-2022-30190
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\msdt.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='msdt.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -cab %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /cab %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –cab %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —cab %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―cab %' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Suspicious Cabinet File Execution Via Msdt.EXE

author: frack113
description: Detect modification of TreatAs key to enable "rundll32.exe -sta" command
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%TreatAs\\(Default)' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE(((NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\Common Files\\Microsoft Shared\\ClickToRun\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\OfficeClickToRun.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\Microsoft Office\\root\\integration\\integrator.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Microsoft Office\\root\\integration\\integrator.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\system32\\svchost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR (NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\system32\\msiexec.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\msiexec.exe' ESCAPE '\')), 0))))
title: COM Hijacking via TreatAs

'C:\\ProgramData\\chocolatey\\tools\\shimgen.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '%\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\Windows Defender Advanced Threat Protection%' ESCAPE '\' OR (ParentCommandLine LIKE
