author: TropChaud
description:
Detects the use of the Group Policy Management Editor (GPME) to modify Default Domain or Default Domain Controllers Group Policy Objects (GPOs).
Adversaries may leverage GPME to make stealthy changes in these default GPOs to deploy malicious GPOs configurations across the domain without raising suspicion.
falsepositives: Legitimate use of GPME to modify GPOs
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\mmc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='MMC.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%gpme.msc%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%gpobject:%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%31B2F340-016D-11D2-945F-00C04FB984F9%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%6AC1786C-016F-11D2-945F-00C04FB984F9%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Windows Default Domain GPO Modification via GPME

author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel, Elastic (idea)
description: Detects the creation of a scheduled task using the "-XML" flag with a file without the '.xml' extension. This behavior could be indicative of potential defense evasion attempt during persistence
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\schtasks.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='schtasks.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/create%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-create%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/xml%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-xml%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%.xml%' ESCAPE '\' OR (IntegrityLevel='System' OR IntegrityLevel='S-1-16-16384') OR (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (ParentCommandLine LIKE '%:\\WINDOWS\\Installer\\MSI%' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%.tmp,zzzzInvokeManagedCustomActionOutOfProc%' ESCAPE '\'))), 0)) AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentProcessName LIKE '%:\\ProgramData\\OEM\\UpgradeTool\\CareCenter\_%\\BUnzip\\Setup\_msi.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%:\\Program Files\\Axis Communications\\AXIS Camera Station\\SetupActions.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%:\\Program Files\\Axis Communications\\AXIS Device Manager\\AdmSetupActions.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%:\\Program Files (x86)\\Zemana\\AntiMalware\\AntiMalware.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%:\\Program Files\\Dell\\SupportAssist\\pcdrcui.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Suspicious Scheduled Task Creation via Masqueraded XML File

author: frack113, Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects registry modifications to the 'ms-settings' protocol handler, which is frequently targeted for UAC bypass or persistence.
Attackers can modify this registry to execute malicious code with elevated privileges by hijacking the command execution path.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='reg.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '%add%' ESCAPE '\') OR (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='powershell.exe' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%New-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Set-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ni %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%sp %' ESCAPE '\'))) AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\ms-settings\\shell\\open\\command%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Registry Modification of MS-settings Protocol Handler

author: frack113, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detect use of the Windows 8.3 short name. Which could be used as a method to avoid command-line detection
falsepositives: Applications could use this notation occasionally which might generate some false positives. In that case Investigate the parent and child process.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%~1.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%~1.bat%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%~1.msi%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%~1.vbe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%~1.vbs%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%~1.dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%~1.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%~1.js%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%~1.hta%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%~2.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%~2.bat%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%~2.msi%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%~2.vbe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%~2.vbs%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%~2.dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%~2.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%~2.js%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%~2.hta%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE(((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\WebEx\\WebexHost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\thor\\thor64.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\xampp\\vcredist\\VCREDI~1.EXE%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Use NTFS Short Name in Command Line

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), Christopher Peacock '@securepeacock' (Update)
description: Detects issues with Windows Defender Real-Time Protection features
falsepositives: Some crashes can occur sometimes and the event doesn't provide enough information to tune out these cases. Manual exception is required
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Microsoft-Windows-Windows Defender/Operational' AND ((EventID=3002 OR EventID=3007) AND (NOT COALESCE((Feature_Name LIKE '\%\%886' ESCAPE '\' AND (Reason LIKE '\%\%892' ESCAPE '\' OR Reason LIKE '\%\%858' ESCAPE '\')), 0)))
title: Windows Defender Real-Time Protection Failure/Restart

author: frack113
description: Detects usage of "Reflection.Assembly" load functions to dynamically load assemblies in memory
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%[Reflection.Assembly]::load%' ESCAPE '\')
title: Potential In-Memory Execution Using Reflection.Assembly

author: Ensar Şamil, @sblmsrsn, OSCD Community
description: Detects SyncAppvPublishingServer process execution which usually utilized by adversaries to bypass PowerShell execution restrictions.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%SyncAppvPublishingServer.exe%' ESCAPE '\')
title: SyncAppvPublishingServer Execution to Bypass Powershell Restriction

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects password change for the computer's domain account or host principal via "ksetup.exe"
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\ksetup.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='ksetup.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '% /setcomputerpassword %' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Computer Password Change Via Ksetup.EXE

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects suspicious PowerShell download command
falsepositives: PowerShell scripts that download content from the Internet
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4103 AND (ContextInfo LIKE '%System.Net.WebClient%' ESCAPE '\' AND (ContextInfo LIKE '%.DownloadFile(%' ESCAPE '\' OR ContextInfo LIKE '%.DownloadString(%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Suspicious PowerShell Download - PoshModule

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects suspicious command line reg.exe tool adding key to RUN key in Registry
falsepositives: Legitimate software automatically (mostly, during installation) sets up autorun keys for legitimate reasons.
Legitimate administrator sets up autorun keys for legitimate reasons.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%reg%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% add %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\WOW6432Node\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Policies\\Explorer\\Run%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Potential Persistence Attempt Via Run Keys Using Reg.EXE

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects PAExec service installation
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='System' AND ((Provider_Name='Service Control Manager' AND EventID=7045) AND (ServiceName LIKE 'PAExec-%' ESCAPE '\' OR ImagePath LIKE 'C:\\WINDOWS\\PAExec-%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: PAExec Service Installation

author: oscd.community, Zach Stanford @svch0st, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects potential abuse of Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL) binary as a Living of the Land binary in order to execute arbitrary Linux or Windows commands.
falsepositives: Automation and orchestration scripts may use this method to execute scripts etc.
Legitimate use by Windows to kill processes opened via WSL (example VsCode WSL server)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wsl.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='wsl.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -e %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --exec%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --system%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --shell-type %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /mnt/c%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --user root%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -u root%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%--debug-shell%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -d %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -e kill %' ESCAPE '\')), 0))))
title: Arbitrary Command Execution Using WSL

author: X__Junior (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects uncommon and potentially suspicious one-liner command containing both "ping" and "copy" at the same time, which is usually used by malware.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='Cmd.Exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%ping%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%copy %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -n %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /n %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –n %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —n %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―n %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -y %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /y %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –y %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —y %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―y %' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Potentially Suspicious Ping/Copy Command Combination

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the use of "DumpMinitool.exe" a tool that allows the dump of process memory via the use of the "MiniDumpWriteDump"
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\DumpMinitool.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\DumpMinitool.x86.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\DumpMinitool.arm64.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='DumpMinitool.exe' OR OriginalFileName='DumpMinitool.x86.exe' OR OriginalFileName='DumpMinitool.arm64.exe')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '% Full%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% Mini%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% WithHeap%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: DumpMinitool Execution

author: Max Altgelt (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the execution of other scripts using the Node executable packaged with Adobe Creative Cloud
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\Adobe Creative Cloud Experience\\libs\\node.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%Adobe Creative Cloud Experience\\js%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Node Process Executions

author: frack113
description: Detects potential persistence using Appx DebugPath
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND ((TargetObject LIKE '%Classes\\ActivatableClasses\\Package\\Microsoft.%' ESCAPE '\' AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\DebugPath' ESCAPE '\') OR (TargetObject LIKE '%\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\PackagedAppXDebug\\Microsoft.%' ESCAPE '\' AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\(Default)' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Potential Persistence Using DebugPath

author: frack113
description: Detects attempts of decoding a base64 Gzip archive in a PowerShell script. This technique is often used as a method to load malicious content into memory afterward.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%FromBase64String%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%MemoryStream%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%H4sI%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Suspicious FromBase64String Usage On Gzip Archive - Ps Script

author: Roberto Rodriguez (Cyb3rWard0g), OTR (Open Threat Research)
description: Detects suspicious use of the WSMAN provider without PowerShell.exe as the host application.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Windows PowerShell' AND (Data LIKE '%ProviderName=WSMan%' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE(((Data LIKE '%HostApplication=powershell%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%HostApplication=C:\\Windows\\System32\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\powershell%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%HostApplication=C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\powershell%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%HostApplication=C:/Windows/System32/WindowsPowerShell/v1.0/powershell%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%HostApplication=C:/Windows/SysWOW64/WindowsPowerShell/v1.0/powershell%' ESCAPE '\') OR Data REGEXP 'HostId=[a-zA-Z0-9-]{36}\s+EngineVersion='), 0)) AND (NOT COALESCE((Data LIKE '%HostApplication=C:\\Hexnode\\Hexnode Agent\\Current\\HexnodeAgent.exe%' ESCAPE '\'), 0)))
title: Suspicious Non PowerShell WSMAN COM Provider

author: frack113
description:
Adversaries may establish persistence and/or elevate privileges by executing malicious content triggered by application shims.
The Microsoft Windows Application Compatibility Infrastructure/Framework (Application Shim) was created to allow for backward compatibility of software as the operating system codebase changes over time
falsepositives: Legitimate custom SHIM installations will also trigger this rule
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND ((TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\AppCompatFlags\\InstalledSDB\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\AppCompatFlags\\Custom\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((NewValue='' OR NewValue='(Empty)' OR NewValue IS NULL), 0))))
title: Potential Persistence Via Shim Database Modification

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the execution of wmic with the "qfe" flag in order to obtain information about installed hotfix updates on the system. This is often used by pentester and attacker enumeration scripts
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((OriginalFileName='wmic.exe' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\WMIC.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '% qfe%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Windows Hotfix Updates Reconnaissance Via Wmic.EXE

author: Andreas Hunkeler (@Karneades), Nasreddine Bencherchali
description: Detects shell spawned from Java host process, which could be a sign of exploitation (e.g. log4j exploitation)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\java.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\bash.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentProcessName LIKE '%build%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%build%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Shell Process Spawned by Java.EXE

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects execution of Remote Utilities RAT (RURAT) from an unusual location (outside of 'C:\Program Files')
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\rutserv.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\rfusclient.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR Product='Remote Utilities') AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\Remote Utilities%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Remote Utilities%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Remote Access Tool - RURAT Execution From Unusual Location

author: frack113
description:
Detects an appx package deployment that was blocked by the local computer policy.
The following events indicate that an AppX package deployment was blocked by a policy:
- Event ID 441: The package deployment operation is blocked by the "Allow deployment operations in special profiles" policy
- Event ID 442: Deployments to non-system volumes are blocked by the "Disable deployment of Windows Store apps to non-system volumes" policy."
- Event ID 453: Package blocked by a platform policy.
- Event ID 454: Package blocked by a platform policy.
falsepositives: Unlikely, since this event notifies about blocked application deployment. Tune your applocker rules to avoid blocking legitimate applications.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Microsoft-Windows-AppXDeploymentServer/Operational' AND (EventID=441 OR EventID=442 OR EventID=453 OR EventID=454)
title: Deployment Of The AppX Package Was Blocked By The Policy

author: frack113, Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects potential CommandLine obfuscation using unicode characters.
Adversaries may attempt to make an executable or file difficult to discover or analyze by encrypting, encoding, or otherwise obfuscating its contents on the system or in transit.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%ˣ%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%˪%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ˢ%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%∕%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%⁄%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%¯%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%®%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%¶%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Potential CommandLine Obfuscation Using Unicode Characters

author: frack113
description:
Adversaries may search the Registry on compromised systems for insecurely stored credentials.
The Windows Registry stores configuration information that can be used by the system or other programs.
Adversaries may query the Registry looking for credentials and passwords that have been stored for use by other programs or services
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% query %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/t %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%REG\_SZ%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/s%' ESCAPE '\')) AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%/f %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%HKLM%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%/f %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%HKCU%' ESCAPE '\') OR CommandLine LIKE '%HKCU\\Software\\SimonTatham\\PuTTY\\Sessions%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Enumeration for Credentials in Registry

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects a Mesh Agent service installation. Mesh Agent is used to remotely manage computers
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='System' AND ((Provider_Name='Service Control Manager' AND EventID=7045) AND (ImagePath LIKE '%MeshAgent.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceName LIKE '%Mesh Agent%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Mesh Agent Service Installation

author: Nikita Nazarov, oscd.community
description: Adversaries may attempt to enumerate software for a variety of reasons, such as figuring out what security measures are present or if the compromised system has a version of software that is vulnerable.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%query%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\software\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/v%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%svcversion%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Detected Windows Software Discovery

author: @gott_cyber
description:
Detects the use of the PhoneDeepLink parameter to potentially sideload a DLL file that does not exist. This non-existent DLL file is named "ShellChromeAPI.dll".
Adversaries can drop their own renamed DLL and execute it via DeviceEnroller.exe using this parameter
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\deviceenroller.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='deviceenroller.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '%/PhoneDeepLink%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Potential DLL Sideloading Via DeviceEnroller.EXE

author: frack113, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), CrimpSec
description: Detects registry modifications that change features of internal Windows tools (malware like Agent Tesla uses this technique)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (((TargetObject LIKE '%SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Policies\\Explorer\\DisableCMD' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Policies\\Explorer\\NoControlPanel' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Policies\\Explorer\\NoRun' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Policies\\Explorer\\StartMenuLogOff' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Policies\\System\\DisableChangePassword' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Policies\\System\\DisableLockWorkstation' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Policies\\System\\DisableRegistryTools' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Policies\\System\\DisableTaskmgr' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Policies\\System\\NoDispBackgroundPage' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Policies\\System\\NoDispCPL' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%SOFTWARE\\Policies\\Microsoft\\Windows\\Explorer\\DisableNotificationCenter' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%SOFTWARE\\Policies\\Microsoft\\Windows\\System\\DisableCMD' ESCAPE '\') AND NewValue='DWORD (0x00000001)') OR ((TargetObject LIKE '%SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Policies\\System\\ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Policies\\System\\InactivityTimeoutSecs' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Policies\\System\\shutdownwithoutlogon' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\PushNotifications\\ToastEnabled' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\Storage\\Write Protection' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\StorageDevicePolicies\\WriteProtect' ESCAPE '\') AND NewValue='DWORD (0x00000000)')))
title: Disable Internal Tools or Feature in Registry

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects usage of the WMI class "Win32_NTEventlogFile" in a potentially suspicious way (delete, backup, change permissions, etc.) from a PowerShell script
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Win32\_NTEventlogFile%' ESCAPE '\' AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.BackupEventlog(%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.ChangeSecurityPermissions(%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.ChangeSecurityPermissionsEx(%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.ClearEventLog(%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.Delete(%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.DeleteEx(%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.Rename(%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.TakeOwnerShip(%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.TakeOwnerShipEx(%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Potentially Suspicious Call To Win32_NTEventlogFile Class - PSScript

author: Ialle Teixeira @teixeira0xfffff, Austin Songer @austinsonger
description: Detects when a user performs data exfiltration by using DataSvcUtil.exe
falsepositives: DataSvcUtil.exe being used may be performed by a system administrator.
Verify whether the user identity, user agent, and/or hostname should be making changes in your environment.
DataSvcUtil.exe being executed from unfamiliar users should be investigated. If known behavior is causing false positives, it can be exempted from the rule.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%/in:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/out:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/uri:%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\DataSvcUtil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='DataSvcUtil.exe')))
title: LOLBAS Data Exfiltration by DataSvcUtil.exe

author: Zach Mathis
description: Detects when an application acquires a certificate private key
falsepositives: Legitimate application requesting certificate exports will trigger this. Apply additional filters as needed
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Microsoft-Windows-CAPI2/Operational' AND EventID=70
title: Certificate Private Key Acquired

author: frack113
description: An adversary may compress or encrypt data that is collected prior to exfiltration using 3rd party utilities
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%winzip.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%winzip64.exe%' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%-s"%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -min %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -a %' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Compress Data and Lock With Password for Exfiltration With WINZIP

author: frack113
description:
The Reset-ComputerMachinePassword cmdlet changes the computer account password that the computers use to authenticate to the domain controllers in the domain.
You can use it to reset the password of the local computer.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4103 AND ContextInfo LIKE '%Reset-ComputerMachinePassword%' ESCAPE '\')
title: Suspicious Computer Machine Password by PowerShell

author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects potentially suspicious explicit credential logon events where the user
is trying to logon with explicit credentials (username and password) that are
different from the current user context. It might indicate an attacker attempting
to escalate privileges after obtaining credentials for a different user account.
falsepositives: RunAs usage from user-installed applications outside Program Files
Administrative scripts using explicit credentials from non-standard paths
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4648 AND (TargetServerName='localhost' OR TargetInfo='localhost' OR (IpAddress='127.0.0.1' OR IpAddress='::1'))) AND (NOT COALESCE((SubjectUserName LIKE '%$' ESCAPE '\' OR (ProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\WinSxS\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR (ProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Program Files (x86)\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR SubjectUserName=TargetUserName), 0)))
title: Potentially Suspicious Explicit Credential Local Logon

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Tim Shelton
description:
Detects potentially suspicious child processes spawned by PowerShell.
Use this rule to hunt for potential anomalies initiating from PowerShell scripts and commands.
falsepositives: False positives are to be expected from PowerShell scripts that might make use of additional binaries such as "mshta", "bitsadmin", etc. Apply additional filters for those scripts.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell\_ise.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\bash.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\bitsadmin.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\certutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\forfiles.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\hh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\schtasks.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\scrcons.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\scriptrunner.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\sh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wmic.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE(((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\certutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-verifystore %' ESCAPE '\') OR (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wmic.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%qfe list%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%diskdrive %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%csproduct %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%computersystem %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% os %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%' ESCAPE '\'))), 0)) AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentCommandLine LIKE '%\\Program Files\\Amazon\\WorkspacesConfig\\Scripts\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\Program Files\\Amazon\\WorkspacesConfig\\Scripts\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Potentially Suspicious PowerShell Child Processes

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects potential exfiltration attempt via audio file using PowerShell
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ((ScriptBlockText LIKE '%[System.Math]::%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%[IO.FileMode]::%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%BinaryWriter%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%0x52%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%0x49%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%0x46%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%0x57%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%0x41%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%0x56%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%0x45%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%0xAC%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Potential Data Exfiltration Via Audio File

author: William Gokah (idea), Raylee Hawkins, Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects an attempt to create a new user account via ADSI (Active Directory Service Interfaces)
using either the WinNT or LDAP provider. This is an uncommon method to create user accounts
and may indicate an attempt to evade detection by avoiding more commonly monitored commands
such as "net user", "New-LocalUser" or "New-ADUser".
falsepositives: Legitimate administrative scripts that use ADSI to provision user accounts but should be rare in most environments
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%[ADSI]%' ESCAPE '\' AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.create("user%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.create(''user%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%WinNT://%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%LDAP://%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: New User Account Creation Attempt Via ADSI

author: Alejandro Houspanossian ('@lekz86')
description:
Detects the execution of concatenated commands via "cmd.exe". Pikabot often executes a combination of multiple commands via the command handler "cmd /c" in order to download and execute additional payloads.
Commands such as "curl", "wget" in order to download extra payloads. "ping" and "timeout" are abused to introduce delays in the command execution and "Rundll32" is also used to execute malicious DLL files.
In the observed Pikabot infections, a combination of the commands described above are used to orchestrate the download and execution of malicious DLL files.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%cmd%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/c%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% & %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% || %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% curl%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% wget%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% timeout %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ping %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% rundll32%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% mkdir %' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Potential Pikabot Infection - Suspicious Command Combinations Via Cmd.EXE

author: Tim Rauch, Elastic (idea)
description: Detects attempts to bypass User Account Control (UAC) by hijacking the Microsoft Management Console (MMC) Windows Firewall snap-in
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\mmc.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%WF.msc%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\WerFault.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: UAC Bypass via Windows Firewall Snap-In Hijack

author: Michael Haag, Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the installation of MSIX/AppX packages with full trust privileges which run with elevated privileges outside normal AppX container restrictions
falsepositives: Some legitimate applications installation which have been missed from filtering can generate fps, thus baselining and tuning is recommended before deploying to production
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Microsoft-Windows-AppXDeploymentServer/Operational' AND ((EventID=400 AND (HasFullTrust='true' OR HasFullTrust=1)) AND (NOT COALESCE(((PackageSourceUri LIKE 'file:///C:/Program\%20Files/%' ESCAPE '\' OR PackageSourceUri LIKE 'file:///C:/Program\%20Files\%20(x86)/%' ESCAPE '\') OR (PackageSourceUri LIKE 'https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/_linkid%' ESCAPE '\' OR (PackageSourceUri LIKE '%.cdn.microsoft.com%' ESCAPE '\' OR PackageSourceUri LIKE '%.cdn.office.net/%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (CallingProcess LIKE 'sysprep.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CallingProcess LIKE 'svchost.exe,AppReadiness%' ESCAPE '\')), 0)) AND (NOT COALESCE((PackageSourceUri LIKE 'x-windowsupdate://%' ESCAPE '\' OR PackageFullName LIKE 'MicrosoftWindows.Client.%' ESCAPE '\'), 0)))
title: Windows AppX Deployment Full Trust Package Installation

author: Michael Haag, Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), juju4, oscd.community, Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects the execution of WMIC in order to get a list of firewall, antivirus and antispywware products.
Adversaries often enumerate security products installed on a system to identify security controls and potential ways to evade detection or disable protection mechanisms.
This information helps them plan their next attack steps and choose appropriate techniques to bypass security measures.
falsepositives: Legitimate use of wmic.exe for reconnaissance of firewall, antivirus and antispywware products.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wmic.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='wmic.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%AntiVirusProduct%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%AntiSpywareProduct%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%FirewallProduct%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Potential Product Class Reconnaissance Via Wmic.EXE

author: frack113
description: Detects cases in which a user uses the built-in Windows utility gpresult to display the Resultant Set of Policy (RSoP) information
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\gpresult.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/z%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/v%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Gpresult Display Group Policy Information

author: juju4, Jonhnathan Ribeiro, oscd.community, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects suspicious execution of rundll32, with specific calls to some DLLs with known LOLBIN functionalities
falsepositives: False positives depend on scripts and administrative tools used in the monitored environment
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((CommandLine LIKE '%javascript:%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.RegisterXLL%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%url.dll%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%OpenURL%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%url.dll%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%OpenURLA%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%url.dll%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%FileProtocolHandler%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%zipfldr.dll%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%RouteTheCall%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%shell32.dll%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%Control\_RunDLL%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%shell32.dll%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%ShellExec\_RunDLL%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%mshtml.dll%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%PrintHTML%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%advpack.dll%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%LaunchINFSection%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%advpack.dll%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%RegisterOCX%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%ieadvpack.dll%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%LaunchINFSection%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%ieadvpack.dll%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%RegisterOCX%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%ieframe.dll%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%OpenURL%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%shdocvw.dll%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%OpenURL%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%syssetup.dll%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%SetupInfObjectInstallAction%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%setupapi.dll%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%InstallHinfSection%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%pcwutl.dll%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%LaunchApplication%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%dfshim.dll%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%ShOpenVerbApplication%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%dfshim.dll%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%ShOpenVerbShortcut%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%scrobj.dll%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%GenerateTypeLib%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%http%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%shimgvw.dll%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%ImageView\_Fullscreen%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%http%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%comsvcs.dll%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%MiniDump%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%shell32.dll,Control\_RunDLL desk.cpl,screensaver,@screensaver%' ESCAPE '\' OR (ParentProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\control.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%.cpl%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Shell32.dll%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%Control\_RunDLL%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.cpl%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (ParentProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\control.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '"C:\\Windows\\system32\\rundll32.exe" Shell32.dll,Control\_RunDLL "C:\\Windows\\System32\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.cpl",' ESCAPE '\')), 0))))
title: Potentially Suspicious Rundll32 Activity

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects a crash of "WinRAR.exe" where the version is lower than 6.23. This could indicate potential exploitation of CVE-2023-40477
falsepositives: Legitimate crash for reasons other than exploitation of the vulnerability
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Application' AND ((Provider_Name='Application Error' AND EventID=1000 AND AppName='WinRAR.exe') AND (NOT COALESCE((AppVersion LIKE '6.23.%' ESCAPE '\' OR AppVersion LIKE '6.24.%' ESCAPE '\' OR AppVersion LIKE '6.25.%' ESCAPE '\' OR AppVersion LIKE '6.26.%' ESCAPE '\' OR AppVersion LIKE '7.%' ESCAPE '\'), 0)))
title: CVE-2023-40477 Potential Exploitation - WinRAR Application Crash

author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects modifications to Default Domain or Default Domain Controllers Group Policy Objects (GPOs).
Adversaries may modify these default GPOs to deploy malicious configurations across the domain.
falsepositives: Legitimate modifications to Default Domain or Default Domain Controllers GPOs
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=5136 AND ObjectClass='groupPolicyContainer' AND (ObjectDN LIKE 'CN={31B2F340-016D-11D2-945F-00C04FB984F9},CN=POLICIES,CN=SYSTEM%' ESCAPE '\' OR ObjectDN LIKE 'CN={6AC1786C-016F-11D2-945F-00C04FB984F9},CN=POLICIES,CN=SYSTEM%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Windows Default Domain GPO Modification

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the execution of "csvde.exe" in order to export organizational Active Directory structure.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\csvde.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='csvde.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '% -f%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '% -i%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Active Directory Structure Export Via Csvde.EXE

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Jonhnathan Ribeiro, oscd.community, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the execution of certutil with the "encode" flag to encode a file to base64. This can be abused by threat actors and attackers for data exfiltration
falsepositives: As this is a general purpose rule, legitimate usage of the encode functionality will trigger some false positives. Apply additional filters accordingly
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\certutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='CertUtil.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-encode%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/encode%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–encode%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—encode%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―encode%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: File Encoded To Base64 Via Certutil.EXE

author: Timur Zinniatullin, oscd.community
description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via RUNDLL LAUNCHER
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%rundll32.exe%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%shell32.dll%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%shellexec\_rundll%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%powershell%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Invoke-Obfuscation RUNDLL LAUNCHER - PowerShell

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects potential abuse of ntdsutil to dump ntds.dit database
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Application' AND (Provider_Name='ESENT' AND (EventID=216 OR EventID=325 OR EventID=326 OR EventID=327) AND Data LIKE '%ntds.dit%' ESCAPE '\')
title: Ntdsutil Abuse

author: frack113
description: Detect set EnableFirewall to 0 to disable the Windows firewall
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND ((TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Policies\\Microsoft\\WindowsFirewall\\StandardProfile\\EnableFirewall' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Policies\\Microsoft\\WindowsFirewall\\DomainProfile\\EnableFirewall' ESCAPE '\') AND NewValue='DWORD (0x00000000)'))
title: Disable Windows Firewall by Registry

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects calls of DLLs exports by ordinal numbers via rundll32.dll.
falsepositives: False positives depend on scripts and administrative tools used in the monitored environment.
Windows control panel elements have been identified as source (mmc).
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='RUNDLL32.EXE') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%,#%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%, #%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dll #%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.ocx #%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE(((CommandLine LIKE '%EDGEHTML.dll%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%#141%' ESCAPE '\') OR ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\Msbuild\\Current\\Bin\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\VC\\Tools\\MSVC\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\Tracker.exe%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\FileTracker32.dll,#1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\FileTracker32.dll",#1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\FileTracker64.dll,#1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\FileTracker64.dll",#1%' ESCAPE '\'))), 0))))
title: DLL Call by Ordinal Via Rundll32.EXE

author: Victor Sergeev, Daniil Yugoslavskiy, Gleb Sukhodolskiy, Timur Zinniatullin, oscd.community, Tim Shelton, frack113 (split)
description: Detects modification of autostart extensibility point (ASEP) in registry.
falsepositives: Legitimate software automatically (mostly, during installation) sets up autorun keys for legitimate reason
Legitimate administrator sets up autorun keys for legitimate reason
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\Software\\Policies\\Microsoft\\Windows\\System\\Scripts%' ESCAPE '\' AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\Startup%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\Shutdown%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\Logon%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\Logoff%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((NewValue='(Empty)'), 0))))
title: System Scripts Autorun Keys Modification

author: frack113
description:
The attacker creates a computer object using those permissions with a password known to her.
After that she clears the attribute ServicePrincipalName on the computer object.
Because she created the object (CREATOR OWNER), she gets granted additional permissions and can do many changes to the object.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='System' AND (Provider_Name='Microsoft-Windows-Directory-Services-SAM' AND (EventID=16990 OR EventID=16991))
title: Potential CVE-2021-42287 Exploitation Attempt

author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel
description: Detects usage of "msedge_proxy.exe" to download arbitrary files
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\msedge\_proxy.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName LIKE 'msedge\_proxy.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%http://%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%https://%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Arbitrary File Download Via MSEDGE_PROXY.EXE

author: @BarryShooshooga, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects write access requests to the Windows Defender exclusions registry keys. This could be an indication of an attacker trying to request a handle or access the object to write new exclusions in order to bypass security.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((AccessList LIKE '%\%\%4417%' ESCAPE '\' OR AccessList LIKE '%\%\%4418%' ESCAPE '\') AND (EventID=4656 OR EventID=4663) AND ObjectName LIKE '%\\Microsoft\\Windows Defender\\Exclusions\\%' ESCAPE '\')
title: Windows Defender Exclusion Registry Key - Write Access Requested

author: Tim Shelton, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the reporting of NTLMv1 being used between a client and server. NTLMv1 is insecure as the underlying encryption algorithms can be brute-forced by modern hardware.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='System' AND (Provider_Name='LsaSrv' AND (EventID=6038 OR EventID=6039))
title: NTLMv1 Logon Between Client and Server

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects potentially suspicious execution of the Regasm/Regsvcs utilities with an uncommon extension.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\Regsvcs.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\Regasm.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='RegSvcs.exe' OR OriginalFileName='RegAsm.exe')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%.dat%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.gif%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.jpeg%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.jpg%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.png%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.txt%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Potentially Suspicious Execution Of Regasm/Regsvcs With Uncommon Extension

author: j4son
description: Detects failed logon attempts from clients with external network IP to an MSSQL server. This can be a sign of a bruteforce attack.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Application' AND ((Provider_Name LIKE '%MSSQL%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventID=18456) AND (NOT COALESCE((Data LIKE '%CLIENT: 10.%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%CLIENT: 172.16.%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%CLIENT: 172.17.%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%CLIENT: 172.18.%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%CLIENT: 172.19.%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%CLIENT: 172.20.%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%CLIENT: 172.21.%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%CLIENT: 172.22.%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%CLIENT: 172.23.%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%CLIENT: 172.24.%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%CLIENT: 172.25.%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%CLIENT: 172.26.%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%CLIENT: 172.27.%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%CLIENT: 172.28.%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%CLIENT: 172.29.%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%CLIENT: 172.30.%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%CLIENT: 172.31.%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%CLIENT: 192.168.%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%CLIENT: 127.%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%CLIENT: 169.254.%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%CLIENT: <local machine>%' ESCAPE '\'), 0)))
title: MSSQL Server Failed Logon From External Network

author: Thomas Patzke
description:
Detects the execution of a script event consumer. When scrcons.exe launches, it does so in response to the creation of an ActiveScriptEventConsumer instance
and will execute registered JScript or VBScript code as a result.
Script event consumers are a built-in Windows Management Instrumentation (WMI) class that
automatically executes a predefined script (in VBScript or JScript) whenever a specific system event occurs.
Adversaries often abuse script event consumers to maintain persistence on a compromised host
by executing a malicious script whenever a specific event occurs.
falsepositives: Dell computers on some versions register an event consumer that is known to cause false positives when brightness is changed by the corresponding keyboard button
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\WINDOWS\\system32\\wbem\\scrcons.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\svchost.exe' ESCAPE '\'))
title: WMI Persistence - Script Event Consumer

author: frack113
description: Detects the rare use of the command line tool shutdown to logoff a user
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\shutdown.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/l%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Suspicious Execution of Shutdown to Log Out

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects execution of 7z in order to compress a file with a ".dmp"/".dump" extension, which could be a step in a process of dump file exfiltration.
falsepositives: Legitimate use of 7z with a command line in which ".dmp" or ".dump" appears accidentally
Legitimate use of 7z to compress WER ".dmp" files for troubleshooting
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((Description LIKE '%7-Zip%' ESCAPE '\' OR (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\7z.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\7zr.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\7za.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='7z.exe' OR OriginalFileName='7za.exe' OR OriginalFileName='7zr.exe')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%.dmp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dump%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.hdmp%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: 7Zip Compressing Dump Files

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects modification addition to the 'TypedPaths' key in the user or admin registry via the commandline. Which might indicate persistence attempt
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Explorer\\TypedPaths%' ESCAPE '\')
title: Persistence Via TypedPaths - CommandLine

author: Victor Sergeev, oscd.community
description: Detects execution of powershell scripts via Runscripthelper.exe
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\Runscripthelper.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%surfacecheck%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Suspicious Runscripthelper.exe

author: frack113, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects the addition of a new "Allow" firewall rule by the WMI process (WmiPrvSE.EXE).
This can occur if an attacker leverages PowerShell cmdlets such as "New-NetFirewallRule", or directly uses WMI CIM classes such as "MSFT_NetFirewallRule".
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Microsoft-Windows-Windows Firewall With Advanced Security/Firewall' AND ((EventID=2004 OR EventID=2071 OR EventID=2097) AND `Action`=3 AND ModifyingApplication LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\wbem\\WmiPrvSE.exe' ESCAPE '\')
title: New Firewall Rule Added In Windows Firewall Exception List Via WmiPrvSE.EXE

author: Ilyas Ochkov, oscd.community
description: Detects uncommon outbound network activity via Kerberos default port indicating possible lateral movement or first stage PrivEsc via delegation.
falsepositives: Web Browsers and third party application might generate similar activity. An initial baseline is required.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=5156 AND DestPort=88) AND (NOT COALESCE(((Application LIKE '\\device\\harddiskvolume%' ESCAPE '\' OR Application LIKE 'C:%' ESCAPE '\') AND Application LIKE '%\\Windows\\System32\\lsass.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0)) AND (NOT COALESCE((((Application LIKE '\\device\\harddiskvolume%' ESCAPE '\' OR Application LIKE 'C:%' ESCAPE '\') AND (Application LIKE '%\\Program Files (x86)\\Google\\Chrome\\Application\\chrome.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Application LIKE '%\\Program Files\\Google\\Chrome\\Application\\chrome.exe' ESCAPE '\')) OR ((Application LIKE '\\device\\harddiskvolume%' ESCAPE '\' OR Application LIKE 'C:%' ESCAPE '\') AND (Application LIKE '%\\Program Files (x86)\\Mozilla Firefox\\firefox.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Application LIKE '%\\Program Files\\Mozilla Firefox\\firefox.exe' ESCAPE '\')) OR Application LIKE '%\\tomcat\\bin\\tomcat8.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0)))
title: Uncommon Outbound Kerberos Connection - Security

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects the execution of Windows binaries from within a WSL instance.
This could be used to masquerade parent-child relationships
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName REGEXP '[a-zA-Z]:\\' AND CurrentDirectory LIKE '%\\\\wsl.localhost%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Windows Binary Executed From WSL

author: frack113
description: Detects inline execution of PowerShell code from a file
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%iex %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Invoke-Expression %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Invoke-Command %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%icm %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%cat %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%get-content %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%type %' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '% -raw%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Powershell Inline Execution From A File

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects a PDQDeploy service installation which indicates that PDQDeploy was installed on the machines.
PDQDeploy can be abused by attackers to remotely install packages or execute commands on target machines
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='System' AND ((Provider_Name='Service Control Manager' AND EventID=7045) AND (ImagePath LIKE '%PDQDeployService.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR (ServiceName='PDQDeploy' OR ServiceName='PDQ Deploy')))
title: New PDQDeploy Service - Server Side

author: Victor Sergeev, oscd.community
description: Detects execution of GfxDownloadWrapper.exe with a URL as an argument to download file.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\GfxDownloadWrapper.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%http://%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%https://%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%https://gameplayapi.intel.com/%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Arbitrary File Download Via GfxDownloadWrapper.EXE

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Gleb Sukhodolskiy, Timur Zinniatullin oscd.community
description: Detects suspicious WMI event filter and command line event consumer based on WMI and Security Logs.
falsepositives: Unknown (data set is too small; further testing needed)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4662 AND ObjectType='WMI Namespace' AND ObjectName LIKE '%subscription%' ESCAPE '\')
title: WMI Persistence - Security

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the execution of Scheduled Tasks where the program being run is located in a suspicious location or where it is an unusual program to be run from a Scheduled Task
falsepositives: False positives may occur with some of the selected binaries if you have tasks using them (which could be very common in your environment). Exclude all the specific trusted tasks before using this rule
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Microsoft-Windows-TaskScheduler/Operational' AND (EventID=129 AND (Path LIKE '%\\calc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Path LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Path LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Path LIKE '%\\mspaint.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Path LIKE '%\\notepad.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Path LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Path LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Scheduled Task Executed Uncommon LOLBIN

author: juju4
description: Detects potential commandline obfuscation using known escape characters
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%h^t^t^p%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%h"t"t"p%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Potential Commandline Obfuscation Using Escape Characters

author: Matt Anderson (Huntress)
description: Detect the use of processes with no name (".exe"), which can be used to evade Image-based detections.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\.exe' ESCAPE '\')
title: Process Launched Without Image Name

author: Timur Zinniatullin, oscd.community
description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via RUNDLL LAUNCHER
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4697 AND (ServiceFileName LIKE '%rundll32.exe%' ESCAPE '\' AND ServiceFileName LIKE '%shell32.dll%' ESCAPE '\' AND ServiceFileName LIKE '%shellexec\_rundll%' ESCAPE '\' AND ServiceFileName LIKE '%powershell%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Invoke-Obfuscation RUNDLL LAUNCHER - Security

author: xknow (@xknow_infosec), xorxes (@xor_xes)
description:
Detects installation of NalDrv or PROCEXP152 services via registry-keys to non-system32 folders.
Both services are used in the tool Ghost-In-The-Logs (https://github.com/bats3c/Ghost-In-The-Logs), which uses KDU (https://github.com/hfiref0x/KDU)
falsepositives: Other legimate tools using this service names and drivers. Note - clever attackers may easily bypass this detection by just renaming the services. Therefore just Medium-level and don't rely on it.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND ((TargetObject LIKE 'HKLM\\System\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\NalDrv\\ImagePath' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE 'HKLM\\System\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\PROCEXP152\\ImagePath' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE(((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\procexp64.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\procexp64a.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\procexp.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\procmon64.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\procmon64a.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\procmon.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\handle.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\handle64.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\handle64a.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND NewValue LIKE '%\\WINDOWS\\system32\\Drivers\\PROCEXP152.SYS%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Suspicious Service Installed

author: Mateusz Wydra, oscd.community
description: Detects the start of a non built-in assistive technology applications via "Atbroker.EXE".
falsepositives: Legitimate, non-default assistive technology applications execution
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\AtBroker.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='AtBroker.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '%start%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%animations%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%audiodescription%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%caretbrowsing%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%caretwidth%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%colorfiltering%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cursorindicator%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cursorscheme%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%filterkeys%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%focusborderheight%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%focusborderwidth%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%highcontrast%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%keyboardcues%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%keyboardpref%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%livecaptions%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%magnifierpane%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%messageduration%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%minimumhitradius%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%mousekeys%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Narrator%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%osk%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%overlappedcontent%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%showsounds%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%soundsentry%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%speechreco%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%stickykeys%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%togglekeys%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%voiceaccess%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%windowarranging%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%windowtracking%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%windowtrackingtimeout%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%windowtrackingzorder%' ESCAPE '\'), 0)) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%Oracle\_JavaAccessBridge%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Uncommon  Assistive Technology Applications Execution Via AtBroker.EXE

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects suspicious child processes of electron apps (teams, discord, slack, etc.). This could be a potential sign of ".asar" file tampering (See reference section for more information) or binary execution proxy through specific CLI arguments (see related rule)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\chrome.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\discord.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\GitHubDesktop.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\keybase.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\msedge.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\msedgewebview2.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\msteams.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\slack.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\teams.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\whoami.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (NewProcessName LIKE '%:\\ProgramData\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%:\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\Discord.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\NVSMI\\nvidia-smi.exe%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Suspicious Electron Application Child Processes

author: frack113
description:
Detects execution of Cmdl32 with the "/vpn" and "/lan" flags.
Attackers can abuse this utility in order to download arbitrary files via a configuration file.
Inspect the location and the content of the file passed as an argument in order to determine if it is suspicious.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmdl32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='CMDL32.EXE') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/vpn%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/lan%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Potential Arbitrary File Download Via Cmdl32.EXE

author: frack113
description:
Detects TOKEN OBFUSCATION technique from Invoke-Obfuscation in Powershell scripts.
Use this rule as a threat-hunting baseline to find obfuscated scripts in your environment.
Once tested and tuned, consider deploying a production detection rule based on this hunting rule.
falsepositives: Edge case might be possible with heavy use of string formatting or obfuscation in legitimate scripts.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ((ScriptBlockText REGEXP '\w+`(\w+|-|.)`[\w+|\s]' OR ScriptBlockText REGEXP '"(\{\d\}){2,}"\s*-f' OR ScriptBlockText REGEXP '(?i)\$\{`?e`?n`?v`?:`?p`?a`?t`?h`?\}') AND (NOT COALESCE((ScriptBlockText LIKE '%${env:path}%' ESCAPE '\' OR (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%it will return true or false instead%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%The function also prevents `Get-ItemProperty` from failing%' ESCAPE '\') OR (Path LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\Microsoft\\Exchange Server\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND Path LIKE '%\\bin\\servicecontrol.ps1' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%`r`n%' ESCAPE '\')), 0))))
title: Powershell Token Obfuscation - Powershell

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects execution of perl using the "-e"/"-E" flags. This is could be used as a way to launch a reverse shell or execute live perl code.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\perl.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='perl.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '% -e%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Perl Inline Command Execution

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the execution of a shell (powershell, bash, wsl...) via Visual Studio Code tunnel. Attackers can abuse this functionality to establish a C2 channel and execute arbitrary commands on the system.
falsepositives: Legitimate use of Visual Studio Code tunnel and running code from there
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\servers\\Stable-%' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\server\\node.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%.vscode-server%' ESCAPE '\') AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\terminal\\browser\\media\\shellIntegration.ps1%' ESCAPE '\') OR (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wsl.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\bash.exe' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Visual Studio Code Tunnel Shell Execution

author: Luc Génaux
description:
Detects potential access attempts to the PowerShell console history directly via history file (ConsoleHost_history.txt).
This can give access to plaintext passwords used in PowerShell commands or used for general reconnaissance.
falsepositives: Legitimate access of the console history file is possible
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%ConsoleHost\_history.txt%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%(Get-PSReadLineOption).HistorySavePath%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Potential PowerShell Console History Access Attempt via History File

author: Sreeman
description:
Detects manual execution of the "Microsoft Compatibility Appraiser" task via schtasks.
In order to trigger persistence stored in the "\AppCompatFlags\TelemetryController" registry key.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\schtasks.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='schtasks.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%run %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\Application Experience\\Microsoft Compatibility Appraiser%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Potential Persistence Via Microsoft Compatibility Appraiser

author: frack113
description: Once established within a system or network, an adversary may use automated techniques for collecting internal data.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%.doc%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.docx%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.xls%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.xlsx%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.ppt%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.pptx%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.rtf%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.pdf%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.txt%' ESCAPE '\') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%dir %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% /b %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% /s %' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='FINDSTR.EXE' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% /e %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /si %' ESCAPE '\')))))
title: Automated Collection Command Prompt

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects call to "Win32_QuickFixEngineering" in order to enumerate installed hotfixes often used in "enum" scripts by attackers
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Win32\_QuickFixEngineering%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%HotFixID%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: PowerShell Hotfix Enumeration

author: Sean Metcalf (source), Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects keywords from well-known PowerShell exploitation frameworks
falsepositives: Depending on the scripts, this rule might require some initial tuning to fit the environment
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%AdjustTokenPrivileges%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%IMAGE\_NT\_OPTIONAL\_HDR64\_MAGIC%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Metasploit%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Microsoft.Win32.UnsafeNativeMethods%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Mimikatz%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%MiniDumpWriteDump%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%PAGE\_EXECUTE\_READ%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ReadProcessMemory.Invoke%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%SE\_PRIVILEGE\_ENABLED%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%SECURITY\_DELEGATION%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%TOKEN\_ADJUST\_PRIVILEGES%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%TOKEN\_ALL\_ACCESS%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%TOKEN\_ASSIGN\_PRIMARY%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%TOKEN\_DUPLICATE%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%TOKEN\_ELEVATION%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%TOKEN\_IMPERSONATE%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%TOKEN\_INFORMATION\_CLASS%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%TOKEN\_PRIVILEGES%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%TOKEN\_QUERY%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Malicious PowerShell Keywords

author: xknow (@xknow_infosec), xorxes (@xor_xes)
description:
Detects the usage of the 'SeLoadDriverPrivilege' privilege. This privilege is required to load or unload a device driver.
With this privilege, the user can dynamically load and unload device drivers or other code in to kernel mode.
This user right does not apply to Plug and Play device drivers.
If you exclude privileged users/admins and processes, which are allowed to do so, you are maybe left with bad programs trying to load malicious kernel drivers.
This will detect Ghost-In-The-Logs (https://github.com/bats3c/Ghost-In-The-Logs) and the usage of Sysinternals and various other tools. So you have to work with a whitelist to find the bad stuff.
falsepositives: Other legimate tools loading drivers. Including but not limited to, Sysinternals, CPU-Z, AVs etc. A baseline needs to be created according to the used products and allowed tools. A good thing to do is to try and exclude users who are allowed to load drivers.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4673 AND PrivilegeList='SeLoadDriverPrivilege' AND Service='-') AND (NOT COALESCE(((ProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\explorer.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\HelpPane.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\ImmersiveControlPanel\\SystemSettings.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\Dism.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\fltMC.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\mmc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\RuntimeBroker.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\ShellHost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\svchost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\SystemSettingsBroker.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\wimserv.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR ProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\WindowsApps\\Microsoft%' ESCAPE '\'), 0)) AND (NOT COALESCE(((ProcessName LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Microsoft\\Teams\\current\\Teams.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE '%\\Google\\Chrome\\Application\\chrome.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE '%\\procexp.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE '%\\procexp64.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE '%\\procexp64a.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE '%\\procmon.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE '%\\procmon64.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE '%\\procmon64a.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR ((ProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Dropbox\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\Dropbox\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND ProcessName LIKE '%\\Dropbox.exe' ESCAPE '\')), 0)))
title: Potential Privileged System Service Operation - SeLoadDriverPrivilege

author: Victor Sergeev, Daniil Yugoslavskiy, Gleb Sukhodolskiy, Timur Zinniatullin, oscd.community, Tim Shelton, frack113 (split)
description: Detects modification of autostart extensibility point (ASEP) in registry.
falsepositives: Legitimate software automatically (mostly, during installation) sets up autorun keys for legitimate reason
Legitimate administrator sets up autorun keys for legitimate reason
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND ((TargetObject LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control%' ESCAPE '\' AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\Terminal Server\\WinStations\\RDP-Tcp\\InitialProgram%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\Terminal Server\\Wds\\rdpwd\\StartupPrograms%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\SecurityProviders\\SecurityProviders%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\SafeBoot\\AlternateShell%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\Print\\Providers%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\Print\\Monitors%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\NetworkProvider\\Order%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\Lsa\\Notification Packages%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\Lsa\\Authentication Packages%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\BootVerificationProgram\\ImagePath%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((NewValue='(Empty)' OR (NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\spoolsv.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\Print\\Monitors\\CutePDF Writer Monitor%' ESCAPE '\' AND (NewValue LIKE 'cpwmon64\_v40.dll' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue='CutePDF Writer')) OR (NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\spoolsv.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND TargetObject LIKE '%Print\\Monitors\\Appmon\\Ports\\Microsoft.Office.OneNote\_%' ESCAPE '\' AND (User LIKE '%AUTHORI%' ESCAPE '\' OR User LIKE '%AUTORI%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\poqexec.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\NetworkProvider\\Order\\ProviderOrder' ESCAPE '\') OR (NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\spoolsv.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\Print\\Monitors\\MONVNC\\Driver' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue='VNCpm.dll')), 0))))
title: CurrentControlSet Autorun Keys Modification

author: Samir Bousseaden
description: Detects remote task creation via at.exe or API interacting with ATSVC namedpipe
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=5145 AND ShareName LIKE '\\\\*\\IPC$' ESCAPE '\' AND RelativeTargetName='atsvc' AND AccessList LIKE '%WriteData%' ESCAPE '\')
title: Remote Task Creation via ATSVC Named Pipe

author: frack113
description: Detects usage of namp/zenmap. Adversaries may attempt to get a listing of services running on remote hosts, including those that may be vulnerable to remote software exploitation
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\nmap.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\zennmap.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='nmap.exe' OR OriginalFileName='zennmap.exe')))
title: PUA - Nmap/Zenmap Execution

author: Victor Sergeev, oscd.community
description: Detects potential DLL sideloading using the Microsoft Office winword process via the '/l' flag.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\WINWORD.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='WinWord.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/l %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Potential Arbitrary DLL Load Using Winword

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects when the 'AllowMultipleTSSessions' value is enabled.
Which allows for multiple Remote Desktop connection sessions to be opened at once.
This is often used by attacker as a way to connect to an RDP session without disconnecting the other users
falsepositives: Legitimate use of the multi session functionality
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Winlogon\\AllowMultipleTSSessions' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue LIKE '%DWORD (0x00000001)' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Winlogon AllowMultipleTSSessions Enable

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects suspicious msiexec process starts with web addresses as parameter
falsepositives: False positives depend on scripts and administrative tools used in the monitored environment
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '% msiexec%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%://%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: MsiExec Web Install

author: NVISO
description: Detects a failed logon attempt from a public IP. A login from a public IP can indicate a misconfigured firewall or network boundary.
