author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects a script interpreter process (like node.js or bun) spawning a known credential scanning tool (e.g., trufflehog, gitleaks).
This behavior is indicative of an attempt to find and steal secrets, as seen in the "Shai-Hulud: The Second Coming" campaign.
falsepositives: Legitimate pre-commit hooks or CI/CD pipeline jobs that use a script to run a credential scanner as part of a security check.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\node.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\bun.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%trufflehog.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%gitleaks.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%trufflehog%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%gitleaks%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Script Interpreter Spawning Credential Scanner - Windows

author: Teymur Kheirkhabarov
description: Detect modification of services configuration (ImagePath, FailureCommand and ServiceDLL) in registry by processes with Medium integrity level
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((IntegrityLevel='Medium' OR IntegrityLevel='S-1-16-8192') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%ControlSet%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%services%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\ImagePath%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\FailureCommand%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\ServiceDll%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Potential Privilege Escalation via Service Permissions Weakness

author: Nisarg Suthar
description: Detects suspicious child processes created by CrushFTP. It could be an indication of exploitation of a RCE vulnerability such as CVE-2025-54309.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\crushftp.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell\_ise.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%IEX%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%enc%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%Hidden%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%bypass%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/c powershell%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%whoami%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%net.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%net1.exe%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\bitsadmin.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\certutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Potential Exploitation of CrushFTP RCE Vulnerability (CVE-2025-54309)

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Tim Shelton, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the clearing of one of the Windows Core Eventlogs. e.g. caused by "wevtutil cl" command execution
falsepositives: Rollout of log collection agents (the setup routine often includes a reset of the local Eventlog)
System provisioning (system reset before the golden image creation)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='System' AND (EventID=104 AND Provider_Name='Microsoft-Windows-Eventlog' AND (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational' OR Channel='Security' OR Channel='System' OR Channel='Windows PowerShell'))
title: Important Windows Eventlog Cleared

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects a process spawned by the terminal service server process (this could be an indicator for an exploitation of CVE-2019-0708)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((ParentCommandLine LIKE '%\\svchost.exe%' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%termsvcs%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE(((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\rdpclip.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\csrss.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\wininit.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\winlogon.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR NewProcessName IS NULL), 0))))
title: Terminal Service Process Spawn

author: Markus Neis, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects potential EmpireMonkey APT activity
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/e:jscript%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\Local\\Temp\\Errors.bat%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Potential EmpireMonkey Activity

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects changes to Internet Explorer's (IE / Windows Internet properties) ZoneMap configuration of the "HTTP" and "HTTPS" protocols to point to the "My Computer" zone. This allows downloaded files from the Internet to be granted the same level of trust as files stored locally.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Internet Settings\\ZoneMap\\ProtocolDefaults%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%http%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% 0%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: IE ZoneMap Setting Downgraded To MyComputer Zone For HTTP Protocols Via CLI

author: Ecco, oscd.community, Jonhnathan Ribeiro, Tim Rauch
description: Detects wmiexec/dcomexec/atexec/smbexec from Impacket framework
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\wmiprvse.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\mmc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\explorer.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\services.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/Q%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/c%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\\\127.0.0.1\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%&1%' ESCAPE '\')) OR ((ParentCommandLine LIKE '%svchost.exe -k netsvcs%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '%taskeng.exe%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/C%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%&1%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: HackTool - Potential Impacket Lateral Movement Activity

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects addition of users to highly privileged groups via "Net" or "Add-LocalGroupMember".
falsepositives: Administrative activity that must be investigated
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((CommandLine LIKE '%localgroup %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% /add%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%Add-LocalGroupMember %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -Group %' ESCAPE '\')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Group Policy Creator Owners%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Schema Admins%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: User Added To Highly Privileged Group

author: Ján Trenčanský
description: Detects AnyDesk Remote Desktop silent installation. Which can be used by attackers to gain remote access.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%--install%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%--start-with-win%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%--silent%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Remote Access Tool - AnyDesk Silent Installation

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects usage of powershell cmdlets to disable or remove ETW trace sessions
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Remove-EtwTraceProvider %' ESCAPE '\' OR (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-EtwTraceProvider %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%0x11%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Disable of ETW Trace - Powershell

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects suspicious script execution from suspicious directories or folders accessible by environment variables that may indicate malware activity.
Script interpreters (cscript, wscript, mshta, powershell) executing from folders like Temp, Public, or user profile directories may suggest attempts to evade detection or execute malicious scripts.
falsepositives: Various legitimate software have been observed to use similar techniques for installation or update purposes;thus, it is recommended to review and tune filters for your environment to reduce false positives before deploying to production.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% -ep bypass %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -ExecutionPolicy bypass %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -w hidden %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/e:javascript %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/e:Jscript %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/e:vbscript %' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='cscript.exe' OR OriginalFileName='mshta.exe' OR OriginalFileName='wscript.exe')) AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Perflogs\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\\%Public\%%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Roaming\\Temp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Temporary Internet%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Windows\\Temp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Start Menu\\Programs\\Startup\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%TEMP\%%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%TMP\%%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%LocalAppData\%\\Temp%' ESCAPE '\') OR ((CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Users\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\Favorites\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Users\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\Favourites\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Users\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\Contacts\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Users\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\Documents\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Users\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\Music\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Users\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\Pictures\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Users\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\Videos\\%' ESCAPE '\'))) AND (NOT COALESCE(((ParentProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\Msiexec.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\Msiexec.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%Install-Chocolatey.ps1%' ESCAPE '\')), 0))))
title: Script Interpreter Execution From Suspicious Folder

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects KrbRelayUp used to perform a universal no-fix local privilege escalation in Windows domain environments where LDAP signing is not enforced
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\KrbRelayUp.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='KrbRelayUp.exe') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% relay %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -Domain %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -ComputerName %' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% krbscm %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -sc %' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% spawn %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -d %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -cn %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -cp %' ESCAPE '\')))
title: HackTool - KrbRelayUp Execution

author: Austin Songer @austinsonger, Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects when a user is potentially trying to bypass the Windows Defender AV by renaming a tool to dump64.exe and placing it in the Visual Studio folder.
Currently the rule is covering only usage of procdump but other utilities can be added in order to increase coverage.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE ':\\Program Files%' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\Microsoft Visual Studio\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\dump64.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (OriginalFileName='procdump' OR (CommandLine LIKE '% -ma %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -mp %' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Potential Windows Defender AV Bypass Via Dump64.EXE Rename

author: Roberto Rodriguez (source), Ilyas Ochkov (rule), oscd.community
description: Detects potential use of Rubeus via registered new trusted logon process
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4611 AND LogonProcessName='User32LogonProcesss')
title: Register new Logon Process by Rubeus

author: Victor Sergeev, oscd.community, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects service path modification via the "sc" binary to a suspicious command or path
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\sc.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%config%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%binPath%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%powershell%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%mshta%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%wscript%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cscript%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%rundll32%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%svchost%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%dllhost%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe /c%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe /k%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe /r%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd /c%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd /k%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd /r%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\Users\\Public%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Downloads\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Desktop\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Microsoft\\Windows\\Start Menu\\Programs\\Startup\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\Windows\\TEMP\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Suspicious Service Path Modification

author: Roberto Rodriguez @Cyb3rWard0g
description: Detects basic PowerShell Remoting (WinRM) by monitoring for network inbound connections to ports 5985 OR 5986
falsepositives: Legitimate use of remote PowerShell execution
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=5156 AND (DestPort=5985 OR DestPort=5986) AND LayerRTID=44)
title: Remote PowerShell Sessions Network Connections (WinRM)

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the execution of certutil with certain flags that allow the utility to download files from direct IPs.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\certutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='CertUtil.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%urlcache %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%verifyctl %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%URL %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%://1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%://2%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%://3%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%://4%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%://5%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%://6%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%://7%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%://8%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%://9%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%://7-%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Suspicious File Downloaded From Direct IP Via Certutil.EXE

author: Dimitrios Slamaris
description: This rule detects a DHCP server in which a specified Callout DLL (in registry) was loaded
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='System' AND (EventID=1033 AND Provider_Name='Microsoft-Windows-DHCP-Server')
title: DHCP Server Loaded the CallOut DLL

author: E.M. Anhaus (originally from Atomic Blue Detections, Endgame), oscd.community
description: Detects the use of the bcdedit command to tamper with the boot configuration data. This technique is often times used by malware or attackers as a destructive way before launching ransomware.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\bcdedit.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='bcdedit.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '%set%' ESCAPE '\' AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%bootstatuspolicy%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%ignoreallfailures%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%recoveryenabled%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%no%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Boot Configuration Tampering Via Bcdedit.EXE

author: Timur Zinniatullin, oscd.community
description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via VAR++ LAUNCHER
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='System' AND (Provider_Name='Service Control Manager' AND EventID=7045 AND (ImagePath LIKE '%&&set%' ESCAPE '\' AND ImagePath LIKE '%cmd%' ESCAPE '\' AND ImagePath LIKE '%/c%' ESCAPE '\' AND ImagePath LIKE '%-f%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ImagePath LIKE '%{0}%' ESCAPE '\' OR ImagePath LIKE '%{1}%' ESCAPE '\' OR ImagePath LIKE '%{2}%' ESCAPE '\' OR ImagePath LIKE '%{3}%' ESCAPE '\' OR ImagePath LIKE '%{4}%' ESCAPE '\' OR ImagePath LIKE '%{5}%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Invoke-Obfuscation VAR++ LAUNCHER OBFUSCATION - System

author: frack113, elhoim, Tim Shelton (fps, alias support), Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects PowerShell scripts attempting to disable scheduled scanning and other parts of Windows Defender ATP or set default actions to allow.
falsepositives: Legitimate PowerShell scripts that disable Windows Defender for troubleshooting purposes. Must be investigated.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ((ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\' AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-dbaf $true%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-dbaf 1%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-dbm $true%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-dbm 1%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-dips $true%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-dips 1%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-DisableArchiveScanning $true%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-DisableArchiveScanning 1%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-DisableBehaviorMonitoring $true%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-DisableBehaviorMonitoring 1%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-DisableBlockAtFirstSeen $true%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-DisableBlockAtFirstSeen 1%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-DisableCatchupFullScan $true%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-DisableCatchupFullScan 1%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-DisableCatchupQuickScan $true%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-DisableCatchupQuickScan 1%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-DisableIntrusionPreventionSystem $true%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-DisableIntrusionPreventionSystem 1%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-DisableIOAVProtection $true%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-DisableIOAVProtection 1%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-DisableRealtimeMonitoring $true%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-DisableRealtimeMonitoring 1%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-DisableRemovableDriveScanning $true%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-DisableRemovableDriveScanning 1%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-DisableScanningMappedNetworkDrivesForFullScan $true%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-DisableScanningMappedNetworkDrivesForFullScan 1%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-DisableScanningNetworkFiles $true%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-DisableScanningNetworkFiles 1%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-DisableScriptScanning $true%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-DisableScriptScanning 1%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-MAPSReporting $false%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-MAPSReporting 0%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-drdsc $true%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-drdsc 1%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-drtm $true%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-drtm 1%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-dscrptsc $true%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-dscrptsc 1%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-dsmndf $true%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-dsmndf 1%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-dsnf $true%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-dsnf 1%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-dss $true%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-dss 1%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\' AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%HighThreatDefaultAction Allow%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%htdefac Allow%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%LowThreatDefaultAction Allow%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ltdefac Allow%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ModerateThreatDefaultAction Allow%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%mtdefac Allow%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%SevereThreatDefaultAction Allow%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%stdefac Allow%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Tamper Windows Defender - ScriptBlockLogging

author: Christian Burkard (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects manipulation of shell open command registry keys such as "ms-settings" and "exefile",
which are commonly abused to achieve UAC bypass (e.g. via fodhelper.exe) or establish persistence
through file association hijacking.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND (OperationType='New registry value created' OR OperationType='Existing registry value modified')) AND (((EventType='SetValue' AND TargetObject LIKE '%Classes\\ms-settings\\shell\\open\\command\\SymbolicLinkValue' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue LIKE '%\\Software\\Classes\\{%' ESCAPE '\') OR TargetObject LIKE '%Classes\\ms-settings\\shell\\open\\command\\DelegateExecute' ESCAPE '\' OR (EventType='SetValue' AND (TargetObject LIKE '%Classes\\ms-settings\\shell\\open\\command\\(Default)' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%Classes\\exefile\\shell\\open\\command\\(Default)' ESCAPE '\'))) AND (NOT COALESCE((NewValue='(Empty)' OR (NewValue='{4813071a-41ad-44a2-9835-886d2f63ca30}' OR NewValue='{A56A841F-E974-45C1-8001-7E3F8A085917}' OR NewValue='{4ED3A719-CEA8-4BD9-910D-E252F997AFC2}' OR NewValue='{BFEC0C93-0B7D-4F2C-B09C-AFFFC4BDAE78}')), 0))))
title: Shell Open Registry Keys Manipulation

author: frack113
description: Detects the modification of the registry to allow a driver or service to persist in Safe Mode.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (((TargetObject LIKE '%\\Control\\SafeBoot\\Minimal\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\Control\\SafeBoot\\Network\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\(Default)' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue='Service') AND (NOT COALESCE(((NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\WINDOWS\\system32\\msiexec.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\Control\\SafeBoot\\Minimal\\SAVService\\(Default)' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\Control\\SafeBoot\\Network\\SAVService\\(Default)' ESCAPE '\')) OR (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\MBAMInstallerService.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\MBAMService\\(Default)' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue='Service') OR (NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Hexnode\\Hexnode Agent\\Current\\HexnodeAgent.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\Control\\SafeBoot\\Minimal\\Hexnode Updater\\(Default)' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\Control\\SafeBoot\\Network\\Hexnode Updater\\(Default)' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\Control\\SafeBoot\\Minimal\\Hexnode Agent\\(Default)' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\Control\\SafeBoot\\Network\\Hexnode Agent\\(Default)' ESCAPE '\') AND NewValue='Service')), 0))))
title: Registry Persistence via Service in Safe Mode

author: Teymur Kheirkhabarov, Ecco, Florian Roth
description: Detects the use of getsystem Meterpreter/Cobalt Strike command by detecting a specific service starting
falsepositives: Commandlines containing components like cmd accidentally
Jobs and services started with cmd
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\services.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (((CommandLine LIKE '%/c%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%echo%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\pipe\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%cmd%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%COMSPEC\%%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (CommandLine LIKE '%rundll32%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.dll,a%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/p:%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%MpCmdRun%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Potential Meterpreter/CobaltStrike Activity

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects changes to the AMSI come server registry key in order disable AMSI scanning functionalities. When AMSI attempts to starts its COM component, it will query its registered CLSID and return a non-existent COM server. This causes a load failure and prevents any scanning methods from being accessed, ultimately rendering AMSI useless
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\CLSID\\{fdb00e52-a214-4aa1-8fba-4357bb0072ec}\\InProcServer32\\(Default)' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((NewValue LIKE '\%windir\%\\system32\\amsi.dll' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Potential AMSI COM Server Hijacking

author: David Ledbetter (shellcode), Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects Base64 encoded Shellcode
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%OiCAAAAYInlM%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%OiJAAAAYInlM%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: PowerShell ShellCode

author: David Burkett, @signalblur
description: It is extremely abnormal for svchost.exe to spawn without any CLI arguments and is normally observed when a malicious process spawns the process and injects code into the process memory space.
falsepositives: Rpcnet.exe / rpcnetp.exe which is a lojack style software. https://www.blackhat.com/docs/us-14/materials/us-14-Kamlyuk-Kamluk-Computrace-Backdoor-Revisited.pdf
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%svchost.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\svchost.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE(((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\rpcnet.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\rpcnetp.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR CommandLine IS NULL), 0))))
title: Suspect Svchost Activity

author: @SBousseaden, Florian Roth
description: Detects logon events that have characteristics of events generated during an attack with RottenPotato and the like
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4624 AND LogonType=3 AND TargetUserName='ANONYMOUS LOGON' AND WorkstationName='-' AND (IpAddress='127.0.0.1' OR IpAddress='::1'))
title: RottenPotato Like Attack Pattern

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects suspicious start of rundll32.exe without any parameters as found in CobaltStrike beacon activity
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe"' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\rundll32' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\Microsoft\\Edge\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Rundll32 Execution Without CommandLine Parameters

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects creation of a new service via "sc" command or the powershell "new-service" cmdlet with suspicious binary paths
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\sc.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%create%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%binPath=%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (CommandLine LIKE '%New-Service%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-BinaryPathName%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%powershell%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%mshta%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%wscript%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cscript%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%svchost%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%dllhost%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe /c%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe /k%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe /r%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%rundll32%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\Users\\Public%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Downloads\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Desktop\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Microsoft\\Windows\\Start Menu\\Programs\\Startup\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\Windows\\TEMP\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Suspicious New Service Creation

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), @Kostastsale
description:
Detects changes to the registry value "PythonFunctionWarnings" that would prevent any warnings or alerts from showing when Python functions are about to be executed.
Threat actors could run malicious code through the new Microsoft Excel feature that allows Python to run within the spreadsheet.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\Microsoft\\Office\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\Excel\\Security\\PythonFunctionWarnings' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue='DWORD (0x00000001)'))
title: Python Function Execution Security Warning Disabled In Excel - Registry

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects potentially suspicious file downloads directly from IP addresses using Wget.exe
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wget.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='wget.exe') AND CommandLine REGEXP '://[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}' AND CommandLine LIKE '%http%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine REGEXP '\s-O\s' OR CommandLine LIKE '%--output-document%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%.ps1' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.ps1''' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.ps1"' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dat' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dat''' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dat"' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.msi' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.msi''' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.msi"' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.bat' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.bat''' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.bat"' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.exe''' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.exe"' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.vbs' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.vbs''' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.vbs"' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.vbe' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.vbe''' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.vbe"' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.hta' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.hta''' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.hta"' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dll' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dll''' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dll"' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.psm1' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.psm1''' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.psm1"' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Suspicious File Download From IP Via Wget.EXE

author: Tim Rauch, Elastic (idea)
description: Detects Invoke-Mimikatz PowerShell script and alike. Mimikatz is a credential dumper capable of obtaining plaintext Windows account logins and passwords.
falsepositives: Mimikatz can be useful for testing the security of networks
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ((ScriptBlockText LIKE '%DumpCreds%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%DumpCerts%' ESCAPE '\') OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%sekurlsa::logonpasswords%' ESCAPE '\' OR (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%crypto::certificates%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%CERT\_SYSTEM\_STORE\_LOCAL\_MACHINE%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Potential Invoke-Mimikatz PowerShell Script

author: Roberto Rodriguez (Cyb3rWard0g), OTR (Open Threat Research)
description: Potential threat actor tampering with Sysmon manifest and eventually disabling it
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND (ObjectName LIKE '%WINEVT\\Publishers\\{5770385f-c22a-43e0-bf4c-06f5698ffbd9}%' ESCAPE '\' OR ObjectName LIKE '%WINEVT\\Channels\\Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational%' ESCAPE '\') AND ObjectValueName='Enabled' AND NewValue=0) OR (EventID=4663 AND (ObjectName LIKE '%WINEVT\\Publishers\\{5770385f-c22a-43e0-bf4c-06f5698ffbd9}%' ESCAPE '\' OR ObjectName LIKE '%WINEVT\\Channels\\Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational%' ESCAPE '\') AND AccessMask='0x10000'))
title: Sysmon Channel Reference Deletion

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects renamed SysInternals tool execution with a binary named ps.exe as used by Dragonfly APT group and documented in TA17-293A report
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%ps.exe -accepteula%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-s cmd /c netstat%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Ps.exe Renamed SysInternals Tool

author: Roberto Rodriguez (source), Dominik Schaudel (rule)
description: Detects successful logon with logon type 9 (NewCredentials) which matches the Overpass the Hash behavior of e.g Mimikatz's sekurlsa::pth module.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4624 AND LogonType=9 AND LogonProcessName='seclogo' AND AuthenticationPackageName='Negotiate')
title: Successful Overpass the Hash Attempt

author: Christian Burkard (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects the execution of Xwizard tool from a non-default directory.
When executed from a non-default directory, this utility can be abused in order to side load a custom version of "xwizards.dll".
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\xwizard.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='xwizard.exe') AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\WinSxS\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Xwizard.EXE Execution From Non-Default Location

author: Joseliyo Sanchez, @Joseliyo_Jstnk
description:
Detects the execution of more.com and vbc.exe in the process tree.
This behavior was observed by a set of samples related to Lummac Stealer.
The Lummac payload is injected into the vbc.exe process.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\more.com' ESCAPE '\' AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\vbc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='vbc.exe')))
title: Lummac Stealer Activity - Execution Of More.com And Vbc.exe

author: Nikita Nazarov, oscd.community
description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via use Clip.exe in Scripts
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4697 AND ServiceFileName LIKE '%(Clipboard|i%' ESCAPE '\')
title: Invoke-Obfuscation Via Use Clip - Security

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects a ping command that uses a hex encoded IP address
falsepositives: Unlikely, because no sane admin pings IP addresses in a hexadecimal form
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\ping.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine REGEXP '0x[a-fA-F0-9]{8}'))
title: Ping Hex IP

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects uses of a renamed legitimate createdump.exe LOLOBIN utility to dump process memory
falsepositives: Command lines that use the same flags
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((OriginalFileName LIKE 'FX\_VER\_INTERNALNAME\_STR' ESCAPE '\' OR ((CommandLine LIKE '% -u %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -f %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.dmp%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% --full %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% --name %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.dmp%' ESCAPE '\'))) AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\createdump.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Renamed CreateDump Utility Execution

author: Roberto Rodriguez (Cyb3rWard0g), OTR (Open Threat Research)
description:
Detects potential malicious modification of the property value of IsCredGuardEnabled from
HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SecurityProviders\WDigest to disable Cred Guard on a system.
This is usually used with UseLogonCredential to manipulate the caching credentials.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND (OperationType='New registry value created' OR OperationType='Existing registry value modified')) AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\IsCredGuardEnabled' ESCAPE '\')
title: Wdigest CredGuard Registry Modification

author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects attempts to disable security event logging by adding the `MiniNt` registry key.
This key is used to disable the Windows Event Log service, which collects and stores event logs from the operating system and applications.
Adversaries may want to disable this service to prevent logging of security events that could be used to detect their activities.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='reg.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% add %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\MiniNt%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell\_ise.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%New-Item %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ni %' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\MiniNt%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Security Event Logging Disabled via MiniNt Registry Key - Process

author: Trent Liffick (@tliffick), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects registry changes to Microsoft Office "AccessVBOM" to a value of "1" which disables trust access for VBA on the victim machine and lets attackers execute malicious macros without any Microsoft Office warnings.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\Security\\AccessVBOM' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue='DWORD (0x00000001)'))
title: Trust Access Disable For VBApplications

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects suspicious PowerShell scripts accessing SAM hives
falsepositives: PowerShell scripts fixing HiveNightmare / SeriousSAM ACLs
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%\\HarddiskVolumeShadowCopy%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%System32\\config\\sam%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Copy-Item%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cp $\_.%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cpi $\_.%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%copy $\_.%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.File]::Copy(%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: PowerShell SAM Copy

author: pH-T (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects service installation with suspicious folder patterns
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='System' AND ((Provider_Name='Service Control Manager' AND EventID=7045) AND (ImagePath REGEXP '^[Cc]:\\[Pp]rogram[Dd]ata\\.{1,9}\.exe' OR ImagePath REGEXP '^[Cc]:\\.{1,9}\.exe'))
title: Service Installation with Suspicious Folder Pattern

author: Daniel Bohannon (@Mandiant/@FireEye), oscd.community
description: Detects all variations of obfuscated powershell IEX invocation code generated by Invoke-Obfuscation framework from the following code block \u2014
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText REGEXP '\$PSHome\[\s*\d{1,3}\s*\]\s*\+\s*\$PSHome\[' OR ScriptBlockText REGEXP '\$ShellId\[\s*\d{1,3}\s*\]\s*\+\s*\$ShellId\[' OR ScriptBlockText REGEXP '\$env:Public\[\s*\d{1,3}\s*\]\s*\+\s*\$env:Public\[' OR ScriptBlockText REGEXP '\$env:ComSpec\[(\s*\d{1,3}\s*,){2}' OR ScriptBlockText REGEXP '\*mdr\*\W\s*\)\.Name' OR ScriptBlockText REGEXP '\$VerbosePreference\.ToString\('))
title: Invoke-Obfuscation Obfuscated IEX Invocation - PowerShell

author: James Pemberton / @4A616D6573
description: Detects the creation of suspicious accounts similar to ANONYMOUS LOGON, such as using additional spaces. Created as an covering detection for exclusion of Logon Type 3 from ANONYMOUS LOGON accounts.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4720 AND (SamAccountName LIKE '%ANONYMOUS%' ESCAPE '\' AND SamAccountName LIKE '%LOGON%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Suspicious Windows ANONYMOUS LOGON Local Account Created

author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects specific process tree behavior linked to "rundll32" executions, wherein the associated DLL lacks a common ".dll" extension, often signaling potential Pikabot activity.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%:\\ProgramData\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Installer\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Roaming\\%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE(((CommandLine LIKE '%.cpl %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.cpl,%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dll %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dll,%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.inf %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.inf,%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%.cpl' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.cpl"' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dll' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dll"' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.inf' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.inf"' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.cpl''' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dll''' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.inf''' ESCAPE '\')), 0))))
title: Pikabot Fake DLL Extension Execution Via Rundll32.EXE

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects when an attacker tries to modify an already existing scheduled tasks to run from a suspicious location
Attackers can create a simple looking task in order to avoid detection on creation as it's often the most focused on
Instead they modify the task after creation to include their malicious payload
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\schtasks.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% /Change %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% /TN %' ESCAPE '\')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Roaming\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\WINDOWS\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Desktop\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Downloads\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Temporary Internet%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\ProgramData\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\Perflogs\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%ProgramData\%%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%appdata\%%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%comspec\%%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%localappdata\%%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%regsvr32%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%rundll32%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd /c %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd /k %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd /r %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe /c %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe /k %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe /r %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%powershell%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%mshta%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%wscript%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cscript%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%certutil%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%bitsadmin%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%bash.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%bash %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%scrcons%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%wmic %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%wmic.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%forfiles%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%scriptrunner%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%hh.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%hh %' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Suspicious Modification Of Scheduled Tasks

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the execution of a renamed version of the Plink binary
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((OriginalFileName='Plink' OR (CommandLine LIKE '% -l forward%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -P %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -R %' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\plink.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Renamed Plink Execution

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), oscd.community, Jonhnathan Ribeiro
description: Detects exploitation attempt of privilege escalation vulnerability via SetupComplete.cmd and PartnerSetupComplete.cmd described in CVE-2019-1378
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((ParentCommandLine LIKE '%\\cmd.exe%' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%/c%' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%C:\\Windows\\Setup\\Scripts\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ParentCommandLine LIKE '%SetupComplete.cmd' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '%PartnerSetupComplete.cmd' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\WinSxS\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\Setup\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Exploiting SetupComplete.cmd CVE-2019-1378

author: X__Junior (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the execution of a Chromium based browser process with the "headless" flag and a URL pointing to the mockbin.org service (which can be used to exfiltrate data).
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\brave.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\chrome.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\msedge.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\opera.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\vivaldi.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%--headless%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%://run.mocky%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%://mockbin%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Chromium Browser Headless Execution To Mockbin Like Site

author: Hieu Tran
description: Detects a registry key used by IceID in a campaign that distributes malicious OneNote files
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND (OperationType='New registry value created' OR OperationType='Existing registry value modified')) AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\Software\\firm\\soft\\Name' ESCAPE '\')
title: Potential Qakbot Registry Activity

author: Christian Burkard (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the pattern of UAC Bypass using consent.exe and comctl32.dll (UACMe 22)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\consent.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\werfault.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (IntegrityLevel='High' OR IntegrityLevel='System' OR IntegrityLevel='S-1-16-16384' OR IntegrityLevel='S-1-16-12288')))
title: UAC Bypass Using Consent and Comctl32 - Process

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects suspicious process related to rundll32 based on command line that invokes inline VBScript as seen being used by UNC2452
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%rundll32.exe%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%Execute%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%RegRead%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%window.close%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Suspicious Rundll32 Invoking Inline VBScript

author: Mauricio Velazco, Michael Haag
description: Detect PetitPotam coerced authentication activity.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=5145 AND ShareName LIKE '\\\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND ShareName LIKE '%\\IPC$' ESCAPE '\' AND RelativeTargetName='lsarpc' AND SubjectUserName='ANONYMOUS LOGON')
title: Possible PetitPotam Coerce Authentication Attempt

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), frack113
description: Detects activity mentioned in Operation Wocao report
falsepositives: Administrators that use checkadmin.exe tool to enumerate local administrators
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%checkadmin.exe 127.0.0.1 -all%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name=powershell dir=in%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd /c powershell.exe -ep bypass -file c:\\s.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/tn win32times /f%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%create win32times binPath=%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\c$\\windows\\system32\\devmgr.dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -exec bypass -enc JgAg%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%type %keepass\\KeePass.config.xml%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%iie.exe iie.txt%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%reg query HKEY\_CURRENT\_USER\\Software\\%\\PuTTY\\Sessions\\%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Operation Wocao Activity

author: Christopher Peacock
description: Detects registry keys related to NetWire RAT
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='New registry value created') AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\software\\NetWire%' ESCAPE '\')
title: Potential NetWire RAT Activity - Registry

author: pH-T (Nextron Systems), Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects suspicious service installation commands
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='System' AND (Provider_Name='Service Control Manager' AND EventID=7045 AND (ImagePath LIKE '% -nop %' ESCAPE '\' OR ImagePath LIKE '% -sta %' ESCAPE '\' OR ImagePath LIKE '% -w hidden %' ESCAPE '\' OR ImagePath LIKE '%:\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ImagePath LIKE '%.downloadfile(%' ESCAPE '\' OR ImagePath LIKE '%.downloadstring(%' ESCAPE '\' OR ImagePath LIKE '%\\ADMIN$\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ImagePath LIKE '%\\Perflogs\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ImagePath LIKE '%&&%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Suspicious Service Installation

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects execution of the "mofcomp" utility as a child of a suspicious shell or script running utility or by having a suspicious path in the commandline.
The "mofcomp" utility parses a file containing MOF statements and adds the classes and class instances defined in the file to the WMI repository.
Attackers abuse this utility to install malicious MOF scripts
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\mofcomp.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='mofcomp.exe') AND ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\wsl.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Contacts\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Favorites\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Favourites\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Music\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Pictures\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Videos\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\WINDOWS\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%appdata\%%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%temp\%%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%tmp\%%' ESCAPE '\'))) AND (NOT COALESCE(((ParentProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\wbem\\WmiPrvSE.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\Windows\\TEMP\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.mof' ESCAPE '\') OR (ParentCommandLine LIKE '%\\InstallUtil.exe /Uninstall C:\\Windows\\CCM\\Microsoft.ConfigurationManager.SVProvider.dll' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\InstallUtil.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\Windows\\TEMP%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.tmp%' ESCAPE '\'))), 0)) AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentCommandLine IS NULL), 0))))
title: Potentially Suspicious Mofcomp Execution

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: This method detects a service install of malicious services mentioned in Carbon Paper - Turla report by ESET
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='System' AND (Provider_Name='Service Control Manager' AND EventID=7045 AND (ServiceName='srservice' OR ServiceName='ipvpn' OR ServiceName='hkmsvc'))
title: Turla Service Install

author: Matt Anderson (Huntress)
description:
Detects the use of PowerShell to execute the 'Set-MpPreference' cmdlet to configure Windows Defender's threat severity default action to 'Allow' (value '6') or 'NoAction' (value '9').
This is a highly suspicious configuration change that effectively disables Defender's ability to automatically mitigate threats of a certain severity level.
An attacker might use this technique via the command line to bypass defenses before executing payloads.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Set-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-LowThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-ModerateThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-HighThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-SevereThreatDefaultAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-ltdefac %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-mtdefac %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-htdefac %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-stdefac %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Allow%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%6%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%NoAction%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%9%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: PowerShell Defender Threat Severity Default Action Set to 'Allow' or 'NoAction'

author: Jason (https://github.com/0xbcf)
description:
Detects potential abuse of WerFaultSecure.exe to dump Protected Process Light (PPL) processes like LSASS or to freeze security solutions (EDR/antivirus).
This technique is used by tools such as EDR-Freeze and WSASS to bypass PPL protections and access sensitive information or disable security software.
Distinct command line patterns help identify the specific tool:
- WSASS usage typically shows: "WSASS.exe WerFaultSecure.exe [PID]" in ParentCommandLine
- EDR-Freeze usage typically shows: "EDR-Freeze_[version].exe [PID] [timeout]" in ParentCommandLine
Legitimate debugging operations using WerFaultSecure are rare in production environments and should be investigated.
falsepositives: Legitimate usage of WerFaultSecure for debugging purposes
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\WerFaultSecure.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='WerFaultSecure.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% /h %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% /pid %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% /tid %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% /encfile %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% /cancel %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% /type %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% 268310%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: PPL Tampering Via WerFaultSecure

author: Michael Haag, Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Markus Neis, Elastic, FPT.EagleEye Team
description: Detects a suspicious process spawning from an Outlook process.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\OUTLOOK.EXE' ESCAPE '\' AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\AppVLP.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\bash.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\forfiles.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\hh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\mftrace.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\msbuild.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\msdt.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\msiexec.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\schtasks.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\scrcons.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\scriptrunner.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\sh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\svchost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wmic.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\')))

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects suspicious inline VBScript keywords as used by UNC2452
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%Execute%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%CreateObject%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%RegRead%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%window.close%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Suspicious VBScript UN2452 Pattern

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects specific command line argument being passed to a binary as seen being used by the malware Small Sieve.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND CommandLine LIKE '%.exe Platypus' ESCAPE '\')
title: Small Sieve Malware CommandLine Indicator

author: Tom Ueltschi (@c_APT_ure)
description: Detects the addition of a new LogonScript to the registry value "UserInitMprLogonScript" for potential persistence
falsepositives: Legitimate addition of Logon Scripts via the command line by administrators or third party tools
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND CommandLine LIKE '%UserInitMprLogonScript%' ESCAPE '\')
title: Potential Persistence Via Logon Scripts - CommandLine

author: Sreeman, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Adversaries can use curl to download payloads remotely and execute them. Curl is included by default in Windows 10 build 17063 and later.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine LIKE '% -c %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /c %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –c %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —c %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―c %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%curl %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%http%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-o%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%&%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Curl Download And Execute Combination

author: megan201296
description: Detects registry keys related to Ursnif malware.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='New registry value created') AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\Software\\AppDataLow\\Software\\Microsoft\\3A861D62-51E0-7C9D-AB0E-15700F2219A4' ESCAPE '\')
title: Potential Ursnif Malware Activity - Registry

author: Tim Rauch, Elastic (idea)
description: Detects deletion of Windows Volume Shadow Copies with PowerShell code and Get-WMIObject. This technique is used by numerous ransomware families such as Sodinokibi/REvil
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%Get-WmiObject%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%gwmi%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Get-CimInstance%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%gcim%' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%Win32\_ShadowCopy%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%.Delete()%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Remove-WmiObject%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%rwmi%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Remove-CimInstance%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%rcim%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Deletion of Volume Shadow Copies via WMI with PowerShell

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the usage of schtasks with the delete flag and the asterisk symbol to delete all tasks from the schedule of the local computer, including tasks scheduled by other users.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\schtasks.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% /delete %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/tn *%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% /f%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Delete All Scheduled Tasks

author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects tampering of the Vulnerable Driver Blocklist registry via command line tools such as PowerShell or REG.EXE.
The Vulnerable Driver Blocklist is a security feature that helps prevent the loading of known vulnerable drivers.
Disabling this feature may indicate an attempt to bypass security controls, often targeted by threat actors
to facilitate the installation of malicious or vulnerable drivers, particularly in scenarios involving Endpoint Detection and Response
falsepositives: It is very unlikely for legitimate activities to disable the Vulnerable Driver Blocklist via command line tools; thus it is recommended to investigate promptly.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll' OR OriginalFileName='reg.exe')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%add %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%New-ItemProperty %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Set-ItemProperty %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%si %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\Control\\CI\\Config%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%VulnerableDriverBlocklistEnable%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Vulnerable Driver Blocklist Registry Tampering Via CommandLine

description: Detects usage of the "Set-Service" powershell cmdlet to configure a new SecurityDescriptor that allows a service to be hidden from other utilities such as "sc.exe", "Get-Service"...etc. (Works only in powershell 7)
falsepositives: Rare intended use of hidden services
Rare FP could occur due to the non linearity of the ScriptBlockText log
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ((ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-SecurityDescriptorSddl %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-sd %' ESCAPE '\') AND ((ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Set-Service %' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%D;;%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%;;;IU%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%;;;SU%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%;;;BA%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%;;;SY%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%;;;WD%' ESCAPE '\'))))

description: Detects encoded base64 MZ header in the commandline
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%TVqQAAMAAAAEAAAA%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%TVpQAAIAAAAEAA8A%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%TVqAAAEAAAAEABAA%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%TVoAAAAAAAAAAAAA%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%TVpTAQEAAAAEAAAA%' ESCAPE '\'))

description: Triggers on any Sysmon "FileBlockExecutable" event, which indicates a violation of the configured block policy
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational' AND EventID=27
title: Sysmon Blocked Executable

author: TropChaud
description: Detect usage of the "sqlite" binary to query databases in Chromium-based browsers for potential data stealing.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((Product='SQLite' OR (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\sqlite.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\sqlite3.exe' ESCAPE '\')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\User Data\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Opera Software\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\ChromiumViewer\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Login Data%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Cookies%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Web Data%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%History%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Bookmarks%' ESCAPE '\')))

description: Detects scheduled task creations or modification on a suspicious schedule type
falsepositives: Legitimate processes that run at logon. Filter according to your environment
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\schtasks.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='schtasks.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% ONLOGON %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ONSTART %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ONCE %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ONIDLE %' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%NT AUT%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% SYSTEM%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%HIGHEST%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))

rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=5145 AND ShareName LIKE '\\\\*\\ADMIN$' ESCAPE '\' AND (RelativeTargetName LIKE '%SYSTEM32\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND RelativeTargetName LIKE '%.tmp%' ESCAPE '\'))

description: Detects adding and using Exchange PowerShell snap-ins to export mailbox data. As seen used by HAFNIUM and APT27
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND CommandLine LIKE '%Add-PSSnapin%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Microsoft.Exchange.Powershell.Snapin%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Microsoft.Exchange.Management.PowerShell.SnapIn%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\msiexec.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%$exserver=Get-ExchangeServer ([Environment]::MachineName) -ErrorVariable exerr 2> $null%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))

description: Detects when 'DllRegisterServer' is called in the commandline and the image is not rundll32. This could mean that the 'rundll32' utility has been renamed in order to avoid detection
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%DllRegisterServer%' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Potential Renamed Rundll32 Execution

author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems), @unresolvedhost
description:
Detects two stages of the RedSun post-exploitation process chain that deliver a SYSTEM-level shell to the attacker's interactive session.
Observed process chain
  services.exe
    → TieringEngineService.exe
      → conhost.exe             (SYSTEM, CommandLine: bare path, no arguments)
        → cmd.exe / shell       (SYSTEM, TerminalSessionId = attacker's session)

Stage 1 — TieringEngineService.exe spawns argument-less conhost.exe:
  After winning the oplock + Cloud Files mount point race, the malicious TieringEngineService.exe (RedSun.exe copied to System32, started via CoCreateInstance
  / services.exe) detects it is NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM and calls LaunchConsoleInSessionId().
  This opens \\.\pipe\REDSUN, reads the attacker's session ID, duplicates the SYSTEM token, re-stamps it with that session ID via SetTokenInformation(TokenSessionId), then
  calls CreateProcessAsUser to spawn conhost.exe with no arguments.

Stage 2 — Shell spawned from rogue conhost.exe (EDR sources with GrandParentImage):
  The rogue SYSTEM conhost.exe spawns a shell (cmd.exe, PowerShell, etc.) as SYSTEM in the attacker's interactive session.
  On EDR sources that expose GrandParentImage, the full three-level chain (TieringEngineService.exe → conhost.exe → shell) can be matched directly.
  The legitimate TieringEngineService.exe is a headless COM server that is unlikely to spawn conhost.exe under normal conditions.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\TieringEngineService.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\conhost.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%conhost.exe"' ESCAPE '\' AND (User LIKE '%AUTHORI%' ESCAPE '\' OR User LIKE '%AUTORI%' ESCAPE '\' OR User LIKE '%$%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (GrandParentImage LIKE '%\\TieringEngineService.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\conhost.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell\_ise.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (User LIKE '%AUTHORI%' ESCAPE '\' OR User LIKE '%AUTORI%' ESCAPE '\' OR User LIKE '%$%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: RedSun - Conhost.exe Spawned by TieringEngineService.exe
