author: MSFT (idea), Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects suspicious command execution by child processes of the GoAnywhere Managed File Transfer (MFT) application, which may indicate exploitation such as CVE-2025-10035.
This behavior is indicative of post-exploitation activity related to CVE-2025-10035, as observed in campaigns by the threat actor Storm-1175.
falsepositives: Legitimate administrative scripts or built-in GoAnywhere functions could potentially trigger this rule. Tuning may be required based on normal activity in your environment.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\GoAnywhere\\tomcat\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell\_ise.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%IEX%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%enc%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%Hidden%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%bypass%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine REGEXP 'net\s+user' OR CommandLine REGEXP 'net\s+group' OR CommandLine REGEXP 'query\s+session') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%whoami%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%systeminfo%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%dsquery%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%localgroup administrators%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%nltest%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%samaccountname=%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%adscredentials%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%o365accountconfiguration%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.DownloadString(%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.DownloadFile(%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%FromBase64String(%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%System.IO.Compression%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%System.IO.MemoryStream%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%curl%' ESCAPE '\'))) OR ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%powershell%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%whoami%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%net.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%net1.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%rundll32%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%quser%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%nltest%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%curl%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (CommandLine LIKE '%bitsadmin%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%certutil%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%mshta%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cscript%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%wscript%' ESCAPE '\')))))
title: Potential Exploitation of GoAnywhere MFT Vulnerability

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: This rule detects a suspicious crash of the Microsoft Malware Protection Engine
falsepositives: MsMpEng might crash if the "C:\" partition is full
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Application' AND (Provider_Name='Windows Error Reporting' AND EventID=1001 AND (Data LIKE '%MsMpEng.exe%' ESCAPE '\' AND Data LIKE '%mpengine.dll%' ESCAPE '\'))

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects suspicious DACL modifications to allow access to a service from a suspicious trustee. This can be used to override access restrictions set by previous ACLs.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\sc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='sc.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%sdset%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%A;%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%;IU%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%;SU%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%;BA%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%;SY%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%;WD%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Hexnode\\Hexnode Agent\\Current\\HexnodeAgent.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))

author: Jonathan Cheong, oscd.community
description: Detects Obfuscated use of stdin to execute PowerShell
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND CommandLine REGEXP 'cmd.{0,5}(?:/c|/r).+powershell.+(?:\$\{?input\}?|noexit).+\"')

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Tim Shelton (fp werfault)
description: Detects suspicious process executions in which Sysmon itself is the parent of a process, which could be a sign of exploitation (e.g. CVE-2022-41120)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\Sysmon.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\Sysmon64.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE(((NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Users\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\Sysmon.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\Sysmon64.exe' ESCAPE '\')) OR (NewProcessName LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Sysmon.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Sysmon64.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\conhost.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\WerFault.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\WerFaultSecure.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\wevtutil.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\wevtutil.exe%' ESCAPE '\') OR NewProcessName IS NULL), 0))))
title: Suspicious Sysmon as Execution Parent

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali
description: Detects potential exploitation attempt of undocumented Windows Server Pre Auth Remote Code Execution (RCE)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\svchost.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\svchost.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%-k DHCPServer%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-k DHCPServer%' ESCAPE '\' AND (User LIKE '%NETWORK SERVICE%' ESCAPE '\' OR User LIKE '%NETZWERKDIENST%' ESCAPE '\' OR User LIKE '%SERVIZIO DI RETE%' ESCAPE '\' OR User LIKE '%SERVICIO DE RED%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Potential Exploitation Attempt Of Undocumented WindowsServer RCE

author: frack113
description: When configured with suitable command line arguments, w32tm can act as a delay mechanism
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\w32tm.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='w32time.dll') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/stripchart%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/computer:%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/period:%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/dataonly%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/samples:%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Use of W32tm as Timer

author: Roberto Rodriguez (source), Ilyas Ochkov (rule), oscd.community
description: The 'LsaRegisterLogonProcess' function verifies that the application making the function call is a logon process by checking that it has the SeTcbPrivilege privilege set. Possible Rubeus tries to get a handle to LSA.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4673 AND Service='LsaRegisterLogonProcess()' AND Keywords='0x8010000000000000')
title: User Couldn't Call a Privileged Service 'LsaRegisterLogonProcess'

author: Nounou Mbeiri, Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects the execution of the Restic backup tool, which can be used for data exfiltration.
Threat actors may leverage Restic to back up and exfiltrate sensitive data to remote storage locations, including cloud services.
If not legitimately used in the enterprise environment, its presence may indicate malicious activity.
falsepositives: Legitimate use of Restic for backup purposes within the organization.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((CommandLine LIKE '%--password-file%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%init%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -r %' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%--use-fs-snapshot%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%backup%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -r %' ESCAPE '\')) OR ((CommandLine LIKE '%sftp:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%rest:http%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%s3:s3.%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%s3.http%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%azure:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% gs:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%rclone:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%swift:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% b2:%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% init %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -r %' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: PUA - Restic Backup Tool Execution

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects potential RDP connection via Mstsc using a local ".rdp" file located in suspicious locations.
falsepositives: Likelihood is related to how often the paths are used in the environment
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\mstsc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='mstsc.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%.rdp' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.rdp"' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\spool\\drivers\\color%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\Tasks\_Migrated %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Tasks\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Tracing\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Downloads\\%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Suspicious Mstsc.EXE Execution With Local RDP File

author: oscd.community, Dmitry Uchakin
description: Unfixed method for UAC bypass from Windows 10. WSReset.exe file associated with the Windows Store. It will run a binary file contained in a low-privilege registry.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND (OperationType='New registry value created' OR OperationType='Existing registry value modified')) AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\AppX82a6gwre4fdg3bt635tn5ctqjf8msdd2\\Shell\\open\\command' ESCAPE '\')
title: UAC Bypass Via Wsreset

author: elhoim, Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects potentially suspicious child processes of "regsvr32.exe".
falsepositives: Unlikely, but can rarely occur. Apply additional filters accordingly.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\calc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\explorer.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\net.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\net1.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\nltest.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\notepad.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\schtasks.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\werfault.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\werfault.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -u -p %' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Potentially Suspicious Child Process Of Regsvr32

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects blocked image load events with revoked certificates by code integrity.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Microsoft-Windows-CodeIntegrity/Operational' AND EventID=3036
title: CodeIntegrity - Blocked Image Load With Revoked Certificate

author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the use of Kali Linux through Windows Subsystem for Linux
falsepositives: Legitimate installation or usage of Kali Linux WSL by administrators or security teams
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((((NewProcessName LIKE '%:\\Users\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\packages\\KaliLinux%' ESCAPE '\') OR (NewProcessName LIKE '%:\\Users\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Microsoft\\WindowsApps\\kali.exe%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (NewProcessName LIKE '%:\\Program Files\\WindowsApps\\KaliLinux.%' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\kali.exe' ESCAPE '\')) OR (((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\wsl.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\wslhost.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\kali.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\KaliLinux%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%Kali.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Kali-linux%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%kalilinux%' ESCAPE '\'))) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '% -i %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --install %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --unregister %' ESCAPE '\'), 0)))))
title: WSL Kali-Linux Usage

author: Thomas Patzke
description: The CrachMapExec pentesting framework implements a PowerShell obfuscation with some static strings detected by this rule.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%join%split%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%( $ShellId[1]+$ShellId[13]+''x'')%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%( $PSHome[%]+$PSHOME[%]+%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%( $env:Public[13]+$env:Public[5]+''x'')%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%( $env:ComSpec[4,%,25]-Join'''')%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%[1,3]+''x''-Join'''')%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: HackTool - CrackMapExec PowerShell Obfuscation

author: Bartlomiej Czyz, Relativity
description: Detects usage of Metasploit SMB PsExec (exploit/windows/smb/psexec) and Impacket psexec.py by triggering on specific service installation
falsepositives: Possible, different agents with a 8 character binary and a 4, 8 or 16 character service name
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4697 AND ServiceFileName REGEXP '^%systemroot%\\[a-zA-Z]{8}\.exe$' AND ServiceName REGEXP '(^[a-zA-Z]{4}$)|(^[a-zA-Z]{8}$)|(^[a-zA-Z]{16}$)' AND ServiceStartType=3 AND ServiceType='0x10') AND (NOT COALESCE((ServiceName='PSEXESVC'), 0)))
title: Metasploit Or Impacket Service Installation Via SMB PsExec

author: Bhabesh Raj
description: Detects potential sideloading of "mpclient.dll" by Windows Defender processes ("MpCmdRun" and "NisSrv") from their non-default directory.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\MpCmdRun.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\NisSrv.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Windows Defender\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\Microsoft Security Client\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\Windows Defender\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\Windows Defender\\Platform\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\WinSxS\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Potential Mpclient.DLL Sideloading Via Defender Binaries

author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel
description: Detects potential abuse of the provisioning registry key for indirect command execution through "Provlaunch.exe".
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Provisioning\\Commands\\%' ESCAPE '\')
title: Potential Provisioning Registry Key Abuse For Binary Proxy Execution - REG

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects changes to the "Default" property for keys located in the \Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\App Paths\ registry. Which might be used as a method of persistence
The entries found under App Paths are used primarily for the following purposes.
First, to map an application's executable file name to that file's fully qualified path.
Second, to prepend information to the PATH environment variable on a per-application, per-process basis.
falsepositives: Legitimate applications registering their binary from on of the suspicious locations mentioned above (tune it)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\App Paths%' ESCAPE '\' AND (TargetObject LIKE '%(Default)' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%Path' ESCAPE '\') AND (NewValue LIKE '%\\Users\\Public%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%\\Desktop\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%\\Downloads\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%\%temp\%%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%\%tmp\%%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%iex%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%Invoke-%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%rundll32%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%regsvr32%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%mshta%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%cscript%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%wscript%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%.bat%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%.hta%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%.ps1%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Potential Persistence Via App Paths Default Property

author: pH-T (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects suspicious service installation scripts
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='System' AND ((Provider_Name='Service Control Manager' AND EventID=7045) AND (ImagePath LIKE '% -c %' ESCAPE '\' OR ImagePath LIKE '% /c %' ESCAPE '\' OR ImagePath LIKE '% –c %' ESCAPE '\' OR ImagePath LIKE '% —c %' ESCAPE '\' OR ImagePath LIKE '% ―c %' ESCAPE '\' OR ImagePath LIKE '% -r %' ESCAPE '\' OR ImagePath LIKE '% /r %' ESCAPE '\' OR ImagePath LIKE '% –r %' ESCAPE '\' OR ImagePath LIKE '% —r %' ESCAPE '\' OR ImagePath LIKE '% ―r %' ESCAPE '\' OR ImagePath LIKE '% -k %' ESCAPE '\' OR ImagePath LIKE '% /k %' ESCAPE '\' OR ImagePath LIKE '% –k %' ESCAPE '\' OR ImagePath LIKE '% —k %' ESCAPE '\' OR ImagePath LIKE '% ―k %' ESCAPE '\') AND (ImagePath LIKE '%cscript%' ESCAPE '\' OR ImagePath LIKE '%mshta%' ESCAPE '\' OR ImagePath LIKE '%powershell%' ESCAPE '\' OR ImagePath LIKE '%pwsh%' ESCAPE '\' OR ImagePath LIKE '%regsvr32%' ESCAPE '\' OR ImagePath LIKE '%rundll32%' ESCAPE '\' OR ImagePath LIKE '%wscript%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Suspicious Service Installation Script

author: Max Altgelt (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects process creation events where the Image field lacks an absolute path,
which occurs when the backing file no longer exists on disk at the time of
logging - commonly caused by Process Ghosting or other unorthodox process creation techniques.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0)) AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName IS NULL OR (NewProcessName='-' OR NewProcessName='') OR ((NewProcessName='MemCompression' OR NewProcessName='Registry' OR NewProcessName='System' OR NewProcessName='vmmem' OR NewProcessName='vmmemWSL') OR (CommandLine='MemCompression' OR CommandLine='Registry' OR CommandLine='vmmem' OR CommandLine='vmmemWSL'))), 0))))
title: Execution Of Non-Existing File

author: Denis Szadkowski, DIRT / DCSO CyTec
description: This rule detects the execution of the extended storage procedure backdoor named Maggie in the context of Microsoft SQL server
falsepositives: Legitimate extended stored procedures named maggie
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Application' AND (Provider_Name='MSSQLSERVER' AND EventID=8128 AND Message LIKE '%maggie%' ESCAPE '\')
title: MSSQL Extended Stored Procedure Backdoor Maggie

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects suspicious way to dump the kernel on Windows systems using dtrace.exe, which is available on Windows systems since Windows 10 19H1
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\dtrace.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%lkd(0)%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%syscall:::return%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%lkd(%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Suspicious Kernel Dump Using Dtrace

author: Tim Rauch (Nextron Systems), Elastic (idea)
description: Detects a service installed by a client which has PID 0 or whose parent has PID 0
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='System' AND (Provider_Name='Service Control Manager' AND EventID=7045 AND ProcessId=0)
title: Service Installed By Unusual Client - System

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects execution of the POWERHOLD script seen used by FIN7 as reported by WithSecureLabs
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%$env:APPDATA%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%function MainPayload%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%::WriteAllBytes%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%wscript.exe%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Potential APT FIN7 POWERHOLD Execution

author: Chakib Gzenayi (@Chak092), Hosni Mribah
description: Alerts on Metasploit host's authentications on the domain.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (((EventID=4625 OR EventID=4624) AND LogonType=3 AND AuthenticationPackageName='NTLM' AND WorkstationName REGEXP '^[A-Za-z0-9]{16}$') OR (EventID=4776 AND Workstation REGEXP '^[A-Za-z0-9]{16}$'))
title: Metasploit SMB Authentication

author: frack113, Nextron Systems
description:
Detects the setting of the environement variable "windir" to a non default value.
Attackers often abuse this variable in order to trigger a UAC bypass via the "SilentCleanup" task.
The SilentCleanup task located in %windir%\system32\cleanmgr.exe is an auto-elevated task that can be abused to elevate any file with administrator privileges without prompting UAC.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\Environment\\windir' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((NewValue LIKE '\%SystemRoot\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Bypass UAC Using SilentCleanup Task

author: Jonathan Cheong, oscd.community
description: Detects Obfuscated use of stdin to execute PowerShell
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='System' AND ((Provider_Name='Service Control Manager' AND EventID=7045 AND (ImagePath LIKE '%cmd%' ESCAPE '\' AND ImagePath LIKE '%powershell%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ImagePath LIKE '%/c%' ESCAPE '\' OR ImagePath LIKE '%/r%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (ImagePath LIKE '%noexit%' ESCAPE '\' OR (ImagePath LIKE '%input%' ESCAPE '\' AND ImagePath LIKE '%$%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Invoke-Obfuscation STDIN+ Launcher - System

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects a certain command line flag combination used by mpiexec.exe LOLBIN from HPC pack that can be used to execute any other binary
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\mpiexec.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=d8b52ef6aaa3a81501bdfff9dbb96217%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% /n 1 %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -n 1 %' ESCAPE '\')))
title: MpiExec Lolbin

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects suspicious process related to rundll32 based on command line that includes a *.sys file as seen being used by UNC2452
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%rundll32.exe%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%.sys,%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.sys %' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Suspicious Rundll32 Activity Invoking Sys File

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects suspicious use of 'calc.exe' with command line parameters or in a suspicious directory, which is likely caused by some PoC or detection evasion.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\calc.exe %' ESCAPE '\' OR (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\calc.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%:\\Windows\\WinSxS\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0)))))
title: Suspicious Calculator Usage

author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects attempts to disable Windows Credential Guard by setting registry values to 0. Credential Guard uses virtualization-based security to isolate secrets so that only privileged system software can access them.
Adversaries may disable Credential Guard to gain access to sensitive credentials stored in the system, such as NTLM hashes and Kerberos tickets, which can be used for lateral movement and privilege escalation.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND ((TargetObject LIKE '%\\DeviceGuard\\EnableVirtualizationBasedSecurity' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\DeviceGuard\\LsaCfgFlags' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\Lsa\\LsaCfgFlags' ESCAPE '\') AND NewValue='DWORD (0x00000000)'))
title: Windows Credential Guard Disabled - Registry

author: Lednyov Alexey, oscd.community, Sreeman
description:
Detects potential persistence behavior using the windows telemetry registry key.
Windows telemetry makes use of the binary CompatTelRunner.exe to run a variety of commands and perform the actual telemetry collections.
This binary was created to be easily extensible, and to that end, it relies on the registry to instruct on which commands to run.
The problem is, it will run any arbitrary command without restriction of location or type.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND ((TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\AppCompatFlags\\TelemetryController\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\Command' ESCAPE '\' AND (NewValue LIKE '%.bat%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%.bin%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%.cmd%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%.dat%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%.hta%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%.jar%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%.js%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%.msi%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%.ps%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%.sh%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%.vb%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((NewValue LIKE '%\\system32\\CompatTelRunner.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%\\system32\\DeviceCensus.exe%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Potential Registry Persistence Attempt Via Windows Telemetry

author: Jonathan Cheong, oscd.community
description: Detects Obfuscated use of Clip.exe to execute PowerShell
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ScriptBlockText REGEXP 'cmd.{0,5}(?:/c|/r).+clip(?:\.exe)?.{0,4}&&.+clipboard]::\(\s\\"\{\d\}.+-f.+"')
title: Invoke-Obfuscation CLIP+ Launcher - PowerShell

author: Alexander McDonald
description: Detects potential process injection via Microsoft Remote Asssistance (Msra.exe) by looking at suspicious child processes spawned from the aforementioned process. It has been a target used by many threat actors and used for discovery and persistence tactics
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\msra.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%msra.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\arp.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\net.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\netstat.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\nslookup.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\route.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\schtasks.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\whoami.exe' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Potential Process Injection Via Msra.EXE

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects execution of a specific binary based on filename and hash used by Lace Tempest to load additional malware as reported by SysAid Team
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%:\\Program Files\\SysAidServer\\tomcat\\webapps\\usersfiles\\user.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%SHA256=B5ACF14CDAC40BE590318DEE95425D0746E85B1B7B1CBD14DA66F21F2522BF4D%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Lace Tempest Malware Loader Execution

author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects potential exploitation of CVE-2025-53770 by identifying indicators such as suspicious command lines discovered in Post-Exploitation activities.
CVE-2025-53770 is a zero-day vulnerability in SharePoint that allows remote code execution.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\w3wp.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%cwBwAGkAbgBzAHQAYQBsAGwAMAAuAGEAcwBwAHgA%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%MAcABpAG4AcwB0AGEAbABsADAALgBhAHMAcAB4A%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%zAHAAaQBuAHMAdABhAGwAbAAwAC4AYQBzAHAAeA%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%c3BpbnN0YWxsMC5hc3B4%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%OgBcAFAAUgBPAEcAUgBBAH4AMQBcAEMATwBNAE0ATwBOAH4AMQBcAE0ASQBDAFIATwBTAH4AMQBcAFcARQBCAFMARQBSAH4AMQBcADEANQBcAFQARQBNAFAATABBAFQARQBcAEwAQQBZAE8AVQBUAFMA%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%oAXABQAFIATwBHAFIAQQB+ADEAXABDAE8ATQBNAE8ATgB+ADEAXABNAEkAQwBSAE8AUwB+ADEAXABXAEUAQgBTAEUAUgB+ADEAXAAxADUAXABUAEUATQBQAEwAQQBUAEUAXABMAEEAWQBPAFUAVABTA%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%6AFwAUABSAE8ARwBSAEEAfgAxAFwAQwBPAE0ATQBPAE4AfgAxAFwATQBJAEMAUgBPAFMAfgAxAFwAVwBFAEIAUwBFAFIAfgAxAFwAMQA1AFwAVABFAE0AUABMAEEAVABFAFwATABBAFkATwBVAFQAUw%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%OgBcAFAAUgBPAEcAUgBBAH4AMQBcAEMATwBNAE0ATwBOAH4AMQBcAE0ASQBDAFIATwBTAH4AMQBcAFcARQBCAFMARQBSAH4AMQBcADEANgBcAFQARQBNAFAATABBAFQARQBcAEwAQQBZAE8AVQBUAFMA%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%6AFwAUABSAE8ARwBSAEEAfgAxAFwAQwBPAE0ATQBPAE4AfgAxAFwATQBJAEMAUgBPAFMAfgAxAFwAVwBFAEIAUwBFAFIAfgAxAFwAMQA2AFwAVABFAE0AUABMAEEAVABFAFwATABBAFkATwBVAFQAUw%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE title: Potential SharePoint ToolShell CVE-2025-53770 Exploitation Indicators

author: Elastic, @SBousseaden
description:
Detects a suspicious local successful logon event where the Logon Package is Kerberos, the remote address is set to localhost, and the target user SID is the built-in local Administrator account.
This may indicate an attempt to leverage a Kerberos relay attack variant that can be used to elevate privilege locally from a domain joined limited user to local System privileges.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4624 AND LogonType=3 AND AuthenticationPackageName='Kerberos' AND IpAddress='127.0.0.1' AND TargetUserSid LIKE 'S-1-5-21-%' ESCAPE '\' AND TargetUserSid LIKE '%-500' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((IpPort='0'), 0)))
title: Potential Privilege Escalation via Local Kerberos Relay over LDAP

author: frack113
description: Detects the usage of nimgrab, a tool bundled with the Nim programming framework and used for downloading files.
falsepositives: Legitimate use of Nim on a developer systems
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\nimgrab.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR (Hashes LIKE '%MD5=2DD44C3C29D667F5C0EF5F9D7C7FFB8B%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%SHA256=F266609E91985F0FE3E31C5E8FAEEEC4FFA5E0322D8B6F15FE69F4C5165B9559%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=C07FDDD21D123EA9B3A08EEF44AAAC45%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: PUA - Nimgrab Execution

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), frack113
description: Detects activity mentioned in Operation Wocao report
falsepositives: Administrators that use checkadmin.exe tool to enumerate local administrators
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4799 AND TargetUserName LIKE 'Administr%' ESCAPE '\' AND CallerProcessName LIKE '%\\checkadmin.exe' ESCAPE '\')
title: Operation Wocao Activity - Security

author: CD_R0M_
description: Detects the abuse of custom file open handler, executing powershell
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%shell\\open\\command\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND (NewValue LIKE '%powershell%' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue LIKE '%-command%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Custom File Open Handler Executes PowerShell

author: Teymur Kheirkhabarov, Harish Segar
description: Detects a suspicious or uncommon parent processes of PowerShell
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%tomcat%' ESCAPE '\' OR (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\amigo.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\browser.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\chrome.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\firefox.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\httpd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\iexplore.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\jbosssvc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\microsoftedge.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\microsoftedgecp.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\MicrosoftEdgeSH.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\nginx.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\outlook.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\php-cgi.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\safari.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\services.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\sqlagent.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\sqlserver.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\sqlservr.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\vivaldi.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\w3wp.exe' ESCAPE '\')) AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%/c powershell%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/c pwsh%' ESCAPE '\') OR Description='Windows PowerShell' OR Product='PowerShell Core 6' OR (OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll'))))
title: Suspicious PowerShell Parent Process

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects when adversaries stop services or processes by deleting or disabling their respective scheduled tasks in order to conduct data destructive activities
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (((EventID=4699 OR EventID=4701) AND (TaskName LIKE '%\\Windows\\SystemRestore\\SR%' ESCAPE '\' OR TaskName LIKE '%\\Windows\\Windows Defender\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR TaskName LIKE '%\\Windows\\BitLocker%' ESCAPE '\' OR TaskName LIKE '%\\Windows\\WindowsBackup\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR TaskName LIKE '%\\Windows\\WindowsUpdate\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR TaskName LIKE '%\\Windows\\UpdateOrchestrator\\Schedule%' ESCAPE '\' OR TaskName LIKE '%\\Windows\\ExploitGuard%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((EventID=4699 AND SubjectUserName LIKE '%$' ESCAPE '\' AND TaskName LIKE '%\\Windows\\Windows Defender\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0)))
title: Important Scheduled Task Deleted/Disabled

author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel
description: Detects the execution of the "msxsl" binary with an "http" keyword in the command line. This might indicate a potential remote execution of XSL files.
falsepositives: Msxsl is not installed by default and is deprecated, so unlikely on most systems.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\msxsl.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%http%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Remote XSL Execution Via Msxsl.EXE

author: Dimitrios Slamaris, @atc_project (fix)
description: This rule detects a DHCP server error in which a specified Callout DLL (in registry) could not be loaded
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='System' AND ((EventID=1031 OR EventID=1032 OR EventID=1034) AND Provider_Name='Microsoft-Windows-DHCP-Server')
title: DHCP Server Error Failed Loading the CallOut DLL

author: pH-T (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects Certify a tool for Active Directory certificate abuse based on PE metadata characteristics and common command line arguments.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\Certify.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='Certify.exe' OR Description LIKE '%Certify%' ESCAPE '\') OR ((CommandLine LIKE '%.exe cas %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.exe find %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.exe pkiobjects %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.exe request %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.exe download %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% /vulnerable%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /template:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /altname:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /domain:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /path:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /ca:%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: HackTool - Certify Execution

author: Chirag Damani
description:
Detects execution of the hacktool NetExec.
NetExec (formerly CrackMapExec) is a widely used post-exploitation tool designed for Active Directory penetration testing and network enumeration
In enterprise environments, the use of NetExec is considered suspicious or potentially malicious because it enables attackers to enumerate hosts, exploit network services, and move laterally across systems.
Threat actors and red teams commonly use NetExec to identify vulnerable systems, harvest credentials, and execute commands remotely.
falsepositives: Legitimate use of NetExec by security professionals or system administrators for network assessment and management.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\nxc.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% ftp %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ldap %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% mssql %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% nfs %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% rdp %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% smb %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ssh %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% vnc %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% winrm %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% wmi %' ESCAPE '\')))
title: HackTool - NetExec Execution

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali
description: Detects the use of NSudo tool for command execution
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\NSudo.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\NSudoLC.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\NSudoLG.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='NSudo.exe' OR OriginalFileName='NSudoLC.exe' OR OriginalFileName='NSudoLG.exe')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-U:S %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-U:T %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-U:E %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-P:E %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-M:S %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-M:H %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-U=S %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-U=T %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-U=E %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-P=E %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-M=S %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-M=H %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-ShowWindowMode:Hide%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: PUA - NSudo Execution

author: Eli Salem, Sander Wiebing, oscd.community
description: Detects the import of an alternate data stream with regini.exe, regini.exe can be used to modify registry keys.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\regini.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='REGINI.EXE') AND CommandLine REGEXP ':[^ \\]'))
title: Suspicious Registry Modification From ADS Via Regini.EXE

author: Jonathan Cheong, oscd.community
description: Detects Obfuscated use of stdin to execute PowerShell
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ScriptBlockText REGEXP 'cmd.{0,5}(?:/c|/r).+powershell.+(?:\$?\{?input\}?|noexit).+"')
title: Invoke-Obfuscation STDIN+ Launcher - Powershell

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects specific command line execution used by Mustang Panda in a targeted attack against the Australian government as reported by Lab52
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%copy SolidPDFCreator.dll%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\Users\\Public\\Libraries\\PhotoTvRHD\\SolidPDFCreator.dll%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%reg %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%SolidPDF%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\Users\\Public\\Libraries\\PhotoTvRHD\\%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Potential APT Mustang Panda Activity Against Australian Gov

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), oscd.community
description: Detects the execution of netsh to configure a port forwarding of port 3389 (RDP) rule
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\netsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='netsh.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% i%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% p%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%=3389%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% c%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: RDP Port Forwarding Rule Added Via Netsh.EXE

author: Micah Babinski (@micahbabinski), Zach Mathis (@yamatosecurity)
description: Detects successful logon from public IP address via SMB. This can indicate a publicly-exposed SMB port.
falsepositives: Legitimate or intentional inbound connections from public IP addresses on the SMB port.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4624 AND LogonType=3) AND (NOT COALESCE(((IpAddress='::1' OR IpAddress LIKE '10.%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE '127.%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE '172.16.%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE '172.17.%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE '172.18.%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE '172.19.%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE '172.20.%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE '172.21.%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE '172.22.%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE '172.23.%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE '172.24.%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE '172.25.%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE '172.26.%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE '172.27.%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE '172.28.%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE '172.29.%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE '172.30.%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE '172.31.%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE '192.168.%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE '169.254.%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE 'fc%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE 'fd%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE 'fe8%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE 'fe9%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE 'fea%' ESCAPE '\' OR IpAddress LIKE 'feb%' ESCAPE '\') OR IpAddress='-'), 0)))
title: External Remote SMB Logon from Public IP

author: andrewdanis
description:
Detects suspicious Speech Runtime Binary Execution by monitoring its child processes.
Child processes spawned by SpeechRuntime.exe could indicate an attempt for lateral movement via COM & DCOM hijacking.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\SpeechRuntime.exe' ESCAPE '\')
title: Suspicious Speech Runtime Binary Child Process

author: frack113, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects when a all the rules have been deleted from the Windows Defender Firewall configuration
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Microsoft-Windows-Windows Firewall With Advanced Security/Firewall' AND ((EventID=2033 OR EventID=2059) AND (NOT COALESCE((ModifyingApplication LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\svchost.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0)) AND (NOT COALESCE((ModifyingApplication LIKE '%:\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\Windows Defender\\Platform\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND ModifyingApplication LIKE '%\\MsMpEng.exe%' ESCAPE '\'), 0)))
title: All Rules Have Been Deleted From The Windows Firewall Configuration

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects uses of the SysInternals ProcDump utility in which ProcDump or its output get renamed, or a dump file is moved or copied to a different name
falsepositives: False positives are expected in cases in which ProcDump just gets copied to a different directory without any renaming
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%copy procdump%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%move procdump%' ESCAPE '\') OR ((CommandLine LIKE '%copy %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.dmp %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%2.dmp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%lsass%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%out.dmp%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (CommandLine LIKE '%copy lsass.exe\_%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%move lsass.exe\_%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Potential SysInternals ProcDump Evasion

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Teymur Kheirkhabarov
description: Detects the execution of "whoami.exe" by privileged accounts that are often abused by threat actors
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((OriginalFileName='whoami.exe' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\whoami.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (User LIKE '%AUTHORI%' ESCAPE '\' OR User LIKE '%AUTORI%' ESCAPE '\' OR User LIKE '%TrustedInstaller%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Whoami.EXE Execution From Privileged Process

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects suspicious powershell command line parameters used in Empire
falsepositives: Other tools that incidentally use the same command line parameters
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -NoP -sta -NonI -W Hidden -Enc %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -noP -sta -w 1 -enc %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -NoP -NonI -W Hidden -enc %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -noP -sta -w 1 -enc%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -enc  SQB%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -nop -exec bypass -EncodedCommand %' ESCAPE '\'))
title: HackTool - Empire PowerShell Launch Parameters

author: Christian Burkard (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the pattern of UAC Bypass using a path parsing issue in winsat.exe (UACMe 52)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((IntegrityLevel='High' OR IntegrityLevel='System' OR IntegrityLevel='S-1-16-16384' OR IntegrityLevel='S-1-16-12288') AND ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\system32\\winsat.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%C:\\Windows \\system32\\winsat.exe%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: UAC Bypass Abusing Winsat Path Parsing - Process

author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the occurrence of numerous space characters in RunMRU registry paths, which may indicate execution via phishing lures using clickfix techniques to hide malicious commands in the Windows Run dialog box from naked eyes.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND ((TargetObject LIKE '%\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Explorer\\RunMRU\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue LIKE '%#%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NewValue LIKE '%            %' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%            %' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%            %' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%            %' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%            %' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%            %' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%            %' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%            %' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%            %' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%            %' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%            %' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%            %' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%            %' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Suspicious Space Characters in RunMRU Registry Path - ClickFix

author: pH-T (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects Stracciatella which executes a Powershell runspace from within C# (aka SharpPick technique) with AMSI, ETW and Script Block Logging disabled based on PE metadata characteristics.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\Stracciatella.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='Stracciatella.exe' OR Description='Stracciatella' OR (Hashes LIKE '%SHA256=9d25e61ec1527e2a69d7c2a4e3fe2fe15890710c198a66a9f25d99fdf6c7b956%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%SHA256=fd16609bd9830c63b9413671678bb159b89c357d21942ddbb6b93add808d121a%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: HackTool - Stracciatella Execution

author: Nextron Systems
description: Detects msdt.exe executed by a suspicious parent as seen in CVE-2022-30190 / Follina exploitation
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\schtasks.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\wmic.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\wsl.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\msdt.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='msdt.exe')))
title: Suspicious MSDT Parent Process

author: @kostastsale
description: Detects the redirection of Ursnif discovery commands as part of the initial execution of the malware.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\explorer.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/C %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% >> %\\AppData\\local\\temp*.bin%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Ursnif Redirection Of Discovery Commands

author: Ensar Şamil, @sblmsrsn, @oscd_initiative
description: Detects successful code compilation via Visual Basic Command Line Compiler that utilizes Windows Resource to Object Converter.
falsepositives: Utilization of this tool should not be seen in enterprise environment
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\vbc.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cvtres.exe' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Visual Basic Command Line Compiler Usage

author: Stamatis Chatzimangou (st0pp3r)
description: Detects execution of NoFilter, a tool for abusing the Windows Filtering Platform for privilege escalation via hardcoded policy name indicators
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=5447 AND FilterName LIKE '%RonPolicy%' ESCAPE '\') OR (EventID=5449 AND ProviderContextName LIKE '%RonPolicy%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: HackTool - NoFilter Execution

author: Max Altgelt (Nextron Systems), Tobias Michalski (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects a command used by conti to find volume shadow backups
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%vssadmin list shadows%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%log.txt%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Conti Volume Shadow Listing

author: Christian Burkard (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the creation of a local hidden user account which should not happen for event ID 4720.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4720 AND TargetUserName LIKE '%$' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((TargetUserName='HomeGroupUser$'), 0)))
title: Hidden Local User Creation

author: elhoim
description: Detects renamed vmnat.exe or portable version that can be used for DLL side-loading
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (OriginalFileName='vmnat.exe' AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE '%vmnat.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Renamed Vmnat.exe Execution

author: Markus Neis, Swisscom
description: Detects registry modifications potentially related to the Ke3chang/TidePool malware as seen in campaigns running in 2019 and 2020
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-Property DWORD -name DisableFirstRunCustomize -value 2 -Force%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-Property String -name Check\_Associations -value%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-Property DWORD -name IEHarden -value 0 -Force%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Potential Ke3chang/TidePool Malware Activity

author: Meroujan Antonyan (vx3r)
description:
Detects the execution of obfuscated PowerShell commands that attempt to install MSI packages via the Windows Installer COM object (`WindowsInstaller.Installer`).
The technique involves manipulating strings to hide functionality, such as constructing class names using string insertion (e.g., 'indowsInstaller.Installer'.Insert(0,'W')) and correcting
malformed URLs (e.g., converting 'htps://' to 'https://') at runtime. This behavior is commonly associated with malware loaders or droppers that aim to bypass static detection
by hiding intent in runtime-generated strings and using legitimate tools for code execution. The use of `InstallProduct` and COM object creation, particularly combined with
hidden window execution and suppressed UI, indicates an attempt to install software (likely malicious) without user interaction.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell\_ise.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName LIKE 'PowerShell\_ISE.EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-ComObject%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%InstallProduct(%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.Insert(%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%UILevel%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Obfuscated PowerShell MSI Install via WindowsInstaller COM

author: MSTIC, FPT.EagleEye
description: Suspicious behaviours related to an actor tracked by Microsoft as SOURGUM
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%windows\\system32\\Physmem.sys%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%Windows\\system32\\ime\\SHARED\\WimBootConfigurations.ini%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%Windows\\system32\\ime\\IMEJP\\WimBootConfigurations.ini%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%Windows\\system32\\ime\\IMETC\\WimBootConfigurations.ini%' ESCAPE '\') OR (((NewProcessName LIKE '%windows\\system32\\filepath2%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%windows\\system32\\ime%' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%reg add%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%HKEY\_LOCAL\_MACHINE\\software\\classes\\clsid\\{7c857801-7381-11cf-884d-00aa004b2e24}\\inprocserver32%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%HKEY\_LOCAL\_MACHINE\\software\\classes\\clsid\\{cf4cc405-e2c5-4ddd-b3ce-5e7582d8c9fa}\\inprocserver32%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: SOURGUM Actor Behaviours

author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects system restore registry modification via command line, which can be used by adversaries to disable system restore on the computer.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='powershell.exe' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll' OR OriginalFileName='reg.exe')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '% add %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Set-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%New-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Policies\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\SystemRestore%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\SystemRestore%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%DisableConfig%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%DisableSR%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: System Restore Registry Modification via CommandLine

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects suspicious launch of the PSEXESVC service on this system and a sub process run as LOCAL_SYSTEM (-s), which means that someone remotely started a command on this system running it with highest privileges and not only the privileges of the login user account (e.g. the administrator account)
falsepositives: Users that debug Microsoft Intune issues using the commands mentioned in the official documentation; see https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/mem/intune/apps/intune-management-extension
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\PSEXESVC.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (User LIKE '%AUTHORI%' ESCAPE '\' OR User LIKE '%AUTORI%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: PsExec Service Child Process Execution as LOCAL SYSTEM

author: Samir Bousseaden, Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects potential exploitation of CVE-2026-33829, a vulnerability in the Windows Snipping Tool URI handler (ms-screensketch:).
An attacker can abuse the 'filePath' parameter to supply a UNC path or HTTP URL, causing SnippingTool.exe to initiate a connection to a remote resource.
When a UNC path is used (e.g. \\attacker.com\share), this triggers an outbound NTLM authentication attempt, allowing the attacker to capture or relay the victim's Net-NTLMv2 hash.
HTTP-based paths may result in remote file loading or server-side request forgery (SSRF)-style access.
The URI can be delivered via a malicious hyperlink, phishing email, or web page.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\SnippingTool.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%ms-screensketch:edit_&filePath=\\\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ms-screensketch:edit_&filePath=\%\%5C%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ms-screensketch:edit_&filePath=\%5C%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ms-screensketch:edit_&filePath=http%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Potential CVE-2026-33829 Exploitation - Windows Snipping Tool Remote File Path URI

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects UAC bypass method using Windows event viewer
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\mscfile\\shell\\open\\command' ESCAPE '\')
title: UAC Bypass via Event Viewer

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), MSTIC (idea)

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the use of various CLI utilities exfiltrating data via web requests
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell\_ise.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%curl %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Invoke-RestMethod%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Invoke-WebRequest%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%irm %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%iwr %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%wget %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -ur%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -me%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -b%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% POST %' ESCAPE '\')) OR ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\curl.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%--ur%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -d %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --data %' ESCAPE '\')) OR (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wget.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%--post-data%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%--post-file%' ESCAPE '\'))) AND ((CommandLine REGEXP 'net\s+view' OR CommandLine REGEXP 'sc\s+query') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%Get-Content%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%GetBytes%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%hostname%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ifconfig%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ipconfig%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%netstat%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%nltest%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%qprocess%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%systeminfo%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%tasklist%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ToBase64String%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%whoami%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%type %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% > %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% C:\\%' ESCAPE '\'))))

author: Nik Seetharaman

author: frack113
description: Detects tampering with the "ChannelAccess" registry key in order to change access to Windows event channel.

title: Change Winevt Channel Access Permission Via Registry

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects PoC tool used to exploit LPE vulnerability CVE-2021-41379
falsepositives: Other MSI packages for which your admins have used that name
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Application' AND (EventID=1033 AND Provider_Name='MsiInstaller' AND Data LIKE '%test pkg%' ESCAPE '\')
title: LPE InstallerFileTakeOver PoC CVE-2021-41379

author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects tampering of AMSI (Anti-Malware Scan Interface) related registry values via command line tools such as reg.exe or PowerShell.
AMSI provides a generic interface for applications and services to integrate with antimalware products.
Adversaries may disable AMSI to evade detection of malicious scripts and code execution.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows Script\\Settings%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%AmsiEnable%' ESCAPE '\') AND ((((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Set-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%New-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%sp %' ESCAPE '\')) OR ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='reg.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '%add%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Windows AMSI Related Registry Tampering Via CommandLine

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects when an internet hosted webdav share is mounted using the "net.exe" utility
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\net.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\net1.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='net.exe' OR OriginalFileName='net1.exe')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '% use %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% http%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Windows Internet Hosted WebDav Share Mount Via Net.EXE

author: Michael Haag
description: Detects the use of DISM to enable the PowerShell Web Access feature, which could be used for remote access and potential abuse
falsepositives: Legitimate PowerShell Web Access installations by administrators
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\dism.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='DISM.EXE') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%WindowsPowerShellWebAccess%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/online%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/enable-feature%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: PowerShell Web Access Feature Enabled Via DISM

author: Nikita Nazarov, oscd.community
description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via use MSHTA in Scripts
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='System' AND (Provider_Name='Service Control Manager' AND EventID=7045 AND (ImagePath LIKE '%mshta%' ESCAPE '\' AND ImagePath LIKE '%vbscript:createobject%' ESCAPE '\'))

description:
Detects changes to the "Ports" registry key with data that includes a Windows path or a file with a suspicious extension.
This could be an attempt to exploit CVE-2020-1048 - a Windows Print Spooler elevation of privilege vulnerability.
falsepositives: New printer port install on host
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Ports%' ESCAPE '\' AND (NewValue LIKE '%.bat%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%.com%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%.vbe%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%.vbs%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%C:%' ESCAPE '\')))

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects when the MSSQL "xp_cmdshell" stored procedure is used to execute commands
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Application' AND (Provider_Name LIKE '%MSSQL%' ESCAPE '\' AND EventID=33205 AND (Data LIKE '%object\_name:xp\_cmdshell%' ESCAPE '\' AND Data LIKE '%statement:EXEC%' ESCAPE '\'))

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects changes to the "DisableHypervisorEnforcedPagingTranslation" registry value. Where the it is set to "1" in order to disable the Hypervisor Enforced Paging Translation feature.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\DisableHypervisorEnforcedPagingTranslation' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue='DWORD (0x00000001)'))

author: E.M. Anhaus (originally from Atomic Blue Detections, Tony Lambert), oscd.community
description: Identifies use of Fodhelper.exe to bypass User Account Control. Adversaries use this technique to execute privileged processes.

rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\fodhelper.exe' ESCAPE '\')

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects suspicious changes to the Windows Defender configuration
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Microsoft-Windows-Windows Defender/Operational' AND (EventID=5007 AND (NewValue LIKE '%\\Windows Defender\\DisableAntiSpyware %' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%\\Windows Defender\\Scan\\DisableRemovableDriveScanning %' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%\\Windows Defender\\Scan\\DisableScanningMappedNetworkDrivesForFullScan %' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%\\Windows Defender\\SpyNet\\DisableBlockAtFirstSeen %' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%\\Real-Time Protection\\SpyNetReporting %' ESCAPE '\'))

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects non-sysinternals tools setting the "accepteula" key which normally is set on sysinternals tool execution

description:
Detects usage of winget to add a new insecure (http) download source.
Winget will not allow the addition of insecure sources, hence this could indicate potential suspicious activity (or typos)

author: frack113
description:
Detects specific windows registry modifications made by BlackByte ransomware variants.
BlackByte set three different registry values to escalate privileges and begin setting the stage for lateral movement and encryption.
This rule triggers when any of the following registry keys are set to DWORD 1, however all three should be investigated as part of a larger BlackByte ransomware detection and response effort.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND ((TargetObject LIKE 'HKLM\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Policies\\System\\LocalAccountTokenFilterPolicy' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE 'HKLM\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Policies\\System\\EnableLinkedConnections' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE 'HKLM\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\FileSystem\\LongPathsEnabled' ESCAPE '\') AND NewValue='DWORD (0x00000001)'))
title: Blackbyte Ransomware Registry

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects when an attacker adds a new "Debugger" value to the "Hangs" key in order to achieve persistence which will get invoked when an application crashes
falsepositives: This value is not set by default but could be rarly used by administrators
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\Windows Error Reporting\\Hangs\\Debugger%' ESCAPE '\')
title: Add Debugger Entry To Hangs Key For Persistence

author: @gott_cyber, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects uncommon child process of Setres.EXE.
Setres.EXE is a Windows server only process and tool that can be used to set the screen resolution.
It can potentially be abused in order to launch any arbitrary file with a name containing the word "choice" from the current execution path.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\setres.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\choice%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE '%C:\\Windows\\System32\\choice.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\choice.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Uncommon Child Process Of Setres.EXE
