author: Jonathan Cheong, oscd.community
description: Detects Obfuscated use of Clip.exe to execute PowerShell
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4103 AND Payload REGEXP 'cmd.{0,5}(?:/c|/r).+clip(?:\.exe)?.{0,4}&&.+clipboard]::\(\s\\"\{\d\}.+-f.+"')
title: Invoke-Obfuscation CLIP+ Launcher - PowerShell Module

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects execution of "rundll32" calling "advpack.dll" with potential obfuscated ordinal calls in order to leverage the "RegisterOCX" function
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='RUNDLL32.EXE' OR CommandLine LIKE '%rundll32%' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%advpack%' ESCAPE '\' AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%#+%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%12%' ESCAPE '\') OR CommandLine LIKE '%#-%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Suspicious Advpack Call Via Rundll32.EXE

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects registry changes to Office trust records where the path is located in a potentially suspicious location
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\Security\\Trusted Documents\\TrustRecords%' ESCAPE '\' AND (TargetObject LIKE '%/AppData/Local/Microsoft/Windows/INetCache/%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%/AppData/Local/Temp/%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%/PerfLogs/%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%C:/Users/Public/%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%file:///D:/%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%file:///E:/%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Macro Enabled In A Potentially Suspicious Document

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects Windows command lines that miss a space before or after the /c flag when running a command using the cmd.exe.
This could be a sign of obfuscation of a fat finger problem (typo by the developer).
falsepositives: Legitimate use of cmd.exe with no arguments e.g. via system("") in C to enable ANSI escape codes
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe/c%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\cmd/c%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%"cmd/c%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe/k%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\cmd/k%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%"cmd/k%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe/r%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\cmd/r%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%"cmd/r%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%/cwhoami%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/cpowershell%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/cschtasks%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/cbitsadmin%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/ccertutil%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/kwhoami%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/kpowershell%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/kschtasks%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/kbitsadmin%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/kcertutil%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe /c%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd /c%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe /k%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd /k%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe /r%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd /r%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE(((CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe /c %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd /c %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe /k %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd /k %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe /r %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd /r %' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%AppData\\Local\\Programs\\Microsoft VS Code\\resources\\app\\node\_modules%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe/c .' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine='cmd.exe /c' OR CommandLine='cmd /c')), 0))))
title: Cmd.EXE Missing Space Characters Execution Anomaly

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects Windows error reporting events where the process that crashed is LSASS (Local Security Authority Subsystem Service).
This could be the cause of a provoked crash by techniques such as Lsass-Shtinkering to dump credentials.
falsepositives: Rare legitimate crashing of the lsass process
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Application' AND (Provider_Name='Application Error' AND EventID=1000 AND AppName='lsass.exe' AND ExceptionCode='c0000001')
title: LSASS Process Crashed - Application

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects when an attacker adds a new "DLLPathOverride" value to the "Natural Language" key in order to achieve persistence which will get invoked by "SearchIndexer.exe" process
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\ContentIndex\\Language\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\StemmerDLLPathOverride%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\WBDLLPathOverride%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\StemmerClass%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\WBreakerClass%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Potential Persistence Via DLLPathOverride

author: Matt Anderson (Huntress)
description:
Detects the use of reg.exe to disable the Event Tracing for Windows (ETW) Autologger session for Windows Defender API and Audit events.
By setting the 'Start' value to '0' for the 'DefenderApiLogger' or 'DefenderAuditLogger' session, an attacker can prevent these critical security events
from being logged, effectively blinding monitoring tools that rely on this data. This is a powerful defense evasion technique.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='reg.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\Control\\WMI\\Autologger\\DefenderApiLogger\\Start%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Control\\WMI\\Autologger\\DefenderAuditLogger\\Start%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%add%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%0%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%0x00000001%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Disabling Windows Defender WMI Autologger Session via Reg.exe

author: @neu5ron, Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Jonhnathan Ribeiro, oscd.community
description: Detects command line activity that tries to clear or disable any ETW trace log which could be a sign of logging evasion.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%cl%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/Trace%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%clear-log%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/Trace%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%sl%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/e:false%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%set-log%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/e:false%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%logman%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%update%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%trace%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%--p%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-ets%' ESCAPE '\') OR CommandLine LIKE '%Remove-EtwTraceProvider%' ESCAPE '\' OR (CommandLine LIKE '%Set-EtwTraceProvider%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%0x11%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: ETW Trace Evasion Activity

author: frack113
description: Detects the usage of "pypykatz" to obtain stored credentials. Adversaries may attempt to extract credential material from the Security Account Manager (SAM) database through Windows registry where the SAM database is stored
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pypykatz.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\python.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%live%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%registry%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: HackTool - Pypykatz Credentials Dumping Activity

author: oscd.community, Natalia Shornikova
description: Detects powershell script installed as a Service
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='System' AND (Provider_Name='Service Control Manager' AND EventID=7045 AND (ImagePath LIKE '%powershell%' ESCAPE '\' OR ImagePath LIKE '%pwsh%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: PowerShell Scripts Installed as Services

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects commands that indicate a Raccine removal from an end system. Raccine is a free ransomware protection tool.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%taskkill %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%RaccineSettings.exe%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%reg.exe%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%delete%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%Raccine Tray%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%schtasks%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/DELETE%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%Raccine Rules Updater%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Raccine Uninstall

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the execution of the tool PowerTool which has the ability to kill a process, delete its process file, unload drivers, and delete the driver files
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\PowerTool.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\PowerTool64.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR OriginalFileName='PowerTool.exe'))
title: HackTool - PowerTool Execution

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects commandline containing reference to files ending with a "." This scheme has been seen used by raspberry-robin
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND CommandLine REGEXP '\\[a-zA-Z0-9]{1,32}\.[a-zA-Z0-9]{1,6}\.[ "'']{1}')
title: Potential Raspberry Robin Dot Ending File

author: Sander Wiebing, Jonhnathan Ribeiro, Daniil Yugoslavskiy, oscd.community
description: Detects Netsh command execution that whitelists a program located in a suspicious location in the Windows Firewall
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\netsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='netsh.exe') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%firewall%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%add%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%allowedprogram%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%advfirewall%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%firewall%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%add%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%rule%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%action=allow%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%program=%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%:\\$Recycle.bin\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\RECYCLER.BIN\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\RECYCLERS.BIN\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\SystemVolumeInformation\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Users\\Default\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Users\\Desktop\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\addins\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\cursors\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\debug\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\drivers\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\fonts\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\help\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\system32\\tasks\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Tasks\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Downloads\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Local Settings\\Temporary Internet Files\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Temporary Internet Files\\Content.Outlook\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%Public\%\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%TEMP\%%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%TMP\%%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Suspicious Program Location Whitelisted In Firewall Via Netsh.EXE

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects when a user enable developer features such as "Developer Mode" or "Application Sideloading". Which allows the user to install untrusted packages.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\SystemSettingsAdminFlows.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='SystemSettingsAdminFlows.EXE') AND CommandLine LIKE '%TurnOnDeveloperFeatures%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%DeveloperUnlock%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%EnableSideloading%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Potential Signing Bypass Via Windows Developer Features

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects when someone is adding or removing applications or folders from exploit guard "ProtectedFolders" or "AllowedApplications"
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Microsoft-Windows-Windows Defender/Operational' AND (((EventID=5007 AND NewValue LIKE '%\\Windows Defender\\Windows Defender Exploit Guard\\Controlled Folder Access\\AllowedApplications\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NewValue LIKE '%\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%\\Desktop\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%\\PerfLogs\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=5007 AND OldValue LIKE '%\\Windows Defender\\Windows Defender Exploit Guard\\Controlled Folder Access\\ProtectedFolders\\%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Windows Defender Exploit Guard Tamper

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the invocation of the Stored User Names and Passwords dialogue (Key Manager)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='RUNDLL32.EXE') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%keymgr%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%KRShowKeyMgr%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Suspicious Key Manager Access

author: frack113
description: Detects the use of SDelete to erase a file not the free space
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (OriginalFileName='sdelete.exe' AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '% -h%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -c%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -z%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /?%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Potential File Overwrite Via Sysinternals SDelete

author: Roberto Rodriguez (Cyb3rWard0g), OTR (Open Threat Research)
description: Potential adversaries stopping ETW providers recording loaded .NET assemblies.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND ObjectName LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\.NETFramework' ESCAPE '\' AND ObjectValueName='ETWEnabled' AND NewValue=0) OR (EventID=4657 AND ObjectName LIKE '%\\Environment%' ESCAPE '\' AND (ObjectValueName LIKE 'COMPlus\_ETWEnabled' ESCAPE '\' OR ObjectValueName LIKE 'COMPlus\_ETWFlags' ESCAPE '\') AND NewValue=0))
title: ETW Logging Disabled In .NET Processes - Registry

author: Tim Rauch, Elastic (idea)
description: Detects an unexpected process spawning from dns.exe which may indicate activity related to remote code execution or other forms of exploitation as seen in CVE-2020-1350 (SigRed)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\dns.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\conhost.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Unusual Child Process of dns.exe

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Maxime Thiebaut
description: Detects a explorer.exe sub process of the RazerInstaller software which can be invoked from the installer to select a different installation folder but can also be exploited to escalate privileges to LOCAL SYSTEM
falsepositives: User selecting a different installation folder (check for other sub processes of this explorer.exe process)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\RazerInstaller.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (IntegrityLevel='System' OR IntegrityLevel='S-1-16-16384')) AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\Installer\\Razer\\Installer\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Suspicious RazerInstaller Explorer Subprocess

author: Andreas Hunkeler (@Karneades)
description: Detects usage of the "sc.exe" utility adding a new service with special permission seen used by threat actors which makes the service hidden and unremovable.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\sc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='sc.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%sdset%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%DCLCWPDTSD%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Service DACL Abuse To Hide Services Via Sc.EXE

author: Nikita Nazarov, oscd.community
description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via use Rundll32 in Scripts
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ((ScriptBlockText LIKE '%&&%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%rundll32%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%shell32.dll%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%shellexec\_rundll%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%value%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%invoke%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%comspec%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%iex%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Invoke-Obfuscation Via Use Rundll32 - PowerShell

author: frack113, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects changes to Microsoft Office protected view registry keys with which the attacker disables this feature.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND ((TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Office\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\Security\\ProtectedView\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND ((NewValue='DWORD (0x00000001)' AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\DisableAttachementsInPV' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\DisableInternetFilesInPV' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\DisableIntranetCheck' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\DisableUnsafeLocationsInPV' ESCAPE '\')) OR (NewValue='DWORD (0x00000000)' AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\enabledatabasefileprotectedview' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\enableforeigntextfileprotectedview' ESCAPE '\')))))
title: Microsoft Office Protected View Disabled

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects suspicious command line patterns seen being used by MERCURY APT
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-exec bypass -w 1 -enc%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%UwB0AGEAcgB0AC0ASgBvAGIAIAAtAFMAYwByAGkAcAB0AEIAbABvAGMAawAgAHsAKABzAGEAcABzACAAKAAiAHAA%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: MERCURY APT Activity

author: Teymur Kheirkhabarov, oscd.community, David ANDRE (additional keywords), Tim Shelton
description: Detection well-known mimikatz command line arguments
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%DumpCreds%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%mimikatz%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%::aadcookie%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%::detours%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%::memssp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%::mflt%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%::ncroutemon%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%::ngcsign%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%::printnightmare%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%::skeleton%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%::preshutdown%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%::mstsc%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%::multirdp%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%rpc::%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%token::%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%crypto::%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%dpapi::%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%sekurlsa::%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%kerberos::%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%lsadump::%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%privilege::%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%process::%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%vault::%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: HackTool - Mimikatz Execution

author: frack113
description: Detects calls to the AtomicTestHarnesses "Invoke-ATHRemoteFXvGPUDisablementCommand" which is designed to abuse the "RemoteFXvGPUDisablement.exe" binary to run custom PowerShell code via module load-order hijacking.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Invoke-ATHRemoteFXvGPUDisablementCommand%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Invoke-ATHRemoteFXvGPUDisableme%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: RemoteFXvGPUDisablement Abuse Via AtomicTestHarnesses

author: Christian Burkard (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the pattern of UAC Bypass using pkgmgr.exe and dism.exe (UACMe 23)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\pkgmgr.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\dism.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (IntegrityLevel='High' OR IntegrityLevel='System' OR IntegrityLevel='S-1-16-16384' OR IntegrityLevel='S-1-16-12288')))
title: UAC Bypass Using PkgMgr and DISM

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the use of RemoteKrbRelay, a Kerberos relaying tool via CommandLine flags and PE metadata.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\RemoteKrbRelay.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='RemoteKrbRelay.exe') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% -clsid %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -target %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -victim %' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%-rbcd %' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-cn %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%--computername %' ESCAPE '\')) OR (CommandLine LIKE '%-chp %' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-chpPass %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-chpUser %' ESCAPE '\')) OR (CommandLine LIKE '%-addgroupmember %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-group %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-groupuser %' ESCAPE '\') OR ((CommandLine LIKE '%-smb %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%--smbkeyword %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%interactive%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%secrets%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%service-add%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: HackTool - RemoteKrbRelay Execution

author: Oleg Kolesnikov @securonix invrep_de, oscd.community, Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Christian Burkard (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects attackers using tooling with bad opsec defaults.
E.g. spawning a sacrificial process to inject a capability into the process without taking into account how the process is normally run.
One trivial example of this is using rundll32.exe without arguments as a sacrificial process (default in CS, now highlighted by c2lint), running WerFault without arguments (Kraken - credit am0nsec), and other examples.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\WerFault.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%WerFault.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\regsvcs.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%regsvcs.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\regasm.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%regasm.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE(((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Microsoft\\EdgeUpdate\\Install\\{%' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\BraveSoftware\\Brave-Browser\\Application\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Google\\Chrome\\Application\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\Installer\\setup.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%--uninstall %' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\')), 0))))
title: Bad Opsec Defaults Sacrificial Processes With Improper Arguments

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects suspicious remote procedure call (RPC) service anomalies based on the spawned sub processes (long shot to detect the exploitation of vulnerabilities like CVE-2022-26809)
falsepositives: Some cases in which the service spawned a werfault.exe process
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\svchost.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%-k RPCSS%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Potential CVE-2022-26809 Exploitation Attempt

author: Ahmed Farouk, Nasreddine Bencherchali
description:
Detects execution of commands via the run dialog box on Windows by checking values of the "RunMRU" registry key.
This technique was seen being abused by threat actors to deceive users into pasting and executing malicious commands, often disguised as CAPTCHA verification steps.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Explorer\\RunMRU%' ESCAPE '\' AND (((NewValue LIKE '%powershell%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%pwsh%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NewValue LIKE '% -e %' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '% -ec %' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '% -en %' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '% -enc %' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '% -enco%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%ftp%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%Hidden%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%http%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%iex%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%Invoke-%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (NewValue LIKE '%wmic%' ESCAPE '\' AND (NewValue LIKE '%shadowcopy%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%process call create%' ESCAPE '\')))))
title: Potentially Suspicious Command Executed Via Run Dialog Box - Registry

author: ok @securonix invrep-de, oscd.community, frack113
description: Detects attackers attempting to disable Windows Defender using Powershell
falsepositives: Minimal, for some older versions of dev tools, such as pycharm, developers were known to sometimes disable Windows Defender to improve performance, but this generally is not considered a good security practice.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-DisableBehaviorMonitoring $true%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-DisableRuntimeMonitoring $true%' ESCAPE '\')) OR ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\sc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='sc.exe') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%stop%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%WinDefend%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%delete%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%WinDefend%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%config%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%WinDefend%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%start=disabled%' ESCAPE '\')))))
title: Disable Windows Defender AV Security Monitoring

author: frack113
description:
Detects PowerShell scripts that utilize native PowerShell Identity modules to request Kerberos tickets.
This behavior is typically seen during a Kerberos or silver ticket attack. A successful execution will output the SPNs for the endpoint in question.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%System.IdentityModel.Tokens.KerberosRequestorSecurityToken%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.GetRequest()%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Suspicious Kerberos Ticket Request via PowerShell Script - ScriptBlock

author: Samir Bousseaden
description: Detect lateral movement using GPO scheduled task, usually used to deploy ransomware at scale
falsepositives: If the source IP is not localhost then it's super suspicious, better to monitor both local and remote changes to GPO scheduled tasks.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=5136 AND (AttributeLDAPDisplayName='gPCMachineExtensionNames' OR AttributeLDAPDisplayName='gPCUserExtensionNames') AND (AttributeValue LIKE '%CAB54552-DEEA-4691-817E-ED4A4D1AFC72%' ESCAPE '\' OR AttributeValue LIKE '%AADCED64-746C-4633-A97C-D61349046527%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=5145 AND ShareName LIKE '%\\SYSVOL' ESCAPE '\' AND RelativeTargetName LIKE '%ScheduledTasks.xml' ESCAPE '\' AND (AccessList LIKE '%WriteData%' ESCAPE '\' OR AccessList LIKE '%\%\%4417%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Persistence and Execution at Scale via GPO Scheduled Task

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects suspicious DACL modifications via the "Set-Service" cmdlet using the "SecurityDescriptorSddl" flag (Only available with PowerShell 7) that can be used to hide services or make them unstopable
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-SecurityDescriptorSddl %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-sd %' ESCAPE '\') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%Set-Service %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%D;;%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%;;;IU%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%;;;SU%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%;;;BA%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%;;;SY%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%;;;WD%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Suspicious Service DACL Modification Via Set-Service Cmdlet

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects tampering with attachment manager settings policies associations to lower the default file type risks (See reference for more information)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Policies\\Associations\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND ((TargetObject LIKE '%\\DefaultFileTypeRisk' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue='DWORD (0x00006152)') OR (TargetObject LIKE '%\\LowRiskFileTypes' ESCAPE '\' AND (NewValue LIKE '%.zip;%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%.rar;%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%.exe;%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%.bat;%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%.com;%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%.cmd;%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%.reg;%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%.msi;%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%.htm;%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%.html;%' ESCAPE '\')))))
title: Potential Attachment Manager Settings Associations Tamper

author: Michael R. (@nahamike01)
description: Detects the execution of CSharp interactive console by PowerShell
falsepositives: Possible depending on environment. Pair with other factors such as net connections, command-line args, etc.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\csi.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell\_ise.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND OriginalFileName='csi.exe'))
title: Suspicious Use of CSharp Interactive Console

author: sigma
description: Detects process handle on LSASS process with certain access mask and object type SAM_DOMAIN
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4656 AND ProcessName LIKE '%\\lsass.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND AccessMask='0x705' AND ObjectType LIKE 'SAM\_DOMAIN' ESCAPE '\')
title: Password Dumper Activity on LSASS

author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects attempts to disable AMSI (Anti-Malware Scan Interface) by modifying the AmsiEnable registry value.
Anti-Malware Scan Interface (AMSI) is a security feature in Windows that allows applications and services to integrate with anti-malware products for enhanced protection against malicious content.
Adversaries may attempt to disable AMSI to evade detection by security software, allowing them to execute malicious scripts or code without being scanned.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows Script\\Settings\\AmsiEnable' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue='DWORD (0x00000000)'))
title: AMSI Disabled via Registry Modification

author: Jason Lynch
description: Detects an executable in the users directory started from one of the Microsoft Office suite applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Publisher, Visio)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\WINWORD.EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\EXCEL.EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\POWERPNT.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\MSPUB.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\VISIO.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\MSACCESS.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\EQNEDT32.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\users\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\Teams.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Suspicious Binary In User Directory Spawned From Office Application

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects specific command line execution used by Lace Tempest to download Cobalt Strike as reported by SysAid Team
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-nop -w hidden -c IEX ((new-object net.webclient).downloadstring(%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/a'')%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Lace Tempest Cobalt Strike Download

author: Max Altgelt (Nextron Systems), Tobias Michalski (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects a command used by conti to exfiltrate NTDS
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%7za.exe%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\C$\\temp\\log.zip%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Conti NTDS Exfiltration Command

author: Vasiliy Burov
description: Detects command line parameters used by Hydra password guessing hack tool
falsepositives: Software that uses the caret encased keywords PASS and USER in its command line
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%-u %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-p %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%^USER^%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%^PASS^%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: HackTool - Hydra Password Bruteforce Execution

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects scenarios where system auditing for important events such as "Process Creation" or "Logon" events is disabled.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4719 AND (SubcategoryGuid='{0CCE9210-69AE-11D9-BED3-505054503030}' OR SubcategoryGuid='{0CCE9211-69AE-11D9-BED3-505054503030}' OR SubcategoryGuid='{0CCE9212-69AE-11D9-BED3-505054503030}' OR SubcategoryGuid='{0CCE9215-69AE-11D9-BED3-505054503030}' OR SubcategoryGuid='{0CCE921B-69AE-11D9-BED3-505054503030}' OR SubcategoryGuid='{0CCE922B-69AE-11D9-BED3-505054503030}' OR SubcategoryGuid='{0CCE922F-69AE-11D9-BED3-505054503030}' OR SubcategoryGuid='{0CCE9230-69AE-11D9-BED3-505054503030}' OR SubcategoryGuid='{0CCE9235-69AE-11D9-BED3-505054503030}' OR SubcategoryGuid='{0CCE9236-69AE-11D9-BED3-505054503030}' OR SubcategoryGuid='{0CCE9237-69AE-11D9-BED3-505054503030}' OR SubcategoryGuid='{0CCE923F-69AE-11D9-BED3-505054503030}' OR SubcategoryGuid='{0CCE9240-69AE-11D9-BED3-505054503030}' OR SubcategoryGuid='{0CCE9242-69AE-11D9-BED3-505054503030}') AND (AuditPolicyChanges LIKE '%\%\%8448%' ESCAPE '\' OR AuditPolicyChanges LIKE '%\%\%8450%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4719 AND SubcategoryGuid='{0CCE9217-69AE-11D9-BED3-505054503030}' AND AuditPolicyChanges LIKE '%\%\%8448%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Important Windows Event Auditing Disabled

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects tampering with the MacroRuntimeScanScope registry key to disable runtime scanning of enabled macros
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND ((TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\Microsoft\\Office\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\Common\\Security%' ESCAPE '\') AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\MacroRuntimeScanScope' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue='DWORD (0x00000000)'))
title: Disable Macro Runtime Scan Scope

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects a suspicious output redirection to the local admins share, this technique is often found in malicious scripts or hacktool stagers
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%>%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\\\127.0.0.1\\admin$\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\\\localhost\\admin$\\%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Suspicious Redirection to Local Admin Share

author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects potential exploitation of remote code execution vulnerability CVE-2025-33053
which involves unauthorized code execution via WebDAV through external control of file names or paths.
The exploit abuses legitimate utilities like iediagcmd.exe or CustomShellHost.exe  by manipulating
their working directories to point to attacker-controlled WebDAV servers, causing them to execute
malicious executables (like route.exe) from the WebDAV path instead of legitimate system binaries
through Process.Start() search order manipulation.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((ParentProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\internet explorer\\iediagcmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\CustomShellHost.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CurrentDirectory LIKE '\\\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CurrentDirectory LIKE '%\\DavWWWRoot\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\DavWWWRoot\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '\\\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\route.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\netsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\makecab.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\dxdiag.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\ipconfig.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\explorer.exe' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Potential Exploitation of RCE Vulnerability CVE-2025-33053

author: Nikita Nazarov, oscd.community
description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via use MSHTA in Scripts
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%set%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%&&%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%mshta%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%vbscript:createobject%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.run%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%(window.close)%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Invoke-Obfuscation Via Use MSHTA

author: Roberto Rodriguez (Cyb3rWard0g), OTR (Open Threat Research)
description: Detects the installation of the Azure Hybrid Connection Manager service to allow remote code execution from Azure function.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND (OperationType='New registry value created' OR OperationType='Existing registry value modified')) AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\Services\\HybridConnectionManager%' ESCAPE '\' OR (EventType='SetValue' AND NewValue LIKE '%Microsoft.HybridConnectionManager.Listener.exe%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: HybridConnectionManager Service Installation - Registry

author: Micah Babinski, @micahbabinski, Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems), Luc Génaux
description:
Detects the presence of the "u202+E" character, which causes a terminal, browser, or operating system to render text in a right-to-left sequence.
This character is used as an obfuscation and masquerading techniques by adversaries to trick users into opening malicious files.
falsepositives: Commandlines that contains scriptures such as arabic or hebrew might make use of this character
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\u202e%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%[U+202E]%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%‮%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Potential Defense Evasion Via Right-to-Left Override

author: Christian Burkard (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the pattern of UAC Bypass using a msconfig GUI hack (UACMe 55)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((IntegrityLevel='High' OR IntegrityLevel='System' OR IntegrityLevel='S-1-16-16384' OR IntegrityLevel='S-1-16-12288') AND ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\pkgmgr.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '"C:\\Windows\\system32\\msconfig.exe" -5' ESCAPE '\'))
title: UAC Bypass Using MSConfig Token Modification - Process

author: Ecco, E.M. Anhaus, oscd.community
description:
Detects suspicious parameters of fsutil (deleting USN journal, configuring it with small size, etc).
Might be used by ransomwares during the attack (seen by NotPetya and others).
falsepositives: Scripts and administrative tools used in the monitored environment
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\fsutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='fsutil.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%deletejournal%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%createjournal%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%setZeroData%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Fsutil Suspicious Invocation

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), oscd.community, Jonhnathan Ribeiro
description: Detects the registration of a debugger for a program that is available in the logon screen (sticky key backdoor).
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\CurrentVersion\\Image File Execution Options\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%sethc.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%utilman.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%osk.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%magnify.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%narrator.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%displayswitch.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%atbroker.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%HelpPane.exe%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Suspicious Debugger Registration Cmdline

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects attempts to remove Windows Defender configuration using the 'MpPreference' cmdlet
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Remove-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\' AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-ControlledFolderAccessProtectedFolders %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-AttackSurfaceReductionRules\_Ids %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-AttackSurfaceReductionRules\_Actions %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-CheckForSignaturesBeforeRunningScan %' ESCAPE '\')))

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects when a program changes the default file association of any extension to an executable.
When a file is opened, the default program used to open the file (also called the file association or handler) is checked. File association selections are stored in the Windows Registry and can be edited by users, administrators, or programs that have Registry access or by administrators using the built-in assoc utility. Applications can modify the file association for a given file extension to call an arbitrary program when a file with the given extension is opened.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='Cmd.Exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%assoc %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%exefile%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%.exe=exefile%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Change Default File Association To Executable Via Assoc

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), omkar72, oscd.community
description:
Detects execution of the "finger.exe" utility.
Finger.EXE or "TCPIP Finger Command" is an old utility that is still present on modern Windows installation. It Displays information about users on a specified remote computer (typically a UNIX computer) that is running the finger service or daemon.
Due to the old nature of this utility and the rareness of machines having the finger service. Any execution of "finger.exe" can be considered "suspicious" and worth investigating.
falsepositives: Admin activity (unclear what they do nowadays with finger.exe)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (OriginalFileName='finger.exe' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\finger.exe' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Finger.EXE Execution

author: yxinmiracle, Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects execution of the Grixba reconnaissance tool based on suspicious command-line parameter combinations.
This tool is used by the Play ransomware group for network enumeration, data gathering, and event log clearing.
falsepositives: Legitimate tools that use similar command-line argument structures (e.g., a tool with '--mode scan' and '--input file.txt') could trigger this rule. However, the specific combinations are indicative of reconnaissance or defense evasion.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%-m %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-mode %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-m:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-mode:%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-i %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-input %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-i:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-input:%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%scan %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%scanall %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%:f %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:r %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:s %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% f %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% r %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% s %' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Grixba Malware Reconnaissance Activity

author: Roberto Rodriguez (Cyb3rWard0g), OTR (Open Threat Research), Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Sreeman, FPT.EagleEye Team
description: Detects the use of the Windows Update Client binary (wuauclt.exe) for proxy execution.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wuauclt.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='wuauclt.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%UpdateDeploymentProvider%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%RunHandlerComServer%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '% /UpdateDeploymentProvider UpdateDeploymentProvider.dll %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% wuaueng.dll %' ESCAPE '\' OR (CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\UUS\\Packages\\Preview\\amd64\\updatedeploy.dll /ClassId%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\UUS\\amd64\\UpdateDeploy.dll /ClassId%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\WinSxS\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\UpdateDeploy.dll /ClassId %' ESCAPE '\')), 0))))
title: Proxy Execution Via Wuauclt.EXE

title: Suspicious Greedy Compression Using Rar.EXE

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects actions that clear the local ShimCache and remove forensic evidence

author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects modifications to DNS records in Active Directory where the Distinguished Name (DN) contains a base64-encoded blob
matching the pattern "1UWhRCAAAAA...BAAAA". This pattern corresponds to a marshaled CREDENTIAL_TARGET_INFORMATION structure,
commonly used in Kerberos coercion attacks. Adversaries may exploit this to coerce victim systems into authenticating to
attacker-controlled hosts by spoofing SPNs via DNS. It is one of the strong indicators of a Kerberos coercion attack,.
where adversaries manipulate DNS records to spoof Service Principal Names (SPNs) and redirect authentication requests like CVE-2025-33073.
Please investigate the user account that made the changes, as it is likely a low-privileged account that has been compromised.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (((EventID=5136 OR EventID=5137) AND ObjectClass='dnsNode' AND (ObjectDN LIKE '%UWhRCA%' ESCAPE '\' AND ObjectDN LIKE '%BAAAA%' ESCAPE '\' AND ObjectDN LIKE '%CN=MicrosoftDNS%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=4662 AND (AdditionalInfo LIKE '%UWhRCA%' ESCAPE '\' AND AdditionalInfo LIKE '%BAAAA%' ESCAPE '\' AND AdditionalInfo LIKE '%CN=MicrosoftDNS%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Potential Kerberos Coercion by Spoofing SPNs via DNS Manipulation

author: @Kostastsale, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects the execution of SharpWSUS or WSUSpendu, utilities that allow for lateral movement through WSUS.
Windows Server Update Services (WSUS) is a critical component of Windows systems and is frequently configured in a way that allows an attacker to circumvent internal networking limitations.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine LIKE '% -Inject %' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -PayloadArgs %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -PayloadFile %' ESCAPE '\')) OR ((CommandLine LIKE '% approve %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% create %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% check %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% delete %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% /payload:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /payload=%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /updateid:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /updateid=%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: HackTool - SharpWSUS/WSUSpendu Execution

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects when the enablement of developer features such as "Developer Mode" or "Application Sideloading". Which allows the user to install untrusted packages.

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

title: Suspicious Get-ADDBAccount Usage

Detects suspicious FileFix execution patterns where users are tricked into running malicious commands through browser file upload dialog manipulation.
This attack typically begins when users visit malicious websites impersonating legitimate services or news platforms,
which may display fake CAPTCHA challenges or direct instructions to open file explorer and paste clipboard content.
The clipboard content usually contains commands that download and execute malware, such as information stealing tools.
falsepositives: Legitimate use of PowerShell or other utilities launched from browser extensions or automation tools

author: Nischal Khadgi
description:
Detects changes to "DsrmAdminLogonBehavior" registry value.
During a Domain Controller (DC) promotion, administrators create a Directory Services Restore Mode (DSRM) local administrator account with a password that rarely changes. The DSRM account is an “Administrator” account that logs in with the DSRM mode when the server is booting up to restore AD backups or recover the server from a failure.
Attackers could abuse DSRM account to maintain their persistence and access to the organization's Active Directory.
If the "DsrmAdminLogonBehavior" value is set to "0", the administrator account can only be used if the DC starts in DSRM.
If the "DsrmAdminLogonBehavior" value is set to "1", the administrator account can only be used if the local AD DS service is stopped.
If the "DsrmAdminLogonBehavior" value is set to "2", the administrator account can always be used.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\Control\\Lsa\\DsrmAdminLogonBehavior' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((NewValue='DWORD (0x00000000)'), 0))))
title: Directory Service Restore Mode(DSRM) Registry Value Tampering

rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%hctac%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%kaerb%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%dnammoc%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ekovn%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%eliFd%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%rahc%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%etirw%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%golon%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%tninon%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%eddih%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%tpircS%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ssecorp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%llehsrewop%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%esnopser%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%daolnwod%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%tneilCbeW%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%tneilc%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ptth%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%elifotevas%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%46esab%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%htaPpmeTteG%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%tcejbO%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%maerts%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%hcaerof%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%retupmoc%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '% -EncodedCommand %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -enc %' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))

author: Nik Seetharaman
description:
Detects modifications to the CMSTP App Paths registry key. This may indicate abuse of
Microsoft Connection Manager Profile Installer (CMSTP) for arbitrary code execution or UAC bypass.
falsepositives: Legitimate CMSTP use (unlikely in modern enterprise environments)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND (OperationType='New registry value created' OR OperationType='Existing registry value modified')) AND (TargetObject LIKE '%SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\App Paths\\cmmgr32.exe\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE(((TargetObject LIKE '%SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\App Paths\\cmmgr32.exe\\CmstpExtensionDll' ESCAPE '\' AND (NewValue LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\cmcfg32.dll' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\cmcfg32.dll' ESCAPE '\')) OR NewValue='(Empty)'), 0))))
title: CMSTP App Paths Registry Key Modification

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), oscd.community
description: Detects a possible persistence mechanism using RUN key for Windows Explorer and pointing to a suspicious folder
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Policies\\Explorer\\Run' ESCAPE '\' AND (NewValue LIKE '%:\\$Recycle.bin\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%:\\ProgramData\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%:\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%:\\Users\\Default\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%:\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\')))

author: frack113, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects when an adversary uses the reg.exe utility to add or modify new keys or subkeys
falsepositives: Rare legitimate add to registry via cli (to these locations)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='reg.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppDataLow\\Software\\Microsoft\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Policies\\Microsoft\\Windows\\OOBE%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Policies\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Winlogon%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\Currentversion\\Winlogon%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\SecurityProviders\\WDigest%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Microsoft\\Windows Defender\\%' ESCAPE '\')))

author: Sean Metcalf (source), Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the use of PSAttack PowerShell hack tool
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%PS ATTACK!!!%' ESCAPE '\')
title: PowerShell PSAttack

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects when a user downloads a file from an IP based URL using CertOC.exe
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\certoc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='CertOC.exe') AND CommandLine REGEXP '://[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-GetCACAPS%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: File Download From IP Based URL Via CertOC.EXE

author: X__Junior (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects usage of Windows Input Method Editor (IME) keyboard layout feature, which allows an attacker to load a DLL into the process after sending the WM_INPUTLANGCHANGEREQUEST message.
Before doing this, the client needs to register the DLL in a special registry key that is assumed to implement this keyboard layout. This registry key should store a value named "Ime File" with a DLL path.
IMEs are essential for languages that have more characters than can be represented on a standard keyboard, such as Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.
falsepositives: IMEs are essential for languages that have more characters than can be represented on a standard keyboard, such as Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND ((TargetObject LIKE '%\\Control\\Keyboard Layouts\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND TargetObject LIKE '%Ime File%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((NewValue LIKE '%.ime' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Uncommon Extension In Keyboard Layout IME File Registry Value

author: omkar72
description: Detects potential malicious modification of run keys by winekey or team9 backdoor
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND (OperationType='New registry value created' OR OperationType='Existing registry value modified')) AND TargetObject LIKE '%Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run\\Backup Mgr' ESCAPE '\')
title: WINEKEY Registry Modification

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects execution of the "mshta" utility with an argument containing the "http" keyword, which could indicate that an attacker is executing a remotely hosted malicious hta file
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='MSHTA.EXE') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%http://%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%https://%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ftp://%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Remotely Hosted HTA File Executed Via Mshta.EXE

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects PowerShell command line patterns in combincation with encoded commands that often appear in malware infection chains
falsepositives: Other tools that work with encoded scripts in the command line instead of script files
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='PowerShell.Exe' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -e %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -en %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -enc %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -enco%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% JAB%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% SUVYI%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% SQBFAFgA%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% aWV4I%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% IAB%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% PAA%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% aQBlAHgA%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentProcessName LIKE '%C:\\Packages\\Plugins\\Microsoft.GuestConfiguration.ConfigurationforWindows\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\gc\_worker.exe%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Suspicious PowerShell Encoded Command Patterns

author: Matt Anderson (Huntress)
description:
Detects the use of reg.exe or PowerShell to delete the Windows Defender context menu handler registry keys.
This action removes the "Scan with Microsoft Defender" option from the right-click menu for files, directories, and drives.
Attackers may use this technique to hinder manual, on-demand scans and reduce the visibility of the security product.
falsepositives: May be part of a system customization or "debloating" script, but this is highly unusual in a managed corporate environment.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell\_ise.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName LIKE 'powershell\_ise.EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll' OR OriginalFileName='reg.exe')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%del%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Remove-Item%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ri %' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\shellex\\ContextMenuHandlers\\EPP%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Windows Defender Context Menu Removed

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects creation of local users via the net.exe command with the option "never expire"
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\net.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\net1.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='net.exe' OR OriginalFileName='net1.exe')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%user%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%add%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%expires:never%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: New User Created Via Net.EXE With Never Expire Option

author: X__Junior
description: Detects changes to the Windows EventLog channel permission values. It focuses on changes to the Security Descriptor Definition Language (SDDL) string, as modifications to these values can restrict access to specific users or groups, potentially aiding in defense evasion by controlling who can view or modify a event log channel. Upon execution, the user shouldn't be able to access the event log channel via the event viewer or via utilities such as "Get-EventLog" or "wevtutil".
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (((TargetObject LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\EventLog\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\CustomSD' ESCAPE '\') OR ((TargetObject LIKE '%\\Policies\\Microsoft\\Windows\\EventLog\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\WINEVT\\Channels%' ESCAPE '\') AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\ChannelAccess' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NewValue LIKE '%D:(D;%' ESCAPE '\' OR (NewValue LIKE '%D:(%' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue LIKE '%)(D;%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\servicing\\TrustedInstaller.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR (NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\WinSxS\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\TiWorker.exe' ESCAPE '\')), 0)) AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName='' OR NewProcessName IS NULL), 0))))
title: Windows Event Log Access Tampering Via Registry

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects execution of "odbcconf" with the "REGSVR" action where the DLL in question doesn't contain a ".dll" extension. Which is often used as a method to evade defenses.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\odbcconf.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='odbcconf.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '%REGSVR %' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Jonhnathan Ribeiro, oscd.community
description: Detects Trojan loader activity as used by APT28
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\%LOCALAPPDATA\%%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%.dat",%' ESCAPE '\' OR (CommandLine LIKE '%.dll #1' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dll" #1' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dll",#1' ESCAPE '\'))) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects when an attacker tries to add a new network provider in order to dump clear text credentials, similar to how the NPPSpy tool does it
falsepositives: Other legitimate network providers used and not filtred in this rule
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\System\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\NetworkProvider%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Potential Credential Dumping Attempt Using New NetworkProvider - CLI

author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects suspicious child process creation by the Notepad++ updater process (gup.exe).
This could indicate potential exploitation of the updater component to deliver unwanted malware.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\gup.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%bitsadmin%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%certutil%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%curl%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%finger%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%forfiles%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%regsvr32%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%rundll32%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%wget%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Suspicious Child Process of Notepad++ Updater - GUP.Exe

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects a suspicious Microsoft desktopimgdownldr execution with parameters used to download files from the Internet
falsepositives: False positives depend on scripts and administrative tools used in the monitored environment
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine LIKE '% /lockscreenurl:%' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%.jpg%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.jpeg%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.png%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))) OR (CommandLine LIKE '%reg delete%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\PersonalizationCSP%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Suspicious Desktopimgdownldr Command

author: Elastic (idea), Tobias Michalski (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects a privilege elevation attempt by coercing NTLM authentication on the Printer Spooler service
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='RUNDLL32.EXE') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\windows\\system32\\davclnt.dll,DavSetCookie%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%http%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%spoolss%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%srvsvc%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/print/pipe/%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Suspicious NTLM Authentication on the Printer Spooler Service

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects suspicious PowerShell invocation command parameters
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4103 AND ((ContextInfo LIKE '% -enc %' ESCAPE '\' OR ContextInfo LIKE '% -EncodedCommand %' ESCAPE '\' OR ContextInfo LIKE '% -ec %' ESCAPE '\') AND (ContextInfo LIKE '% -w hidden %' ESCAPE '\' OR ContextInfo LIKE '% -window hidden %' ESCAPE '\' OR ContextInfo LIKE '% -windowstyle hidden %' ESCAPE '\' OR ContextInfo LIKE '% -w 1 %' ESCAPE '\') AND (ContextInfo LIKE '% -noni %' ESCAPE '\' OR ContextInfo LIKE '% -noninteractive %' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Suspicious PowerShell Invocations - Generic - PowerShell Module

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects command that type the content of ntdll.dll to a different file or a pipe in order to evade AV / EDR detection. As seen being used in the POC NtdllPipe
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%type \%windir\%\\system32\\ntdll.dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%type \%systemroot\%\\system32\\ntdll.dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%type c:\\windows\\system32\\ntdll.dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\ntdll.dll > \\\\.\\pipe\\%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: NtdllPipe Like Activity Execution

author: frack113
description:
Adversaries may abuse features of Winlogon to execute DLLs and/or executables when a user logs in.
Winlogon.exe is a Windows component responsible for actions at logon/logoff as well as the secure attention sequence (SAS) triggered by Ctrl-Alt-Delete.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Winlogon\\Notify\\logon' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue LIKE '%.dll' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Winlogon Notify Key Logon Persistence

author: Ján Trenčanský, frack113
description: Detects disabling of the Windows Defender feature of scanning for malware and other potentially unwanted software
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Microsoft-Windows-Windows Defender/Operational' AND EventID=5010
title: Windows Defender Malware And PUA Scanning Disabled

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the invocation of TabTip via CLSID as seen when JuicyPotatoNG is used on a system in brute force mode
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='System' AND (Provider_Name='Microsoft-Windows-DistributedCOM' AND EventID=10001 AND param1 LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\Common Files\\microsoft shared\\ink\\TabTip.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND param2=2147943140 AND param3='{054AAE20-4BEA-4347-8A35-64A533254A9D}')
title: Local Privilege Escalation Indicator TabTip

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the restoration of files from the defender quarantine
falsepositives: Legitimate administrator activity restoring a file
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Microsoft-Windows-Windows Defender/Operational' AND EventID=1009
title: Win Defender Restored Quarantine File

author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects the use of qoperation.exe with the -file argument to write a JSP file to the webroot, indicating a webshell drop.
This is a post-authentication step corresponding to CVE-2025-57790.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%qoperation%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%exec%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -af %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.xml %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\Apache\\webapps\\ROOT\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.jsp%' ESCAPE '\'))

author: X__Junior (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects "GoogleUpdate.exe" spawning a new instance of itself in an uncommon location as seen used by the Goofy Guineapig backdoor
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\GoogleUpdate.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\GoogleUpdate.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE(((NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\Google\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Google\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Google\\Update\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Potential Goofy Guineapig GoolgeUpdate Process Anomaly

author: Austin Songer @austinsonger
description: Identifies when a user attempts to clear console history. An adversary may clear the command history of a compromised account to conceal the actions undertaken during an intrusion.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Clear-History%' ESCAPE '\' OR ((ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Remove-Item%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%rm%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ConsoleHost\_history.txt%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%(Get-PSReadlineOption).HistorySavePath%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Clearing Windows Console History

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects PowerShell execution to set the ACL of a file or a folder
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll') OR (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Set-Acl %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-AclObject %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-Path %' ESCAPE '\')))
title: PowerShell Script Change Permission Via Set-Acl

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects usage of wsudo (Windows Sudo Utility). Which is a tool that let the user execute programs with different permissions (System, Trusted Installer, Administrator...etc)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wsudo.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='wsudo.exe' OR Description='Windows sudo utility' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\wsudo-bridge.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%-u System%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-uSystem%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-u TrustedInstaller%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-uTrustedInstaller%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --ti %' ESCAPE '\')))

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects uncommon or suspicious child processes of "eventvwr.exe" which might indicate a UAC bypass attempt
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\eventvwr.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\mmc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\WerFault.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\WerFault.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Potentially Suspicious Event Viewer Child Process

author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel
description:
Detects a suspicious process that is masquerading as the legitimate "svchost.exe" by naming its binary "svchost.exe" and executing from an uncommon location.
Adversaries often disguise their malicious binaries by naming them after legitimate system processes like "svchost.exe" to evade detection.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\svchost.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE(((NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\svchost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\svchost.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR OriginalFileName='svchost.exe'), 0))))
title: Suspicious Process Masquerading As SvcHost.EXE
