author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the use of SharpEvtHook, a tool that tampers with the Windows event logs
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\SharpEvtMute.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Description='SharpEvtMute' OR (CommandLine LIKE '%--Filter "rule %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%--Encoded --Filter \\"%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: HackTool - SharpEvtMute Execution

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects installation of new shim databases that try to patch sections of known processes for potential process injection or persistence.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\AppCompatFlags\\Custom\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\csrss.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\dllhost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\explorer.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\RuntimeBroker.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\services.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\sihost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\svchost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\taskhostw.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\winlogon.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\WmiPrvSe.exe' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Suspicious Shim Database Patching Activity

author: Roberto Rodriguez (Cyb3rWard0g), OTR (Open Threat Research)
description: Potential adversaries stopping ETW providers recording loaded .NET assemblies.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND ((TargetObject LIKE '%SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\.NETFramework\\ETWEnabled' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue='DWORD (0x00000000)') OR ((TargetObject LIKE '%\\COMPlus\_ETWEnabled' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\COMPlus\_ETWFlags' ESCAPE '\') AND (NewValue=0 OR NewValue='DWORD (0x00000000)'))))
title: ETW Logging Disabled In .NET Processes - Sysmon Registry

author: Bhabesh Raj
description: Detects execution of ADRecon.ps1 for AD reconnaissance which has been reported to be actively used by FIN7
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Function Get-ADRExcelComOb%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-ADRGPO%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-ADRDomainController%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%ADRecon-Report.xlsx%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: PowerShell ADRecon Execution

author: X__Junior (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects creation of local users via the net.exe command with the name of "DarkGate"
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\net.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\net1.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%user%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%add%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%DarkGate%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%SafeMode%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: DarkGate - User Created Via Net.EXE

author: Orlinum , BlueDefenZer
description: Detects certificate creation with template allowing risk permission subject and risky EKU
falsepositives: Proxy SSL certificate with subject modification
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (((EventID=4898 AND (TemplateContent LIKE '%1.3.6.1.5.5.7.3.2%' ESCAPE '\' OR TemplateContent LIKE '%1.3.6.1.5.2.3.4%' ESCAPE '\' OR TemplateContent LIKE '%1.3.6.1.4.1.311.20.2.2%' ESCAPE '\' OR TemplateContent LIKE '%2.5.29.37.0%' ESCAPE '\')) AND TemplateContent LIKE '%CT\_FLAG\_ENROLLEE\_SUPPLIES\_SUBJECT%' ESCAPE '\') OR ((EventID=4899 AND (NewTemplateContent LIKE '%1.3.6.1.5.5.7.3.2%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewTemplateContent LIKE '%1.3.6.1.5.2.3.4%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewTemplateContent LIKE '%1.3.6.1.4.1.311.20.2.2%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewTemplateContent LIKE '%2.5.29.37.0%' ESCAPE '\')) AND NewTemplateContent LIKE '%CT\_FLAG\_ENROLLEE\_SUPPLIES\_SUBJECT%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: ADCS Certificate Template Configuration Vulnerability with Risky EKU

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), memory-shards
description: Detects execution of the AgentExecutor.exe binary. Which can be abused as a LOLBIN to execute powershell scripts with the ExecutionPolicy "Bypass" or any binary named "powershell.exe" located in the path provided by 6th positional argument
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\AgentExecutor.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='AgentExecutor.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -powershell%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -remediationScript%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE(((CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\Windows\\System32\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\Microsoft.Management.Services.IntuneWindowsAgent.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Suspicious AgentExecutor PowerShell Execution

author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel
description: Detects the setting of a new value in the Autorun key that is used by the Kapeka backdoor for persistence.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run%' ESCAPE '\' AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\Sens Api' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\OneDrive' ESCAPE '\') AND (NewValue LIKE '%:\\WINDOWS\\system32\\rundll32.exe%' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue LIKE '%.wll%' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue LIKE '%#1%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Kapeka Backdoor Autorun Persistence

author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects registry modifications related to 'OracleOciLib' and 'OracleOciLibPath' under 'MSDTC' settings.
Threat actors may modify these registry keys to redirect the loading of 'oci.dll' to a malicious DLL, facilitating phantom DLL hijacking via the MSDTC service.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND ((TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\MSDTC\\MTxOCI\\OracleOciLib' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((NewValue LIKE '%oci.dll%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))) OR (TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\MSDTC\\MTxOCI\\OracleOciLibPath' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((NewValue LIKE '%\%SystemRoot\%\\System32\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0)))))
title: Registry Modification for OCI DLL Redirection

author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects deletion of the RunMRU registry key, which stores the history of commands executed via the Run dialog.
In the clickfix techniques, the phishing lures instruct users to open a run dialog through (Win + R) and execute malicious commands.
Adversaries may delete this key to cover their tracks after executing commands.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='reg.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% del%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Explorer\\RunMRU%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: RunMRU Registry Key Deletion

author: Tim Rauch, frack113
description: Detects deletion of Windows Volume Shadow Copies with PowerShell code and Get-WMIObject. This technique is used by numerous ransomware families such as Sodinokibi/REvil
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ((ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-WmiObject%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%gwmi%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-CimInstance%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%gcim%' ESCAPE '\') AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Win32\_ShadowCopy%' ESCAPE '\' AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.Delete()%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Remove-WmiObject%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%rwmi%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Remove-CimInstance%' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '%rcim%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Deletion of Volume Shadow Copies via WMI with PowerShell - PS Script

author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects attempts to add, modify, or delete Windows Credential Guard related registry keys or values via command line tools such as Reg.exe or PowerShell.
Credential Guard uses virtualization-based security to isolate secrets so that only privileged system software can access them.
Adversaries may disable Credential Guard to gain access to sensitive credentials stored in the system, such as NTLM hashes and Kerberos tickets, which can be used for lateral movement and privilege escalation.
The rule matches suspicious command lines that target DeviceGuard or LSA registry paths and manipulate keys like EnableVirtualizationBasedSecurity, RequirePlatformSecurityFeatures, or LsaCfgFlags.
Such activity may indicate an attempt to disable or tamper with Credential Guard, potentially exposing sensitive credentials for misuse.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll' OR OriginalFileName='reg.exe')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%add %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%New-ItemProperty %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Set-ItemProperty %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%si %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%delete %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%del %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Remove-ItemProperty %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%rp %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\Control\\DeviceGuard%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Control\\LSA%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Software\\Policies\\Microsoft\\Windows\\DeviceGuard%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%EnableVirtualizationBasedSecurity%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%RequirePlatformSecurityFeatures%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%LsaCfgFlags%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Windows Credential Guard Registry Tampering Via CommandLine

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the use of a renamed SysInternals Sdelete, which is something an administrator shouldn't do (the renaming)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (OriginalFileName='sdelete.exe' AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\sdelete.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\sdelete64.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\sdelete64a.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Renamed Sysinternals Sdelete Execution

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Jonhnathan Ribeiro, oscd.community
description: Detects suspicious command lines used in Covenant luanchers
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((CommandLine LIKE '%-Sta%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-Nop%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-Window%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%Hidden%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-Command%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-EncodedCommand%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (CommandLine LIKE '%sv o (New-Object IO.MemorySteam);sv d %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%mshta file.hta%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%GruntHTTP%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-EncodedCommand cwB2ACAAbwAgA%' ESCAPE '\')))

author: Trent Liffick (@tliffick)
description: Attempts to detect system changes made by Blue Mockingbird
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%sc config%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%wercplsupporte.dll%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wmic.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%COR\_PROFILER' ESCAPE '\')))

author: oscd.community, Natalia Shornikova, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects potential abuse of the "manage-bde.wsf" script as a LOLBIN to proxy execution
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='wscript.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '%manage-bde.wsf%' ESCAPE '\') OR (((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%manage-bde.wsf%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0)))))

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Vasiliy Burov, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects Ryuk ransomware activity
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%del /s /f /q c:\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%*.bac%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%*.bak%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%*.bkf%' ESCAPE '\') OR ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\net.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\net1.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% stop %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% /y%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%samss%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%audioendpointbuilder%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%unistoresvc\_%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%AcrSch2Svc%' ESCAPE '\'))))

author: Roberto Rodriguez @Cyb3rWard0g, Open Threat Research (OTR)
description: Detects a threat actor creating a file named `iertutil.dll` in the `C:\Program Files\Internet Explorer\` directory over the network for a DCOM InternetExplorer DLL Hijack scenario.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=5145 AND RelativeTargetName LIKE '%\\Internet Explorer\\iertutil.dll' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((SubjectUserName LIKE '%$' ESCAPE '\'), 0)))
title: DCOM InternetExplorer.Application Iertutil DLL Hijack - Security

author: @Kostastsale
description: Detects the initial execution of "cmd.exe" which spawns "explorer.exe" with the appropriate command line arguments for opening the "My Computer" folder.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\explorer.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%shell:mycomputerfolder%' ESCAPE '\'))

author: frack113
description: Triggers on any Sysmon "FileBlockShredding" event, which indicates a violation of the configured shredding policy.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational' AND EventID=28
title: Sysmon Blocked File Shredding

author: frack113
description:
Detects execution of the "net.exe" command in order to add a group named "ESX Admins".
This could indicates a potential exploitation attempt of CVE-2024-37085, which allows an attacker to elevate their privileges to full administrative access on an domain-joined ESXi hypervisor.
VMware ESXi hypervisors joined to an Active Directory domain consider any member of a domain group named "ESX Admins" to have full administrative access by default.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\net.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\net1.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='net.exe' OR OriginalFileName='net1.exe')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/add%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/domain%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%ESX Admins%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%group%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\PowerShell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='PowerShell.exe' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%New-ADGroup%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%ESX Admins%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Potential Exploitation of CVE-2024-37085 - Suspicious Creation Of ESX Admins Group

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects changes to the "NoLMHash" registry value in order to allow Windows to store LM Hashes.
By setting this registry value to "0" (DWORD), Windows will be allowed to store a LAN manager hash of your password in Active Directory and local SAM databases.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%System\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\Lsa\\NoLMHash' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue='DWORD (0x00000000)'))
title: Enable LM Hash Storage

author: yxinmiracle
description: Detects the use of PowerShell with Uninstall-WindowsFeature or Remove-WindowsFeature cmdlets to disable or remove the Windows Defender GUI feature, a common technique used by adversaries to evade defenses.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell\_ise.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName LIKE 'PowerShell\_ISE.EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Uninstall-WindowsFeature%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Remove-WindowsFeature%' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%Windows-Defender%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Suspicious Uninstall of Windows Defender Feature via PowerShell

author: Samir Bousseaden
description: detects execution of psexec or paexec with renamed service name, this rule helps to filter out the noise if psexec is used for legit purposes or if attacker uses a different psexec client other than sysinternal one
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=5145 AND ShareName LIKE '\\\\*\\IPC$' ESCAPE '\' AND (RelativeTargetName LIKE '%-stdin' ESCAPE '\' OR RelativeTargetName LIKE '%-stdout' ESCAPE '\' OR RelativeTargetName LIKE '%-stderr' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((RelativeTargetName LIKE 'PSEXESVC%' ESCAPE '\'), 0)))
title: Suspicious PsExec Execution

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Jason Lynch
description: Detects execution of renamed version of PAExec. Often used by attackers
falsepositives: Weird admins that rename their tools
Software companies that bundle PAExec with their software and rename it, so that it is less embarrassing
When executed with the "-s" flag. PAExec will copy itself to the "C:\Windows\" directory with a different name. Usually like this "PAExec-[XXXXX]-[ComputerName]"
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((Description='PAExec Application' OR OriginalFileName='PAExec.exe' OR Product LIKE '%PAExec%' ESCAPE '\' OR (Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=11D40A7B7876288F919AB819CC2D9802%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=6444f8a34e99b8f7d9647de66aabe516%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=dfd6aa3f7b2b1035b76b718f1ddc689f%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=1a6cca4d5460b1710a12dea39e4a592c%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\paexec.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\PAExec-%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Renamed PAExec Execution

author: Tim Rauch (Nextron Systems), Elastic (idea)
description: Detects a service installed by a client which has PID 0 or whose parent has PID 0
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4697 AND (ClientProcessId=0 OR ParentProcessId=0))
title: Service Installed By Unusual Client - Security

author: pH-T (Nextron Systems), @Kostastsale, TheDFIRReport, X__Junior (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the creation of a schtask that potentially executes a base64 encoded payload stored in the Windows Registry using PowerShell.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\schtasks.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='schtasks.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '%/Create%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%FromBase64String%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%encodedcommand%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Get-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% gp %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%HKCU:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%HKLM:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%registry::%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%HKEY\_%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Scheduled Task Executing Encoded Payload from Registry

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects a ProcessHacker tool that elevated privileges to a very high level
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='System' AND (Provider_Name='Service Control Manager' AND EventID=7045 AND ServiceName LIKE 'ProcessHacker%' ESCAPE '\' AND AccountName='LocalSystem')
title: ProcessHacker Privilege Elevation

author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects execution of EDR-Freeze, a tool that exploits the MiniDumpWriteDump function and WerFaultSecure.exe to suspend EDR and Antivirus processes on Windows.
EDR-Freeze leverages a race-condition attack to put security processes into a dormant state by suspending WerFaultSecure at the moment it freezes the target process.
This technique does not require kernel-level exploits or BYOVD, but instead abuses user-mode functionality to temporarily disable monitoring by EDR or Antimalware solutions.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\EDR-Freeze%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\EDRFreeze%' ESCAPE '\') AND NewProcessName LIKE '%.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=1195F7935954A2CD09157390C33F8E8C%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=129F58DE3D687FB7F012BF6C3D679997%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=2C617A175D0086251642C6619F7CC8BA%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=8828F0B906F7844358FB92A899E9520F%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=AF76D95157EC554DC1EF178E4E66D447%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=E1B04316B61ACA31DD52ABBEC0A37FD5%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=8B2D5B54AFCFEC60D54F6B31D80ED4A0%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=AB8BB31EDD91D2A05FE7B62A535E9EB7%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Hacktool - EDR-Freeze Execution

author: pH-T (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the creation of a schtask that executes a file from C:\Users\<USER>\AppData\Local
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\schtasks.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/Create%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/RU%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/TR%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\Users\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%NT AUT%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% SYSTEM %' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE(((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentProcessName LIKE '%TeamViewer\_.exe%' ESCAPE '\') AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\schtasks.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/TN TVInstallRestore%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Suspicious Schtasks Execution AppData Folder

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description:
Threat actors can use an older version of the auditpol binary available inside the NT resource kit to change audit policy configuration to impair detection capability.
This can be carried out by selectively disabling/removing certain audit policies as well as restoring a custom policy owned by the threat actor.
falsepositives: The old auditpol utility isn't available by default on recent versions of Windows as it was replaced by a newer version. The FP rate should be very low except for tools that use a similar flag structure
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/logon:none%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/system:none%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/sam:none%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/privilege:none%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/object:none%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/process:none%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/policy:none%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Audit Policy Tampering Via NT Resource Kit Auditpol

author: Sean Metcalf (source), Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects PowerShell called from an executable by the version mismatch method
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Windows PowerShell' AND (EventID=400 AND ((Data LIKE '%EngineVersion=2.%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%EngineVersion=4.%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%EngineVersion=5.%' ESCAPE '\') AND Data LIKE '%HostVersion=3.%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: PowerShell Called from an Executable Version Mismatch

author: Nikita Nazarov, oscd.community
description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via Stdin in Scripts
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4103 AND Payload REGEXP '(?i)(set).*&&\s?set.*(environment|invoke|\$?\{?input).*&&.*"')
title: Invoke-Obfuscation Via Stdin - PowerShell Module

author: Max Altgelt (Nextron Systems), Tobias Michalski (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the execution of the builtin "copy" command that targets a shadow copy (sometimes used to copy registry hives that are in use)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%copy %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\\\?\\GLOBALROOT\\Device\\HarddiskVolumeShadowCopy%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Copy From VolumeShadowCopy Via Cmd.EXE

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the execution of the "wusa.exe" (Windows Update Standalone Installer) utility to extract ".cab" files using the "/extract" argument from potentially suspicious paths.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wusa.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/extract:%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%:\\PerfLogs\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Appdata\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Cab File Extraction Via Wusa.EXE From Potentially Suspicious Paths

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects execution of LiveKD with the "-m" flag to potentially dump the kernel memory
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\livekd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\livekd64.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR OriginalFileName='livekd.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -m%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /m%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –m%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —m%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―m%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Kernel Memory Dump Via LiveKD

author: Tobias Michalski (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects a failed installation of a Exchange Transport Agent
falsepositives: Legitimate installations of exchange TransportAgents. AssemblyPath is a good indicator for this.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='MSExchange Management' AND (EventID=6 AND Data LIKE '%Install-TransportAgent%' ESCAPE '\')
title: Failed MSExchange Transport Agent Installation

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects the execution of the SharpDPAPI tool based on CommandLine flags and PE metadata.
SharpDPAPI is a C# port of some DPAPI functionality from the Mimikatz project.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\SharpDPAPI.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='SharpDPAPI.exe') OR ((CommandLine LIKE '% backupkey %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% blob %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% certificates %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% credentials %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% keepass %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% masterkeys %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% rdg %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% vaults %' ESCAPE '\') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '% {%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%}:%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% /file:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /machine%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /mkfile:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /password:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /pvk:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /server:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /target:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /unprotect%' ESCAPE '\')))))
title: HackTool - SharpDPAPI Execution

author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects suspicious activity where the WMIC process is used to create an autorun registry entry via reg.exe, which is often indicative of persistence mechanisms employed by malware.
falsepositives: Legitimate administrative activity or software installations

title: Suspicious Autorun Registry Modified via WMI

author: Moriarty Meng (idea), Anton Kutepov (rule), oscd.community
description: Detects PowerShell script execution via input stream redirect
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine REGEXP '\s-\s*<'))

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), X__Junior
description: Detects changes to the "Winlogon" registry key where a process will set the value of the "Shell" to a value that was observed being used by KamiKakaBot samples in order to achieve persistence.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Winlogon\\Shell' ESCAPE '\' AND (NewValue LIKE '%-nop -w h%' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue LIKE '%$env%' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue LIKE '%explorer.exe%' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue LIKE '%Start-Process%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Potential KamiKakaBot Activity - Winlogon Shell Persistence

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Markus Neis, Jonhnathan Ribeiro, Daniil Yugoslavskiy, Anton Kutepov, oscd.community
description: Detects suspicious powershell process starts with base64 encoded commands (e.g. Emotet)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND ((CommandLine LIKE '% -e%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% JAB%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% SUVYI%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% SQBFAFgA%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% aQBlAHgA%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% aWV4I%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% IAA%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% IAB%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% UwB%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% cwB%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (CommandLine LIKE '%.exe -ENCOD %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% BA^J e-%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '% -ExecutionPolicy remotesigned %' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Suspicious Encoded PowerShell Command Line

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the use of HandleKatz, a tool that demonstrates the usage of cloned handles to Lsass in order to create an obfuscated memory dump of the same
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\loader.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%--pid:%' ESCAPE '\') OR (Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=38D9E015591BBFD4929E0D0F47FA0055%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=0E2216679CA6E1094D63322E3412D650%' ESCAPE '\') OR ((CommandLine LIKE '%--pid:%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%--outfile:%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%.dmp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%lsass%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.obf%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%dump%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: HackTool - HandleKatz LSASS Dumper Execution

author: John Lambert (idea), Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects PowerShell calling a credential prompt
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%PromptForCredential%' ESCAPE '\')
title: PowerShell Credential Prompt

author: elhoim, CD_ROM_
description: Detects RunDLL32.exe spawning explorer.exe as child, which is very uncommon, often observes Gamarue spawning the explorer.exe process in an unusual way
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\explorer.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentCommandLine LIKE '%\\shell32.dll,Control\_RunDLL%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: RunDLL32 Spawning Explorer

author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects suspicious Kerberos ticket requests via command line using System.IdentityModel.Tokens.KerberosRequestorSecurityToken class.
Threat actors may use command line interfaces to request Kerberos tickets for service accounts in order to
perform offline password cracking attacks commonly known as Kerberoasting or other Kerberos ticket abuse
techniques like silver ticket attacks.
falsepositives: Legitimate command line usage by administrators or security tools.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='powershell.exe' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%System.IdentityModel.Tokens.KerberosRequestorSecurityToken%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.GetRequest()%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Suspicious Kerberos Ticket Request via CLI

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects PowerShell module creation where the module Contents are set to "function Get-VMRemoteFXPhysicalVideoAdapter". This could be a sign of potential abuse of the "RemoteFXvGPUDisablement.exe" binary which is known to be vulnerable to module load-order hijacking.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ScriptBlockText LIKE 'function Get-VMRemoteFXPhysicalVideoAdapter {%' ESCAPE '\')
title: Potential RemoteFXvGPUDisablement.EXE Abuse - PowerShell ScriptBlock

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects usage of the WMI class "Win32_NTEventlogFile" in a potentially suspicious way (delete, backup, change permissions, etc.) from a PowerShell script
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Win32\_NTEventlogFile%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%.BackupEventlog(%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.ChangeSecurityPermissions(%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.ChangeSecurityPermissionsEx(%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.ClearEventLog(%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.Delete(%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.DeleteEx(%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.Rename(%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.TakeOwnerShip(%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.TakeOwnerShipEx(%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Potentially Suspicious Call To Win32_NTEventlogFile Class

author: frack113
description: Detects the execution of the LOLBIN PrintBrm.exe, which can be used to create or extract ZIP files. PrintBrm.exe should not be run on a normal workstation.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\PrintBrm.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -f%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.zip%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: PrintBrm ZIP Creation of Extraction

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects execution of "odbcconf" with the "INSTALLDRIVER" action where the driver doesn't contain a ".dll" extension. This is often used as a defense evasion method.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\odbcconf.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='odbcconf.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '%INSTALLDRIVER %' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Suspicious Driver/DLL Installation Via Odbcconf.EXE

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects a DNS server error in which a specified plugin DLL (in registry) could not be loaded
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='DNS Server' AND (EventID=150 OR EventID=770 OR EventID=771)
title: DNS Server Error Failed Loading the ServerLevelPluginDLL

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects suspicious parent processes that should not have any children or should only have a single possible child program
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\minesweeper.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\winver.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\bitsadmin.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\csrss.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\certutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\eventvwr.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\calc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\notepad.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE(((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\WerFault.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wermgr.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\conhost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\mmc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\win32calc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\notepad.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR NewProcessName IS NULL), 0)))))
title: Suspicious Process Parents

author: EagleEye Team, Florian Roth
description: Detects new commands that add new printer port which point to suspicious file
falsepositives: New printer port install on host
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%Add-PrinterPort -Name%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.bat%' ESCAPE '\')) OR CommandLine LIKE '%Generic / Text Only%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Suspicious PrinterPorts Creation (CVE-2020-1048)

author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects the use of reg.exe to export registry paths associated with third-party credentials.
Credential stealers have been known to use this technique to extract sensitive information from the registry.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='reg.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%save%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%export%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\Aerofox\\Foxmail\\V3.1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\Aerofox\\FoxmailPreview%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\DownloadManager\\Passwords%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\FTPWare\\COREFTP\\Sites%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\IncrediMail\\Identities%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\Martin Prikryl\\WinSCP 2\\Sessions%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\Mobatek\\MobaXterm%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\OpenSSH\\Agent\\Keys%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\OpenVPN-GUI\\configs%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\ORL\\WinVNC3\\Password%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\Qualcomm\\Eudora\\CommandLine%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\RealVNC\\WinVNC4%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\RimArts\\B2\\Settings%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\SimonTatham\\PuTTY\\Sessions%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\SimonTatham\\PuTTY\\SshHostKeys%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\Sota\\FFFTP%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\TightVNC\\Server%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Software\\WOW6432Node\\Radmin\\v3.0\\Server\\Parameters\\Radmin%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Registry Export of Third-Party Credentials

author: Beyu Denis, oscd.community (rule), @_felamos (idea)
description: The Devtoolslauncher.exe executes other binary
falsepositives: Legitimate use of devtoolslauncher.exe by legitimate user
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\devtoolslauncher.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%LaunchForDeploy%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Devtoolslauncher.exe Executes Specified Binary

author: Ecco, Daniil Yugoslavskiy, oscd.community, D3F7A5105, Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects the clearing or configuration tampering of EventLog using utilities such as "wevtutil", "powershell" and "wmic".
This technique were seen used by threat actors and ransomware strains in order to evade defenses.
falsepositives: Scripts and administrative tools used in the monitored environment
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wevtutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='wevtutil.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%clear-log %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% cl %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%set-log %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% sl %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%lfn:%' ESCAPE '\')) OR ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell\_ise.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%Clear-EventLog %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Remove-EventLog %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Limit-EventLog %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Clear-WinEvent %' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%Eventing.Reader.EventLogSession%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%ClearLog%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%Diagnostics.EventLog%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%Clear%' ESCAPE '\'))) OR ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell\_ise.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wmic.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%ClearEventLog%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE(((ParentProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\msiexec.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\msiexec.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '% sl %' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Suspicious Eventlog Clearing or Configuration Change Activity

author: Sreeman
description:
The Tasks folder in system32 and syswow64 are globally writable paths.
Adversaries can take advantage of this and load or influence any script hosts or ANY .NET Application
in Tasks to load and execute a custom assembly into cscript, wscript, regsvr32, mshta, eventvwr
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%echo %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%copy %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%type %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%file createnew%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% C:\\Windows\\System32\\Tasks\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% C:\\Windows\\SysWow64\\Tasks\\%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Tasks Folder Evasion

author: Diego Perez (@darkquassar), Markus Neis, Swisscom (Improve Rule), Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects execution of mshta.exe with file types that looks like they do not typically represent HTA (HTML Application) content,
such as .png, .jpg, .zip, .pdf, and others, which are often polyglots. MSHTA is a legitimate Windows utility for executing HTML Applications
containing VBScript or JScript. Threat actors often abuse this lolbin utility to download and
execute malicious scripts disguised as benign files or hosted under misleading extensions to evade detection.
falsepositives: False positives depend on scripts and administrative tools used in the monitored environment
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='mshta.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%.7z%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.avi%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.bat%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.bmp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.conf%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.csv%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.doc%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.gif%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.gz%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.ini%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.jpe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.jpg%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.json%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.lnk%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.log%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.mkv%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.mp3%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.mp4%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.pdf%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.png%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.ppt%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.rar%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.rtf%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.svg%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.tar%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.tmp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.txt%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.xls%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.xml%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.yaml%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.yml%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.zip%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%vbscript%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: MSHTA Execution with Suspicious File Extensions

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Jonhnathan Ribeiro, oscd.community
description: Detects the execution of certutil with either the "decode" or "decodehex" flags to decode base64 or hex encoded files. This can be abused by attackers to decode an encoded payload before execution
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\certutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='CertUtil.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-decode %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/decode %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–decode %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—decode %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―decode %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-decodehex %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/decodehex %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–decodehex %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—decodehex %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―decodehex %' ESCAPE '\')))
title: File Decoded From Base64/Hex Via Certutil.EXE

author: Nikita Nazarov, oscd.community
description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via use Rundll32 in Scripts
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4697 AND (ServiceFileName LIKE '%&&%' ESCAPE '\' AND ServiceFileName LIKE '%rundll32%' ESCAPE '\' AND ServiceFileName LIKE '%shell32.dll%' ESCAPE '\' AND ServiceFileName LIKE '%shellexec\_rundll%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ServiceFileName LIKE '%value%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceFileName LIKE '%invoke%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceFileName LIKE '%comspec%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceFileName LIKE '%iex%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Invoke-Obfuscation Via Use Rundll32 - Security

author: Max Altgelt (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects usage of a PowerShell command to dump the live memory of a Windows machine
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%Get-StorageDiagnosticInfo%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%-IncludeLiveDump%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Live Memory Dump Using Powershell

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the execution of "logman" utility in order to disable or delete Windows trace sessions
falsepositives: Installer tools that disable services, e.g. before log collection agent installation
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\logman.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='Logman.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%stop %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%delete %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Circular Kernel Context Logger%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%EventLog-%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%SYSMON TRACE%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%SysmonDnsEtwSession%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Suspicious Windows Trace ETW Session Tamper Via Logman.EXE

author: Bhabesh Raj
description: Detects possible successful exploitation for vulnerability described in CVE-2021-26857 by looking for | abnormal subprocesses spawning by Exchange Server's Unified Messaging service
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\UMWorkerProcess.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE '%wermgr.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%WerFault.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Potential CVE-2021-26857 Exploitation Attempt

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects suspicious renamed SysInternals DebugView execution
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (Product='Sysinternals DebugView' AND (NOT COALESCE((OriginalFileName='Dbgview.exe' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\Dbgview.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Renamed SysInternals DebugView Execution

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects command line parameters used by ADCSPwn, a tool to escalate privileges in an active directory network by coercing authenticate from machine accounts and relaying to the certificate service
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '% --adcs %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% --port %' ESCAPE '\'))
title: HackTool - ADCSPwn Execution

author: montysecurity, Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects suspicious execution patterns where users are tricked into running malicious commands via clipboard manipulation, either through the Windows Run dialog (ClickFix) or File Explorer address bar (FileFix).
Attackers leverage social engineering campaigns—such as fake CAPTCHA challenges or urgent alerts—encouraging victims to paste clipboard contents, often executing mshta.exe, powershell.exe, or similar commands to infect systems.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\explorer.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%#%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%account%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%anti-bot%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%botcheck%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%captcha%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%challenge%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%confirmation%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%fraud%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%human%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%identification%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%identificator%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%identity%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%robot%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%validation%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%verification%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%verify%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Suspicious ClickFix/FileFix Execution Pattern

author: Semanur Guneysu @semanurtg, oscd.community
description: Detection of unusual child processes by different system processes
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\winlogon.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\services.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\lsass.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\csrss.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\smss.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\wininit.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\spoolsv.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\searchindexer.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (User LIKE '%AUTHORI%' ESCAPE '\' OR User LIKE '%AUTORI%' ESCAPE '\')) AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll' OR OriginalFileName='Cmd.Exe'))) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '% route %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% ADD %' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))

author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects when the Windows Vulnerable Driver Blocklist is set to disabled. This setting is crucial for preventing the loading of known vulnerable drivers,
and its modification may indicate an attempt to bypass security controls. It is often targeted by threat actors to facilitate the installation of malicious or vulnerable drivers,
particularly in scenarios involving Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) bypass techniques.
This rule applies to systems that support the Vulnerable Driver Blocklist feature, including Windows 10 version 1903 and later, and Windows Server 2022 and later.
Note that this change will require a reboot to take effect, and this rule only detects the registry modification action.
falsepositives: Unlikely and should be investigated immediately.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\Control\\CI\\Config\\VulnerableDriverBlocklistEnable' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue='DWORD (0x00000000)'))
title: Windows Vulnerable Driver Blocklist Disabled

author: frack113
description:
Detects changes to the "DisableRestrictedAdmin" registry value in order to disable or enable RestrictedAdmin mode.
RestrictedAdmin mode prevents the transmission of reusable credentials to the remote system to which you connect using Remote Desktop.
This prevents your credentials from being harvested during the initial connection process if the remote server has been compromise

title: PUA- IOX Tunneling Tool Execution

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects execution of "reg.exe" commands with the "add" or "copy" flags on safe boot registry keys. Often used by attacker to allow the ransomware to work in safe mode as some security products do not
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='reg.exe') AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\SafeBoot%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% copy %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% add %' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Add SafeBoot Keys Via Reg Utility

author: E.M. Anhaus (originally from Atomic Blue Detections, Tony Lambert), oscd.community, Florian Roth
description: Detects use of WSReset.exe to bypass User Account Control (UAC). Adversaries use this technique to execute privileged processes.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\wsreset.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\conhost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='CONHOST.EXE'), 0))))
title: Bypass UAC via WSReset.exe

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Wojciech Lesicki
description: Detects known malicious service installs that appear in cases in which a Cobalt Strike beacon elevates privileges or lateral movement
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4697 AND ((ServiceFileName LIKE '%ADMIN$%' ESCAPE '\' AND ServiceFileName LIKE '%.exe%' ESCAPE '\') OR (ServiceFileName LIKE '%\%COMSPEC\%%' ESCAPE '\' AND ServiceFileName LIKE '%start%' ESCAPE '\' AND ServiceFileName LIKE '%powershell%' ESCAPE '\') OR ServiceFileName LIKE '%powershell -nop -w hidden -encodedcommand%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceFileName LIKE '%SUVYIChOZXctT2JqZWN0IE5ldC5XZWJjbGllbnQpLkRvd25sb2FkU3RyaW5nKCdodHRwOi8vMTI3LjAuMC4xO%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceFileName LIKE '%lFWCAoTmV3LU9iamVjdCBOZXQuV2ViY2xpZW50KS5Eb3dubG9hZFN0cmluZygnaHR0cDovLzEyNy4wLjAuMT%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceFileName LIKE '%JRVggKE5ldy1PYmplY3QgTmV0LldlYmNsaWVudCkuRG93bmxvYWRTdHJpbmcoJ2h0dHA6Ly8xMjcuMC4wLjE6%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: CobaltStrike Service Installations - Security

author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects attempts to disable Windows EventLog autologger sessions via registry modification.
The AutoLogger event tracing session records events that occur early in the operating system boot process.
Applications and device drivers can use the AutoLogger session to capture traces before the user logs in.
Adversaries may disable these sessions to evade detection and prevent security monitoring of early boot activities and system events.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\reg.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='reg.exe' OR OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '%add %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Set-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%New-ItemProperty%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%si %' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\Control\\WMI\\Autologger\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Start%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Enabled%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Windows EventLog Autologger Session Registry Modification Via CommandLine

author: Teymur Kheirkhabarov (idea), Vasiliy Burov (rule), oscd.community, Tim Shelton (fp)
description: Detects the PowerShell command lines with special characters
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND (CommandLine REGEXP '\+.*\+.*\+.*\+.*\+.*\+.*\+.*\+.*\+.*\+.*\+.*\+.*\+.*\+' OR CommandLine REGEXP '\{.*\{.*\{.*\{.*\{.*\{.*\{.*\{.*\{.*\{' OR CommandLine REGEXP '\^.*\^.*\^.*\^.*\^' OR CommandLine REGEXP '`.*`.*`.*`.*`')) AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\Amazon\\SSM\\ssm-document-worker.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR (CommandLine LIKE '%new EventSource("Microsoft.Windows.Sense.Client.Management"%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%public static extern bool InstallELAMCertificateInfo(SafeFileHandle handle);%' ESCAPE '\')), 0))))
title: Potential PowerShell Command Line Obfuscation

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects suspicious Rundll32 execution from control.exe as used by Equation Group and Exploit Kits
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\System32\\control.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='RUNDLL32.EXE')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%Shell32.dll%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Suspicious Control Panel DLL Load

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects the setting of the DLL that handles the custom protocol handler.
Seen being created by Forest Blizzard APT as reported by MSFT.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\CLSID\\{026CC6D7-34B2-33D5-B551-CA31EB6CE345}\\Server%' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue LIKE '%.dll' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Forest Blizzard APT - Custom Protocol Handler DLL Registry Set

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects suspicious usage of the ShellExec_RunDLL function to launch other commands as seen in the the raspberry-robin attack
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%ShellExec\_RunDLL%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\Desktop\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%comspec%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%iex%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Invoke-%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%msiexec%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%odbcconf%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%regsvr32%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Suspicious Usage Of ShellExec_RunDLL

author: Andreas Braathen (mnemonic.io)
description:
Detects the execution of rundll32 that leads to the invocation of legitimate Windows binaries.
The malware Pikabot has been seen to use this technique for process hollowing through hard-coded Windows binaries
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\SearchFilterHost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\SearchProtocolHost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\sndvol.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wermgr.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wwahost.exe' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\sndvol.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '%mmsys.cpl%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Potential Pikabot Hollowing Activity

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the use of NirCmd tool for command execution as SYSTEM user
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND CommandLine LIKE '% runassystem %' ESCAPE '\')
title: PUA - NirCmd Execution As LOCAL SYSTEM

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects a specific binary name seen used by SNAKE malware during its installation as described by CISA in their report
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\jpsetup.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\jpinst.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE(((CommandLine='jpinst.exe' OR CommandLine='jpinst' OR CommandLine='jpsetup.exe' OR CommandLine='jpsetup') OR CommandLine='' OR CommandLine IS NULL), 0))))
title: Potential SNAKE Malware Installation Binary Indicator

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects SharpLdapWhoami, a whoami alternative that queries the LDAP service on a domain controller
falsepositives: Programs that use the same command line flags
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\SharpLdapWhoami.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR (OriginalFileName LIKE '%SharpLdapWhoami%' ESCAPE '\' OR Product='SharpLdapWhoami') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% /method:ntlm' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /method:kerb' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /method:nego' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /m:nego' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /m:ntlm' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /m:kerb' ESCAPE '\')))
title: HackTool - SharpLdapWhoami Execution

author: Teymur Kheirkhabarov
description: Detection of sc.exe utility spawning by user with Medium integrity level to change service ImagePath or FailureCommand
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\sc.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (IntegrityLevel='Medium' OR IntegrityLevel='S-1-16-8192')) AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%config%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%binPath%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%failure%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%command%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Possible Privilege Escalation via Weak Service Permissions

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: One of the Windows Eventlogs has been cleared. e.g. caused by "wevtutil cl" command execution
falsepositives: Rollout of log collection agents (the setup routine often includes a reset of the local Eventlog)
System provisioning (system reset before the golden image creation)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=517 AND Provider_Name='Security') OR (EventID=1102 AND Provider_Name='Microsoft-Windows-Eventlog'))
title: Security Eventlog Cleared

author: Chirag Damani (KPMG India), Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects the usage of SystemSettingsAdminFlows.exe to disable Windows Defender.
SystemSettingsAdminFlows.exe is a legitimate Windows component used for administrative configuration tasks.
However, attackers may abuse it to disable Windows Defender as part of their attack chain, especially in the context of ransomware or other malware campaigns.
falsepositives: Legitimate turn off of Windows Defender by the technical users or administrators for troubleshooting or other purposes.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\SystemSettingsAdminFlows.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='SystemSettingsAdminFlows.EXE') AND CommandLine LIKE '%defender%' ESCAPE '\') AND (((CommandLine LIKE '%RTP %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%RealTimeProtection %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%DisableEnhancedNotifications %' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%1%' ESCAPE '\') OR ((CommandLine LIKE '%SubmitSamplesConsent %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%SpyNetReporting %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%DisableCDPUserAuthPolicy %' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%0%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Windows Defender Disabled Via SystemSettingsAdminFlows.EXE

author: Nikita Nazarov, oscd.community
description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via use Clip.exe in Scripts
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ScriptBlockText REGEXP '(?i)echo.*clip.*&&.*(Clipboard|i`?n`?v`?o`?k`?e`?)')
title: Invoke-Obfuscation Via Use Clip - Powershell

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects when adversaries stop services or processes by deleting their respective scheduled tasks in order to conduct data destructive activities
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\schtasks.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='schtasks.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-delete%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/delete%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–delete%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—delete%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―delete%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\Windows\\BitLocker%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Windows\\ExploitGuard%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Windows\\SystemRestore\\SR%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Windows\\UpdateOrchestrator\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Windows\\Windows Defender\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Windows\\WindowsBackup\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Windows\\WindowsUpdate\\%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Delete Important Scheduled Task

author: @Kostastsale, TheDFIRReport
description: Detects the execution of the commonly used ZeroLogon PoC executable.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cool.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\zero.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%Administrator%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-c%' ESCAPE '\')) AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%taskkill%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/f%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/im%' ESCAPE '\') OR CommandLine LIKE '%powershell%' ESCAPE '\')))

author: Jonathan Cheong, oscd.community
description: Detects Obfuscated use of Environment Variables to execute PowerShell
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4697 AND (ServiceFileName LIKE '%cmd%' ESCAPE '\' AND ServiceFileName LIKE '%"set%' ESCAPE '\' AND ServiceFileName LIKE '%-f%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ServiceFileName LIKE '%/c%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceFileName LIKE '%/r%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Invoke-Obfuscation VAR+ Launcher - Security

author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects exploitation of LNK file command-line length discrepancy, where attackers hide malicious commands beyond the 260-character UI limit while the actual command-line argument field supports 4096 characters using whitespace padding (e.g., 0x20, 0x09-0x0D).
Adversaries insert non-printable whitespace characters (e.g., Line Feed \x0A, Carriage Return \x0D) to pad the visible section of the LNK file, pushing malicious commands past the UI-visible boundary.
The hidden payload, executed at runtime but invisible in Windows Explorer properties, enables stealthy execution and evasion—commonly used for social engineering attacks.
This rule flags suspicious use of such padding observed in real-world attacks.
rule:
SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\explorer.exe' ESCAPE '' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '%.lnk%' ESCAPE '') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%                 %' ESCAPE '' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\u0009%' ESCAPE '' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\u000A%' ESCAPE '' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\u0011%' ESCAPE '' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\u0012%' ESCAPE '' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\u0013%' ESCAPE '' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\u000B%' ESCAPE '' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\u000C%' ESCAPE '' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\u000D%' ESCAPE '') OR CommandLine REGEXP '





')))
title: Suspicious LNK Command-Line Padding with Whitespace Characters

author: Tobias Michalski (Nextron Systems), David Bertho (@dbertho) & Eirik Sveen (@0xSV1), Storebrand
description:
Detects potential persistence activity via outlook home page.
An attacker can set a home page to achieve code execution and persistence by editing the WebView registry keys.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND ((TargetObject LIKE '%\\Software\\Microsoft\\Office\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\Outlook\\WebView\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\URL' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Potential Persistence Via Outlook Home Page

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects exploitation indicators related to PaperCut MF/NG Exploitation
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine LIKE '% /c %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%powershell%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-nop -w hidden%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%Invoke-WebRequest%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%setup.msi%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-OutFile%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%msiexec %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/i %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%setup.msi %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/qn %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%IntegratorLogin=fimaribahundq%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: PaperCut MF/NG Exploitation Related Indicators

author: frack113
description: Detects TOKEN OBFUSCATION technique from Invoke-Obfuscation
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine REGEXP '\w+`(?:\w+|-|.)`[\w+|\s]' OR CommandLine REGEXP '"(?:\{\d\})+"\s*-f' OR CommandLine REGEXP '(?i)\$\{`?e`?n`?v`?:`?p`?a`?t`?h`?\}') AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%${env:path}%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Powershell Token Obfuscation - Process Creation

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects commands that temporarily turn off Volume Snapshots
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\Services\\VSS\\Diag%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/d Disabled%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Disabled Volume Snapshots

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the use of a renamed Adfind.exe. AdFind continues to be seen across majority of breaches. It is used to domain trust discovery to plan out subsequent steps in the attack chain.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((CommandLine LIKE '%domainlist%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%trustdmp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%dcmodes%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%adinfo%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% dclist %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%computer\_pwdnotreqd%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%objectcategory=%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-subnets -f%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%name="Domain Admins"%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-sc u:%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%domainncs%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%dompol%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% oudmp %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%subnetdmp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%gpodmp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%fspdmp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%users\_noexpire%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%computers\_active%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%computers\_pwdnotreqd%' ESCAPE '\') OR (Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=BCA5675746D13A1F246E2DA3C2217492%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=53E117A96057EAF19C41380D0E87F1C2%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=d144de8117df2beceaba2201ad304764%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=12ce1c0f3f5837ecc18a3782408fa975%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=4fbf3f084fbbb2470b80b2013134df35%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=49b639b4acbecc49d72a01f357aa4930%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=680dad9e300346e05a85023965867201%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=21aa085d54992511b9f115355e468782%' ESCAPE '\') OR OriginalFileName='AdFind.exe') AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\AdFind.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))

author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects suspicious child processes related to Windows Shell utilities spawned by `conhost.exe`, which could indicate malicious activity using trusted system components.
falsepositives: Legitimate administrative tasks using `conhost.exe` to spawn child processes such as `cmd.exe`, `powershell.exe`, or `regsvr32.exe`.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\conhost.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell\_ise.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='cmd.exe' OR OriginalFileName='cscript.exe' OR OriginalFileName='mshta.exe' OR OriginalFileName LIKE 'powershell\_ise.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='powershell.exe' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll' OR OriginalFileName='regsvr32.exe' OR OriginalFileName='wscript.exe'))))
title: Potentially Suspicious Child Processes Spawned by ConHost

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the creation of a process executing as user called "ANONYMOUS" seen used by the "MileStone2016" variant of COLDSTEEL
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\Windows\\System32\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\AppData\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND User LIKE '%ANONYMOUS%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: COLDSTEEL RAT Anonymous User Process Execution

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects a suspicious printer driver installation with an empty Manufacturer value
falsepositives: Alerts on legitimate printer drivers that do not set any more details in the Manufacturer value
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (((TargetObject LIKE '%\\Control\\Print\\Environments\\Windows x64\\Drivers%' ESCAPE '\' AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\Manufacturer%' ESCAPE '\') AND NewValue='(Empty)') AND (NOT COALESCE((TargetObject LIKE '%\\CutePDF Writer v4.0\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR (TargetObject LIKE '%\\VNC Printer (PS)\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\VNC Printer (UD)\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\Version-3\\PDF24\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Suspicious Printer Driver Empty Manufacturer
