author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects code fragments found in small and obfuscated AMSI bypass PowerShell scripts
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%[Ref].Assembly.GetType%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%SetValue($null,$true)%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%NonPublic,Static%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: AMSI Bypass Pattern Assembly GetType

author: Andreas Hunkeler (@Karneades)
description: Detects specific process parameters as used by ACTINIUM scheduled task persistence creation.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%schtasks%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%create%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%wscript%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% /e:vbscript%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Potential ACTINIUM Persistence Activity

author: Nikita Nazarov, oscd.community
description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via use Clip.exe in Scripts
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND CommandLine REGEXP '(?i)echo.*clip.*&&.*(?:Clipboard|i`?n`?v`?o`?k`?e`?)')
title: Invoke-Obfuscation Via Use Clip

author: Vadim Khrykov, Cyb3rEng
description: Office application called wmic to proxye execution through a LOLBIN process. This is often used to break suspicious parent-child chain (Office app spawns LOLBin).
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\WINWORD.EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\EXCEL.EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\POWERPNT.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\MSPUB.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\VISIO.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\MSACCESS.EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\EQNEDT32.EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\ONENOTE.EXE' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\wordpad.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\wordview.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wbem\\WMIC.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='wmic.exe') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%process%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%create%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%call%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%regsvr32%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%rundll32%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%msiexec%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%mshta%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%verclsid%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%wscript%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cscript%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Suspicious WMIC Execution Via Office Process

author: Ján Trenčanský, frack113, AlertIQ, Nasreddine Bencherchali
description: Detects when an attacker or tool disables the  Windows Defender service (WinDefend) via the registry
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\Services\\WinDefend\\Start' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue='DWORD (0x00000004)'))
title: Windows Defender Service Disabled - Registry

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), X__Junior (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects usage of Gpg4win to encrypt/decrypt files located in potentially suspicious locations.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\gpg.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\gpg2.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR Product='GNU Privacy Guard (GnuPG)' OR Description='GnuPG’s OpenPGP tool') AND CommandLine LIKE '%-passphrase%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%:\\PerfLogs\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Roaming\\%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: File Encryption/Decryption Via Gpg4win From Suspicious Locations

author: Markus Neis, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects a suspicious child process spawning from Outlook where the image is located in a remote location (SMB/WebDav shares).
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\outlook.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE '\\\\%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Suspicious Remote Child Process From Outlook

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects a suspicious curl process start on Windows and outputs the requested document to a local file
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\curl.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Product='The curl executable') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%\%AppData\%%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%Public\%%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%Temp\%%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%tmp\%%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Desktop\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\PerfLogs\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\ProgramData\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%.dll' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.gif' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.jpeg' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.jpg' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.png' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.temp' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.tmp' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.txt' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.vbe' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.vbs' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((ParentProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\Git\\usr\\bin\\sh.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\Git\\mingw64\\bin\\curl.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%--silent --show-error --output %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%gfw-httpget-%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%AppData%' ESCAPE '\')), 0))))
title: Suspicious Curl.EXE Download

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the execution of msiexec.exe from an uncommon directory
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\msiexec.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName LIKE '\\msiexec.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\WinSxS\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Potential MsiExec Masquerading

author: frack113, Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects execution of Netcat. Adversaries may use a non-application layer protocol for communication between host and C2 server or among infected hosts within a network
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\nc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\ncat.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\netcat.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% -lvp %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -lvnp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -l -v -p %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -lv -p %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -l --proxy-type http %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -vnl --exec %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -vnl -e %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --lua-exec %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --sh-exec %' ESCAPE '\')))
title: PUA - Netcat Suspicious Execution

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects suspicious encoded character syntax often used for defense evasion
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%[char]0x%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%(WCHAR)0x%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Potential PowerShell Obfuscation Via WCHAR/CHAR

author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects usage of curl to upload files to known file sharing domains, which may indicate data exfiltration.
falsepositives: Legitimate file uploads to these services by administrators or developers
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\curl.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='curl.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%0x0.st%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%bashupload.com%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%chunk.io%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%file.io%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%filebin.net%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%pastebin%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%send.firefox.com%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%temp.sh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%transfer.sh%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ufile.io%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%uploadfiles.io%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%wetransfer.com%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%x0.at%' ESCAPE '\') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '% --form%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --upload-file%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --data%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -X POST%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --request POST %' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine REGEXP '\s-[FTd]\s' OR CommandLine REGEXP '\s-sT\s'))))
title: Curl File Upload To File Sharing Websites

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects usage of the "FromBase64String" function in the commandline which is used to decode a base64 encoded string
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND CommandLine LIKE '%::FromBase64String(%' ESCAPE '\')
title: Base64 Encoded PowerShell Command Detected

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects suspicious mshta process execution patterns
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='MSHTA.EXE') AND ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\ProgramData\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%C:\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\'))) OR ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='MSHTA.EXE') AND (NOT COALESCE(((NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%.htm%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.hta%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%mshta' ESCAPE '\')), 0)))))
title: Suspicious Mshta.EXE Execution Patterns

author: Bhabesh Raj, Sittikorn S, Aaron Greetham (@beardofbinary) - NCC Group
description: Detects execution of RClone utility for exfiltration as used by various ransomwares strains like REvil, Conti, FiveHands, etc
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%--config %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%--no-check-certificate %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% copy %' ESCAPE '\') OR ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\rclone.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Description='Rsync for cloud storage') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%pass%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%user%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%copy%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%sync%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%config%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%lsd%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%remote%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ls%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%mega%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%pcloud%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ftp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%ignore-existing%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%auto-confirm%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%transfers%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%multi-thread-streams%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%no-check-certificate %' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: PUA - Rclone Execution

author: @ScoubiMtl
description: Detects the modification of Outlook security setting to allow unprompted execution of macros.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\Outlook\\Security\\Level' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue LIKE '%0x00000001%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Outlook Macro Execution Without Warning Setting Enabled

author: frack113
description: Detect change of the user account associated with the FAX service to avoid the escalation problem.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE 'HKLM\\System\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\Fax\\ObjectName' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((NewValue LIKE '%NetworkService%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Change User Account Associated with the FAX Service

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Patrick Bareiss, Anton Kutepov, oscd.community, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

'%\\bcdedit.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\bitsadmin.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\certreq.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\certutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmstp.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\conhost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\consent.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\csrss.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\dashost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\defrag.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\dfrgui.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\dism.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\dllhost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\dllhst3g.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\dwm.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\eventvwr.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\fsquirt.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\finger.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\logonui.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\LsaIso.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\lsass.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\lsm.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\msiexec.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\ntoskrnl.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell\_ise.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' NewProcessName LIKE '%\\smartscreen.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\smss.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\spoolsv.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\svchost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\taskhost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\taskhostw.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\Taskmgr.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\userinit.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\werfault.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\werfaultsecure.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wininit.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wsl.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wsmprovhost.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE(((NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\$WINDOWS.~BT\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\$WinREAgent\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\SoftwareDistribution\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\SystemTemp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\uus\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE NewProcessName LIKE '%C:\\Program Files\\WindowsApps\\Microsoft.PowerShellPreview%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Microsoft\\WindowsApps\\Microsoft.PowerShellPreview%' ESCAPE author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects blocked load events that did not meet the authenticode signing level requirements or violated the code integrity policy.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Microsoft-Windows-CodeIntegrity/Operational' AND EventID=3077
title: CodeIntegrity - Blocked Image/Driver Load For Policy Violation

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the registration of a new ODBC driver where the driver is located in a potentially suspicious location
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\ODBC\\ODBCINST.INI\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\Driver' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\Setup' ESCAPE '\') AND (NewValue LIKE '%:\\PerfLogs\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%:\\ProgramData\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%:\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%:\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Registration\\CRMLog%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\com\\dmp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\FxsTmp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\Microsoft\\Crypto\\RSA\\MachineKeys\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\spool\\drivers\\color\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\spool\\PRINTERS\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\spool\\SERVERS\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\Tasks\_Migrated\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%:\\Windows\\System32\\Tasks\\Microsoft\\Windows\\SyncCenter\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\com\\dmp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\FxsTmp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\Tasks\\Microsoft\\Windows\\PLA\\System\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\Tasks\\Microsoft\\Windows\\SyncCenter\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Tasks\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Tracing\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%\\AppData\\Roaming\\%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Potentially Suspicious ODBC Driver Registered

author: frack113
description: Disables HTTP logging on a Windows IIS web server as seen by Threat Group 3390 (Bronze Union)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\appcmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='appcmd.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%set%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%config%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%section:httplogging%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%dontLog:true%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Disable Windows IIS HTTP Logging

author: Timur Zinniatullin, oscd.community
description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via VAR++ LAUNCHER
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ScriptBlockText REGEXP '(?i)&&set.*(\{\d\}){2,}\\"\s+?-f.*&&.*cmd.*/c')
title: Invoke-Obfuscation VAR++ LAUNCHER OBFUSCATION - PowerShell

author: Nikita Nazarov, oscd.community
description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via use MSHTA in Scripts
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '%set%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%&&%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%mshta%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%vbscript:createobject%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%.run%' ESCAPE '\' AND ScriptBlockText LIKE '%(window.close)%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Invoke-Obfuscation Via Use MSHTA - PowerShell

author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects cast exceptions in Windows Server Update Services (WSUS) application logs that highly indicate exploitation attempts of CVE-2025-59287, a deserialization vulnerability in WSUS.
falsepositives: Legitimate WSUS operations that may trigger similar error messages
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Application' AND (Provider_Name='Windows Server Update Services' AND EventID=7053 AND (Data LIKE '%System.InvalidCastException%' ESCAPE '\' AND Data LIKE '%System.Windows.Data.ObjectDataProvider%' ESCAPE '\' AND Data LIKE '%Unable to cast object of type%' ESCAPE '\' AND Data LIKE '%System.Windows.Media.Brush%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Exploitation Activity of CVE-2025-59287 - WSUS Deserialization

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the installation of a DNS plugin DLL via ServerLevelPluginDll parameter in registry, which can be used to execute code in context of the DNS server (restart required)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\services\\DNS\\Parameters\\ServerLevelPluginDll' ESCAPE '\')
title: New DNS ServerLevelPluginDll Installed

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects a set of suspicious network related commands often used in recon stages
falsepositives: False positives depend on scripts and administrative tools used in the monitored environment
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%nslookup%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\_ldap.\_tcp.dc.\_msdcs.%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Network Reconnaissance Activity

author: frack113, Florian Roth
description: Detects the execution of a renamed version of the "Mavinject" process. Which can be abused to perform process injection using the "/INJECTRUNNING" flag
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((OriginalFileName='mavinject32.exe' OR OriginalFileName='mavinject64.exe') AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\mavinject32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\mavinject64.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Renamed Mavinject.EXE Execution

author: E.M. Anhaus (originally from Atomic Blue Detections, Endgame), oscd.community
description: Detect commandline usage of Microsoft Connection Manager Profile Installer (cmstp.exe) to install specially formatted local .INF files
falsepositives: Legitimate use of cmstp.exe utility by legitimate user
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmstp.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='CMSTP.EXE') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%/s%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-s%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/au%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-au%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/ni%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-ni%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Bypass UAC via CMSTP

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects suspicious PowerShell download patterns that are often used in malicious scripts, stagers or downloaders (make sure that your backend applies the strings case-insensitive)
falsepositives: Software installers that pull packages from remote systems and execute them
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%IEX ((New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadString%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%IEX (New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadString%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%IEX((New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadString%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%IEX(New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadString%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -command (New-Object System.Net.WebClient).DownloadFile(%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -c (New-Object System.Net.WebClient).DownloadFile(%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Suspicious PowerShell Download and Execute Pattern

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the exploitation of a security bypass and elevation of privilege vulnerability with Authentication Negotiation by using weak RC4-HMAC negotiation
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='System' AND (EventID=42 AND (Provider_Name='Kerberos-Key-Distribution-Center' OR Provider_Name='Microsoft-Windows-Kerberos-Key-Distribution-Center') AND Level=2)
title: Potential KDC RC4-HMAC Downgrade Exploit - CVE-2022-37966

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects change the the "AutodialDLL" key which could be used as a persistence method to load custom DLL via the "ws2_32" library
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\Services\\WinSock2\\Parameters\\AutodialDLL%' ESCAPE '\')
title: Potential Persistence Via AutodialDLL

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the 3CXDesktopApp updater downloading a known compromised version of the 3CXDesktopApp software
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\3CXDesktopApp\\app\\update.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%--update%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%http%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/electron/update/win32/18.12%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Potential Compromised 3CXDesktopApp Update Activity

author: Matt Anderson, Dray Agha, Anna Pham (Huntress)
description:
Detects execution of the Kernel Driver Utility (KDU) tool.
KDU can be used to bypass driver signature enforcement and load unsigned or malicious drivers into the Windows kernel.
Potentially allowing for privilege escalation, persistence, or evasion of security controls.
falsepositives: Legitimate driver development, testing, or administrative troubleshooting (e.g., enabling/disabling hardware)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\kdu.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\hamakaze.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR OriginalFileName='hamakaze.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-map %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-prv %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-dse %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-ps %' ESCAPE '\')))
title: PUA - Kernel Driver Utility (KDU) Execution

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects a "dllhost" process spawning with no commandline arguments which is very rare to happen and could indicate process injection activity or malware mimicking similar system processes.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\dllhost.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine='dllhost.exe' OR CommandLine='dllhost')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine IS NULL), 0))))
title: Dllhost.EXE Execution Anomaly

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects changes to the Netsh registry key to add a new DLL value that is located on a suspicious location. This change might be an indication of a potential persistence attempt by adding a malicious Netsh helper
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\NetSh%' ESCAPE '\' AND ((NewValue LIKE '%:\\Perflogs\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%:\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '%\\Temporary Internet%' ESCAPE '\') OR ((NewValue LIKE '%:\\Users\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue LIKE '%\\Favorites\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR (NewValue LIKE '%:\\Users\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue LIKE '%\\Favourites\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR (NewValue LIKE '%:\\Users\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue LIKE '%\\Contacts\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR (NewValue LIKE '%:\\Users\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue LIKE '%\\Pictures\\%' ESCAPE '\')))))
title: New Netsh Helper DLL Registered From A Suspicious Location

author: Teymur Kheirkhabarov, Daniil Yugoslavskiy, oscd.community
description: Files with well-known filenames (sensitive files with credential data) copying
falsepositives: Copying sensitive files for legitimate use (eg. backup) or forensic investigation by legitimate incident responder or forensic investigator.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\esentutl.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName LIKE '\\esentutl.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%vss%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -m %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /m %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –m %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —m %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―m %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -y %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /y %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –y %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —y %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―y %' ESCAPE '\')) OR (CommandLine LIKE '%\\config\\RegBack\\sam%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\config\\RegBack\\security%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\config\\RegBack\\system%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\config\\sam%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\config\\security%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\config\\system %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\repair\\sam%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\repair\\security%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\repair\\system%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\windows\\ntds\\ntds.dit%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Copying Sensitive Files with Credential Data

author: frack113
description:
Detects processes setting a new DLL in DllName in under HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\W32Time\TimeProvider.
Adversaries may abuse time providers to execute DLLs when the system boots.
The Windows Time service (W32Time) enables time synchronization across and within domains.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND ((TargetObject LIKE '%\\Services\\W32Time\\TimeProviders%' ESCAPE '\' AND TargetObject LIKE '%\\DllName' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((NewValue LIKE '\%SystemRoot\%\\System32\\vmictimeprovider.dll' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE '\%systemroot\%\\system32\\w32time.dll' ESCAPE '\' OR NewValue LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\SYSTEM32\\w32time.DLL' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: New TimeProviders Registered With Uncommon DLL Name

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), NCSC (Idea)
description: Detects specific process behavior observed with Devil Bait samples
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%>>\%APPDATA\%\\Microsoft\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%.xml' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.txt' ESCAPE '\')) AND (CommandLine REGEXP 'ipconfig\s+/all' OR (CommandLine LIKE '%dir%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%systeminfo%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%tasklist%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Potential Devil Bait Malware Reconnaissance

author: Maxim Pavlunin
description: Detects a suspicious execution of a Microsoft HTML Help (HH.exe)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((OriginalFileName='HH.exe' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\hh.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%.application%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Content.Outlook\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Downloads\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Suspicious HH.EXE Execution

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the use of CoercedPotato, a tool for privilege escalation
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\CoercedPotato.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --exploitId %' ESCAPE '\' OR (Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=A75D7669DB6B2E107A44C4057FF7F7D6%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=F91624350E2C678C5DCBE5E1F24E22C9%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=14C81850A079A87E83D50CA41C709A15%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: HackTool - CoercedPotato Execution

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects a suspicious process command line that uses whoami as first parameter (as e.g. used by EfsPotato)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND CommandLine LIKE '%.exe whoami%' ESCAPE '\')
title: WhoAmI as Parameter

author: @kostastsale
description: Detects the execution of SOAPHound, a .NET tool for collecting Active Directory data, using specific command-line arguments that may indicate an attempt to extract sensitive AD information.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine LIKE '% --buildcache %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --bhdump %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --certdump %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --dnsdump %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -c %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --cachefilename %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -o %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --outputdirectory%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: HackTool - SOAPHound Execution

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the use of KrbRelay, a Kerberos relaying tool
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\KrbRelay.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='KrbRelay.exe') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% -spn %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -clsid %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -rbcd %' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%shadowcred%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%clsid%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%spn%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%spn %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%session %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%clsid %' ESCAPE '\')))
title: HackTool - KrbRelay Execution

author: Sittikorn S, Tim Shelton
description: Detects service creation from KrbRelayUp tool used for privilege escalation in Windows domain environments where LDAP signing is not enforced (the default settings)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='System' AND (EventID=7045 AND ServiceName='KrbSCM')
title: KrbRelayUp Service Installation

author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects Kapeka backdoor process execution pattern, where the dropper launch the backdoor binary by calling rundll32 and passing the backdoor's first export ordinal (#1) with a "-d" argument.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='RUNDLL32.EXE') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%:\\ProgramData%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local%' ESCAPE '\') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%.wll%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%#1%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -d%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%.wll%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%#1' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Kapeka Backdoor Execution Via RunDLL32.EXE

author: Arda Buyukkaya (EclecticIQ)
description: Detects the execution of the "curl.exe" command, referencing "SOCKS" and ".onion" domains, which could be indicative of Kalambur backdoor activity.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\curl.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%socks5h://%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%socks5://%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%socks4a://%' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%.onion%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Kalambur Backdoor Curl TOR SOCKS Proxy Execution

author: frack113
description: Detects the creation of a symbolic link between "cmd.exe" and the accessibility on-screen keyboard binary (osk.exe) using "mklink". This technique provides an elevated command prompt to the user from the login screen without the need to log in.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='Cmd.Exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%mklink%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\osk.exe%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\cmd.exe%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Potential Privilege Escalation Using Symlink Between Osk and Cmd

author: Timur Zinniatullin, oscd.community
description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via VAR++ LAUNCHER
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%&&set%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%cmd%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/c%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-f%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%{0}%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%{1}%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%{2}%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%{3}%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%{4}%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%{5}%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Invoke-Obfuscation VAR++ LAUNCHER OBFUSCATION

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects potential psexec command that initiate execution on a remote systems via common commandline flags used by the utility
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%accepteula%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -u %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -p %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% \\\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%\\\\localhost%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\\\127.%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Potential PsExec Remote Execution

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the execution of certutil with the "encode" flag to encode a file to base64 where the extensions of the file is suspicious
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\certutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='CertUtil.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-encode%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/encode%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–encode%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—encode%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―encode%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%.acl%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.bat%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.doc%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.gif%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.jpeg%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.jpg%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.mp3%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.pdf%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.png%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.ppt%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.tmp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.xls%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.xml%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Suspicious File Encoded To Base64 Via Certutil.EXE

author: Bhabesh Raj
description: Detects triggering of AMSI by Windows Defender.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Microsoft-Windows-Windows Defender/Operational' AND (EventID=1116 AND SourceName='AMSI')
title: Windows Defender AMSI Trigger Detected

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects suspicious ways to use the "DumpMinitool.exe" binary
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\DumpMinitool.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\DumpMinitool.x86.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\DumpMinitool.arm64.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='DumpMinitool.exe' OR OriginalFileName='DumpMinitool.x86.exe' OR OriginalFileName='DumpMinitool.arm64.exe')) AND ((NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\Microsoft Visual Studio\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\Extensions\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0)) OR CommandLine LIKE '%.txt%' ESCAPE '\' OR ((CommandLine LIKE '% Full%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% Mini%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% WithHeap%' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%--dumpType%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))))
title: Suspicious DumpMinitool Execution

author: @gott_cyber
description: Detects the execution of EDRSilencer, a tool that leverages Windows Filtering Platform (WFP) to block Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) agents from reporting security events to the server based on PE metadata information.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\EDRSilencer.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='EDRSilencer.exe' OR Description LIKE '%EDRSilencer%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: HackTool - EDRSilencer Execution

author: Nikita Nazarov, oscd.community
description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via use Clip.exe in Scripts
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4103 AND Payload REGEXP '(?i)echo.*clip.*&&.*(Clipboard|i`?n`?v`?o`?k`?e`?)')
title: Invoke-Obfuscation Via Use Clip - PowerShell Module

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects execution of VMware Xfer utility (VMwareXferlogs.exe) from the non-default directory which may be an attempt to sideload arbitrary DLL
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\VMwareXferlogs.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\VMware\\%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: DLL Sideloading by VMware Xfer Utility

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects the attempt to create an ActiveScriptEventConsumer via WMIC.EXE.
An ActiveScriptEventConsumer is a built-in Windows Management Instrumentation (WMI) class that
automatically executes a predefined script (in VBScript or JScript) whenever a specific system event occurs.
Adversaries often abuse ActiveScriptEventConsumer to maintain persistence on a compromised host by executing a malicious script whenever a specific event occurs.
falsepositives: Legitimate software creating script event consumers
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((OriginalFileName='wmic.exe' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\WMIC.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%ActiveScriptEventConsumer%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% CREATE %' ESCAPE '\')))
title: NewActiveScriptEventConsumer Creation Attempt via Wmic.EXE

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), frack113
description: Detects the execution of a renamed "gpg.exe". Often used by ransomware and loaders to decrypt/encrypt data.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (OriginalFileName='gpg.exe' AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\gpg.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\gpg2.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Renamed Gpg.EXE Execution

author: frack113, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Attempting to disable scheduled scanning and other parts of Windows Defender ATP or set default actions to allow.
falsepositives: Legitimate PowerShell scripts that disable Windows Defender for troubleshooting purposes. Must be investigated.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Windows PowerShell' AND (EventID=600 AND (Data LIKE '%Set-MpPreference%' ESCAPE '\' AND ((Data LIKE '%-dbaf $true%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%-dbaf 1%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%-dbm $true%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%-dbm 1%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%-dips $true%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%-dips 1%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%-DisableArchiveScanning $true%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%-DisableArchiveScanning 1%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%-DisableBehaviorMonitoring $true%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%-DisableBehaviorMonitoring 1%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%-DisableBlockAtFirstSeen $true%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%-DisableBlockAtFirstSeen 1%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%-DisableCatchupFullScan $true%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%-DisableCatchupFullScan 1%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%-DisableCatchupQuickScan $true%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%-DisableCatchupQuickScan 1%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%-DisableIntrusionPreventionSystem $true%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%-DisableIntrusionPreventionSystem 1%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%-DisableIOAVProtection $true%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%-DisableIOAVProtection 1%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%-DisableRealtimeMonitoring $true%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%-DisableRealtimeMonitoring 1%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%-DisableRemovableDriveScanning $true%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE LIKE '%-DisableScriptScanning 1%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%-MAPSReporting $false%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%-MAPSReporting 0%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%-drdsc $true%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%-dsmndf $true%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%-dsmndf 1%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%-dsnf $true%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%-dsnf 1%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%-dss $true%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%-dss 1%' ESCAPE '\') OR (Data LIKE '%HighThreatDefaultAction Allow%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%htdefac Allow%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE '%LowThreatDefaultAction Allow%' ESCAPE '\' OR Data LIKE LIKE '%stdefac Allow%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Tamper Windows Defender - PSClassic

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), Andreas Braathen (mnemonic.io)
description: Detects exploitation attempt of CVE-2023-38331 (WinRAR before v6.23), where an attacker can leverage WinRAR to execute arbitrary commands and binaries.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\WinRAR.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\Rar$%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine REGEXP '\.[a-zA-Z0-9]{1,4} \.' AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='Cmd.Exe' OR OriginalFileName='cscript.exe' OR OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll' OR OriginalFileName='wscript.exe'))))
title: CVE-2023-38331 Exploitation Attempt - Suspicious WinRAR Child Process

author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects installation of Kali Linux distribution through Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL).
Attackers may use Kali Linux WSL to leverage its penetration testing tools and capabilities for malicious purposes.
falsepositives: Legitimate installation or usage of Kali Linux WSL by administrators or security teams
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wsl.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='wsl') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% --install %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -i %' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%kali%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Installation of WSL Kali-Linux

author: Teymur Kheirkhabarov, Ecco, Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the use of getsystem Meterpreter/Cobalt Strike command by detecting a specific service installation
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4697 AND (((ServiceFileName LIKE '%/c%' ESCAPE '\' AND ServiceFileName LIKE '%echo%' ESCAPE '\' AND ServiceFileName LIKE '%\\pipe\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND (ServiceFileName LIKE '%cmd%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceFileName LIKE '%\%COMSPEC\%%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (ServiceFileName LIKE '%rundll32%' ESCAPE '\' AND ServiceFileName LIKE '%.dll,a%' ESCAPE '\' AND ServiceFileName LIKE '%/p:%' ESCAPE '\') OR ServiceFileName LIKE '\\\\127.0.0.1\\ADMIN$\\%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Meterpreter or Cobalt Strike Getsystem Service Installation - Security

author: Markus Neis
description: Detects potential LethalHTA technique where the "mshta.exe" is spawned by an "svchost.exe" process
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\svchost.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Potential LethalHTA Technique Execution

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects suspicious PowerShell invocation command parameters
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4104 AND ((ScriptBlockText LIKE '% -enc %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '% -EncodedCommand %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '% -ec %' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '% -w hidden %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '% -window hidden %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '% -windowstyle hidden %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '% -w 1 %' ESCAPE '\') AND (ScriptBlockText LIKE '% -noni %' ESCAPE '\' OR ScriptBlockText LIKE '% -noninteractive %' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Suspicious PowerShell Invocations - Generic

author: Cedric MAURUGEON, Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the use of the Microsoft Windows Resource Leak Diagnostic tool "rdrleakdiag.exe" to dump process memory
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\rdrleakdiag.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='RdrLeakDiag.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-memdmp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/memdmp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%–memdmp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%—memdmp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%―memdmp%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%fullmemdmp%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -o %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /o %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –o %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —o %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―o %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -p %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /p %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –p %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —p %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―p %' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Process Memory Dump via RdrLeakDiag.EXE

author: FPT.EagleEye, wagga, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects usage of the "TcpClient" class. Which can be abused to establish remote connections and reverse-shells. As seen used by the Nishang "Invoke-PowerShellTcpOneLine" reverse shell and other.
falsepositives: In rare administrative cases, this function might be used to check network connectivity
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll') OR (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\')) AND (CommandLine LIKE '% Net.Sockets.TCPClient%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.GetStream(%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.Write(%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Potential Powershell ReverseShell Connection

author: Markus Neis, Swisscom
description: Detects the execution of a renamed "jusched.exe" as seen used by the cobalt group
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((Description='Java Update Scheduler' OR Description='Java(TM) Update Scheduler') AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\jusched.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Renamed Jusched.EXE Execution

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects the use of Ngrok, a utility used for port forwarding and tunneling, often used by threat actors to make local protected services publicly available.
Involved domains are bin.equinox.io for download and *.ngrok.io for connections.
falsepositives: Another tool that uses the command line switches of Ngrok
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine LIKE '% tcp 139%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% tcp 445%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% tcp 3389%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% tcp 5985%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% tcp 5986%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% start %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%--all%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%--config%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.yml%' ESCAPE '\') OR (NewProcessName LIKE '%ngrok.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% tcp %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% http %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% authtoken %' ESCAPE '\')) OR (CommandLine LIKE '%.exe authtoken %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.exe start --all%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: PUA - Ngrok Execution

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: detects the usage of path traversal in conhost.exe indicating possible command/argument confusion/hijacking
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentCommandLine LIKE '%conhost%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/../../%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Conhost.exe CommandLine Path Traversal

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects tampering with attachment manager settings policies attachments (See reference for more information)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Policies\\Attachments\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND ((TargetObject LIKE '%\\HideZoneInfoOnProperties' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue='DWORD (0x00000001)') OR (TargetObject LIKE '%\\SaveZoneInformation' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue='DWORD (0x00000002)') OR (TargetObject LIKE '%\\ScanWithAntiVirus' ESCAPE '\' AND NewValue='DWORD (0x00000001)'))))
title: Potential Attachment Manager Settings Attachments Tamper

author: iwillkeepwatch
description: Detects the addition of a SSP to the registry. Upon a reboot or API call, SSP DLLs gain access to encrypted and plaintext passwords stored in Windows.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND (OperationType='New registry value created' OR OperationType='Existing registry value modified')) AND ((TargetObject LIKE '%\\Control\\Lsa\\Security Packages' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\Control\\Lsa\\OSConfig\\Security Packages' ESCAPE '\') AND (NOT COALESCE(((NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\system32\\msiexec.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\syswow64\\MsiExec.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR NewProcessName IS NULL), 0))))
title: Security Support Provider (SSP) Added to LSA Configuration

author: j4son
description: Detect access to files and shares with names and extensions used by BlueSky ransomware which could indicate a current or previous encryption attempt.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (((EventID=4663 OR EventID=4656) AND (ObjectName LIKE '%.bluesky' ESCAPE '\' OR ObjectName LIKE '%DECRYPT FILES BLUESKY%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (EventID=5145 AND (RelativeTargetName LIKE '%.bluesky' ESCAPE '\' OR RelativeTargetName LIKE '%DECRYPT FILES BLUESKY%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: BlueSky Ransomware Artefacts

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the execution of Sysinternals ADExplorer with the "-snapshot" flag in order to save a local copy of the active directory database to a suspicious directory. This can be used by attackers to extract data for Bloodhound, usernames for password spraying or use the meta data for social engineering. The snapshot doesn't contain password hashes but there have been cases, where administrators put passwords in the comment field.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\ADExp.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\ADExplorer.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\ADExplorer64.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\ADExplorer64a.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR OriginalFileName='AdExp' OR Description='Active Directory Editor' OR Product='Sysinternals ADExplorer') AND CommandLine LIKE '%snapshot%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\Downloads\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Suspicious Active Directory Database Snapshot Via ADExplorer

author: X__Junior (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects execution of the "wusa.exe" (Windows Update Standalone Installer) utility by a parent process that is located in a suspicious location.
Attackers could instantiate an instance of "wusa.exe" in order to bypass User Account Control (UAC). They can duplicate the access token from "wusa.exe" to gain elevated privileges.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wusa.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%:\\Perflogs\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%:\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\Appdata\\Local\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\Temporary Internet%' ESCAPE '\') OR ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%:\\Users\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\Favorites\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR (ParentProcessName LIKE '%:\\Users\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\Favourites\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR (ParentProcessName LIKE '%:\\Users\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\Contacts\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR (ParentProcessName LIKE '%:\\Users\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\Pictures\\%' ESCAPE '\'))) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%.msu%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Wusa.EXE Executed By Parent Process Located In Suspicious Location

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects suspicious patterns in program names or folders that are often found in malicious samples or hacktools
falsepositives: Legitimate tools that accidentally match on the searched patterns
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\CVE-202%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\CVE202%' ESCAPE '\') OR (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\poc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\artifact.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\artifact64.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\artifact\_protected.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\artifact32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\artifact32big.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%obfuscated.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%obfusc.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\meterpreter' ESCAPE '\')) OR (CommandLine LIKE '%inject.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Invoke-CVE%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%pupy.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%payload.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%beacon.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%PowerView.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%bypass.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%obfuscated.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%obfusc.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%obfus.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%obfs.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%evil.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%MiniDogz.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\_enc.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\shell.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\rshell.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%revshell.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\av.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\av\_test.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%adrecon.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%mimikatz.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\PowerUp\_%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%powerup.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Temp\\a.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Temp\\p.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Temp\\1.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Hound.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%encode.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%powercat.ps1%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Suspicious Program Names

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the usage of attrib with the "+s" option to set scripts or executables located in suspicious locations as system files to hide them from users and make them unable to be deleted with simple rights. The rule limits the search to specific extensions and directories to avoid FPs
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\attrib.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='ATTRIB.EXE') AND CommandLine LIKE '% +s%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '% \%%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\Local\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\ProgramData\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Downloads\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%.bat%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dll%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.hta%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.ps1%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.vbe%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.vbs%' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine LIKE '%\\Windows\\TEMP\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%.exe%' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Set Suspicious Files as System Files Using Attrib.EXE

author: Tanner Filip, Austin Worline, Chad Hudson, Matt Anderson
description: Detects exploitation attempt of Cleo's CVE-2024-50623 by looking for a "cmd.exe" process spawning from the Celo software suite with suspicious Powershell commandline.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\javaw.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (ParentCommandLine LIKE '%Harmony%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '%lexicom%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '%VersaLex%' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentCommandLine LIKE '%VLTrader%' ESCAPE '\') AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%powershell%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -enc %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -EncodedCommand%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.Download%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: CVE-2024-50623 Exploitation Attempt - Cleo

author: pH-T (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the execution of the "net use" command to mount a WebDAV server and then immediately execute some content in it. As seen being used in malicious LNK files
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='Cmd.EXE') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% net use http%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%& start /b %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\DavWWWRoot\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%.exe %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.dll %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.bat %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.vbs %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.ps1 %' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Suspicious File Execution From Internet Hosted WebDav Share

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the use of DefenderCheck, a tool to evaluate the signatures used in Microsoft Defender. It can be used to figure out the strings / byte chains used in Microsoft Defender to detect a tool and thus used for AV evasion.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\DefenderCheck.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Description='DefenderCheck'))
title: PUA - DefenderCheck Execution

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Teymur Kheirkhabarov, Daniil Yugoslavskiy, oscd.community
description: Detects well-known credential dumping tools execution via service execution events
falsepositives: Legitimate Administrator using credential dumping tool for password recovery
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4697 AND (ServiceFileName LIKE '%cachedump%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceFileName LIKE '%dumpsvc%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceFileName LIKE '%fgexec%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceFileName LIKE '%gsecdump%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceFileName LIKE '%mimidrv%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceFileName LIKE '%pwdump%' ESCAPE '\' OR ServiceFileName LIKE '%servpw%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Credential Dumping Tools Service Execution - Security

author: frack113
description: Adversaries may disable security tools to avoid possible detection of their tools and activities by uninstalling Crowdstrike Falcon
falsepositives: Administrator might leverage the same command line for debugging or other purposes. However this action must be always investigated
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\WindowsSensor.exe%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% /uninstall%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% /quiet%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Uninstall Crowdstrike Falcon Sensor

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects when an attacker modifies the registry value of the "hhctrl" to point to a custom binary
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\CLSID\\{52A2AAAE-085D-4187-97EA-8C30DB990436}\\InprocServer32\\(Default)%' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((NewValue LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\hhctrl.ocx' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Persistence Via Hhctrl.ocx

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects unusual parent or children of the ImagingDevices.exe (Windows Contacts) process as seen being used with Bumblebee activity
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\WmiPrvSE.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\svchost.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\dllhost.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\ImagingDevices.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\ImagingDevices.exe' ESCAPE '\'))
title: ImagingDevices Unusual Parent/Child Processes

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: This the exploitation of a NTFS vulnerability as reported without many details via Twitter
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='System' AND (Provider_Name='Ntfs' AND EventID=55 AND Origin='File System Driver' AND (Description LIKE '%contains a corrupted file record%' ESCAPE '\' AND Description LIKE '%The name of the file is "\\"%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: NTFS Vulnerability Exploitation

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the suspicious execution of a utility to convert Windows 3.x .grp files or for persistence purposes by malicious software or actors
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%grpconv.exe -o%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%grpconv -o%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: Suspicious GrpConv Execution

author: Liran Ravich
description:
Detects instances of svchost.exe running with an unusual or uncommon command line parameter by excluding known legitimate or common patterns.
This could point at a file masquerading as svchost, a process injection, or hollowing of a legitimate svchost instance.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\svchost.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT COALESCE((CommandLine REGEXP '-k\s\w{1,64}(?:\s?(?:-p|-s))?' OR CommandLine='' OR CommandLine IS NULL), 0)) AND (NOT COALESCE(((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\MsMpEng.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%svchost.exe%' ESCAPE '\') OR (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\MRT.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine='svchost.exe')), 0))))
title: Uncommon Svchost Command Line Parameter

author: frack113
description: load malicious registered COM objects
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='RUNDLL32.EXE') AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%-sta %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-localserver %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%{%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%}%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Rundll32 Registered COM Objects

author: @2xxeformyshirt (Security Risk Advisors) - rule; Teymur Kheirkhabarov (idea)
description: Detects MMC20.Application Lateral Movement; specifically looks for the spawning of the parent MMC.exe with a command line of "-Embedding" as a child of svchost.exe
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\svchost.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\mmc.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%-Embedding%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: MMC20 Lateral Movement

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects suspicious process patterns found in logs when CrackMapExec is used
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((CommandLine LIKE '%tasklist /fi %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%Imagename eq lsass.exe%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe /c %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe /r %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe /k %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd /c %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd /r %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd /k %' ESCAPE '\') AND (User LIKE '%AUTHORI%' ESCAPE '\' OR User LIKE '%AUTORI%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (CommandLine LIKE '%do rundll32.exe C:\\windows\\System32\\comsvcs.dll, MiniDump%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% full%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%\%\%B%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%tasklist /v /fo csv%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%findstr /i "lsass"%' ESCAPE '\')))
title: HackTool - CrackMapExec Process Patterns

author: John Lambert (rule)
description: Detects base64 encoded strings used in hidden malicious PowerShell command lines
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='PowerShell.EXE' OR OriginalFileName='pwsh.dll')) AND CommandLine LIKE '% hidden %' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%AGkAdABzAGEAZABtAGkAbgAgAC8AdAByAGEAbgBzAGYAZQByA%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%aXRzYWRtaW4gL3RyYW5zZmVy%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%IAaQB0AHMAYQBkAG0AaQBuACAALwB0AHIAYQBuAHMAZgBlAHIA%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%JpdHNhZG1pbiAvdHJhbnNmZX%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%YgBpAHQAcwBhAGQAbQBpAG4AIAAvAHQAcgBhAG4AcwBmAGUAcg%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Yml0c2FkbWluIC90cmFuc2Zlc%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects scheduled task creation using "schtasks" that contain potentially suspicious or uncommon commands
falsepositives: Software installers that run from temporary folders and also install scheduled tasks are expected to generate some false positives
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\schtasks.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%/Create %' ESCAPE '\') AND (((CommandLine LIKE '%/sc minute %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/ru system %' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%cmd /c%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd /k%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd /r%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe /c %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe /k %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe /r %' ESCAPE '\')) OR (CommandLine LIKE '% -decode %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -enc %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -w hidden %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% bypass %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% IEX%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.DownloadData%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.DownloadFile%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.DownloadString%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/c start /min %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%FromBase64String%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%mshta http%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%mshta.exe http%' ESCAPE '\') OR ((CommandLine LIKE '%:\\ProgramData\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Tmp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%:\\Windows\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\AppData\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%AppData\%%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%Temp\%%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\%tmp\%%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%cscript%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%curl%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%wscript%' ESCAPE '\')))))
title: Suspicious Command Patterns In Scheduled Task Creation

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects potential process patterns related to Cobalt Strike beacon activity
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe /C whoami' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\') OR ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\runonce.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\dllhost.exe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe /c echo%' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%> \\\\.\\pipe%' ESCAPE '\')) OR ((ParentCommandLine LIKE '%cmd.exe /C echo%' ESCAPE '\' AND ParentCommandLine LIKE '% > \\\\.\\pipe%' ESCAPE '\') AND CommandLine LIKE '%conhost.exe 0xffffffff -ForceV1' ESCAPE '\') OR (ParentCommandLine LIKE '%/C whoami' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%conhost.exe 0xffffffff -ForceV1' ESCAPE '\')))
title: Potential CobaltStrike Process Patterns

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects command line parameters used by Bloodhound and Sharphound hack tools
falsepositives: Other programs that use these command line option and accepts an 'All' parameter
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((Product LIKE '%SharpHound%' ESCAPE '\' OR Description LIKE '%SharpHound%' ESCAPE '\' OR (Company LIKE '%SpecterOps%' ESCAPE '\' OR Company LIKE '%evil corp%' ESCAPE '\') OR (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\Bloodhound.exe%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\SharpHound.exe%' ESCAPE '\')) OR (CommandLine LIKE '% -CollectionMethod All %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --CollectionMethods Session %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --Loop --Loopduration %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% --PortScanTimeout %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.exe -c All -d %' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Invoke-Bloodhound%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%Get-BloodHoundData%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% -JsonFolder %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% -ZipFileName %' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '% DCOnly %' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '% --NoSaveCache %' ESCAPE '\')))
title: HackTool - Bloodhound/Sharphound Execution

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects tampering with autologger trace sessions which is a technique used by attackers to disable logging.
The AutoLogger event tracing session records events up that occur early in the operating system boot process.
Applications and device drivers can use the AutoLogger session to capture traces before the user logs in, and also used by security solutions as telemetry source.
Adversaries may disable these sessions to evade detection and prevent security monitoring of early boot activities and system events.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND ((EventID=4657 AND OperationType='Existing registry value modified') AND ((TargetObject LIKE '%\\Control\\WMI\\Autologger\\%' ESCAPE '\' AND ((TargetObject LIKE '%\\EventLog-%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\Defender%' ESCAPE '\') AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\Enabled' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\Start' ESCAPE '\') AND NewValue='DWORD (0x00000000)')) AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Windows\\system32\\wevtutil.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR ((NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\Windows Defender\\Platform\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Program Files\\Windows Defender\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE 'C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Windows Defender\\%' ESCAPE '\') AND NewProcessName LIKE '%\\MsMpEng.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\DefenderApiLogger\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR TargetObject LIKE '%\\DefenderAuditLogger\\%' ESCAPE '\'))), 0))))
title: Potential AutoLogger Sessions Tampering

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects the use of 3proxy, a tiny free proxy server
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\3proxy.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR Description='3proxy - tiny proxy server' OR CommandLine LIKE '%.exe -i127.0.0.1 -p%' ESCAPE '\'))
title: PUA - 3Proxy Execution

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description: Execution of plink to perform data exfiltration and tunneling
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\plink.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%:127.0.0.1:3389%' ESCAPE '\') OR ((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\plink.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%:3389%' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -P 443%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% -P 22%' ESCAPE '\'))))
title: Potential RDP Tunneling Via Plink

author: Timur Zinniatullin, oscd.community
description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via VAR++ LAUNCHER
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Channel='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' OR Channel='PowerShellCore/Operational') AND (EventID=4103 AND Payload REGEXP '(?i)&&set.*(\{\d\}){2,}\\"\s+?-f.*&&.*cmd.*/c')
title: Invoke-Obfuscation VAR++ LAUNCHER OBFUSCATION - PowerShell Module

author: Nextron Systems, @Kostastsale
description: Detects sdiagnhost.exe calling a suspicious child process (e.g. used in exploits for Follina / CVE-2022-30190)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND ((ParentProcessName LIKE '%\\sdiagnhost.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\pwsh.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\mshta.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\wscript.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\taskkill.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\regsvr32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\rundll32.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\calc.exe' ESCAPE '\')) AND (NOT COALESCE(((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\cmd.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND CommandLine LIKE '%bits%' ESCAPE '\') OR (NewProcessName LIKE '%\\powershell.exe' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%-noprofile -' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%-noprofile' ESCAPE '\'))), 0))))
title: Sdiagnhost Calling Suspicious Child Process

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
description:
Detects the execution of a renamed AutoIt2.exe or AutoIt3.exe.
AutoIt is a scripting language and automation tool for Windows systems. While primarily used for legitimate automation tasks, it can be misused in cyber attacks.
Attackers can leverage AutoIt to create and distribute malware, including keyloggers, spyware, and botnets. A renamed AutoIt executable is particularly suspicious.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (((CommandLine LIKE '% /AutoIt3ExecuteScript%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /ErrorStdOut%' ESCAPE '\') OR (Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=FDC554B3A8683918D731685855683DDF%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=CD30A61B60B3D60CECDB034C8C83C290%' ESCAPE '\' OR Hashes LIKE '%IMPHASH=F8A00C72F2D667D2EDBB234D0C0AE000%' ESCAPE '\') OR (OriginalFileName='AutoIt3.exe' OR OriginalFileName='AutoIt2.exe' OR OriginalFileName='AutoIt.exe')) AND (NOT COALESCE((NewProcessName LIKE '%\\AutoIt.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\AutoIt2.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\AutoIt3\_x64.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR NewProcessName LIKE '%\\AutoIt3.exe' ESCAPE '\'), 0))))
title: Renamed AutoIt Execution

description: Detects the execution of "forfiles" from a non-default location, in order to potentially spawn a custom "cmd.exe" from the current working directory.

description: Detects a command that accesses the VolumeShadowCopy in order to extract sensitive files such as the Security or SAM registry hives or the AD database (ntds.dit)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE Channel='Security' AND (EventID=4688 AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\\\?\\GLOBALROOT\\Device\\HarddiskVolumeShadowCopy%' ESCAPE '\' AND (CommandLine LIKE '%\\NTDS.dit%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\SYSTEM%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%\\SECURITY%' ESCAPE '\')))

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), Elastic (idea)

author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)
description: Detects a suspicious copy operation that tries to copy a known LOLBIN from system (System32, SysWOW64, WinSxS) directories to another on disk in order to bypass detections based on locations.

author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
